to H.I.M. The Emperor of Japan visited the Chi Ta (Chi Ta)

Subject. Male Chinese bayoneted by Japanese soldier while resisting arrest
in Yangtzepoo district.
Made by. D. S. I. Smith Forwarded by. /s/ M. Eust.

Sir,
At 4.50 p.m. 17/3/39 a male Chinese named Kau S Foh
(高專福), age 34 years, native of Shanghai, M/fitter,
residing in a country house at the rear of the Ying Ziang
Kong Hospital (引翔港) Hochien Road came to this
station and reported that he had been stabbed by a Japanese
soldier. He had several stab wounds in his face and was
bleeding profusely. He collapsed in the Charge Room.
Almost immediately afterwards 2nd Class Private
I. Fujii attached to the Ito Detachment, stationed Wong
Shing Road P.O. entered the Charge Room and reported
that he had stabbed the injured man with his bayonet when
he resisted arrest.
2nd Class Private Fujii stated that on the night of
the 15/3/39 he arrested the injured man for being concerned
with about five others who made good their escape, in
stealing telephone cable at the rear of the Ying Ziang
Kong Village, and later took him to the Ito
Detachment Headquarters, Wong Shing Road where he was
locked up in an improvised cell. Early on the morning of
the 16/3/39 the injured man made good his escape. Private
Fujii went on to add that at about 4 p.m. 17/3/39 he
visited the injured man's home and upon entering the
house the injured man attacked him with a meat chopper and
ran out of the house. Private Fujii states that he drew
his bayonet and chased the injured man and stabbed him
several times whilst he was running.
The Japanese Military Police were communicated with
and Private Fujii was handed over to Capp. M. Nakano.
The injured man was conveyed in the S. F. R. Ambulance

主题。一名中国男子在杨树浦区拒捕时被日本士兵刺伤。
由副督察史密斯（Smith）撰写 由 M. Eust. 转发。

先生，
1939年3月17日下午4时50分，一名名叫高專福（Kau S Foh）的中国男子，34岁，上海籍，职业钳工，居住在霍肯路（Hochien Road）引翔港医院后方的一所乡间住宅内，来到本巡捕房报案，称他被一名日本士兵刺伤。他面部有多处刺伤，大量出血。他在候审室昏倒。
几乎与此同时，隶属于伊藤支队、驻守宏星路（Wong Shing Road）邮局的二等兵藤井（I. Fujii）进入候审室，报告称他在逮捕该伤者时因对方拒捕而用刺刀将其刺伤。
二等兵藤井称，1939年3月15日晚，他逮捕了该伤者，因其与另外约五人（已逃脱）涉嫌在引翔港村后方盗窃电话电缆有关，随后将其带至宏星路伊藤支队总部，关押在一间临时牢房内。1939年3月16日清晨，该伤者成功逃脱。藤井二等兵接着补充说，1939年3月17日下午4时许，他前往伤者家中，刚进屋，伤者便用切肉刀袭击他并跑出屋外。藤井二等兵称，他拔出刺刀追赶伤者，并在其逃跑过程中多次刺中他。
随后联系了日本宪兵队，并将藤井二等兵移交给中野（M. Nakano）上尉。
伤者由 S. F. R. 救护车送往

    At 11 p.m. 15/3/39 I was returning home from the

accosted by two Japanese soldiers who flashed their
torches at me. I became afraid and ran away, they gave
chase and arrested me and later took me to the Japanese
Military Headquarters on Ya Yue San Road. Then they
accused me of having stolen some electric wire and beat me
with a bamboo pole. After that my hands were tied behind
my back with cord and they put me in a dog kennel. They
also sprinkled cold water over my body. When I discovered
that no one was guarding me I untied the cord and freed
myself then made good my escape. I did not return home
immediately as I was afraid that the soldiers would come
to re-arrest me, as I had given them my address when I was
arrested and they had verified it. However at 10 a.m.
17/3/39 I went home and at about 4 p.m. same date a
Japanese soldier came to my home. I picked up a vegetable
knife and pointed it at the soldier to frighten him and
ran out the house. The Japanese soldier chased me and
with his bayonet stabbed me about the face. I kept on
running and picked up a number of stones which I intended
throwing at the soldier.

Sir,

Further enquiries regarding the above mentioned arrests, made by the undersigned and J. D. C. 132 ascertained the following particulars. All the arrested persons were taken to J. N. L. P.'s Headquarters Hannen Road on the evening of 22/2/39 where they were interrogated as suspected guerillas. As no proof was forthcoming that this was the case, all the persons concerned were released the following day- 23/2/39. Information regarding the disposal of the case was obtained from Commander Hiyashi J. N. L. P. Headquarters. The undersigned would like to mention that at no time during the past eight months have the Japanese Authorities come to the station and sought co-operation when they wished to make arrests and do not even trouble to inform the Police when such arrests are made. Once the arrested persons are in the custody of the Japanese Authorities, it is difficult if not impossible to interview them and obtain particulars. The undersigned and J. D. C. 132 proceeded to the Kung Dah Cotton Mill 2767 Pingliang Road, where the Headquarters of the J. N. L. P. for Yangtzepoo district is situated. The officer in charge, Commander Yoneda was interviewed with a view to making arrangements with the J. N. L. P. when they intended entering premises and placing persons under arrest in this district, to enable the Police to ascertain the names and addresses of the arrested persons. REPORT

Subject.........Japanese soldier causing trouble at 146 Glen Rd.

Made by.......D.S. Stevens,...........Forwarded by....................................................

Sir,

At 11.30.p.m.15-11-38,a male Chinese named Zung Yue Tsa
32 years native of Yangchow,residing at 146 Glen Rd,came to the
station accompanied by his friend named Lee Oong Kuh (      )
24 years native of Yangchow,residing at the same address,and
reported that at about 11.15.p.m.same date,they together with
three other inmates of the above mentioned premises were playing
Mah-Jongg,and drinking wine together,when a Japanese soldier armed
with a rifle and apparently under the influence of drink,demanded
entrance to the house.On being admitted,he told the occupants that
he was going to take them all to the Japanese Military Headquar-
ters for the offence of gambling,with which statement he extracted
cartridges from his pocket and inserted them into the magazine
of his rifle.At this juncture the two above mentioned male Chin-
ese ran out of the room and made their way to this station,where
the incident was reported,leaving the soldier on the premises.
The Japanese Military Police were communicated with and attended
this station.The Military Police were accompanied to 146 Glen Rd.
by D.S. Stevens and J.D.C.132,but on arrival at this address it
was ascertained that the soldier who was the cause of the trouble
had left the premises.

先生：

就附上的马塞尔·达雷事务所1938年10月24日来信一事，该公司维涅先生（Mr. Vigne）于1938年10月29日来到杨树浦巡捕房，与签署人就警方针对占据杨树浦地区房屋且拒绝支付租金的租户应采取的行动进行了面谈。马塞尔·达雷事务所是这些房屋的代理方。向显然不了解警方在此类案件中处境的维涅先生解释称，针对违规租户唯一可采取的行动是：如果有证据表明所述租户在有关方面就向认可房东或代表所述房屋房东的代理人支付租金一事向其提出交涉后，仍强行闯入房屋并继续居住 therein，则可因其非法侵入罪传唤其出庭，但警方无权对其实施即决驱逐。鉴于目前的局势，该公司在北区收取租金的情况相当复杂。马塞尔·达雷事务所此前曾通过第一特区地方法院（1st S.S.D. Court）对违规租户采取法律行动。在一起判决不利于租户的案件中，法院随后致函马塞尔·达雷事务所，告知他们由于涉案房屋所在地区的现有状况，法院无法执行判决。目前，在杨树浦地区，由马塞尔·达雷事务所代理的35栋房屋的 occupant 在多次交涉后仍拒绝支付租金。签署人建议由本巡捕房的一名中国侦探陪同该事务所代表——

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Y'poo Station,
REPORT
Date Oct. 17th, 19 38.
Subject Residents of Lane 1825 Y'poo Road suspected of obtaining water
by illegal means.
Made by D. S. I. Kennedy Forwarded by (Signature)

Sir,
At 10 a.m. 17/10/38 Nawaja Singh Indian Watchman employed
by Cabinet Marcel Darré 1 The Bund for premises at Lane 1825
Y'poo Road, came to the station and reported that the tenants
in this alleyway were obtaining water in an unlawful manner.
The undersigned and C.D.S.60 proceeded to the alleyway in
question and made the following enquiries. There are thirteen
houses at present occupied in this alleyway and out of this
number, three admit paying rent to the landlords. No water
is laid on, and the tenants on being questioned as to the source
of their supply, stated that a hydrant was opened every
morning at Sungpan Road market by the P.H.D. and they received
their supplies from this source. The tenants strongly denied
tampering with the S.W.W. main at the entrance to the alleyway
which act would ensure a steady flow to their homes. The
Indian watchman finishes duty at 6 p.m. daily and though residing
in one of the houses in the alleyway, admitted that he had not
actually seen any of the tenants turning on the water from the
main. He persisted however in stating that he heard the sound
of running water emanating from several houses in the alleyway
at night time, although he did not enter the premises to
investigate. Several occupied houses were visited by the
undersigned and C.D.S.60 and it looked very like as if the
watchman's suspicions were correct, small lengths of rubber hose
being laid from the taps in the kitchen into receptacles, in
each of the houses visited. The houses belong to Chinese
landlords and Cabinet Marcel Darré do the rent collecting,
letting of houses etc. for them. The Shanghai Water Works were
informed and they are sending along a representative in order to
ascertain whether the tenants in this alleyway are obtaining
their water in an illegal manner.
(Signature)
D. S. I.

D.D.O. "D"
S.I.

事由：怀疑杨树浦路1825弄居民以非法手段获取用水。
由警探长肯尼迪（D. S. I. Kennedy）呈报，经（签名）转呈

先生：

1938年10月17日上午10时，受雇于外滩马塞尔·达雷事务所（Cabinet Marcel Darré 1 The Bund）负责杨树浦路1825弄物业的印度守夜人纳瓦贾·辛格（Nawaja Singh）来到巡捕房，报告称该弄堂内的租户以非法方式获取用水。签署人与第60号中国侦探副督察（C.D.S.60）前往该弄堂进行了如下调查。目前该弄堂内有十三户人家居住，其中三户承认向房东支付租金。该处未接通自来水，当询问租户水源时，他们称公共卫生局（P.H.D.）每天早上在松潘路市场打开一个消防栓，他们从此处取水。租户强烈否认篡改位于弄堂入口处的上海自来水公司（S.W.W.）总水管的行为，该行为可确保水流稳定流入其家中。该印度守夜人每天下午6点下班，虽然居住在弄堂内的一所房屋中，但他承认并未亲眼看到任何租户从总水管放水。然而，他坚持称夜间听到弄堂内多所房屋传出流水声，尽管他并未进入屋内调查。签署人与第60号中国侦探副督察走访了几处有人居住的房屋，情况看起来很像守夜人的怀疑是正确的，因为在走访的每所房屋中，都发现有小段橡胶软管从厨房的水龙头连接到容器中。这些房屋属于中国房东，马塞尔·达雷事务所（Cabinet Marcel Darré）为他们代收租金、出租房屋等。已通知上海自来水公司，他们将派代表前来查明该弄堂内的租户是否以非法方式获取用水。
（签名）
警探长（D. S. I.）

Sir,
Re attached letter from Cabinet Marcel Darré dated 2/9/38
I beg to report that Mr. Ito manager of the Dah Kong Cotton
Mill 195 Tengyush Road has again been interviewed regarding the
arrangements made between him and Cabinet Marcel Darré in
respect of houses situated in Lane 2181 Y'poo Road taken over
by the management of the Dah Kong Mill as living quarters for
their Chinese staff. Mr. Ito stated that the landlords of the
houses in question were handing over to the management of the
Dah Kong Mill through Cabinet Marcel Darré the sum of $1,500.00
for repairs to be effected to damaged houses in this alleyway.
The question of rental has already been settled, every family
taking over quarters in this alleyway paying a monthly rental of
$8.50 to Cabinet Marcel Darré, who are responsible for the water
to be laid on to the various houses. The expenses incurred
through fixing up electric lights is to be borne jointly by the
two parties concerned. It seems peculiar that Cabinet Marcel
Darré should write this letter on 2/9/38 pointing out that
Chinese tenants were prevented by force from taking up residence
in this alleyway when at the same time they (Cabinet Marcel
Darré) were negotiating with the management of the Dah Kong
Cotton Mill for the latter firm to take over all the houses in
this alleyway as living quarters for their Chinese staff.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
D. S. I.

Sir,

At 10 a.m. 19/8/38 Mr. W. Goulbourn representing Cabinet
Marcel Darre No. 1 The Bund, came to the Station and reported
that houses at Lane 2181 Yangtszepoo Road was being taken over
by the Dah Kong Mill as living quarters for their Chinese staff.
Enquiries ascertained that Cabinet Marcel Darre are the agents
for the Chinese owners of the property at Lane 2181 Yangtszepoo
Road, and previous negotiations carried out between the manage-
ment of the Dah Kong Mill and said Cabinet Marcel Darre for the
taking over of the property by the former, had broken down.
Goulbourn was under the impression that the property was being
taken over by the Japanese without any recompense being made to
the owners. The undersigned and J.D.S. 83 Osano accordingly
proceeded to the Dah Kong Mill, 195 Tengyueh Road and interviewed
a Mr. Nakano in the absence of Mr. Ito, the manager who is ill
at present. Mr. Nakano stated that Mr. Ito was taking the
matter up with Cabinet Marcel Darre with a view to paying the
necessary rental after the property was taken over. The
contents of the 53 houses concerned including furniture and beds
are still intact since the former tenants evacuated and are to
be used by the various tenants taking over the houses.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

撰写人：副督察长肯尼迪 转呈人：[签名] [签名]

先生，

1938年8月19日上午10时，代表外滩1号马塞尔·达雷（Marcel Darre）事务所的W. Goulbourn先生来到巡捕房，报告称杨树浦路2181弄的房屋正被大康纱厂接管，作为中国职员的宿舍。经查询得知，马塞尔·达雷事务所是杨树浦路2181弄房产中国业主的代理人，此前大康纱厂管理层与该马塞尔·达雷事务所之间关于由前者接管房产的谈判已破裂。Goulbourn认为，房产正被日方接管，而业主未获得任何补偿。因此，卑职与日本侦探社第83号警员小野（Osano）前往腾越路195号的大康纱厂，在经理伊藤（Ito）先生因病缺席的情况下，会见了中野（Nakano）先生。中野先生表示，伊藤先生正在与马塞尔·达雷事务所交涉此事，以便在接管房产后支付必要的租金。涉及的53栋房屋内的物品，包括家具和床铺，自原租户撤离以来仍完好无损，并将由接管各房屋的新租户使用。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
副督察长

REPORT
Date July 18th, 1938.
Subject Recovery of Electric Motors removed from Hwa Foo Hat Factory, 310
Hochien Road during local hostilities.
Made by D.S. Stevens Forwarded by O. Wiener, SI

Sir,
At 10.15 a.m. 18/7/38 Tsang Tuh Kang (曾德康), 30, engineer
of the Hwa Foo Hat Factory, 310 Hochien Road, came to the station
and requested assistance to recover 7 electric motors belonging to
his firm that he stated were on the premises of the Sien Dah Machi-
ne Co. 345 Hochien Road. These motors, he stated, had, together
with some fifty more, been removed from the Hwa Foo Hat Co.
during the early part of local hostilities, no report, however,
having been made at the Y'poo Station. D.S.I. Kennedy, C.D.C.
307 and the undersigned accompanied Tsang to the Sien Dah Co.
where Mr. Allenspach, (Swiss) owner, was interviewed. Mr.
Allenspach readily admitted having the motors on his premises,
stating that the manager of the Hwa Foo Co. one Tsung Kyi Ching
(張基卿), was a business acquaintance and friend of his and that
when, during the hostilities, he, Mr. Allenspach, had seen the
motors outside the factory, dismantled and apparently ready to
be taken away (these premises were extensively looted during the
hostilities) he had decided to take them into his own factory for
safe-keeping. On production of receipts bearing the motor No's.
by the engineer Tsang Tuh Kang, the seven machines were removed
to Y'poo Station where they will be detained at the wish of Tsang,
his premises still being occasionally occupied by Japanese
Military, and as there is a possibility of further recoveries
being made.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 19.VII.38）

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D.S. Stevens
D.S. 222

先生，
1938年7月18日上午10时15分，霍钦路310号华福帽厂的工程师、30岁的曾德康（Tsang Tuh Kang）来到巡捕房，请求协助追回属于其公司的7台电动机，他称这些电动机位于霍钦路345号先达机器公司（Sien Dah Machine Co.）的 premises 内。他称，这些电动机连同另外约五十台，在当地战事初期从华福帽厂被移走，但当时并未向杨树浦巡捕房报案。副督察长肯尼迪、刑事侦缉队第307号警员及卑职陪同曾某前往先达公司，会见了业主阿伦斯巴赫（Allenspach）先生（瑞士人）。阿伦斯巴赫先生 readily 承认电动机在其处所内，并称华福公司经理张基卿（Tsung Kyi Ching）是他的商业熟人和朋友；在战事期间，阿伦斯巴赫先生看到工厂外有拆卸好的电动机，显然准备被运走（这些处所在战事期间遭到严重抢劫），于是他决定将它们搬进自己的工厂妥善保管。在工程师曾德康出示印有电动机编号的收据后，这七台机器被移至杨树浦巡捕房，应曾某要求予以扣留，因为其处所仍偶尔被日本军队占用，且有可能追回更多物品。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别处 1938年7月19日）

此致，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
D.S. 史蒂文斯

先生，

1月8日下午4时50分。巡捕第74号（J.P.S. 74）在巡逻时遇到钱凤甫（Chien Fong Fu），32岁，扬州人，职业为铜匠，受雇于上海电力公司（S.P. Co.）江边电站，持有紧急通行证第363号，在白周路（Baichow Road）上携带大量衣物和炊具。

经巡捕第74号询问，钱凤甫称他离开上海电力公司工作场所是为了从家中取回一些衣物。他未持有日本当局签发的通行证。因此，巡捕第74号将财物放回钱凤甫指认的杨树浦路48号柏爱坊（Pah Ai Faung）的房屋内，并将他带至巡捕房。

上海电力公司的雅各布斯（Jacobs）先生获悉此事。他表示，钱某无权离开公司处所，并请求警方在可能时将其护送至控制室，由其当局处理。

由于时间已晚，钱凤甫被拘留在本巡捕房，并于1月9日上午10时05分移交。

1月9日上午10时40分。巡捕第5号（J.P.S. 5）将谢三（Tse San），60岁，赖世翁（Lai Si Ong），32岁，上述公司的员工带至巡捕房，他们分别持有紧急通行证第448号和969号。巡捕在杨树浦路靠近腾越路处遇到他们，他们携带声称是从杨树浦路宋家台145号（Sung Ka Tai）取回的自有衣物。

在巡捕房讯问后，这些人连同F.S. Salisbury 在路上遇到的另外五人，一并被移交给上海电力公司控制室。

经查实，乔丹（Jordan） superintendent 正在采取强力措施，以防止该公司员工

Subject (in full) Male Chinese suffering from Tyroid Fever in Yangtzepoo
District.
Made by D.S.I.McCahey Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,
At 10.05 a.m. December 23rd. a telephone message from the
No.3 of the Shanghai Cotton Mills, Kwanghsin Road, reported in
Japanese that there was a male Chinese at that mill sick and
suspected of suffering from typhoid fever.
It was stated that the sick man was an employee of the
mill. Enquiries, however, elicited the fact that this man had
been brought to Shanghai by the Japanese Military as a pressed
labourer on or about December 7th. and that he had since been
working at the above mentioned mill.
The above facts were transmitted to the S.F. Brigade Ambu-
lance Service who turned out an ambulance and removed Wong Ah
Ching, 28, Lotien, N.P.A. to the Lester Chinese Hospital where he
was certified suffering from typhoid fever and detained.

Yours obediently,
[Signature]
Det. Sub. Inspt.

Sino-Japanese hostilities in Yangtsepoo district for 24 hours
ending 6 a.m. 28/10/37.
D. S. I. Crighton. Andrews . Officer i/c.

Sir,
I beg to report that throughout the morning and afternoon,
of the 27/10/37, nothing of an outstanding nature took place
in this district.
At 6 -30 p.m. 27/10/37, a party of the J.N.L.P. accompanied
by an officer came to station, and requested assistance to
approach the Shanghai Power Co, and Gas Co. authorities, regarding
the extinguishing of all unnecessary lights on their premises,
as information had been received that Chinese batteries located
in Pootung would carry out a bombardment of this district, and
adjoining areas. The assistance was rendered, and both companies
complied with the request as far as they possilily could.
At approximately 7 p.m. Japanese men-o-war lying in the
river opened up a bombardment of the Pootung area, and continued
until 8-30 p.m., when they were forced to stop owing to the
approach of Chinese planes, which flew over this district, but
dropped no bombs.
At 1-30 a.m. 28/10/37, Chinese planes again flew over this
district, however no bombs were dropped in this area.

I am, Sir,
Yours Obediently
John Crighton
D. S. I.

截至1937年10月28日上午6时的24小时内，杨树浦区的中日敌对行动。
副督察克莱顿（Crighton）。安德鲁斯（Andrews）。主管警官。

先生，
谨此报告，在1937年10月27日的整个上午和下午，本区未发生任何显著事件。
1937年10月27日下午6时30分，一队日本海军陆战队（J.N.L.P.）在一名军官的陪同下来到巡捕房，请求协助接洽上海电力公司和煤气公司当局，要求熄灭其场所内所有不必要的灯光，因为收到情报称位于浦东的中国炮兵阵地将对本区及邻近地区进行轰炸。我方提供了协助，两家公司均在可能范围内遵从了这一要求。
大约晚上7时，停泊在江面上的日本军舰开始对浦东地区进行轰炸，并持续至晚上8时30分，由于中国飞机飞临本区上空，他们被迫停止轰炸，但这些飞机并未投掷炸弹。
1937年10月28日凌晨1时30分，中国飞机再次飞越本区上空，然而本区域并未落有炸弹。

此致，
敬礼

Yangtsepoo 24 10 37
October 23rd. 37
Conditions in Yangtsepoo district as a consequence of the
Sino-Japanese Incident for the 24 hours ending 6 a.m. 23/10/37
D.S. Duke

Sir,

I beg to report that conditions in the district were quiet
during the day until 6.10 p.m. when a Chinese plane appeared
and drew anti-air craft fire. This raid only occupied a few
minutes and only one bomb was distinctly noticed at this
station, from the sound seeming to be towards the East; at
the same time, however, a fire was seen to spring up South-
West of the station. Japanese planes took to the air immed-
iately afterwards.

At about 10.25 p.m. a second air-raid occurred, resulting
in two Chinese incendiary bombs being dropped on Chinese
property on Ward Rd. -- the Ward Printing and Dyeing Co.,
1514 Ward Rd. At the request of the J.N.L.P., the Shanghai
Fire Brigade attended, escorted by police from this station.
The main squad worked on the fire until 2.30 a.m. when it
was brought under control and a small party of five Chinese
left behind
firemen/to continue, arrangements having been made with the
J.N.L.P. that this should be done. While attending this fire
two more air-raids took place, at 11.50 p.m. and 12.13 a.m.,
but no bombs were seen to drop and it is not known whether
any actually did on these later occasions. Damage to the
Ward Printing Factory consists mostly of totally destroyed
shacks, formerly used as staff quarters, and super-structure
the main buildings are unscathed.

It was learnt yesterday that the Cathay Laundry, 1178
Pingliang Road, was struck by a bomb on 21/10/37 and this is
the subject of a separate report.

I am, Sir,
yours obediently

D. D. O. "D"

1937年10月23日。
截至1937年10月23日上午6时的24小时内，因中日事变导致的杨树浦区状况
杜克（Duke）副督察

先生，

谨此报告，本区白天状况平静，直至下午6时10分，一架中国飞机出现并引来高射炮火。此次空袭仅持续数分钟，从声音判断，本站明显注意到仅有一枚炸弹落在东方；与此同时，可见车站西南方向起火。日本飞机随即升空。

大约晚上10时25分，发生第二次空袭，导致两枚中国燃烧弹落在华德路（Ward Rd.）的中国产业上——即华德路1514号的华德印染公司（Ward Printing and Dyeing Co.）。应日本海军陆战队（J.N.L.P.）的请求，上海救火会（Shanghai Fire Brigade）出动，由本站警察护送。主力分队一直灭火至凌晨2时30分，火势得到控制，并留下一支由五名中国消防员组成的小队继续工作，已与日本海军陆战队就此作出安排。在处理此次火灾期间，又发生了两次空袭，分别在晚上11时50分和凌晨12时13分，但未观察到有炸弹落下，也不清楚在这些后续情况下是否实际有炸弹落下。华德印刷厂的损失主要包括完全被毁的棚屋（原用作职员宿舍），主体建筑的上层结构完好无损。

昨日获悉，平凉路1178号的 Cathay Laundry（音译：国泰洗衣店）于1937年10月21日遭炸弹击中，此事将另行报告。

此致，
敬礼

Japanese men-o-war lying in the river off this district, carried

    At 7 p.m. 20/10/37, Chinese planes flew over this district,
and although bombs were heard to drop, the exact location is
at present unknown. Shortly after this raid was finished, ex-
tensive rifle and machine gun fire was heard coming from the
direction of Ward road, also at the same time Japanese men-o-
war put up a terrific bombardment of Pootung.
    At 8-30 p.m. another air raid was carried out over this
district by Chinese planes, and again bombs were heard to drop
north east of the station, apparently in the vicinity of the
Japanese airdrome.
    At 10-06 p.m. Chinese planes again visited this district,
and on this occasion dropped bombs in the vicinity of the
Yeu Foong (        ) Cotton Mill quarters, a Japanese property

Misc. 218
REGISTER
8039 A
Yangtsepoo D. 19 10 37
October 15th. 37
Bombs and shells fall in Yangtsepoo district, 14/10/37.
D.S. Duke
Sir,
I beg to report that between 5.30 p.m. and 5.50 p.m.
four shells, evidently fired from Pootung fell on or near
Poyang Road in the vicinity of the Japanese Commercial
School. No damage or no injuries were known to have
been caused.
At 6 p.m. anti-aircraft opened fire and an unknown
number of Chinese planes appeared overhead. At the same
time Japanese warships commenced to shell Pootung so that
the noise was such that an accurate estimate of bombs
dropped locally is difficult. It is considered, however,
that seven bombs were heard to fall.
Subsequent enquiries ascertained that two of these fell
fifteen yards apart, about three yards south of Yang-
tsepoo Road between the Gas Company and Pingting Road.
No injuries and no damage.
A third struck the Shanghai Power Company coke dump
causing one Chinese to receive a very slight head injury
from a piece of flying coke. The injured man was attended
by the U.S.M.C., and declined an offer of attendance by
the S.F.B. Ambulance. With regard to this mishap the
management of the Company is very anxious that it should
receive as little publicity as possible and, when
informing the Special Branch this request was mentioned.
A large fire was seen to the west of this station
just beyond the district boundary and this may account
for the other four bombs.
A piece of shrapnel weighing about one pound fell at
6 p.m. in the station compound .

1937年10月15日。
1937年10月14日，炸弹和炮弹落在杨树浦区。
杜克（Duke）副督察
先生，
谨此报告，下午5时30分至5时50分之间，四发炮弹（显然从浦东发射）落在日本商业学校附近的波阳路（Poyang Road）上或附近。据悉未造成损坏或伤亡。
下午6时，高射炮开火，不知数量的中国飞机出现在头顶。同时，日本军舰开始炮击浦东，以致噪音巨大，难以准确估计本地落下的炸弹数量。然而，据信听到了七枚炸弹落下声。
随后的查询查明，其中两枚相距十五码，落在杨树浦路以南约三码处，介于煤气公司与平定路（Pingting Road）之间。无伤亡，无损坏。
第三枚击中了上海电力公司的焦炭堆，导致一名中国人被飞溅的焦炭碎片轻微击中头部受伤。伤者由美国海军陆战队（U.S.M.C.）救治，并拒绝了上海救火会救护车的救治提议。关于此事故，公司管理层非常希望尽可能少地公开此事，在向特别支部通报时提到了这一请求。
在本站以西、刚过区界的地方看到一场大火，这或许能解释另外四枚炸弹的去向。
一块重约一磅的弹片在下午6时落在巡捕房大院内。

Yangtzepoo 8039 #
14th October 37.
Sino-Japanese hostilities in Yangtzepoo district for 24 hours
ending 6 a.m. 15/10/37.
D.S.I.Crighton. [签名] Officer i/c.

Sir,
I beg to report, that from early morning of the 14/10/37,
Japanese men-o-war, and air force, have kept up a continues
bombardment of the Pootung area, directly opposite to this and
Yulin road districts.
At 2-30 p.m. 14/10/37, D.S.I.Crighton whilst on patrol
along with J.D.S.42, observed that the Belgian Consular Notice
previously posted outside the Kung Chin Iron Works, 66 Lingching
road, had been removed, and in its place, a large white paper
poster, bearing Japanese characters, which when translated
read as follows:- For military purposes. In addition to this
notice, another, bearing the names of the Japanese engineers
previously employed at this factory was posted in the same position.
At 5.30 p.m. Chinese shells started to fall in the
district, evidently coming from Pootung. Four were seen to f
fall on Poyang Rd. in the vicinity of the Japanese Commercial
School. It is possible that damage to the Poyang Rd. side of
the Orient Paint Co. premises was caused by these shells . At
6 p.m. , whilst the Pootung batteries were still firing,
Chinese planes appeared overhead and dropped a number of bombs
in the district. During the course of the night Chinese air-
craft again flew over the district at the following times:
10 p.m., 11 p.m., 2 a.m., 2.45 a.m., 3.28 a.m., 5.08 a.m., &
5.15 a.m. A tour of the district resulted in the following
hits being noticed, some of which were mentioned in Misc.218.
Shells
North-East corner Kueyang/Yangtzepoo Roads
Yangtzepoo Rd., 80 yds. West of Glen on South side
Japanese Crematorium (Mitsui Bussan Kaisha Lumber yard)
4, Tungliang Rd. -- two shells

杨树浦 8039 #
1937年10月14日。
截至1937年10月15日上午6时的24小时内，杨树浦地区的中日敌对行动。
副督察克里顿 (D.S.I. Crighton)。[签名] 主管警官。

先生：
谨此报告，自1937年10月14日清晨起，日本军舰及空军持续轰炸与本辖区及榆林路地区正对的浦东区域。
1937年10月14日下午2时30分，副督察克里顿与第42号日本侦探警员 (J.D.S.42) 一同巡逻时观察到，此前张贴在临清路66号公勤铁厂 (Kung Chin Iron Works) 外的比利时领事馆告示已被移除，取而代之的是一张印有日文的大白纸海报，翻译后内容如下：“供军事用途”。除该告示外，同一位置还张贴了另一张告示，列有此前在该工厂受雇的日本工程师姓名。
下午5时30分，炮弹开始落入本区，显然来自浦东。目击四枚炮弹落在日本商业学校附近的波阳路。东方油漆公司 (Orient Paint Co.) 物业靠波阳路一侧的损坏可能由这些炮弹造成。下午6时，当浦东炮台仍在射击时，中国飞机出现在上空，并在本区投下数枚炸弹。夜间，中国飞机再次在以下时间飞越本区：晚上10时、11时，凌晨2时、2时45分、3时28分、5时08分及5时15分。对本区的巡视发现以下中弹情况，部分已在杂项报告218号 (Misc.218) 中提及。
炮弹
贵阳路/杨树浦路东北角
杨树浦路，格伦路 (Glen) 以西80码处南侧

191/37.
Yangtzepoo 8039 A
17th October 37
Sino-Japanese hostilities in the Yangtzepoo district
for 24 hours ending 6 a.m. 17/10/37.
D.S.I.Crighton. Alexander Officer i/c.

Sir,
I beg to report that throughout the morning and after-
noon of 16/10/37, nothing of an outstanding nature took
place within this area.
At approximately 6 p.m. 16/10/37, a very large calibre
field gun was heard firing from somewhere at the rear of
this station, the objective apparently being Chapei. This
firing continued, at intervals of about every twenty minutes
up until about 10 p.m., altogether about 15 shells being
fired.
At 12 M.n. 16/10/37, the heavy drone of planes could
be heard approaching this district, and a few seconds later
a bomb was heard to explode somewhere south east of the
station. This resulted in Japanese anti-aircraft batteries
opening fire, the direction of fire at this time being
directly over the station, the plane apparently flying in
a north east direction, in an endeavour to locate the above
stated heavy field gun battery. A few seconds later a
terrific explosion was heard and felt, coming from the
rear of this station, but whether or not a hit was scored
on this battery cannot be confirmed, although the bombing
had the effect of silencing it for the remainder of the
night. This raid lasted for about 15 minutes.

I am, Sir,
Yours Obediently.
John Crighton
D. S. I.

D. D. O. "D"

1937年10月17日
截至1937年10月17日上午6时的24小时内，杨树浦地区的中日敌对行动。
副督察克里顿. 亚历山大 (Alexander) 主管警官。

先生：
谨此报告，1937年10月16日整个上午和下午，本区域内未发生任何显著事件。
1937年10月16日下午6时左右，听到一门大口径野战炮从本局后方某处开火，目标显然是闸北。这种射击以大约每二十分钟一次的间隔持续进行，直到晚上10时左右，总共发射了约15发炮弹。
1937年10月16日午夜12时，听到飞机沉重的轰鸣声逼近本区，几秒钟后，听到一枚炸弹在本局东南某处爆炸。这导致日本高射炮台开火，此时的射击方向直接越过本局上空，飞机显然向东北方向飞行，试图定位上述重型野战炮台。几秒钟后，听到并感觉到来自本局后方的一次剧烈爆炸，但无法确认是否击中了该炮台，尽管轰炸的效果使其在当晚余下时间内停止了射击。这次空袭持续了约15分钟。

先生，
您忠实的仆人。
约翰·克里顿 (John Crighton)
副督察 (D. S. I.)

Yangtzepoo 14 / 10 / 37
12th October 37.
Sino-Japanese hostilities in the Yangtzepoo district for 24
hours ending 6 a.m. 12/10/37.
D.S.I.Crighton. Officer i/c.

Sir,

I beg to report that throughout the afternoon and evening
11/10/37 Japanese men-o-war lying in the river off this district
carried out a bombardment of the North Railway station area.
This was, towards dusk, replied to by Chinese batteries in the
same area, but apparently without effect, the shells appearing
to drop short. Simultaneously to this artillery duel, bursts
of machine gun fire could be heard in the vicinity of Kiang-
wan. Between 5 and 6 p.m. 11/10/37, Japanese bombing planes
carried out raids in the Pootung area almost directly opposite
Lay road jetty.
? ? Between 4-45 and 5-30 a.m. 12/10/37, Chinese
artillery batteries located on the Pootung side, commenced
a bombardment of this district, and although no hits were
registered in the vicinity of the station, several shells were
heard to pass over, and explode to the north east of same,
possibly in the region of the Japanese airdrome, and Kung Dah
No.1 cotton mill. This was replied to by Japanese men-o-war,
lying in the river off the airport, also at 6 a.m. four scout-
ing planes took off from the airdrome, and commenced flying
very low, (hedge hopping), over the Pootung area directly oppos-
ite this district. On their return to the airdrome some one
hour later, the Japanese men-o-war again commenced a bombard-
ment of that area.

Although it is suspected that damage has been
done to the Japanese airport, no confirmation of this can be
obtained.

I am, Sir,
Yours Obediently,
John Crighton

(批：C 12/10)

副督察克里顿 (D.S.I. Crighton). 主管警官。

先生：

谨此报告，1937年10月11日下午和晚间，停泊在本区外河面上的日本军舰对北站地区进行了轰炸。黄昏时分，同一地区的中国炮台予以还击，但显然无效，炮弹似乎落点偏近。在这场炮战的同时，可以听到江湾附近传来阵阵机枪声。1937年10月11日下午5时至6时之间，日本轰炸机对几乎正对雷路码头的浦东地区进行了空袭。
? ? 1937年10月12日凌晨4时45分至5时30分之间，位于浦东一侧的中国炮兵阵地开始轰炸本区，虽然在本局附近未记录到中弹，但听到数枚炮弹飞过，并在其东北方向爆炸，可能在日本机场和公大第一棉纺厂 (Kung Dah No.1 cotton mill) 区域。停泊在机场外河面上的日本军舰对此进行了还击，此外，上午6时，四架侦察机从机场起飞，开始在正对本区的浦东上空极低空飞行（贴树梢飞行）。约一小时后它们返回机场时，日本军舰再次开始轰炸该区域。

虽然怀疑日本机场受损，但无法获得证实。

先生，
您忠实的仆人，
约翰·克里顿 (John Crighton)

(批：C 12/10)
(批：10. D.O "D")
(批：JR 14/10)

Sino-Japanese hostilities in Yangtzepoo district for
24 hours ending 6 a.m. 7/10/37.
D.S.I.Crighton. （批：Alexander Officer i/c.）

Sir,
    I beg to report that throughout the past 24 hours
the situated in this district has been very quiet.
    At 11 a.m. 6/10/37, a male chinese named Loh Yeu Sai
(        ) age 74, native of Shanghai, residing Sung Kok
Tai, Yangtzepoo road, and handed over to this station on
the evening of the 5/10/37, by the Japanese military, was
escorted to 231 Weihaiwei road, where he was handed over to
his relatives.

2nd.October 37

Sino-Japanese hostilities in Yangtsepoo district for 24
hours ending 6 a.m. 2/10/37.
D.S.I.Crighton (签名) Officer i/c.

Sir,
    I beg to report that throughout the day of 1/10/37, the
situation remained quiet in this area.
    Commencing at 9 p.m. 1/10/37, Chinese bombing planes
visited this district at intervals of every half hour, until
approximately 1 a.m. 2/10/37. During the course of these
raids numerous bombs, both incendiary and high explosive, were
dropped in and around the district, the objective apparently
being Japanese men-o-war lying in the river. As near as can
be ascertained bombs dropped at the following places:- The
site of the new Dong Shing Cotton Mill, Yangtsepoo road oppos
ite the China Soap Co., The Borden's Egg Co, Tengyeuh road, a
lighter belonging to the latter company, lying in the river
fronting the said companies premises, somewhere in the vicinit
of the Kung Dah Cotton Mill G.O.L., and the Japanese airdrome.
    Reference to bombs dropped in and around the Borden's
Egg Co. a separate report is being forwarded re same.
    As near as can be stated at least four planes took
part in these raids, and although heavy barrages of anti-air-
craft was put up on each occasion by the Japanese no planes
were brought down, in this district.

先生：
    谨此报告，在1937年10月1日全天，该地区局势保持平静。
    自1937年10月1日晚上9点开始，中国轰炸机每隔半小时便光顾本区一次，直至约1937年10月2日凌晨1点。在这些空袭过程中，大量燃烧弹和高爆弹被投掷在本区及其周边，目标显然是停泊在江中的日本军舰。据尽可能查明的情况，炸弹投掷在以下地点：新东兴纱厂旧址、杨树浦路中国肥皂公司对面、滕越路博登蛋品公司（Borden's Egg Co.）、属于该公司的一艘驳船（停泊在上述公司 premises 前的河面上）、公大纱厂（G.O.L.）附近的某处，以及日本机场。
    关于投掷在博登蛋品公司及其周边的炸弹，另有一份单独报告呈送。
    据尽可能陈述，至少有四架飞机参与了这些空袭，尽管日军每次均进行了猛烈的防空炮火拦截，但在本区内没有一架飞机被击落。

2nd October 37.
Bombing of the Borden's Egg Co,an American concern,located at
No.2 Tengyeuh road,by Chinese bombing planes.
D.S.170 Duke.
Alexander Tulloch
Sir,
I beg to report that during the course of a Chinese air-
raid,one of a series over this district,which started at 10-(
a.m. 2/10/37,bombs were heard and seen to fall at 12-20 a.m.
in the vicinity between the Shanghai Power Co.and the Gas Co.
A telephone call to the Borden Egg Co.learned that a bomb had
fallen into their office,and that the foreigner in charge had
been injured.
The S.F.B. ambulance was at once called,and a par
of police under Inspt.Andrew proceeded to the scene,where it
was found that Mr.H.H.Cameron,American,employed therein,had
been injured,not seriously,evidently by pieces of flying con-
crete about the legs and body,and a casual Russian labourer
A.Shratva,residing 137 Rue Pere Robert French Concession,had
a cut on the face from the same cause. Both injured persons x
were removed to the Country hospital.
Examination of the premises at the time,and in t
daylight this morning shows that two bombs fell almost simil-
taneously,the first striking company lighter No.599 tied up
at the wharf,piercing its ½" steel plate upper decking,and
continuing through the bottom of the vessel.This bomb caused
a small fire to start on the woodwork and canvas covering on
deck,which was extinguished by the Russian watchman,and casua
labour. The spread of this missile struck,and penetrated the
cabins on lighter No.599 and adjacent lighters,but although
several persons were sleeping on the lighters there were no
casualities. It seemsprobable,however that the injured Russia
who was standing on the open landing stage,and entrance recei
ved his injury from flying objects,either shrapnel or stone.

D.S.170 Duke.
Alexander Tulloch
先生：
    谨此报告，在中国对本区进行的一系列空袭中的一次期间，该系列空袭始于1937年10月2日上午10点（原文此处可能有误，结合上下文应为夜间或凌晨，但原文如此），在上午12点20分（即凌晨0:20），听到并看到炸弹落在上海电力公司与煤气公司之间的区域。致电博登蛋品公司后获悉，一枚炸弹落入其办公室，负责的外国人受伤。
    随即呼叫了工部局消防处（S.F.B.）救护车，由安德鲁巡官（Inspt. Andrew）率领的一队警察前往现场，发现受雇于该公司的美国人H.H.卡梅伦先生（Mr. H.H. Cameron）受伤，伤势不重，显然是被飞溅的混凝土块击中腿部和身体所致；一名居住在法租界罗伯特神父路137号的俄罗斯临时工A. Shratva也因同样原因面部割伤。两名伤者均被送往宏恩医院（Country hospital）。
    当时及今日白昼对现场的检查显示，两枚炸弹几乎同时落下，第一枚击中了系泊在码头的599号公司驳船，穿透了其½英寸厚的钢制上层甲板，并继续穿过船底。这枚炸弹引燃了甲板上的木结构和帆布覆盖物，火势被俄罗斯看守和临时工扑灭。该投射物的碎片击中并穿透了599号驳船及相邻驳船的舱室，但尽管有数人睡在驳船上，并未造成伤亡。然而，似乎那名受伤的俄罗斯人当时正站在敞开的登陆台阶和入口处，他的伤是由飞溅物（无论是弹片还是石块）造成的。

The second bomb struck the roof of the office block,

however, took him nearer to the bomb's point of entry and thi

struck freely by pieces of concrete and flying glass.
Fragments of the bomb found on the floor of the office
are of tempered steel. No fire was caused by this bomb.
NO estimate of the financial damage to property is yet
available but this appears to be comparatively slight,
consisting as it does of a one hole in the roof, broken
windows, smashed office furniture, one hole in the lighter
deck and one in its hull.
At the time of the bombing a Japanese gun-boat was
lying immediately behind the Egg factory premises, firing
at the air raiders, and the objective of the latter may
have been either this gun-boat or the Dah Kang Cotton

混凝土造成的，在登陆台阶上捡到了小片弹片。
第二枚炸弹击中了位于登陆台阶上方、面向河流的办公楼屋顶（该部分的建筑只有两层），显然在撞击时爆炸，炸落了巨大的木质和铁皮制的博登公司招牌，并将碎片喷洒到后面较高部分的建筑墙壁上，穿透了钢筋混凝土屋顶，造成一个直径约2½英尺的洞，并以碎片形式落在楼下办公室的地板上，卡梅伦先生当时正睡在那里。
后者已被防空炮火惊醒，从距离炸弹落点约4英尺的床上起身，正前往更安全的地方。然而，他最初的几步却使他更靠近炸弹的入口点，而炸弹恰在此时落下，导致卡梅伦先生被大量的混凝土碎片和飞溅的玻璃击中。
在办公室地板上发现的炸弹碎片为淬火钢制成。这枚炸弹未引起火灾。

Sino-Japanese hostilities in the Yangtsepoo district for 24
hours ending 6 a.m. 6/10/37.
D.S.I.Crighton. Officer i/c.

Sir,

I beg to report that throughout the morning and afternoon
of the 5/10/37, the situation in this district remained quiet.
Chinese bombing planes flew over this district between
the following times and on each occasion dropped bombs in the
area north east of the station, at least two or three dropping
in the vicinity of the Japanese airdrome:- 6-14 to 6-25 p.m.
6-35 to 6-50 p.m., and 4-30 to 4-45 a.m. 6/10/37.
At 11-55 p.m. 5/10/37, several terrific explosions were
heard east, and north east of this station, and simultaneously
Japanese anti aircraft opened fire, also several search lights
came into action, but no plane could be seen or heard. It was
then discovered that these explosions were shells bursting
and being fired from Chinese batteries in the Pootung area.
In all about twenty shells burst in and around the Kung Dah
cotton mill, Japanese airdrome, and the Shanghai college, but
extent of damage done cannot be stated meantime.

HG.
I am, Sir,
Yours Obediently.
John Crighton
D. S. I.

Sino-Japanese hostilities in Yangtsepoo district for 24 hours
ending 6 a.m. 26/9/37,
D.S.I.Crighten.
Officer i/c.

Sir,
I beg to report that during the morning of 25/9/37 occasional
heavy artillery fire could be heard in the direction of Kiangwan,
also Pootung was subject to heavy bombardment by Japanese Naval
guns. Between 10-30 and 12 noon,numerous air raids was carried
out over the same territories by Japanese bombing planes. In
addition to this shelling and bombing,heavy machine gun and rifle
fire could be heard in the direction of Kiangwan.
At 3-30 p.m. 25/9/37 information was received from the Japan-
ese Military authorities,to the effect that they had rounded up
a number of Chinese inside Lane No.1815 Yangtsepoo Road,and re-
questing the police to evacuate them. The undersigned accompanied
by J.P.S.74 attended,and removed to the International Refugee Camp
Rou De Soys French Concession, twenty nine male and female Chinese
most of whom were residing in this alleyway.
At approximately 8 p.m. 25/9/37,the H.I.J.M. Idzumo,lying in
the river off this district,opened fire with her heavy guns in the
direction of Kiangwan,and shortly after this huge fires could be
seen burning in that area. This firing continued until,shortly
before 11 p.m.when Chinese planes came over this district,and had
dropped at least three bombs before they were recognised,and sub-
ject to heavy anti-aircraft fire.Two of these bombs,said to be
incendiary,dropped on Pingliang road,outside the Dong Shing Japan-
ese mill quarters,a distance of about 500 yards from this station.
The exact location of the other bomb is at present unknown. This
raid lasted for about 15 minutes,and no sooner had it passed than
the H.I.J.M.Idzumo again opened up fire on the Kiangwan area. Be-
tween 11 p.m. and 12 midnight heavy machine gun and rifle fire
could be heard in the direction of Kiangwan,also small boats lyi

1937年9月26日。
截至1937年9月26日上午6时的24小时内，杨树浦地区的中日敌对行动，
D.S.I. Crighten.
主管警官。

先生，
谨此报告，在1937年9月25日上午，偶尔能听到来自江湾方向的重炮声，浦东也遭受了日本海军舰炮的猛烈轰炸。在10:30至中午12点之间，日本轰炸机对上述地区进行了多次空袭。除了炮击和轰炸外，还能听到来自江湾方向的机枪和步枪猛烈射击声。
1937年9月25日下午3:30，收到日本军方当局的消息，称他们在杨树浦路1815弄内包围了一些中国人，并请警方将其撤离。签署人会同J.P.S.74号警员到场，将二十九名男女中国人转移至法租界鲁德索伊（Rou De Soys）国际难民营，其中大多数人居住在该弄堂内。
1937年9月25日晚8点左右，停泊在本区外江面上的日本帝国海军出云号战舰（H.I.J.M. Idzumo）用重炮向江湾方向开火，不久后可见该区域燃起大火。此次炮击一直持续到接近晚上11点，此时中国飞机飞越本区，在被识别并遭到猛烈高射炮火攻击前，至少投下了三枚炸弹。据称其中两枚为燃烧弹，落在平凉路上，东兴日本纱厂宿舍区外，距离本站约500码。另一枚炸弹的确切位置目前未知。这次空袭持续了约15分钟，刚过去不久，出云号战舰再次向江湾地区开火。在晚上11点至午夜12点之间，可以听到来自江湾方向的猛烈机枪和步枪射击声，此外，停泊在吴淞附近及外部的小船也

At 1-5 a/m.26/9/37,Chinese bombing planes again flew over

Sir,

I beg to report that throughout the day of 23/9/37, other than
for occasional shots being fired from Japanese men-o-war in the
river, nothing of an outstanding nature took place in this area.

At 7 p.m. 23/9/37, members of the J.N.L.P. came to station and
requested the assistance of the Fire brigade in extinguishing a
fire at Glen and Yangtsepoo roads corner. The brigade attended
and extinguished a funeral pyre erected by the Public Health Dept.
earlier in the afternoon, for purpose of burning bodies recovered

副巡官克里顿（Crighton）。亚历山大（Alexander）主管警官。

先生：

谨此报告，在1937年9月23日全天，除河面日本军舰偶尔发射炮弹外，本区未发生任何显著事件。

1937年9月23日晚7时，日本海军陆战队（J.N.L.P.）成员来到警局，请求消防队协助扑灭格兰路（Glen Road）与杨树浦路拐角处的火灾。消防队到场后，熄灭了由公共卫生处（Public Health Dept.）于当天下午早些时候搭建的焚尸堆，用于焚烧他们在本区收殓的尸体。

1937年9月23日午夜刚过，听到本警局附近有大规模部队调动，经查询获悉，这些部队为日军，正被调往前线。

19th Sept.

22 9 37
37.
Sino-Japanese hostilities in Yangtszepoo district for 24 hours
ending 6 a.m. 19-9-37.
D.S.I.Crighton.
[签名] officer i/c.

Sir,

I beg to report that shortly after 7 a.m. 18/9/37,a large
fire was observed in the area adjoining the Kung Dah Cotton Mill,
Pingliang and Liping roads corner. This was followed by another
at the rear of the Shanghai Cotton Mill quarters,Pingliang near
Lingching road. As both these places are located within the
"Prohibited Area" police could not attend,nor could the S.F.B.
function.Subsequent enquires through the J.N.L.P.Headquarters
revealed the former to be a number of Chinese houses located O.O.L
fronting the Kung Dah Cotton Mill,whilst the latter was said to
be a number of straw huts at the rear of the Shanghai Cotton Mill
quarters.The origin of both fires is unknown,but circumstances
indicate that same had been set alight be members of the J.N.L.P.
who are sole occupants of that area.

Throughout the morning of the 18/9/37,Japanese warships in
the river off this district,between Pingting and Tinghai roads
carried out a bombardment of Pootung,as did Japanese Air Force.

Between 6-55 and 8-10 p.m.18/9/37 several Chinese planes
flew over this district,three actually being sighted over this
station.Several bombs were dropped in the district north of Ping-
liang road,and it is believed that at least two landed in the
Standard Oil Co. compound Pootung,starting a fire which was
quickly extinguished,and three more landed somewhere in the vici-
ity of the Japanese aerodrome.This raid lasted for approximately
one hour,during which time a terrific barrage of Japanese anti-
aircraft and machine gun fire was put up,several pieces of shrap-
nel falling into the compound of this station. Simultaneously
to this air raid Chinese artillery located in the Pootung side
opened fire in this direction,and although several shells were
pages.zh:
8
杨树浦
9月19日
8039 A
1937年9月22日
1937.
截至1937年9月19日上午6时的24小时内，杨树浦地区的中日敌对行动。
副巡官克里顿（Crighton）。
[签名] 主管警官。

先生：

谨此报告，1937年9月18日上午7时刚过，观察到平凉路与黎平路拐角处、公大纱厂（Kung Dah Cotton Mill）邻近区域发生大火。随后，平凉路近临清路（Lingching road）处的上海纱厂（Shanghai Cotton Mill）宿舍后方也发生火灾。由于这两处地点均位于“禁区”内，警察无法前往，上海救火会（S.F.B.）也无法运作。随后通过日本海军陆战队总部进行的查询显示，前者是位于公大纱厂对面、面向该厂的若干华人民居，后者据称是上海纱厂宿舍后方的若干草棚。两处火灾的起因不明，但情况表明系由占据该区域的日本海军陆战队成员纵火所致。

1937年9月18日上午，停泊在本区附近河面上的日本军舰，在平定路（Pingting）与定海路（Tinghai）之间，对浦东进行了炮击，日本空军也进行了轰炸。

1937年9月18日下午6时55分至8时10分之间，数架中国飞机飞越本区上空，其中三架确实在本警局上方被目击。数枚炸弹投落在平凉路以北的地区，据信至少有两枚落入浦东的美孚石油公司（Standard Oil Co.）大院，引发火灾，但很快被扑灭，另有三枚落在日本机场附近的某处。此次空袭持续约一小时，期间日军高射炮和机枪火力猛烈，数块弹片落入本警局大院内。与此同时，针对此次空袭，位于浦东一侧的中国炮兵向此方向开火，虽然听到数发炮弹

pages.en:
"2"

heard to pass over the station,as far as can be ascertained no
hits were registered in this district,the objective apparently
being Kiangwan.

Between 8-50 and 9-30 p.m. 18/9/37,a similiar
raid was carried out by Chinese planes,and again several bombs
were dropped in this area,three of same within a very short
distance of this station.During this raid a large fire was seen
to start up somewhere on Yangtsepoo road,and subsequent enquires
revealed same to be Behr & Mathews godown Yangtsepoo road,west
of Lay road.Others fires were noticed in the direction of Ward
road boundary.

Between 10-30 and 11-30 p.m. 18/9/37 a further
raid was carried out by Chinese planes,and on this occasion three
to four hits were registered on the China Soap Co,Yangtsepoo
road,causing godowns of this company,situated near the river
front to become ignited. The S.F.B. were informed of this fire
but stated their inability to attend owing to pressure of work.
On receipt of this information all available foreigners under
Inspt.Andrew immediately proceeded to the scene,where it was
seen that the south west godown was well alight,also the Raw
Material department located on the west side of this. As this
fire through being fanned by the wind that was then blowing had
every appearence of spreading to adjoining buildings,members of
the police,using all available fire appliances on the premises
commenced combating same from the North,and were successful in
holding it in check until the arrival of the fire brigade some
forty minutes later,and continued to assist the latter until
3-40 a.m. 19/9/37,when the main body of police returned to the
station for a change of clothing.
pages.zh:
"2"

从警局上空飞过，但据查本区未中弹，其目标显然是江湾。

1937年9月18日晚8时50分至9时30分之间，中国飞机发动了类似的空袭，再次在本区投下数枚炸弹，其中三枚落在离本警局极近的地方。在此次空袭中，有人看到杨树浦路上某处燃起大火，随后的查询显示起火点为杨树浦路西、雷路（Lay road）以西的贝尔-马修斯（Behr & Mathews）仓库。在华德路（Ward road）边界方向也注意到其他火灾。

1937年9月18日晚10时30分至11时30分之间，中国飞机再次发动空袭，此次中国肥皂公司（China Soap Co.，位于杨树浦路）被击中三至四次，导致该公司位于江边的仓库起火。已通知上海救火会此火灾，但他们表示因工作繁忙无法前往。接到此信息后，安德鲁（Andrew）巡官麾下的所有可用外籍警员立即赶赴现场，发现西南侧仓库火势猛烈，位于其西侧的原料部也着火。由于当时风吹助长火势，火灾极有可能蔓延至相邻建筑，警方人员利用现场所有可用的灭火器材从北侧开始灭火，成功控制住火势，直到约四十分钟后消防队抵达，并继续协助消防队，直至1937年9月19日凌晨3时40分，大部分警员返回警局更换衣物。

pages.en:
"3".

From observations made at this fire,it was
definitely ascertained that at least three bombs,two of which
were incendiary had struck the south east godown of this company
and that the fire originated in this godown.Evidence of another
incendiary bomb having hit the Raw Material department was found.
Having got the fire under control,police and fire brigade officers
carried out an inspection of adjoining godowns,and as a result
found that another incendiary bomb had dropped through the roof
of the south west godowm,landing in the midst of a large amount
of wooden cases packed with soap,exploded and scattered its conten
ts,phosphorus,all over these cases,causing several to become ig-
nited.Such cases were pulled into the open,whilst the remainder
were immediately sprayed with water,this having the desired effect
of keeping the fire under control. Whilst thus engaged,at approx-
imately 2 a.m. 19/9/37,Chinese planes again came overhead,this
time dropping three bombs in the vacant ground between the Soap
Co.and Gas Co. One a high explosive landed on Pingting road forty
yards east of the Soap Co.,causing a huge crater in the roadway.
The two bombs,both incendiary,dropped into fields on either side
of this road,without taking any effect. Several pieces of shrap-
nel landed in and around the Soap Co.compound during this raid.
At 3-40 a.m. 19/9/37,the undersigned accompanied
by Inspt Gash and F.S.Walker returned to station for a change of
clothing,and at 4-30 a.m. whilst returning to this fire,accompan-
ied by Inspt.Andrew and J.P.S.49,the undersigned driving Station
M/car 6134,a collision took place between this car and a M/Truck
driven and occupied by Japanese plain clothe men,resulting in
the car being badly damaged,J.P.S.49 seriously injured,and the
undersigned slightly injured,(for full particulars see covering
pages.zh:
"3".

通过对此次火灾的观察，明确证实至少有三枚炸弹，其中两枚为燃烧弹，击中了该公司的东南侧仓库，且火灾起源于该仓库。还发现了另一枚燃烧弹击中原料部的证据。在控制住火势后，警察和消防队官员检查了相邻仓库，结果发现另一枚燃烧弹穿透西南侧仓库的屋顶落下，落在一堆装有肥皂的大木箱中间，爆炸并将其内容物磷散落在这些箱子上，导致数个箱子起火。这些箱子被拖到空旷处，其余的则立即喷水，达到了控制火势的预期效果。在此期间，约1937年9月19日凌晨2时，中国飞机再次飞临上空，此次在肥皂公司与煤气公司之间的空地上投下三枚炸弹。一枚高爆弹落在肥皂公司以东四十码的平定路上，在路面上造成一个巨大的弹坑。另外两枚均为燃烧弹，落在该路两侧的田野里，未造成任何影响。此次空袭期间，数块弹片落在肥皂公司大院内及周边。
1937年9月19日凌晨3时40分，署名者陪同加什（Gash）巡官和F.S.沃克（F.S.Walker）返回警局更换衣物，凌晨4时30分，在陪同安德鲁巡官和J.P.S.49返回火灾现场途中，署名者驾驶警局机动车6134号，与一辆由便衣日本人驾驶并乘坐的军用卡车发生碰撞，导致该车严重受损，J.P.S.49重伤，署名者轻伤，（详细情况见附函

pages.en:
"4".

report). By 5 a.m. 19/9/37 this fire had been got under complet
control. Russian Police Watchman No.137 on duty at these premises
when questioned gave a similiar account of the bombing,but stated
that during the actual bombing of the Soap Co.he was under cover
in a dugout at Anderson Myers Co.which adjoins the Soap Co.
Several pieces of bomb picked up inside the Soap Co.
are now being kept at this station pending instructions re dis-
posal.
Further enquires made at daylight revealed that in
addition to aforegoing bombings,five more bombs,three incendiary,
and two high explosive,were dropped around the Ming Hwa Sugar
Refinery,a Japanese concern,and the Ewo Cold Storage,one Incend-
iarybomb actually landing on the roof of the latter address. No
damage,other then all windows being blown out,was done in either
place. Another high explosive bomb landed in the Yangtszepoo Creek
at the corner of Yangtszepoo and lay roads,with result that shop
No.1381 suffered serious damage.
Information from a Japanese source revealed that one
bomb dropped in a field of Pingliang road near to the J.N.L.P.
headquarters,whilst one of the Chinese planes was brought down
near the D.K.K.Wharf,Broadway east,and that the aviator was defin-
itely Chinese.The plane has since been removed to Hongkew district
where it is now on exhibition.
During these hostilities no casualties were reporte
and at a late hour this morning it was ascertained that J.P.S.49
is not so serious as was at first thought,and will probably be
discharged from hospital within the next few days.His injuries
consist of a large laceration of the face necessitating for
stitches.
pages.zh:
"4".

报告）。截至1937年9月19日上午5时，此火已被完全控制。当时在该处执勤的俄籍巡捕第137号在接受询问时提供了类似的轰炸描述，但称在中国肥皂公司实际遭受轰炸期间，他躲在毗邻肥皂公司的安得生-梅耶斯公司（Anderson Myers Co.）的地堡中。
在肥皂公司内部捡到的几块炸弹碎片现保存在本警局，等待关于处置的指示。
天亮后进行的进一步查询显示，除上述轰炸外，另有五枚炸弹，三枚燃烧弹和两枚高爆弹，投落在明华糖厂（Ming Hwa Sugar Refinery，一家日本企业）和怡和冷气栈（Ewo Cold Storage）周围，其中一枚燃烧弹实际落在后者的屋顶上。两地除所有窗户被震碎外，未造成其他损坏。另一枚高爆弹落在杨树浦路与雷路拐角处的杨树浦浜中，导致1381号店铺严重受损。
来自日本方面的消息显示，一枚炸弹落在靠近日本海军陆战队总部的平凉路田野中，而一架中国飞机在百老汇路（Broadway）东段的大康码头（D.K.K.Wharf）附近被击落，飞行员确认为中国人。该飞机随后被移至虹口区，目前正在展出。
在此次敌对行动期间，未报告人员伤亡，今天凌晨较晚时候获悉，J.P.S.49的伤势不如最初认为的严重，可能在未来几天内出院。他的伤势包括面部大面积撕裂伤，需要缝合。

pages.en:
"5"

In conclusion I wish to state that this
a.m. I interviewed Mr.Fletcher of the China Soap Co,who estimat
the damage done at roughly $300.000.00.

I am,Sir,
Yours Obediently.
John Coughlan
D. S. I.

Sino-Japanese hostilities in Yangtsepoo district for 24 hours
ending 6 a.m. 17-9-37.
D.S.I.Crighton.
(签名) Officer i/c.

Sir,

I beg to report that throughout the day of 16/9/37, hostilities
in and around this district were practically at a standstill, until
after dark, when from observations made it appeared as though a
Chinese battery opened fire into the Civic Centre and Kiangwan areas
causing two large fires to start, one near the Administration Build-
ing and the other near the Kiangwan Race club. This battery appears
to be located in the country to the West of the North Railway Station

At 5-48 p.m. 16/9/37, information was received from the Japanese
Naval Landing Party Headquarters to the effect that seven Chinese
bombing planes accompanied by two fighters had just been sighted
over Woosung travelling in a Westerly direction. Necessary precautions
were taken, but nothing was seen of these planes in this area.

I am, Sir,
Yours Obediently.
(签名: John Crighton)

ending 8am. on 12/9/37.

Made by D.S.I. Watson.    Forwarded by Cash    (signature) for O/C.

P
18/G

Sir,
    I beg to report that during daylight of 11/9/37, Japanese
Aircraft continued to bomb Chinese positions in the vicinity of
the Civic Centre and the Yng Ziang Keng Race Course. These planes
also machine-gunned positions in these areas.
    Between 9-30pm. and 10-30pm. on 11/9/37, the most intense
machine gun and rifle fire hitherto experienced in this area was
heard in the vicinity of the Race Course and in the direction
of the Woosung Military Road. Trench Mortar Batteries were also
used, and a search light, believed to be from one of the
Japanese Naval Craft in the Whangpoo River, was used in
connection with the operations, which illuminated the whole of
the active area.
    Chinese Aircraft appeared over this district at 7-15pm. and
and 10-45pm. on 11/9/37, and were fired on by Anti-Aircraft guns.
As far as is known, no bombs were dropped in this vicinity.
Shortly after the Chinese Craft appeared at 7-15pm. A Japanese
Aeroplane took to the air for a short period.

                                        I am, Sir,

Made by D.S.I.Crighton. Forwarded by [Signature] officer i/c.

Sir,
I beg to report, that throughout the day of 9/9/37, hostilities
on a very large scale continued north of this district, the Japan-
ese carrying out their big push, but with what success cannot be
stated.
Between 11 p.m. 9/9/37 and 2 a.m. 10/9/37 Chinese bombing
planes carried out three raids over this district, and the Japanese
lines, dropping several bombs in all. At 11-45 p.m. 9/9/37 a tel-
ephone message was received from Yangtszepoo Fire Station report-
ing a large fire at the China Import and Export Co. Lumber Yard
on the north side of Yangtszepoo road, near Lay Road, and requesting
a Japanese escort for their machines. The undersigned accompanied
by D.S.I. Watson, and two J.P.C.s. attended, and as a result ascertained
that at approximately 11.30 p.m. 9/9/37, during the second raid
by Chinese bombing planes, one of the planes dropped a large incen-
diary bomb into the China Woodworking Department of the aforesaid
company, causing same to burst into flame. Considerable damage has
been done to this lumber yard, but same cannot be estimated mean-
time.
Another bomb was dropped on
the bank of Lay Road creek, near
Junning Road about 70 yards
north east of the scene of the
fire, presumably at the same
time.
I am, Sir,
Yours Obediently.

由副督察克里希顿（Crichton）撰写。由 [签名] 负责警官转呈。

先生：
谨此报告，在1937年9月9日全天，本区以北的大规模敌对行动仍在继续，日军发动了大规模攻势，但其成功程度尚不可知。

Subject Sino-Japanese hostilities in Yangtsepoo district for 24 hours
ending 8 a.m. 7/9/37.
Made by D.S.I. Crighton. Forwarded by [Signature] Officer i/c.

Sir,
I beg to report, that throughout the morning of the 6/9/37,
other than for occasional shots from naval guns, and air raids
by Japanese planes over Kiangwan, things were comparatively quiet
in this sector.
At 4-15 p.m. 6/9/37, whilst on patrol, the undersigned discovered a block of Chinese houses on Yangtsepoo road, near
Tengting road on fire, and immediately called the fire brigade, who
responded and extinguished same after one hour. The source of this
fire is unknown, but it is suspected that same was caused by a party
of Japanese marines, who half an hour earlier were seen to come out
from this address by S/I Radionoff.
From 7-30 p.m. onwards heavy gun fire was heard
coming from the direction of the boundaries of this district,
and periodically Japanese Naval guns would open up a heavy barrage
over the Kiangwan and Pootung areas. This continued throughout
the night, and towards morning the barrage became much heavier,
over twenty Japanese bombing planes assisting in the bombardment
from daylight onwards. Whether or not this is the commencement of
the Big Push cannot be definitely ascertained.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently
[Signature: John Crighton]
D.S.I.

先生：
谨此报告，在1937年9月6日上午期间，除了偶尔有舰炮射击以及日军飞机对江湾地区的空袭外，本辖区局势相对平静。
1937年9月6日下午4时15分，本人在巡逻时发现杨树浦路靠近腾亭路（Tengting road）的一处中国民居起火，随即呼叫消防队，消防队迅速响应并在一小时后扑灭大火。火灾起因不明，但怀疑是由一队日本海军陆战队员所致，警佐拉迪奥诺夫（Radionoff）曾于半小时前目睹这些人从该地址走出。
自晚上7时30分起，可听到来自本辖区边界方向传来的猛烈炮声，日军舰炮不时对江湾和浦东地区进行猛烈轰击。这种情况持续了一整夜，临近清晨时炮火变得更加猛烈，从黎明起更有二十多架日本轰炸机协助轰炸。这是否标志着“大攻势”的开始，尚无法确定。

ending 6 a.m. 5/9/37.

Made by D.S.I. Crighton. Forwarded by [Signature] officer i/c.

Sir,
I beg to report that at 830 a.m. 4/9/37, 250 members of the
I.N.L.P. in command of a Captain, whilst on route march in the
district came to a halt outside the station gate, the officer i/c
requesting permission for his men to ascend to the station roof
for purpose of making observations. The matter was referred to
C. of P. and was refused. This was conveyed to the Captain who then
marched his men off.

During the morning of the 4/9/37, Japanese bombing planes
carried out raids on the Ying Ziang Kong, Klangwan, and Pootung areas.

Between 3 and 6 p.m. 4/9/37, large consignments of ammunition
were observed being brought into this district by M/trucks from the
direction of Wayside, also at about 7-30 p.m. ten truck loads of
troops, and three batteries of heavy artillery were seen passing
along Yangtsepoo road proceeding east.

During the night of 4/9/37, the distant roll of guns could be
heard coming from the direction of Woosung, and early this morning
other guns, presumably Japanese could be heard firing from the
Ying Ziang Kong and Ward Road areas.

撰写人：副督察克里顿。呈报人：[签名] 主管警官。

先生：
谨此报告，1937年9月4日上午8时30分，由一名上尉指挥的250名日本海军陆战队（I.N.L.P.，原文如此，应为J.N.L.P.）成员在辖区内进行行军途中，在巡捕房大门外停下，该带队军官请求允许其士兵登上巡捕房屋顶进行观察。此事已上报警务处长（C. of P.）并被拒绝。这一决定已传达给该上尉，随后他率领部队离开。

1937年9月4日上午，日本轰炸机对引翔港（Ying Ziang Kong）、江湾（Klangwan，原文拼写错误，应为Kiangwan）和浦东地区进行了空袭。

1937年9月4日下午3时至6时之间，观察到大量弹药由军用卡车从韦赛德（Wayside，音译）方向运入本辖区；此外，约在晚上7时30分，可见十卡车的部队和三个重炮兵连沿杨树浦路向东行进。

1937年9月4日夜間，可听到来自吴淞方向的远处炮声，今天清晨又可听到其他火炮（推测为日军）从引翔港和华德路地区开火的声音。

Date August 31st., 1937. 37

Subject Sino-Japanese Hostilities in the Yangtsepoo District for 24
hours ending 8am. on 31/8/37.

Made by D.S.I. Watson. Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,
I beg to report that Y'Poo District remained quiet on
30/8/37, no Militaryxx or other activities being observed
apart from occasional flights by Japanese Aircraft.
At about 2-45am. on 31/8/37 three shells were fired into
the direction of Chinese Territory North of this district,
either from the Japanese Field Battery on Kueyang Road or from
craft in the Whangpoo River, the shells passing close by Y'Poo
Station.
A few minutes later Chinese Aircraft appeared over the
Whangpoo River and circled over this district. Two bombs
exploded, apparently in Y'Poo District, but the exact location
has not yet been traced. Two large flashes were also seen a
few minutes later, followed by dull thuds, apparently caused
by defective bombs.
The Chinese Aircraft were subjected to fire by Japanese
Anti-Aircraft guns situated in this district and from Japanese
Craft in the Whangpoo River, apparently without effect.
No casualties have been reported.

I am, Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,
[Signature] D.S.I.

先生：
谨报告称，杨树浦地区在1937年8月30日保持平静，除偶尔有日本飞机飞行外，未观察到军事xx或其他活动。
1937年8月31日凌晨约2时45分，三发炮弹射向本区以北的中国领土方向，要么来自贵阳路上的日本野战炮兵连，要么来自黄浦江上的船只，炮弹从杨树浦分局附近掠过。

中国飞机遭到位于本区的日本高射炮和黄浦江上日本船只的射击，但似乎未奏效。

Made by D.S.I. Crighton. Forwarded by [Signature] Officer i/c.

Sir,
I beg to report that at 9-30 a.m. 31/8/37, Captain Noguchi
of the Japanese Naval Landing Party headquarters Pingliang Road,
came to this station, and through J.D.S.42 Uechi, requested assistance
in evacuating all Chinese from the Yangtsepoo District. If these
people refused to move, he stated that he would assist the police
by sending out a party of marines. As far as could be understood
the reason for this evacuation was firstly owing to these people
moving around during curfew hours, secondly that some were suspects
of being snipers, and thirdly that most of them were looters. These
excuses are quite logic, but at the same time it is the opinion of
the undersigned that the principal reason for this evacuation was
a precautionary measure being taken by the Naval Landing Party
to have all Chinese removed from behind their lines, also from the
vicinity of one of their main bases.

Acting on above request all available men under
Insp. Cash and the undersigned, with the assistance of every avail-
able vehicle, including S.V.C. trucks commenced this evacuation
at approximately 10-30 a.m., and continued until 6-30 p.m. by which
time roughly 5,000 persons were removed from various roads and
alleyways in this district to outside the British Consulate grounds

Sir,

I beg to report, that for the past twenty four hours, other than

Between 1-30 and 2-20 a.m. 30/8/37 Chinese bombing planes
again flew over this district, but as far as can be ascertained

action no damage was done to these planes.

extensively from shell and bomb explosions, the former in fact
being absolutely gutted by fire.

milk cows seen straying around Ningkou Road. Assistance was render-

of these cows have been accomadated at this station, whilst the
remainder have been put into the compound of the General Electric
Co. Hochien Road, under the care of several Sikh watchmen, who are

Subject Japanese Hostilities in Yangtszepoo District for 24 hours
ending 8 a.m. 26.8.37.

Made by D.S.I. Crighton Forwarded by R.C. Andrew, Inspector i/c

Sir,
I beg to report that at 6.45 a.m. 25.8.37, a number of rifle shots were heard in the vicinity of Yangtszepoo and Glen Roads corner. Enquiries revealed that a male Chinese age between 45 & 50 years, height 5' 5", dressed in blue short jacket and pants, had been shot several times about the body and was lying on Yangtszepoo Road, about 60 yards west of Glen Road, undoubtedly dead. This shooting was undoubtedly carried out by one of the many Japanese Marine Curfew patrols.

At 8 a.m. 25.8.37, a representative of the Kofa Drug Co., called at this Station and requested assistance to visit the companies factory located on Ward Road, west of Ningkou Road. He was escorted to the Japanese Naval Landing Party Headquarters, located inside the Japanese Primary School, Pingliang Road, where assistance was refused by the officer i/c, who stated that owing to Chinese snipers still being in that vicinity it too dangerous meantime.

Throughout the day (25.8.37), the Japanese Marine carried out sniping patrols in the Yangtszepoo district and at 11 a.m. one of these patrols set fire to a number of Chinese Country houses at the corner of Ningwu and Haichow Roads, completely gutting several of them. At 3 p.m. a similar patrol set fire to the Hwa Shing (華兴) Printing and Dying Works, a Chinese concern, located at 319 Meichow Road, resulting in its complete destruction. As far as can be ascertained no person was injured during these two fires.

先生，
谨此报告，1937年8月25日上午6时45分，在杨树浦路与格兰路（Glen Road）转角附近听到数声枪响。经查，一名年龄在45至50岁之间、身高5英尺5英寸、身穿蓝色短夹克和长裤的中国男子，身体多处中弹，躺在杨树浦路上，位于格兰路以西约60码处，无疑已死亡。此次枪击无疑是由众多日本海军陆战队宵禁巡逻队中的一名成员所为。

1937年8月25日上午8时，科发药房（Kofa Drug Co.）的一名代表来到本分局，请求协助前往位于华德路、宁国路以西的公司工厂。他被护送至位于平凉路日本小学内的日本海军陆战队总部，但主管军官拒绝提供协助，称由于该附近仍有中国狙击手，目前过于危险。

全天（1937年8月25日），日本海军陆战队在杨树浦区进行狙击巡逻，上午11时，其中一支巡逻队在宁武路与海州路转角处放火烧毁数栋中国民房，导致其中几栋被彻底烧毁。下午3时，另一支类似的巡逻队放火烧毁了位于梅周路319号的一家华商企业——华兴印染厂，致其完全毁灭。据查，这两起火灾中无人受伤。

1937年8月25日上午10时至11时之间，停泊在黄浦江上的日本海军舰艇发出猛烈的炮火掩护，大批日军沿

Yangtsepoo Station. August 24, 1937.

The re-occupation of Yangtsepoo and Yulin
Road Police Stations was completed by 5 p.m. on August
22nd.

A guard of Europeans and Russians was left at
"B" and "C" Posts, and Europeans and Sikhs at "D" and
"G" Posts. The Reserve Unit quarters were also occu-
pied by its foreign members and 15 Japanese. (A com-
plete list of personnel will be forwarded later).

The guard at "Col." Post (The Yangtsepoo Cotton
Mill) under S.I. Fernandes has not been interfered with.

Patrols were carried on throughout the day but
nothing of a general interest to report, other than
Chinese houses on fire opposite the Ewo Cotton Mill on
Yangtsepoo Road.

Firing by large and small guns continued inter-
mittently throughout the day by both belligerents. Ex-
tensive bombing by Japanese planes was observed on the
Pootung side of the river.

It has now been definitely established that
Japanese soldiers were landed in the vicinity of Woo-
sung during the early hours of yesterday morning. The
number is as yet unknown. They are gradually relieving
the Marines in that sector.

Re: the occupancy of the various Stations, it
has been found that considerable damage has been done
in the Yangtsepoo Station to Municipal property. A
complete list is being prepared and will be forwarded
later.

杨树浦分局。1937年8月24日。

杨树浦路和榆林路警察分局的重新占领工作已于8月22日下午5时完成。

“B”岗和“C”岗留下了欧洲人和俄罗斯人守卫，“D”岗和“G”岗则为欧洲人和锡克教徒。预备队营房也由外籍成员和15名日本人占用。（完整的人员名单稍后提交）。

由高级巡官费尔南德斯（S.I. Fernandes）负责的“Col.”岗（杨树浦棉纺厂）的守卫未受干扰。

全天进行了巡逻，除杨树浦路怡和棉纺厂对面有中国房屋着火外，无其他值得普遍关注的事项报告。

交战双方全天断续进行大小火炮射击。观察到日军飞机对浦东地区进行了大规模轰炸。

现已确切证实，昨天清晨时分，日军士兵在吴淞附近登陆。人数尚不清楚。他们正在逐步接替该区域的美国海军陆战队。

关于各分局的占用情况，发现杨树浦分局的公产遭受了相当严重的损坏。正在编制完整清单，稍后提交。

1st further REPORT
Date August 17, 1937.

Subject Sino-Japanese Hostilities in Yangtzepoo District for 24 hours
ending 6 a.m.

Made by D.S.I. Crighton Forwarded by [Signature] Officer i/c

Sir,
I beg to report that throughout the day of 16/8/37, a
heavy barrage of heavy artillery was put up from all Japanese
Naval boats lying in the Whangpoo River. Observations made
proved their objective to be Kiangwan and Chapei area.
At approximately 9.30 a.m. 16/8/37, two flights of bombers
in full fighting formation, were observed to be approaching this
district from the west, and all precautions were taken for an
air raid, however subsequent enquiries revealed them to be
Japanese planes returning from the bombing expedition to Nantao
and Lunghwa, where it is alleged considerable damage was done
by them. Both flights kept to the River line all the way down
until when passing over the Shanghai Power Co., the first
2nd
turned north towards Kiangwan and Chapei. The/ continued as
far as Point Island and then altered her course and flew in a
similar direction after the first. Both flights then commenced
a heavy bombing of Chapei and Kiangwan areas.
Although several air raids were made on the Settlement by
Chinese planes, none came over the Yangtzepoo district during
the day.
At 4.30 p.m. 16/8/37, heavy artillery fire was heard coming
in direction of Pootung, and subsequent enquiries revealed this
to be a Chinese battery attempted to bombard Japanese positions
held in Kiangwan and Chapei. Shortly after this barrage had
started a full flight of Japanese bombing planes proceeded to
Pootung, where after some time, according to information received,
they were successful in locating the artillery base, and commenced
bombing same. This had the necessary effect of quietening down
this battery, but between 8 and 9 p.m. it again opened fire.

（左侧手写批注：S / On / Included / 17/7/37）

事由 截至上午6时的24小时内，杨树浦区的中日敌对行动。

制作人 副巡长赖顿（Crighton） 转呈人 [签名] 主管警官

先生，
谨此报告，1937年8月16日全天，停泊在黄浦江上的所有日本海军舰艇发出了猛烈的重炮炮火。观察表明，其目标是江湾和闸北地区。
1937年8月16日上午9时30分左右，观察到两编队轰炸机以完整的战斗队形从西部接近本区，并采取了防空袭的一切预防措施，然而后续调查显示，这些是从南市和龙华轰炸任务返回的日本飞机，据称它们在那裡造成了巨大破坏。两个编队一路沿黄浦江飞行，当飞过上海电力公司时，第一
第二
架/转向北飞往江湾和闸北。第二架继续飞至大尖角岛（Point Island），然后改变航向，跟随第一架朝相同方向飞行。随后，两个编队开始对闸北和江湾地区进行猛烈轰炸。
虽然中国飞机对租界进行了数次空袭，但当天没有一架飞越杨树浦区。
1937年8月16日下午4时30分，听到来自浦东方向的猛烈炮火，后续调查显示，这是一支中国炮兵部队试图轰炸占据江湾和闸北的日军阵地。炮击开始后不久，一整编队日本轰炸机飞往浦东，据收到的消息，一段时间后，他们成功定位了炮兵基地，并开始对其进行轰炸。此举有效地压制了该炮兵部队，但在晚上8时至9时之间，该部队再次开火。

（左侧手写批注：S / On / Included / 17/7/37）

Subject Sino-Japanese Hostilities for 24 hours ending 6 a.m. 15/8/37
in Yangtszepoo District.
Made by D.S.I. Crighton Forwarded by [Signature] Inspt. O. i/c

Sir,
I beg to report that rifle and machine gun fire continued along all fronts at intervals, throughout the morning of the 15/8/37.

At 9.15 a.m. 14/8/37, a telephone message was received from the Zung Tuh (仁德) Cotton Mill, a Chinese concern, located at 590 Linching Road, to the effect that a Chinese Police constable, on duty at No. 4 Post, Linching and Ward Roads corner, had been arrested by the Japanese Naval Landing Party patrol.

On receipt of this information the undersigned accompanied by Inspt. Samashima and three Japanese constables proceeded to the post in question and there encountered C.P.C's 466 and 572, the former reporting that at 9 a.m. 14/8/37, he on observing the red light of No. 4 telephone box flashing proceeded in direction of same, but on crossing Ward Road, was immediately stopped by members of Naval Landing Party, who at the point of bayonet forced them back onto Linching and Ward Road Bridge. Enquiries at the Japanese Naval Landing Party Sectional Headquarters located in the Tung Hwa (東華) Cotton Mill quarters revealed that this procedure had been adopted for the personal safety of the C.P.C's in question, who when answering this phone, exposed themselves to stray bullets which at that particular point were coming over from Chinese front lines, said by Japanese Landing Party Authorities, to be within 600 metres of their positions which were then located about 500 yards from the Settlement boundaries.

Everything being amicably settled the party returned to

先生，
谨此报告，1937年8月15日上午，各条战线间歇性地持续发生步枪和机枪射击。

1937年8月14日上午9时15分，接到位于临清路590号的中资企业仁德纱厂打来的电话，称一名在临清路与华德路拐角处第4岗亭执勤的中国巡捕被日本海军陆战队巡逻队逮捕。

收到此信息后，卑职会同岛崎督察（Inspt. Samashima）及三名日本巡捕前往该岗亭，并在那里遇到了中国巡捕编号466和572，前者报告说，1937年8月14日上午9时，他看到第4号电话亭的红灯闪烁，便朝该方向走去，但在穿过华德路时，立即被海军陆战队成员拦下，后者用刺刀逼迫他们退回到临清路与华德路桥上。在位于东华纱厂宿舍内的日本海军陆战队分队指挥部进行的查询显示，采取这一程序是为了有关中国巡捕的人身安全，因为他们在接听该电话时，会暴露在中国前线射来的流弹之下，据日本陆战队当局称，这些流弹来自距离其阵地600米的地方，而其阵地当时位于距租界边界约500码处。

Between 9 and 10 a.m. minor disturbances took place in
the Sung Sing No. 5 and 6 mills located at Ward Road and
Seoul Road respectively. In each instance it was ascertained that trouble originated through management of these mills
being unable to pay wages, owing to the close down of native
banks.
Both cases were settled amicably and no further trouble
was expected.
At about 10.10 a.m. 14/8/37 a flight of five aeroplanes
appeared in this district from the North West and flew
towards the Kung Dah (公大) Cotton Mill. They were seen to
pass over, or near, the Kung Dah Mill, circle over Point
Island and return towards the mill. When returning over
the mill the flight is thought to have dropped 11 bombs, 6
of which took effect and five fell in fields in the vicinity.
Having passed the Kung Dah two of the planes broke away
from the other three and again flew towards the canal, circling, and thence towards the West, evidently making for the
Yue Foong Cotton Mill. At the point of separation one of
the two planes dropped a bomb which fell in a field north east
of the Ewo Brewery. When nearing the Yue Foong these two
planes let fall three bombs, two of which are thought to have
taken effect in the mill. The third bomb fell into the
river about 50 yards west of Tinghai Road bridge causing a
two masted junk to capsize. The 6 occupants of the junk
were picked up by a sampan which attempted to make a landing
at Tongting Road Jetty. One of the two planes, however,

巡捕房，向负责警官解释了事实，
随后该警官下令撤除华德路上的所有岗哨。
上午9时至10时之间，位于华德路和首尔路（Seoul Road）的宋兴五厂和六厂发生了轻微骚乱。经查实，每次骚乱均因华商银行停业，导致这些工厂的管理层无法支付工资而引起。
两起案件均得到和平解决，预计不会再有麻烦。
1937年8月14日上午10时10分左右，五架飞机从西北方向进入本区，飞向公大纱厂。有人看到它们飞过或经过公大纱厂上空，在复兴岛（Point Island）上空盘旋，然后返回纱厂方向。当飞回纱厂上空时，该机群被认为投下了11枚炸弹，其中6枚命中，5枚落在附近的田野里。
飞过公大纱厂后，其中两架飞机与其他三架分离，再次飞向运河，盘旋，然后向西飞去，显然是飞往裕丰纱厂。在分离点，这两架飞机中的一架投下一枚炸弹，落在怡和啤酒厂东北方向的一块田地里。当接近裕丰纱厂时，这两架飞机投下三枚炸弹，其中两枚被认为击中了工厂。第三枚炸弹落在定海路桥以西约50码处的河中，导致一艘双桅帆船倾覆。船上的6名乘客被一艘舢板救起，该舢板试图在通鼎路码头靠岸。然而，这两架飞机中的一架，

dropped a fourth bomb, intended for the Yue Foong but which
hit the water, about 10 yards away from the sampan, killing
three of the occupants and severely injuring three including
the lao-dah; the only occupant to escape being a small child.
This incident was witnessed by Mr. C.J. Pleace, S.P.Gy, who
telephoned for an ambulance which took the injured persons
to Shantung Road Hospital.

The party of three planes meanwhile were flying over the
Japanese Commercial School, adjoining this station, firing
with machine guns at the Japanese post on top of the school,
who replied with anti-air craft guns. The vicinity general-
ly was at this time sprayed with machine gun fire,
several persons subsequently being admitted to the Sacred
Heart Hospital suffering from bullet wounds.

The three planes then went back into Chinese territory
where they were rejoined by the two planes, after which the
five planes returned and attempted to bomb the Dong Shing
Cotton Mill on Yangtsepoo Road. The bombs missed their
objective and fell into the river. Casualties, if any, not
ascertained.

The planes again circled the district and were successful
with direct hits on the Shanghai Cotton Mill No. 1 and 2,
Kwangshin Road. The repercussion resulted in all shop fronts
within the vicinity being blown in. Extensive looting sub-
sequently took place in this area necessitating the calling
out of the Reserve Unit. Upon the arrival of the latter
the crowd had already dispersed and no arrests were made.
Police were posted and the fronts boarded at again where
necessary, in many cases by the owners themselves.

投下了第四枚炸弹，目标是裕丰纱厂，但落入水中，距离舢板约10码，造成三名乘客死亡，包括老大在内的三人重伤，唯一逃生的是一名幼童。
这一事件由上海工部局乐队指挥 C.J. Pleace 先生目睹，他打电话叫来救护车，将伤者送往山东路医院。

与此同时，那三架飞机飞越毗邻本巡捕房的日本商业学校，用机枪向学校顶部的日本哨所射击，哨所则用高射炮还击。当时附近地区普遍遭到机枪扫射，随后有数人因枪伤被送入圣心医院。

随后这三架飞机返回中国领土，与另外两架飞机汇合，之后五架飞机返回，试图轰炸杨树浦路上的东盛纱厂。炸弹未击中目标，落入河中。是否有伤亡，尚不清楚。

飞机再次在该区盘旋，并成功直接命中广新路的第一和第二上海纱厂。爆炸冲击波导致附近所有店面门窗被震碎。随后该地区发生了大规模抢劫，不得不召预备队出动。待预备队到达时，人群已经散去，无人被捕。警方部署了警力，并在必要时重新 boarded up（封板加固）店面，在许多情况下由业主自行完成。

At approximately 4.45 p.m. a flight of Chinese planes,
thought to be 6 in number, entered Yangtsepoo district
from the west. Having first made a diversion towards the
south where they dropped a number of bombs on the Pootung
side, afterwards learned to be the A.P.C. premises. They
then continued to Yangtsepoo district where they dropped
several bombs in front of the Gas Co., Yangtsepoo Road.
Still flying in a North East direction the planes dropped
two bombs outside the premises of the China Fibre Container
Co., on Haichow Road. Altering their course towards the
South East the planes then dropped 7 bombs successfully on
the Yue Foong Cotton Mill. Damage to property but no
casualties. The planes then returned and flew over this
station in attempts to hit the Japanese school. Several
bombs were dropped north and south of the school but no
direct hits were scored. Planes then flew north, circled,
and dropped one bomb near the Luis Cazzola school on Hang-
chow Road and one which struck 56 Sungpan Road, the home
of a British subject Meja Singh, eye doctor. In the 2nd
case no casualties were sustained in the house but a male
Chinese on the road was killed.
A hole evidently caused by a bomb was observed on Lay
Road near Ward, nearby which the electric cable had been
out. Throughout the 14th spasmodic rifle and
machine gun fire was heard on the northern boundary.
Between 1 a.m. and 3 a.m. 15/8/37 volume of machine gun
fire increased and seemed to be closer.
As far as can be ascertained the following is a list
of persons wounded or killed.

下午4时45分左右，一队中国飞机，估计为6架，从西部进入杨树浦区。它们首先向南佯动，在浦东一侧投下数枚炸弹，后得知目标为 A.P.C.（原文不清，可能指某公司或机构）的房产。随后它们继续飞往杨树浦区，在杨树浦路煤气公司门前投下数枚炸弹。飞机仍向东北方向飞行，在海州路中国纤维容器公司（China Fibre Container Co.）门外投下两枚炸弹。随后改变航向朝东南方向，飞机成功在裕丰纱厂投下7枚炸弹。造成财产损失，但无人员伤亡。随后飞机返回，飞越本巡捕房上空，试图袭击日本学校。数枚炸弹投在学校南北两侧，但未直接命中。随后飞机向北飞行，盘旋，在杭州路路易斯·卡佐拉学校（Luis Cazzola school）附近投下一枚炸弹，另一枚击中松潘路56号，这是英国籍民、眼科医生 Meja Singh 的住所。在后一起事件中，屋内无人伤亡，但路上一名中国男子被炸死。
在华德路附近的雷氏路（Lay Road）上发现一个显然由炸弹造成的坑洞，附近电缆中断。整个14日，北部边界传来间歇性的步枪和机枪射击声。1937年8月15日凌晨1时至3时之间，机枪射击音量增加，似乎更近了。

During the morning of the 15/8/37, and throughout
the day a heavy barrage of fire was kept up on Chapei
and Kiangwan Area, and at approximately 9.30 a.m.
Japanese planes were sighted over Chinese Territory
bombing.

At 4.30 p.m. 15/8/37, five Chinese bombing planes
were against seen over Y'poo District, and this time they
dropped about 20 bombs, most of which were dropped at the
rear of this station badly damaging the Dah Kong Japanese
Mill Quarters, and setting fire to a small Chinese village
in rear of same. The S.F.B. attended and were successful
in extinguishing same.

As far as can be ascertained no casualties resulted
from this raid.

During the night and early morning of 16/8/37,
spasmodic rifle machine gun fire from the North of and
around the station was heard, same being attributed to the
Japanese Naval Landing Party carrying out mopping up
operations in and around Ying Ziang Kong Village.

1937年8月15日上午及全天，闸北和江湾地区遭受猛烈炮火轰击，上午9时30分左右，有人看到日本飞机在中国领土上空进行轰炸。

1937年8月15日下午4时30分，五架中国轰炸机再次出现在杨树浦区上空，这次它们投下了约20枚炸弹，大部分投在本巡捕房后方，严重损坏了大康日本纱厂宿舍，并点燃了其后方的一个小中国村庄。上海救火联合会（S.F.B.）到场并成功扑灭火灾。

据查，此次空袭未造成伤亡。

1937年8月16日夜间及清晨，听到来自巡捕房北部及周围地区间歇性的步枪和机枪射击声，这归因于日本海军陆战队在应象港村（Ying Ziang Kong Village，音译）及其周边进行清扫作战。

1937年8月15日下午12:30，总督察格鲁布（Grubb）在巡视该区时，观察到第29号被告正在杨树浦路的商店进行抢劫。他随即被捕并被带往巡捕房，随后由副督察南卡罗（Nancarrow）率领的一队警员前往该区域，逮捕了第1至28号被告，这些人均在雷氏路（Lay Road）与宋潘路（Sungpan Road）之间的杨树浦路抢劫商店时被当场抓获。

下午3:30，由日本警探第49号（J.P.S.49）率领的一队警员逮捕了其余同样从事抢劫活动的被告。

所有被告将于1937年8月16日上午出庭第一特区地方法院，被控违反《中华民国刑法》第321条第(5)款之盗窃罪。

Date August 15, 1937.

Subject Sino-Japanese Hostilities for 24 hours ending 6 a.m. 15/8/37
in Yangtzepoo District.

Made by D.S.I. Crighton Forwarded by [签名] Inspt. O. i/c

Sir,

I beg to report that rifle and machine gun fire continued along all fronts at intervals, throughout the morning of the 15/8/37.

At 9.15 a.m, 14/8/37, a telephone message was received from the Zung Tuh (仁德) Cotton Mill, a Chinese concern, located at 590 Linching Road, to he effect that a Chinese Police constable, on duty at No. 4 Post, Linching and Ward Roads corner, had been arrested by the Japanese Naval Landing Party patrol.

On receipt of this information, the undersigned accompanied by Inspt. Samashima and three Japanese constables proceeded to the post in question and there encountered C.P.C's 466 and 572, the former reporting that at 9 a.m. 14/8/37, he on observing the red light of No. 4 telephone box flashing proceeded in direction of same, but on crossing Ward Road, was immediately stopped by members of Naval Landing Party, who at the point of boyonet forced them back onto Linching and Ward Road Bridge. Enquiries at the Japanese Naval Landing Party Sectional Headquarters located in the Tung Hwa (東華) Cotton Mill quarters revealed that this procedure had been adopted for the personal safety of the C.P.C's in question, who when answering this phone, exposed themselves to strong bullets which at that particular point were coming over from Chinese front lines, said by Japanese Landing Party Authorities, to be within 600 metres of their positions which were then located about 500 yards from the Settlement boundaries.

Everything being amicably settled the party returned to

主题 截至1937年8月15日上午6时的24小时内杨树浦区的中日敌对行动。

由副高级督察赖顿（Crighton）呈报 转呈 [签名] 督察 O. i/c

先生，

谨此报告，1937年8月15日上午，各战线间歇性持续发生步枪和机枪射击。

1937年8月14日上午9:15，接到位于临清路590号的中资企业仁德棉纺厂（Zung Tuh Cotton Mill）的电话留言，称一名在临清路与华德路转角第4号岗亭执勤的中国巡捕被日本海军陆战队巡逻队逮捕。

收到此信息后，卑职会同岛真 inspector（Samashima）及三名日本巡捕前往该岗亭，并在那里遇到了中国巡捕466号和572号，前者报告称，1937年8月14日上午9时，他看到第4号电话亭的红灯闪烁，便朝该方向走去，但在穿过华德路时，立即被海军陆战队成员拦下，后者用刺刀逼迫他们退回到临清路与华德路桥上。在对位于东华棉纺厂（Tung Hwa Cotton Mill）宿舍区的日本海军陆战队分部总部进行查询后得知，采取这一程序是为了相关中国巡捕的人身安全，因为他们在接听该电话时，将自己暴露于强烈的子弹之下，这些子弹当时正从据日本陆战队当局称距离其阵地仅600米的中国前线射来，而其阵地当时位于距租界边界约500码处。

一切得以和平解决后，小队返回

Between 9 and 10 a.m. minor disturbances took place in
the Sung Sing No. 5 and 6 mills located at Ward Road and
Seoul Road respectively. In each instance it was ascertained that trouble originated through management of these mills
being unable to pay wages, owing to the close down of native
banks.
Both cases were settled amicably and no further trouble
was expected.
At about 10.10 a.m. 14/8/37 a flight of five aeroplanes
appeared in this district from the North West and flew
towards the Kung Dah (公大) Cotton Mill. They were seen to
pass over, or near, the Kung Dah Mill, circle over Point
Island and return towards the mill. When returning over
the mill the flight is thought to have dropped 11 bombs, 6
of which took effect and five fell in fields in the vicinity.
Having passed the Kung Dah two of the planes broke away
from the other three and again flew towards the canal, circling, and thence towards the West, evidently making for the
Yue Foong Cotton Mill. At the point of separation one of
the two planes dropped a bomb which fell in a field north east
of the Ewo Brewery. When nearing the Yue Foong these two
planes let fall three bombs, two of which are thought to have
taken effect in the mill. The third bomb fell into the
river about 50 yards west of Tinghai Road bridge causing a
two masted junk to capsize. The 6 occupants of the junk
were picked up by a sampan which attempted to make a landing
at Tongting Road Jetty. One of the two planes, however,

上午9时至10时之间，位于华德路和首尔路（Seoul Road）的

经查实，每次骚乱均起因于这些纱厂的管理层
因华商银行停业而无法支付工资。
两起案件均得到和平解决，预计不会再有进一步麻烦。
1937年8月14日上午10:10左右，五架飞机从西北方向
出现在该区，并向公大棉纺厂（Kung Dah Cotton Mill）飞去。
人们看到它们飞过或靠近公大纱厂，在复兴岛（Point Island）上空盘旋，
然后返回纱厂方向。当飞回纱厂上空时，
该机群被认为投下了11枚炸弹，其中6枚命中，
5枚落在附近的田野里。
飞过公大纱厂后，其中两架飞机与其他三架分离，
再次飞向运河，盘旋，然后向西飞去，显然是飞往
裕丰棉纺厂（Yue Foong Cotton Mill）。在分离点，
两架飞机中的一架投下一枚炸弹，落在怡和啤酒厂东北方向的
一片田野里。当接近裕丰纱厂时，这两架飞机
投下三枚炸弹，其中两枚被认为击中了纱厂。
第三枚炸弹落入定海路桥以西约50码的河中，
导致一艘双桅帆船倾覆。船上的6名乘客
被一艘舢板救起，该舢板试图在通鼎路码头登陆。
然而，这两架飞机中的一架，
