dropped a fourth bomb, intended for the Yue Foong but which
hit the water, about 10 yards away from the sampan, killing
three of the occupants and severely injuring three including
the lao-dah; the only occupant to escape being a small child.
This incident was witnessed by Mr. C.J. Place, S.P.W., who
telephoned for an ambulance which took the injured persons
to Shantung Road Hospital.
The party of three planes meanwhile were flying over the
Japanese Commercial School, adjoining this station, firing
with machine guns at the Japanese post on top of the school,
who replied with anti-air craft guns. The vicinity general-
ly was at this time were appeared with machine gun fire,
several persons subsequently being admitted to the Sacred
Heart Hospital suffering from bullet wounds.
The three planes then went back into Chinese territory
where they were rejoined by the two planes, after which the
five planes returned and attempted to bomb the Dong Shing
Cotton Mill on Yangtszepoo Road. The bombs missed their
objective and fell into the river. Casualties if any, not
ascertained.
The planes again circled the district and were successful
with direct hits on the Shanghai Cotton Mill No. 1 and 2,
Kwangshin Road. The repercussion resulted in all shop fronts
within the vicinity being blown in. Extensive looting sub-
sequently took place in this area necessitating the calling
out of the Reserve Unit. Upon the arrival of the latter
the crowd had already dispersed and no arrests were made.
Police were posted and the fronts boarded up again where
necessary, in many cases by the owners themselves.

投下第四枚炸弹，原意欲攻击“ Yue Foong ”（音译），但落入水中，距舢板约10码处，炸死船上三人，并致包括船老大（lao-dah）在内的三人重伤；唯一逃生的乘客是一名幼童。
此事由上海公共租界工部局水务处（S.P.W.）的 C.J. Place 先生目击，他电话呼叫救护车，将伤者送往山东路医院。
与此同时，三架飞机组成的编队飞越紧邻本分局的日本商业学校上空，用机枪向该校顶部的日军哨所射击，日军则以高射炮还击。当时附近地区普遍遭受机枪扫射，随后有数人因枪伤被送入圣心医院。
这三架飞机随后返回中国领土，与另外两架飞机汇合，之后五架飞机再次返回，试图轰炸杨树浦路上的“ Dong Shing ”（音译）棉纺厂。炸弹未击中目标，落入河中。伤亡情况（如有）尚未查明。
飞机再次在该区域盘旋，并成功直接命中位于光新路的第一和第二上海棉纺厂。爆炸冲击波导致附近所有店铺的门面被震毁。随后该区域发生了大规模的抢劫，致使后备队（Reserve Unit）出动。待后备队抵达时，人群已散去，无人被捕。警方部署了岗哨，并在必要时由店主自行将店面重新 boarded up（封板）。

At approximately 4.45 p.m. a flight of Chinese planes,
thought to be 6 in number, entered Yangtszepoo district
from the west. Having first made a diversion towards the
south where they dropped a number of bombs on the Pootung
side, afterwards learned to be the A.P.C. premises. They
then continued to Yangtszepoo district where they dropped
several bombs in front of the Gas Co., Yangtszepoo Road.
Still flying in a North East direction the planes dropped
two bombs outside the premises of the China Fibre Container
Co., on Haichow Road. Altering their course towards the
South East the planes then dropped 7 bombs successfully on
the Yue Foong Cotton Mill. Damage to property but no
casualties. The planes then returned and flew over this
station in attempts to hit the Japanese school. Several
bombs were dropped north and south of the school but no
direct hits were scored. Planes then flew north, circled,
and dropped one bomb near the Luis Cazzola school on Hang-
chow Road and one which struck 56 Sungpan Road, the home
of a British subject Meja Singh, eye doctor. In the 2nd
case no casualties were sustained in the house but a male
Chinese on the road was killed.

A hole evidently caused by a bomb was observed on Lay
Road near Ward, nearby which the electric cable had been
cut. Throughout the 14th spasmodic rifle and
machine gun fire was heard on the northern boundary.
Between 1 a.m. and 3 a.m. 15/8/37 volume of machine gun
fire increased and seemed to be closer.

As far as can be ascertained the following is a list
of persons wounded or killed.

下午约4时45分，一队中国飞机（据信为6架）从西部进入杨树浦地区。它们首先向南佯动，在浦东一侧投下数枚炸弹，后得知被炸地点为 A.P.C. （音译）的房产。随后它们继续飞往杨树浦地区，在杨树浦路煤气公司门前投下数枚炸弹。飞机仍向东北方向飞行，在海州路中国纤维容器公司（China Fibre Container Co.）门外投下两枚炸弹。随后改变航向朝东南方向，成功在“ Yue Foong ”（音译）棉纺厂投下7枚炸弹。造成财产损失，但无人员伤亡。随后飞机返航，飞越本分局上空，试图袭击日本学校。数枚炸弹投在学校南北两侧，但未直接命中。飞机随后向北飞行，盘旋后在杭州路路易斯·卡佐拉学校（Luis Cazzola school）附近投下一枚炸弹，另一枚击中宋潘路56号，这是英国籍臣民、眼科医生 Meja Singh 的住所。在后一起事件中，屋内无人伤亡，但路上一名中国男子被炸身亡。

在 Ward 路附近的 Lay 路上发现一个显然由炸弹造成的弹坑， nearby （原文不清/附近）的电缆被切断。整个14日，北部边界断断续续传来步枪和机枪声。1937年8月15日凌晨1时至3时之间，机枪火力增强，且听起来距离更近。

据查明的情况，伤亡人员名单如下。

During the morning of the 15/8/37, and throughout
the day a heavy barrage of fire was kept up on Chapei
and Kiangwan Area, and at approximately 9.30 a.m.
Japanese planes were sighted over Chinese Territory
bombing.

At 4.30 p.m. 15/8/37, five Chinese bombing planes
were against seen over Y'poo District, and this time they
dropped about 20 bombs, most of which were dropped at the
rear of this station badly damaging the Dah Kong Japanese
Mill Quarters, and setting fire to a small Chinese village
in rear of same. The S.F.B. attended and were successful
in extinguishing same.

As far as can be ascertained no casualties resulted
from this raid.

During the night and early morning of 16/8/37,
spasmodic rifle machine gun fire from the North of and
around the station was heard, same being attributed to the
Japanese Naval Landing Party carrying out mopping up
operations in and around Ying Ziang Kong Village.

1937年8月15日上午及全天，闸北和江湾地区遭受猛烈炮火轰击，上午约9时30分，有人目睹日本飞机在中国领土上空进行轰炸。

1937年8月15日下午4时30分，五架中国轰炸机再次出现在杨树浦地区上空，此次投下约20枚炸弹，其中大部分投在本分局后方，严重损坏了大康（Dah Kong）日本工厂宿舍，并点燃了其后方的一个小中国村庄。上海救火会（S.F.B.）到场并成功扑灭火灾。

据查明，此次空袭未造成人员伤亡。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc. File No. 191/37.
8039
Yangtsepoo Station, 37
REPORT
Date. 14th. August. 19 37.

Subject......Sino-Japanese Hostilities break out in Yangtsepoo Dist.

Made by......D.S.I. Crighton................Forwarded by...[Signature]...Officer i/c.

Sir,
I beg to report, that from early morning 13/8/37, the
Japanese Naval Landing Party carried out extensive prepar-
ations on the Northern boundary of this district.
At 10-30 a.m. 13/8/37, information was received that the
Japanese Naval Landing Party were advancing into Chinese
territory, and subsequent enquires revealed this to be true,
i.e. it was found that they had erected sand-bag emplacements
and barbed wire entanglements inside Chinese territory about
500 yards from the Settlement boundaries.
At 3-30 p.m. information was received to the effect that
the Naval Landing Party occupying positions North of Ward
Road had opened fire with machine guns and rifles .
Subsequent enquiries revealed that at approximately 3.15 p.
m. a machine gun post located inside Chinese territory, 500
yards north of Ward and Ningkuo Roads corner had fired several
bursts of machine gun fire. This firing gradually spread
along the northern boundary and eventually at approximately
4.30 p.m. several bullets were heard to pass over and into
the Yangtsepoo District.
At 4.30 p.m. a report was received that the Landing Party
had mounted a field battery on a piece of vacant ground, 200
yards east of Yangtsepoo Station off Pingliang Road. This
battery consisting of four light field guns opened fire into
Chinese territory at approximately 5 p.m. and continued
firing at intervals of about, at first 5 minutes, and later
3 minutes until approximately 7 p.m.. Observations from
the roof of Yangtsepoo Station revealed that the objective
of above firing was Civic Centre and Ying Ziang Kong

（左侧批注：C.D. / Cht / S.I. / D.B.R. / 14/8）

杂项档案号 191/37。
8039
杨树浦分局，37
报告
日期：1937年8月14日。

事由......中日敌对行动在杨树浦地区爆发。

制作人......副巡官 Crighton................转呈人...[签名]...主管警官。

先生，
谨此报告，自1937年8月13日清晨起，日本海军陆战队在本区北部边界进行了大规模的准备工作。
1937年8月13日上午10时30分，收到情报称日本海军陆战队正推进至中国领土，随后的调查证实了这一情况，即发现他们在距离租界边界约500码的中国领土内构筑了沙袋工事和铁丝网障碍物。
下午3时30分，收到情报称，占据 Ward 路以北阵地的海军陆战队已使用机枪和步枪开火。随后的调查显示，下午约3时15分，位于 Ward 路与宁国路拐角以北500码处中国领土内的一个机枪哨所发射了数次机枪点射。这种射击逐渐沿北部边界蔓延，最终在下午约4时30分，听到数发子弹飞过并落入杨树浦地区。
下午4时30分，收到报告称，登陆部队在平凉路旁、距杨树浦分局以东200码的一块空地上架设了一组野战炮兵阵地。该炮兵连由四门轻型野战炮组成，于下午约5时向中国领土开火，并持续间歇性射击，起初间隔约5分钟，后来改为3分钟，直至下午约7时。从杨树浦分局屋顶观察发现，上述炮击的目标是市中心和 Ying Ziang Kong （音译）

（左侧批注：C.D. / Cht / S.I. / D.B.R. / 14/8）

District. Several direct hits were made upon the Government
surrounding buildings in Civic Centre.
Between 7 and 9 p.m. 13/8/37, spasmodic bursts of rifle
and machine gun fire by both sides continued along all fronts.
At 8.30 p.m. 13/8/37 a huge fire was seen in vicinity of
Kung Dah Cotton Mills, Pingliang and Liping Roads corner,
however subsequent enquiries revealed same to have originated
amongst a number of straw huts approximately half a mile to
the rear of this mill in Chinese Territory, off Military Rd.
The S.F. Brigade turned out in response to this call giving
the location as Pingliang and Linching Roads corner, however
on finding same to be in Chinese territory, they returned to
Yangtsepoo Station without functioning.
Simultaneously to above, another conflagration was seen
in the vicinity of Ward Road, but as in the former instance
enquiries revealed same to have originated in a straw hut
settlement north of Ward Road, 300 yards west of Ningkuo
Road inside Chinese territory.
Endeavours were made to ascertain the origin of these
fires but without result.
Throughout the night machine gun and rifle fire was
heard at intervals and at approximately 4 a.m. 14/8/37 the
field gun battery located off Pingliang Road again went into
action.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
John Crighton
D. S. P.

地区。市中心周围的政府建筑遭受数次直接命中。
1937年8月13日晚7时至9时之间，双方在各条战线上持续发生断断续续的步枪和机枪交火。
1937年8月13日晚8时30分，在平凉路与黎平路拐角处的公大（Kung Dah）棉纺厂附近发现大火，然而随后的调查显示，火源起源于中国领土内、军路（Military Rd.）旁、该厂后方约半英里处的一群草棚。上海救火队（S.F. Brigade）响应呼叫出动，给出的位置是平凉路与临清路拐角，但发现该地处于中国领土内后，他们未采取行动便返回杨树浦分局。
与此同时，在 Ward 路附近也观察到另一场大火，但如前例一样，调查显示火源起源于中国领土内、 Ward 路以北、宁国路以西300码处的一处草棚聚居区。
曾试图查明这些火灾的起因，但无结果。
整夜间断断续续听到机枪和步枪声，1937年8月14日凌晨约4时，位于平凉路旁的野战炮兵连再次投入战斗。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，
John Crighton

1937年10月22日。

下午5时35分。来自亚历山大先生（英国驻上海总领事馆）
据悉有炸弹落在宝隆医院附近，贵处是否有相关情报？

下午5时36分。经查询，新闸回复如下。
今日下午4时20分，一枚锡罐装燃烧弹落在新闸路南侧，距浜边两英尺，迈尔伯勒路以西25码处。无人死亡。25人因烧伤受伤。3辆人力车被完全烧毁，3辆部分烧毁。据信该炸弹系由飞机投掷。
（已据此通知亚历山大先生）。

下午6时05分。空袭（下午6时10分解除）

下午6时40分。来自新闸。
今日下午5时至6时之间，受雇于马克姆路堆栈的500名公共工程局（P.W.D.）苦力领取了应付工资。未发生任何意外事件。

下午10时45分。沃德路与梅周路发生炸弹爆炸，引燃一家华人拥有的工厂；损失程度不明。

October 22, 1937.

5.35 p.m. From Mr. Alexander (H.B.M. Consulate-General).
Have you any information on the bomb which I hear
has fallen near the Paulum Hospital.

5.36 p.m. From Sinza upon enquiry.
At 4.20 p.m. today a tin cannister incendiary bomb
fell on the south side of Sinza Road two feet from
the creek and 25 yards west of Myburgh Road. No
one killed. 25 persons injured by burns. 3
ricshas completely destroyed by fire and three partial-
ly burned. The bomb is believed to have been dropped
from an aeroplane.
(Mr. Alexander informed accordingly).

6.05 p.m. Air Raid (off 6.10 p.m.)

6.40 p.m. From Sinza.
Between 5 p.m. and 6 p.m. today 500 P.W.D. coolies
employed at the Markham Road Depot were paid wages
due. No untoward incident occurred.

10.45 p.m. Bomb exploded at Ward and Meichow Roads setting
fire to Chinese owned factory; extent of damage
unknown.

Air-raids at the following times :
1. 6.02 p.m. to 6.08 p.m.
2. 10.22 p.m. to 10.28 p.m.
3. 11.50 p.m. to 11.55 p.m.
4. 12.13 a.m. to 12.19 a.m. Oct. 23.

West Hongkew reports shelling of the Paoshan Road
area during the night. At 3.30 a.m. machine gun
fire became brisk, otherwise, a quiet night.

1937年10月22日。

下午5时35分。来自亚历山大先生（英国驻上海总领事馆）。
据悉有炸弹落在宝隆医院附近，贵处是否有相关情报？

下午5时36分。经查询，新闸回复如下。
今日下午4时20分，一枚锡罐装燃烧弹落在新闸路南侧，距浜边两英尺，迈尔伯勒路以西25码处。无人死亡。25人因烧伤受伤。3辆人力车被完全烧毁，3辆部分烧毁。据信该炸弹系由飞机投掷。
（已据此通知亚历山大先生）。

下午6时05分。空袭（下午6时10分解除）

今日下午5时至6时之间，受雇于马克姆路堆栈的500名公共工程局（P.W.D.）苦力领取了应付工资。未发生任何意外事件。

下午10时45分。沃德路与梅周路发生炸弹爆炸，引燃一家华人拥有的工厂；损失程度不明。

虹口西区报告夜间炮击宝山路地区。凌晨3时30分，机枪射击变得密集，此外，夜间平静。

October 21:

8.40 p.m. - Both Hongkew and West Hongkew report heavy shelling
and machine gun fire in vicinity of North Station
and Jukong Road near Railway.

9.10 p.m. - S.V.C. Observation Post reports:
Japanese warships upstream are shelling the Pootung
side and Chinese batteries are replying. Japanese
appear to be attacking in the vicinity of Jukong
Road near the railway. North Station is being shelled.

10.30 p.m. - Yulin Road reports:
Bombs have been dropped in vicinity of Tsitsihar Road
near Tanyang Road.

10.45 p.m. - F.S. Brand (Waterworks Sub-Station) reports:
When the Chinese planes raided at 10.20 p.m., the
Japanese put up an extensive smoke screen, apparently
to protect their airfield on the Military Road.

11.15 p.m. - Central News Agency via North China Daily News reports
Chinese military authorities admit retreat from
Dasang.
pages.zh:
电话消息
8039#
J4 10 37

10月21日：

晚上8时40分 - 虹口及虹口西区均报告北站附近及铁路附近的鞠恭路一带发生猛烈炮击和机枪射击。

晚上9时10分 - 上海志愿队（S.V.C.）观察哨报告：
上游的日本军舰正在炮击浦东一侧，中国炮台予以还击。日军似乎在铁路附近的鞠恭路一带发动进攻。北站正遭受炮击。

晚上10时30分 - 榆林路报告：
炸弹已投掷在坦阳路附近的齐齐哈尔路一带。

晚上10时45分 - F.S. Brand（自来水厂分站）报告：
当中国飞机于晚上10时20分进行空袭时，日军施放了大面积烟幕，显然是为了保护其位于军工路的机场。

晚上11时15分 - 中央通讯社通过《字林西报》报道
中国军方承认从大场撤退。

7.25 p.m. from C.C.R.
Air raid on 6.57 p.m. - off at 7.25 p.m.
9.50 p.m. October 17, from Y'poo through C.C.R.
During the air raid at 7 p.m. this evening,
several bombs were dropped in the Yangtszepoo district
three of which have been ascertained as follows :-
(1) One bomb struck a coal heap at the Asia
Steel Factory, 379 Hochien Road. No damage.
(2) One bomb landed on a piece of vacant ground
ten yards in rear of the Dai-Ichi Silk
Works, a Japanese concern situated at 479
Hochien Road - no damage.
(3) One bomb struck a two-storey building on
the south-east corner of the 7th Day
Adventist Mission compound, 525 Ningkuo Road
- completely gutted by fire.

10月17日晚上9时50分，来自杨树浦，经中央无线电接收站（C.C.R.）转达。
在今晚7时的空袭期间，杨树浦区投下了数枚炸弹，其中三枚的情况已查明如下：-
(1) 一枚炸弹击中合兴路379号亚洲钢铁厂的煤堆。无损坏。
(2) 一枚炸弹落在合兴路479号日本企业第一制丝厂后方十码的一块空地上 - 无损坏。
(3) 一枚炸弹击中宁国路525号基督复临安息日会传教团大院东南角的一栋两层建筑 - 被大火完全烧毁。

October 16, 1937.

During the night of the 15/16, the usual
machine gun and rifle firing has been heard in the
Paoshan-Paoshing Road area by West Hongkew Station.
Firing of a similar nature has also been heard to
the North of Wayside District. Gunfire was heard
coming from the Whangpoo and a number of shells passed
over Wayside Station going in a northerly direction.

A Chinese battery located in the vicinity
of Markham Road Yards (?) has shelled the Hongkew
area, while between 3.25 a.m. and 3.42 a.m. shells
were heard to explode in the vicinity of Hongkew
Station; damage has not yet been ascertained.

At 5.20 a.m., Japanese planes bombed the
Haskell-Paoshan Roads locality and the North Railway
Station.

X
C 16/10

8039A

1937年10月16日。

在15/16日夜间，虹口西区警署听到宝山-宝兴路地区有常规的机枪和步枪射击声。界路以北也听到类似性质的射击声。听到枪声来自黄浦江，并有数发炮弹越过界路警署向北方向飞去。

位于马克姆路车场(?)附近的一处中国炮兵阵地向虹口地区开炮，而在凌晨3时25分至3时42分之间，听到炮弹在虹口警署附近爆炸；损失情况尚未查明。

凌晨5时20分，日本飞机轰炸了哈斯克尔路-宝山路一带及北火车站。

5.56 p.m. from D.S. Henchman through C.C.R.
A shell has landed at the corner of Peking and Szechuen
Roads.

6 p.m. - air raid. Off 6.07 p.m.

6.08 p.m. Air raid again. Off 6.26 p.m.

6.30 p.m. from French Police
An anti-aircraft shell has fallen on Rue Eugene Bard,
wounding a small boy.

6.32 p.m. - Air Raid. Off 6.43 p.m.
6.53 p.m. - air raid. Off 6.58 p.m.

7 p.m. from D.S. Duke, Y'poo
No fires can be observed as a result of the air raids.
7 or 8 bombs have been dropped, some to the west and some to
the east of the Station. Clouds of dust are rising to the west.
Shells have fallen near the Egg Company and four have fallen
behind the Japanese School from Pootung.

7.13 p.m. from D.S. Duke, Y'poo
We have received information that two bombs fell between
the Gas Company and the Soap Works, 15 yards apart and 3 yards
from Yangtsepoo Road.
pages.zh:
1937年10月14日。

下午5时40分 来自D.S. Henchman，经中央无线电接收站（C.C.R.）转达。
中方正对虹口及狄思威路进行猛烈炮击。

下午5时45分 来自D.S. Henchman，经中央无线电接收站（C.C.R.）转达。
四发炮弹从闸北落在虹口警署附近 - 百老汇大厦附近也有炮击。

下午5时55分 来自D.S. Henchman，经中央无线电接收站（C.C.R.）转达。
一发炮弹落在乍浦路桥及华邮局附近。

下午5时56分 来自D.S. Henchman，经中央无线电接收站（C.C.R.）转达。
一发炮弹落在北京路与四川路路口。

下午6时 - 空袭。下午6时07分解除。

下午6时08分 再次空袭。下午6时26分解除。

下午6时30分 来自法国警察
一枚高射炮弹落在欧仁·巴尔路（Rue Eugene Bard），一名小男孩受伤。

下午6时32分 - 空袭。下午6时43分解除。
下午6时53分 - 空袭。下午6时58分解除。

晚上7时 来自D.S. Duke，杨树浦
空袭后未观察到火灾。投下了7或8枚炸弹，一些落在警署西侧，一些落在东侧。西侧扬起尘土云。炮弹落在蛋品公司附近，另有四发从浦东飞来，落在日本学校后方。

晚上7时13分 来自D.S. Duke，杨树浦
我们收到情报，两枚炸弹落在煤气公司与肥皂厂之间，相距15码，距杨树浦路3码。

pages.en:
- 2 -
October 14, 1937.

7.23 p.m. from D.S. Duke, Ypoo.
One bomb fell in the Shanghai Power Company coal dump.
One Chinese was slightly injured and was attended to on the
spot without necessity for ambulance.

9 p.m. from French Police
It is reported that Chinese troops have reached Darroch
Road and Tsang Chuen Road, east of the Japanese Public School.

9.52 p.m. from D.S. Duke, Yangtazepoo.
The Shanghai Power Company have notified us that they
have been in touch with Mayor O.K. Yui in regard to the bombing
this evening of the Company's coal yard. Mayor Yui expressed
concern and desires in conjunction with Power Company officials
to suppress newspaper reports of the occurrence. P.A. to D.C.
(Special Branch) informed.

9.55 p.m.
Air raid - 10.05 p.m. all clear.

10.02 p.m. from French Police
Information has been received that 20 Chinese planes took
part in the air raids over the Shanghai area between 6 p.m. and
7 p.m. this evening.

10.57 p.m.
Air-raid - 11.05 all clear.

October 15, 1937.

2.47 a.m.
Air raid.

2.55 a.m.
Air raid.

3.35 a.m.
Air raid.
pages.zh:
- 2 -
1937年10月14日。

晚上7点23分，来自杨树浦（Ypoo）的杜克副巡官（D.S. Duke）。
一枚炸弹落在上海电力公司煤堆处。
一名华人受轻伤，在现场接受了救治，无需救护车。

晚上9点，来自法国警察署。
据报，中国军队已抵达日本公立学校以东的达罗克路（Darroch Road）和藏春路（Tsang Chuen Road）。

晚上9点52分，来自杨树浦（Yangtazepoo）的杜克副巡官。
上海电力公司通知我们，他们已就今晚该公司煤场遭轰炸一事与俞鸿钧（O.K. Yui）市长取得联系。俞市长表示关切，并希望与电力公司官员共同压制有关此事的报纸报道。已通知警务助理处长（特别科）。

晚上9点55分。
空袭——晚上10点05分解除警报。

晚上10点02分，来自法国警察署。
收到情报称，今晚6点至7点间，有20架中国飞机参与了对上海地区的空袭。

晚上10点57分。
空袭——晚上11点05分解除警报。

1937年10月15日。

凌晨2点47分。
空袭。

凌晨2点55分。
空袭。

凌晨3点35分。
空袭。

pages.en:
October 16, 1937.

During the night of the 15/16, the usual
machine gun and rifle firing has been heard in the
Paoshan-Paoshing Road area by West Hongkew Station.
Firing of a similar nature has also been heard to
the North of Wayside District. Gunfire was heard
coming from the Whangpoo and a number of shells passed
over Wayside Station going in a northerly direction.

A Chinese battery located in the vicinity
of Markham Road Yards (?) has shelled the Hongkew
area, while between 3.25 a.m. and 3.42 a.m. shells
were heard to explode in the vicinity of Hongkew
Station; damage has not yet been ascertained.

At 5.20 a.m., Japanese planes bombed the
Haskell-Paoshan Roads locality and the North Railway
Station.
pages.zh:
1937年10月16日。

在15日至16日夜间，西虹口车站附近的宝山-宝兴路（Paoshan-Paoshing Road）地区听到了惯常的机枪和步枪射击声。在韦赛德（Wayside，即周家嘴）区以北也听到了类似性质的枪声。听到枪声来自黄浦江，并有数发炮弹越过韦赛德车站向北方飞去。

位于马卡姆路（Markham Road）货场（？）附近的一处中国炮兵阵地向虹口地区开炮，而在凌晨3点25分至3点42分之间，听到炮弹在虹口车站附近爆炸；损失情况尚未查明。

凌晨5点20分，日本飞机轰炸了哈斯克尔路（Haskell Road）-宝山路一带及北站。

pages.en:
October 12 ,1937.
8039 A
15 10 3

2 a.m. Chinese batteries in Pootung heavily shelled
the Eastern District throughout the night.
Japanese warships carried out a heavy
bombardment in Pootung.
Sporadic machine gun, hand grenade and rifle
fire on Paoshan Road and vicinity throughout
the night.
Stations report all quiet.
pages.zh:
1937年10月12日。
8039 A
15 10 3

凌晨2点。浦东的中国炮兵阵地在整个夜间猛烈炮击东区。
日本军舰对浦东进行了猛烈轰击。
整夜在宝山路及其附近地区有零星的机枪、手榴弹和步枪射击声。
各警署报告一切平静。

pages.en:
8039A
15 10 37

October 13, 1937
Chinese Dramatic and Choral Group broadcast of songs and
news between 7 and 8 p.m.:- Nothing objectionable.

October 14, 1937
6.30 a.m. Yangtszepoo:- Very quiet during night.

Yulin Road ) :- Machine gun fire, hand grenade
Wayside    )    and trench mortar reports heard
               beyond Northern boundary between
10.30 p.m. and 12 m.n.

Hongkew:- A few shells heard going over the
          Station from Japanese naval ships in
Whangpoo in direction of Chapei. Not known if
any damage done in District. Intermittent
machine gun fire heard on river from 4 a.m. to
5.30 a.m.

7.20 a.m. From C.C.R. Hongkew reports that during the
night shells fell at Haining and Woosung Roads'
corner and on Chapoo Road at Boone Road and
also at Range Roads' corner. No fires started.
No one injured. Damage at present unknown.
pages.zh:
8039A
15 10 37

1937年10月13日
中国戏剧合唱团在晚上7点至8点广播歌曲和新闻：无不当内容。

1937年10月14日
早上6点30分，杨树浦：夜间非常平静。

榆林路 ）：在北部边界以外，于晚上
韦赛德   ） 10点30分至午夜12点之间，听到机
             枪射击声、手榴弹爆炸声和战壕迫
             击炮发射声。

虹口：听到数发炮弹从黄浦江上的日本军舰
      射过车站，方向朝向闸北。不知区内是
      否有受损情况。凌晨4点至5点30分，听
      到江面上有间歇性的机枪射击声。

早上7点20分。来自中央无线电室（C.C.R.）。虹口报告称，夜间炮弹落在海宁路与吴淞路转角处，以及乍浦路与本恩路（Boone Road）交界处，还有兰路（Range Roads）转角处。未引发火灾。无人受伤。目前损失不明。

pages.en:
8039A
October 10, 1937.

10.10 p.m. News broadcast moderate.
12 m.n. (From C.C.R.) Between 10.30 p.m. and 12 m.n.
Hongkew and Wayside Districts have been shelled from
the direction of Pootung.
From West Hongkew. Spasmodic rifle, machine
gun and trench motar fire heard in Paoshan Road area
all night. Pootung was subjected to shell fire
by the Japanese between 8 p.m. and 12 m.n. No
one so far ascertained to have been injured and
damage so far unknown.
Northern area satisfactory with Chinese troops
still in vicinity of North Station area. The
Royal Ulster Rifles relieved the Welch Fusilier at
2 p.m. yesterday in the North Honan Road area.
Other stations report all quiet during the
night.
pages.zh:
8039A
1937年10月10日。

晚上10点10分。新闻广播适中。
午夜12点。（来自中央无线电室）晚上10点30分至午夜12点之间，
虹口和韦赛德区遭到来自浦东方向的炮击。
来自西虹口。整夜在宝山路地区听到零星
的步枪、机枪和战壕迫击炮射击声。浦东在晚
上8点至午夜12点之间遭受日军炮击。迄今
未发现有人受伤，损失情况尚不清楚。
北部地区情况良好，中国军队仍位于北站
地区附近。皇家阿尔斯特步枪队（Royal Ulster Rifles）于昨
日下午2点在河南北路地区接替了威尔士燧发枪团
（Welch Fusilier）。
其他警署报告夜间一切平静。

pages.en:
October 9, 1937.

3.50 p.m. from Louza
Two Chinese youths in possession of anti-Japanese
posters are now detained in Louza Station.
Advised to take full particulars, confiscate posters
and to dispose of the youths by escorting them over the
boundary.

6.40 p.m. from Sinza
A number of anti-Japanese posters were found posted
on walls on Wenchow and Sinza Roads. Posters read :-
"Down with Japanese Imperialism"
"Tyrant of the East"

6 p.m. from Lookout Watch
Japanese shelling vicinity of Paoshan and Jukong
Roads, also area south of Musieh Guild and Markham Road Yards.
Chinese battery shelling Dixwell and Kashing Roads
area.
A Japanese seaplane dropped two bombs in Pootung
half a mile south of N.Y.K. Pootung Wharf.
Japanese warship opposite Jukong Wharf shelling
West Niangwan.
Two Japanese destroyers are now anchored east of
Soochow Creek.
One Japanese destroyer moored alongside the "Idzumo,"
firing a machine gun into Pootung.

7 p.m. from Bubbling Well
One male Chinese arrested for posting anti-Japanese
posters on walls on Sinza Road.
Advised to confiscate posters, take full particulars
and to dispose of the man by escorting him over the boundary.
pages.zh:
1937年10月9日。

下午3点50分，来自老闸捕房。
两名持有反日海报的中国青年现被拘留在老闸捕房。
建议记录详细资料，没收海报，并将这两名青年护送过界处理。

下午6点40分，来自新闸捕房。
在温州路和新闸路的墙壁上发现张贴了许多反日海报。海报内容为：
“打倒日本帝国主义”
“东方暴君”

下午6点，来自瞭望哨。
日军炮击宝山路和橘公路（Jukong Roads，音译）附近，以及吴协公会（Musieh Guild，音译）和马卡姆路货场以南地区。
中国炮兵炮击狄思威路（Dixwell Road）和嘉善路（Kashing Road）地区。
一架日本水上飞机在浦东日本邮船会社（N.Y.K.）浦东码头以南半英里处投下两枚炸弹。
停在橘公码头对面的日本军舰炮击西娘湾（West Niangwan，音译）。
两艘日本驱逐舰现在停泊在苏州河以东。
一艘日本驱逐舰停靠在“出云”号（Idzumo）旁，向浦东进行机枪射击。

晚上7点，来自静安寺捕房。
一名中国男子因在新闸路墙壁上张贴反日海报而被捕。
建议没收海报，记录详细资料，并将该男子护送过界处理。

pages.en:
- 2 -

8.10 p.m. - From Bubbling Well
Referring to last message at 7 p.m. re arrest of male
Chinese for posting anti-Japanese posters, case now appears
more serious as man states that posters obtained from a
National Salvation Association in Yue Zung Li, Yunnan Road,
under the auspices of an officer of the 88th Division.
Apparently many are being distributed. (D.S. Lockwood
investigating)

8.45 p.m. - From Central
One male Chinese was arrested at 8 p.m. for posting
anti-Japanese posters at Canton and Shanse Roads. Posters
read :-
"Celebrate the National Day and Fight to the End!"
"Who is causing the separation of your families
and children?"
Advised to confiscate posters, take full particulars
and to dispose of the man over the boundary.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

晚上8点10分 - 来自静安寺捕房
关于晚上7点最后一条消息中提到的因张贴反日海报而被捕的中国男子一案，现在看来情况更为严重，因为该男子声称海报是从云南路悦众里（Yue Zung Li，音译）的一个救国会获得的，该会由第88师的一名军官主持。显然有许多海报正在分发中。（洛克伍德副巡官 D.S. Lockwood 正在调查）

晚上8点45分 - 来自中央捕房
一名中国男子于晚上8点因在广东路和山西路张贴反日海报而被捕。海报内容为：
“庆祝国庆，抗战到底！”
“是谁造成你们骨肉分离？”
建议没收海报，记录详细资料，并将该男子移送过界处理。

October 8, 1937. 8039 #
9 10 37

12.40 a.m., 8/10/37 from Hongkew

Shells from batteries believed to be situated
in Footung and Chapei are falling in the Station
compound and in surrounding district.

12.50 a.m., 8/10/37 from Hongkew

A shell hit the 6th floor of the Japanese
quarters. Considerable damage to toilet room.
No injuries.
pages.zh:
1937年10月8日。 8039 #
9 10 37

1937年10月8日，凌晨12点40分，来自虹口。

据信位于浦东和闸北的炮兵阵地发射的炮弹正落在警署大院内及周边地区。

1937年10月8日，凌晨12点50分，来自虹口。

一枚炮弹击中日本宿舍的6楼。厕所受损严重。
无人受伤。

pages.en:
8/10/37.

POLICE SITUATION REPORT.
=========================

1. (A) Heavy fighting in the North Station area between
   7.00 pm and 12 m.n. Afterward spasmodic rifle,
   machine gun, hand grenade and trench mortar fire
   in the same locality until dawn.
   (B) None reported.

2. (A) Light field battery in the North Station area shelling
   Hongkew District.
   Heavy field battery in Pootung.
   River - naval guns shelling Pootung area.
   (B) The Hongkew, Wayside and Yulin Road Police Districts
   heavily shelled between 11.30 pm and 1.00 am by a field
   battery located in Pootung.
   Stray bullets fell in West Hongkew District during fighting.
   At 12.40 am today a shell struck the 6th floor of Japanese
   Quarters, Hongkew Station.

3. No casualties at Police Stations. Details regarding
   damage in Police Districts later.

4. Satisfactory.

5. West - unchanged.
   North - no details.
   River - unchanged.
                         ✓
_________________________

All Stations North of Creek reporting all well.
_________________________
pages.zh:
1937年10月8日。

警务情况报告。
=========================

1. (A) 晚上7点至午夜12点，北站地区发生激烈战斗。此后直到黎明，同一地区仍有零星的步枪、机枪、手榴弹和战壕迫击炮射击声。
   (B) 无报告。

2. (A) 北站地区的轻型野战炮兵连向虹口区开炮。
   浦东有重型野战炮兵。
   江面 - 海军舰炮炮击浦东地区。
   (B) 虹口、韦赛德和榆林路警区在晚上11点30分至凌晨1点之间遭到位于浦东的一个野战炮兵连的猛烈炮击。

8.30 p.m. Information received that Tramway employees are congregated in the Tramsheds at Hart Road, and threatening trouble on 6/10/37, due to the fact that the Tramway Company proposes to keep them on a ten days in the month basis instead of 15 days as demanded by the workers.
C.D.I. Sih Tse Liang informed and D.S. Henchman detailed to attend and conduct enquiries.
10.30 p.m. D.S. Henchman, the Reserve Unit, was called out, due to the fact that the workers unlawfully detained two foreign employees of the Tramway Company. Quiet restored, but trouble, probably a strike expected at about 7.a.m. 6/10.37.

October 6, 1937.

6.30 a.m. Yangtsepoo. Air raid by Chinese plane at 4.35 a.m. Not known if any bombs were dropped. Japanese anti-aircraft guns fired but without effecting a hit, as far as is known.
Yulin Road Air raids by Chinese plane or planes between 11.50 p.m. and 12.06 a.m.; 3.23 a.m. and 3.36 a.m.; and 4.26 a.m. and 4.40 a.m. Not known if any bombs were dropped. Japanese anti-aircraft guns were into action on each occasion.
Wayside. During air raid at 6.14 p.m. anti-aircraft shell fragments fell in Station compound. No damage done.
Hongkew. Quiet except for air raids aforesaid.
West Hongkew. District quiet. Machine gun and rifle fire spasmodic in Paoshan Road area throughout night.
From C.C.R. Reserve Unit has been standing by at Bubbling Well since 6.53 a.m. in connection with expected trouble in Hart Road Tram sheds.

October 3, 1937.
9.10 p.m. - (From Overseas Broadcasting Company--XMHC 700 k.c.)
Overseas Broadcasting Company invite free speech
over their radio by anyone who wishes to speak
on the Sino-Japanese undeclared war.

9.15 p.m. - (From Overseas Broadcasting Company) Woman
discoursed at length on the local situation--
purely propaganda in form, giving a resume of
Japan's past relations with China and the conse-
quences of Japanese domination of the North.
The National Salvation Association was China's
reply to Japan's aggression, she stated.
Japanese destruction of Chinese Culture was
discussed: schools and libraries had been wantonly
destroyed. Chinese culture in Manchuria is being
rigidly suppressed. She also referred to the
destruction caused in and near Shanghai and
Japan's violation of treaties, and stated that
China was resisting with all her soul against
great odds and despite the superiority of Japanese
equipments. Greater than this, however, was the
superiority of Chinese morale in fighting for
their existence. China was not fighting only
for her own existence, but for all humanity.
Attention was drawn to Japanese bomb outrages on
British interests in China, such as the bombing
of the motorcar of the British Ambassador, the
sinking of junks in British waters and the stopping
of British ships at sea as well as the destruction
of British property in Shanghai. British people
should do everything possible to put a stop to
Japanese activities in China, she averred. The

晚上9点10分 - （来自海外广播公司--XMHC 700千周）
海外广播公司邀请任何希望就中日未宣战之战发表意见的人士，通过其电台自由发言。

晚上9点15分 - （来自海外广播公司）一名女子详细论述了当地局势——形式上纯属宣传，概述了日本过去与中国的关系以及日本统治华北的后果。她声称，救国会是中国人对日本侵略的回应。
谈及日本对中国文化的破坏：学校和图书馆遭到肆意摧毁。满洲的中国文化正受到严厉压制。她还提到了在上海及其附近造成的破坏以及日本违反条约的行为，并指出，尽管日本装备占优且困难重重，中国仍全心全意地进行抵抗。然而，比这更重要的是中国人为生存而战所表现出的高昂士气。中国不仅为自身的生存而战，也是为全人类而战。
她提请注意日本针对在华英国利益的轰炸暴行，例如轰炸英国大使的汽车、在英国水域击沉舢板、在海上拦截英国船只以及破坏上海英国的财产。她断言，英国人民应尽一切可能制止日本在中国的活动。该

pages.en:

strike of a British crew on a ship at Hongkong
recently as a protest against Japanese aggression
in China was a most admirable thing.

Signed: Soong Ching-ling
(Madame Sun Yat-sen)

9.40 p.m. - (From Overseas Broadcasting Company) An Englishman,
speaking over X-M-H-C on behalf of the British
Labour Party, urged the British people not to sit
about the local situation
still and do nothing/. He stressed the importance
of international justice and said he was non-
partisan, though Japan, in the opinion of his
party, was the aggressor. Japanese militarists
rode roughshod over the civilian members of the
Japanese Cabinet. He also referred to the
Manchurian outrage which he stated had sabotaged
the League of Nations. He spoke on behalf of
the British Labour Party, he said, and stated that
the views expressed by him were those of his
party in England.

6 p.m. Reported that 20 Japanese marines filtered through an alleyway off Range Road and took the Pantheon Theatre, North Kiangse Road extension with a loss of 6 marines brought down by Chinese machine gun fire. Chinese appeared not to be on the alert. One Chinese soldier found on top of the Theatre was bayoneted.

10.10 p.m. Radio broadcast. Moderate.

12 m.n. Mr. Parker, Reuters, rang through saying that he had received an unconfirmed report to the effect that the Chinese were evacuating the North Station.

6.30 a.m. Station Reports
West Hongkew, Hongkew, Wayside, Yulin Road
and Yangtsepoo Stations report heavy fighting, machine gun
and rifle fire, over a large area adjacent to the Northern
boundary of the Settlement.

West Hongkew Station reports that trench mortars were
in operation in the vicinity of the North Station and that a
howitzer appears to be located ████████ to the rear
(North)of the railway station. At 5.40 a.m. Japanese planes
when passing over the North Station were fired upon by machine guns.
Chinese are digging trenches on the North band of the Soochow
Creek, 100 yards west of Yu Ya Ching Road. The Chinese are also
thought to be laying land mines in this area.

Hongkew Station reports that shells, presumably fired
from batteries in Pootung, fell in the district at approximately
5 a.m.

During the air raids by Chinese aircraft, both Wayside
and Hongkew Stations were hit by shrapnel, no casualties resulted.

Conditions on the Western boundary were quiet during
the night; Japanese Naval guns shelled the Pootung area during
the early morning.

At approximately 2 p.m.10.9.37 the Royal Welch Fusiliers
took over the defence of West Hongkew Sector.

The man, suspected of being a traitor, was uninjured

能否提供刚才在大都会饭店附近爆炸的炸弹的任何详情？
我们目前掌握的唯一详情是，一枚小炮弹（可能由防空炮发射）在福州路靠近江西路处爆炸，致约九人受伤。另一枚小炮弹落在福州路272弄7号房屋附近，但未爆炸。后一种情况无人受伤。

下午9时30分 - 来自新闸巡捕房。
今晚7时45分，一名中国男子由童子军护送至巡捕房，童子军声称从暴民手中救出了该男子。该男子来自新闸路靠近虞洽卿路处。该男子涉嫌为汉奸，但未受伤，经调查证明其为正派公民后，予以释放。

6.30 a.m. Station Reports

West Hongkew, Hongkew, Wayside, Yulin Road
and Yangtszepoo Stations report heavy fighting, machine
gun and rifle fire, over a large area adjacent to the
Northern boundary of the Settlement.

West Hongkew Station reports that trench
mortars were in operation in the vicinity of the North
Station and that a howitzer appears to be located to
the rear (North) of the railway station. At 5.40 a.m.
Japanese planes when passing over the North Station
were fired upon by machine guns. Chinese are digging
trenches on the North band of the Soochow Creek, 100
yards west of Yu Ya Ching Road. The Chinese are also
thought to be laying land mines in this area.

Hongkew Station reports that shells,
presumably fired from batteries in Pootung, fell in the
district at approximately 5 a.m.

During the air raids by Chinese aircraft,
both Wayside and Hongkew Stations were hit by shrapnel,
no casualties resulted.

Conditions on the Western boundary were quiet
during the night; Japanese Naval guns shelled the Pootung
area during the early morning.

上午6时30分 巡捕房报告

西虹口、虹口、汇山、榆林路和杨树浦巡捕房报告，在租界北部边界 adjacent 的大片区域内发生激烈战斗，有机枪和步枪射击声。

西虹口巡捕房报告，战壕迫击炮在北站附近运作，且有一门榴弹炮似乎位于火车站后方（北侧）。上午5时40分，日本飞机飞越北站时遭到机枪射击。中国军队正在苏州河北岸、虞洽卿路以西100码处挖掘战壕。人们认为中国军队也在该区域布设地雷。

虹口巡捕房报告，炮弹（推测由浦东的炮兵连发射）于上午5时左右落入该区。

在中国飞机的空袭期间，汇山和虹口巡捕房均被弹片击中，未造成伤亡。

夜间西部边界情况平静；清晨日本海军炮火轰击浦东地区。

7.45p.m.: Two British sailors were reported missing
at 1 p.m. August 26, from H.M.S. Falmouth while they were
on duty at Nanking Road Jetty. These two men were arrested
on Szechuen Road together with another sailor on leave after
they had fired three shots from their .303 rifle at 6.15 p.m.
to night.

to several telephone calls requiring attention at time of

Attache, Wing Commander Kerby(?), British Air Attache and
Mr. Hall-Patch, Financial Adviser to British Embassy
called at Police Headquarters in connection with examination
by Police of motor car in which the British Ambassador was
wounded. C.D.I. Rose present.

11.15 p.m.: Reference the rumour conveyed to me through
Inspector White i/c Gordon Rd. who was informed by D.O."B"
that 300 Japanese entered premises of Kung Dah Cotton Mill
on Singapore Rd. during afternoon of 26.8.37 and that the same
number alleged to have entered the China-Japan Cotton Mill,
Robison Rd. near Penang Rd. on same date. Enquiries show
that these mills are guarded by units of the S.V.C. and that
the rumour is false.

晚上7点45分：据报道，两名英国水兵于8月26日下午1点
在法尔茅斯号（H.M.S. Falmouth）服役期间，在南京路码头
执勤时失踪。这两名水兵与另一名休假水兵一起，因在今晚
6点15分用其.303口径步枪发射了三发子弹，而在四川路被
逮捕。

晚上10点：由于广播时有数个电话需要处理，未能收听到
电台记者的广播。

晚上10点15分：英国武官洛瓦特-弗雷泽中校（Lieut. Col. Lovat-Fraser）、
英国空军武官柯比联队长（Wing Commander Kerby(?)）以及
英国大使馆财务顾问霍尔-帕奇先生（Mr. Hall-Patch）
来到警察总局，就警方检查英国大使受伤时所乘汽车一事
进行联系。刑事侦缉处主任罗斯（C.D.I. Rose）在场。

晚上11点15分：关于戈登路巡官怀特（Inspector White i/c Gordon Rd.）
向我转达的谣言，他是由“B”区值班警官（D.O."B"）告知，
称300名日本人于1937年8月26日下午进入新加坡路的公大纱厂，
同日另有相同数量的人据称进入靠近槟榔路的罗宾森路的中日纱厂。
经查，这些纱厂由上海志愿团（S.V.C.）部队守卫，该
谣言不实。

pages.en:
11.50p.m.: Central Air Raid Alarm rung. Heavy anti-aircraft
gunfire from Japanese Naval Ships in Whangpoo. Airplane
could not be heard from office.
12.38 a.m. 27.8.37.: From J.S. Kyte, B.W.; The Police at
Bubbling Well understand that no wounded Chinese Soldiers
are to be admitted to the Settlement unless under blanket pass
but the British Military have admitted two truck loads of
wounded soldiers, over Brenan Road railway crossing, one
with 35 men at 7.20 p.m. and one with 30 men about 12 m.n.
all belonging to the 88th Division. It is not known
to which hospital the soldiers were taken or where they received
their wounds. We would like some instructions as the British
Military claim their instructions are to admit the wounded.
Answer: please refer to Supt. MacDermott.
12.m.n. From Pootoo Rd.: Chinese troop train stopped in rear
of Central Mint. Numerous troops alighted. Ammunition, etc.
unloaded.
12.05 a.m. West H'kew : 87 th Division occupying boundaries
of North Thibet Rd. 88th Division in North Station.
2.05 a.m.: Central Air Raid Alarm rung. Drone of aircraft
heard over Whangpoo. Heavy anti-aircraft gun fire from
Japanese Naval ships in the river. Airplanes appeared to
be flying over Central District.
pages.zh:
晚上11点50分：拉响中央防空警报。黄浦江上日本海军舰艇
发出重型高射炮火。办公室内听不到飞机声。
1937年8月27日凌晨12点38分：来自静安寺分局基特（J.S. Kyte, B.W.）；
静安寺警方获悉，除非持有 blanket pass（通用通行证），否则
不得允许受伤的中国士兵进入租界，但英军已在晚上7点20分
和午夜12点左右，经布伦南路铁路道口，接纳了两卡车受伤士兵，
一车35人，另一车30人，均属第88师。不知士兵们被送往哪家
医院，也不知他们在何处受伤。我们需要一些指示，因为英军
声称他们的指令是接纳伤员。
回复：请示麦克德莫特警司（Supt. MacDermott）。
午夜12点，来自普陀路：一列中国军用列车停在中央造币厂后方。
大量士兵下车。弹药等物资被卸下。
凌晨12点05分 西虹口：第87师占据西藏北路边界。第88师在北站。
凌晨2点05分：拉响中央防空警报。听到黄浦江上空有飞机轰鸣声。
江上日本海军舰艇发出重型高射炮火。飞机似乎正飞越中区。

pages.en:
4.20 a.m. From C.C.H.: Ward Road Gaol: 2 shells exploded in
or near the gaol, 5 Indian Warders injured 2 of whom are
seriously wounded.

6 a.m. : Hongkew, Yulin Rd., West Hongkew, Y'poo and Reserve

爆炸，5名印籍狱警受伤，其中2人重伤。

早上6点：虹口、榆林路、西虹口、杨树浦及预备队报告夜间平静。
榆林路和杨树浦认为炸弹落入区内，但尚未核实。虹口、榆林路
和杨树浦报告午夜12点和凌晨2点05分有空袭。

August 30, 1937.

4.15 p.m. from C. C. R.
Shells are falling in the Boone Road area, 200 yards west of North Szechuen Road.

4.50 p.m. from C. C. R.
The shells mentioned in the above report have started a fire at the corner of North Szechuen and Range Roads. The Fire Brigade is not attending as shells are still falling in the area.

7.45 p.m. from C. C. R.
At 6.40 p.m. today a shell exploded in the Elgin Road Market, damaging the roof and injuring three persons.

7.50 p.m. from D.S. Pitts.
A radio message states that the "President Hoover" has been bombed from the air seventy miles out of Shanghai. Extent of damage and nationality of plane unknown.
American Consulate confirm the information; adding that the "President Hoover", whilst en route from Hongkong and Manila, bound for Shanghai where she was to have picked up American refugees, was bombed at 5.40 p.m. today, when 50 miles out of Woosung, by a Chinese aeroplane. No direct hit was scored but three members of the crew were injured and the ship, which has now changed course for Kobe, is holed in several places above the waterline. It is considered however that she should reach her destination safely. H.M.S. "Cumberland" was in attendance. Confirmed by the U.S.S. "Augusta".

10.30 p.m. (Radio Broadcast)
Shanghai Evening News & Mercury Radio Reporter's news broadcast - moderate.
pages.zh:
1937年8月30日。

下午4点15分 来自C. C. R.
炮弹落在布恩路地区，四川北路以西200码处。

下午4点50分 来自C. C. R.
上述报告中提到的炮弹在四川北路与兰路（Range Roads）转角处
引发火灾。消防队未前往扑救，因为该地区仍有炮弹落下。

晚上7点45分 来自C. C. R.
今天下午6点40分，一枚炮弹在埃尔金路市场爆炸，损坏屋顶并
致三人受伤。

晚上7点50分 来自D.S. Pitts。
无线电消息称，“胡佛总统号”（President Hoover）在距上海七十英里处
遭到空中轰炸。受损程度及飞机国籍不明。
美国领事馆证实了这一信息；并补充说，“胡佛总统号”当时正从香港和马尼拉
驶往上海，计划在那里接载美国难民，今天下午5点40分，在距吴淞五十英里处，
被一架中国飞机轰炸。未被直接命中，但三名船员受伤，船体水线以上多处穿孔，
该船现已改变航向前往神户。不过认为其应能安全抵达目的地。坎伯兰号
（H.M.S. "Cumberland"）在旁护卫。奥古斯塔号（U.S.S. "Augusta"）予以证实。

晚上10点30分（无线电广播）
《上海晚邮报与信使报》电台记者新闻广播 - 语气平和。

August 31, 1937. 8039A
8 9 37

5.30 p.m. From C.C.R.
Japanese planes bombing Markham Road junction vicinity.

5.40 p.m.
Japanese army transport lying in mid stream opposite
Japanese Consulate.

5.45 p.m.
Two O.S.K. freighters numbered 22 and 65 have tied up
at the O.S.K. Wharf.

6 p.m.
Big fires still burning at Woosung, Paoshan Road water
tower and Dalny and Yangtszepoo Roads.

6 p.m.
13 Japanese warships are at present in the river.

9.30 p.m. (D.I. Boddy, Sinza)
At 7.45 p.m. this evening U.S. Marines details saw
light signals flashing from the Tien Chien Mill, 1086/40
North Chengtu Road towards a building in Chapel north of the
Soochow Creek. 14 distinct flashes were seen and immediately afte
afterwards answering signals from Chapel were observed. Marines
entered the mill and brought a male Chinese to Sinza Station.
Enquiries on the mill in question by Sinza detectives in conjunct-
ion with Marines showed that a light was being turned on and off
on the top floor of the building. Marines now wish to take this
Chinese away to their Intelligence Office for further questioning.
What shall we do? Hand him over or not? All the evidence
comes from Marine sources.

Answer: (After communicating with C.D.I. Ross)
Let the Marines question him at Sinza Station.
(Captain Boone, U.S.M.C. Intelligence Office, informed)

10.30 p.m.
Radio Reporter's News Broadcast over XMHA contained
nothing of an objectionable nature.

8 9 37

下午5点30分 来自C.C.R.
日本飞机正在轰炸马汉路路口附近。

下午5点40分
一艘日本陆军运输船停泊在日本领事馆对面的江心。

下午5点45分
两艘编号为22和65的大阪商船株式会社（O.S.K.）货轮已系泊在

下午6点
吴淞、宝山路水塔以及大连路和杨树浦路的大火仍在燃烧。

下午6点
目前江上有13艘日本军舰。

晚上9点30分（D.I. Boddy, Sinza）
今晚7点45分，美国海军陆战队分队看到天蟾纱厂（Tien Chien Mill，
成都北路1086/40号）向苏州河北侧的一座教堂建筑发出灯光信号。
观察到14次明显的闪光，随即观察到教堂发出的回应信号。海军陆战队
进入纱厂，并将一名中国男子带至新闸分局。
新闸侦探与海军陆战队联合对该纱厂进行调查，显示该建筑顶层
的灯光正在被开关。海军陆战队现在希望将此中国人带往其情报办公室
进行进一步讯问。我们该怎么办？移交还是不移交？所有证据
均来自海军陆战队方面。

回复：（在与刑事侦缉处主任罗斯沟通后）
让海军陆战队在新闸分局对其进行讯问。
（已通知美国海军陆战队情报办公室布恩上尉（Captain Boone, U.S.M.C. Intelligence Office））

5.30 p.m. From C.D.C. 355.

At 3.50 p.m. to-day Japanese aeroplanes flew over
Jessfield Railway Station area and dropped several bombs,
killing three country people and wounding ten others.

Reference some message Bubbling Well Station reported

Please ask the French Police to arrange to receive
and escort to Nantao, at Avenue Edward VII and Honan Road,
at 5 a.m. 103 refugees arrested during curfew for whom
accommodation in refuges in the Settlement cannot be found.
Reply of French Police please ring up again at 7.45 a.m. when

D.S.I. Logan suggested to S.I. Harper that before

refugees he should consult D.O. "A" early in the morning.

At 2.15 a.m. British troops (Loyals) guarding North

containing parts of gas masks, which was being carried down

下午5时30分。来自中央巡捕房（C.D.C.）355号。

今日下午3时50分，日本飞机飞越兆丰公园火车站（Jessfield Railway Station）区域，投下数枚炸弹，炸死三名乡民，炸伤十人。

据静安寺巡捕房报告的消息，八架飞机向丰田纱厂、松兴二厂及中山路投掷了14至16枚炸弹。一枚炸弹落在兆丰公园铁路桥英军哨所附近15英尺处。

下午6时25分。来自法租界警务处。

十分钟前，日本飞机轰炸南市。一枚炸弹落在凤林角市政府办公处附近。

晚上10时10分至10时25分。《晚邮报》与《字林西报》“广播记者”播报。

温和。

1937年9月2日。

凌晨3时。来自中央情报股哈珀警司（S.I. Harper）。

请设法让法租界警务处安排于上午5时在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）与河南路路口接收并护送103名在宵禁期间被捕的难民前往南市，因在公共租界避难所内无法为其找到安置之处。法租界警务处的回复，请于上午7时45分再次致电询问，届时将给予答复。

洛根副督察（D.S.I. Logan）向哈珀警司建议，在就处置这些难民采取进一步行动之前，他应于清晨咨询“A”区巡官（D.O. "A"）。

凌晨3时30分。来自虹口西区山布鲁克副督察（D.S. Sanbrook）。

凌晨2时15分，守卫西藏北路桥的英军（皇家忠诚团，Loyals）拦截了一艘驳船，该船载有77箱防毒面具部件，正随潮水顺流而下，即将从桥下通过。

stream on the tide as it was about to pass underneath the
bridge. One Chu Hung Pei, manager of the Wah Lee Sze
Machine Co., 112 Route des Soeurs, and one Nyoh Lin Shen,
Station Master, Markham Road Railway Station, who were in
charge of the barge, produced an order issued by the Nanking
Government Authorities and a Release order signed by General
Yang Hu authorizing the release of the materials from the
Markham Road Railway No.1 Godown. These men claimed that
the gas masks were being removed at night time for fear of
Japanese aerial attack, the intention being to have them
towed up the Soochow Creek and thence to Nanking, but that
the tide carried the boat down stream despite their efforts
to secure the barge to the Chinese or North side of the Creek.
The British officer in charge of the area in question took
certain parts of the gas masks away to show to his commanding
officer who is stationed in the Court Buildings, North Soochow
Road, and ordered the detention of the barge pending his
commanding officer's instructions. The crew of the barge
consists of 16 coolies, 2 porters and 1 clerk, all Railway
employees. West Hongkew posted 2 C.P.C's to guard the barge.
It was suggested to D.O. Sanbrook that he should inform his
D.O. as there did not appear to be any grounds for the
detention of the barge. D.O. informed. Replied that he
would go into the matter early in the morning with the
British military.

1937年9月2日。

当时驳船正欲从桥下穿过。负责该驳船的两人，即姐妹会路（Route des Soeurs）112号华利丝机器公司（Wah Lee Sze Machine Co.）经理朱洪培（Chu Hung Pei，音译）以及马克姆路（Markham Road）火车站站长纽林申（Nyoh Lin Shen，音译），出示了一份由南京政府当局签发的命令，以及一份由杨虎将军签署的放行令，授权从马克姆路铁路第一仓库释放这些物资。这些人声称，出于对日本空袭的恐惧，他们正在夜间转移防毒面具，意图将其拖往苏州河上游，进而运往南京；但尽管他们努力将驳船固定在苏州河的中国一侧或北侧，潮水仍将船冲向下游。负责该区域的英军军官取走了部分防毒面具部件，以便向驻扎在北苏州路法院大楼的指挥官展示，并下令扣留该驳船，等候其指挥官的指示。驳船船员包括16名苦力、2名搬运工和1名职员，均为铁路员工。虹口西区派遣了两名中国警务警员（C.P.C's）看守驳船。有人建议山布鲁克副督察通知其上级巡官（D.O.），因为似乎没有任何理由扣留该驳船。已通知巡官。回复称他将于清晨与英军方共同调查此事。

上午5时25分。后备队。
平静。自上午4时起，听到来自江湾方向间歇性的炮击声。

上午5时28分。杨树浦。
上午4时至5时之间，听到来自河中日本舰艇及北火车站附近中国阵地的炮火声。该区其他方面平静。

September 2, 1937.

5.33 a.m. Wayside
District quiet. Between 4 a.m. and 5 a.m. Idzumo
shelled Chapei and Chinese replied also with shellfire.

5.35 a.m. Hongkew
District quiet. Between 4.30 a.m. and 4.50 a.m.
Japanese ship in river bombarded Chapei and Chinese replied
at 5.10 a.m., with 4 shells which passed over the Station
from the direction of Markham Road or North Station towards
the river. Only one was heard to explode.

5.45 a.m. Bubbling Well.
District quiet.

5.48 a.m. Pootoo Road
District quiet. Shells were observed at 4 a.m.
exploding in Chapei near the Soochow Creek opposite Pootoo
Road district
pages.zh:
- 3 -
1937年9月2日。

上午5时33分。外区。
该区平静。上午4时至5时之间，出云号（Idzumo）炮击闸北，中方也以炮火还击。

上午5时35分。虹口。
该区平静。上午4时30分至4时50分之间，河中的日本军舰炮击闸北，中方于上午5时10分还击，发射4枚炮弹，从马克姆路或北火车站方向朝河流飞过车站上空。仅听到一枚爆炸。

上午5时45分。静安寺。
该区平静。

上午5时48分。普陀路。
该区平静。上午4时观察到炮弹在闸北苏州河对面、普陀路区附近爆炸。

pages.en:
Sunday, 29th August 1937.
8039 A
3/ 8 37
3-15 pm (From C.C.R.)
Five Chinese Special Police Constables have been arrested
by the Japanese Naval Landing Party on Broadway Bridge.
Hongkew subsequently confirmed the above adding that the five
Constables were taken to Japanese Police Headquarters on Boone
Road where they were released at 5-30 pm, being escorted to the
Settlement South of the Creek via the Garden Bridge. Their
mission is believed to have been one of curiosity only.

Monday, 30th August 1937.

12.15 a.m. (From C.C.R.)
We have received a message from the Telephone Company
to the effect that intermittent sniping is going on from a
lumber yard at the corner of Yangtszepoo Road and Lay Road.
Yangtszepoo Station has been informed.
1 a.m. (From C.C.R.)
There are aeroplanes flying over the Settlement. They
are presumed to be Chinese as warships on the River have
opened fire. (Alarm bell rung: All clear:1.05 a.m.)

2
30 7

1937年8月29日，星期日。
8039 A
3/ 8 37
下午3时15分（来自中央无线电室 C.C.R.）
五名中国特别警察在百老汇大桥被日本海军陆战队逮捕。随后虹口证实了上述情况，并补充说这五名警员被带往蓬路（Boone Road）的日本警察总部，并于下午5时30分获释，经外白渡桥护送至苏州河以南的租界地区。据信他们的任务仅是出于好奇。

1937年8月30日，星期一。

凌晨12时15分。（来自中央无线电室 C.C.R.）
我们收到电话公司的消息，称在杨树浦路与雷氏路（Lay Road）拐角处的一个木材堆场发生间歇性狙击。已通知杨树浦巡捕房。
凌晨1时。（来自中央无线电室 C.C.R.）
有飞机飞越租界上空。推测为中国飞机，因为河上的军舰已开火。（警报铃响：解除警报：凌晨1时05分。）

August 28, 1937.
8039H
30 8 37
7 p.m. All communication by cable from Shanghai has been
destroyed, believed by bombs. Great Northern, Eastern and
Chinese Government Radio.Broadcast by the Overseas Broadcasting
Association Avenue Road Station. Confirmed by cable company.
8.15 p.m. Lieutenant Kulack, enquiring if the S.M.P. could
confirm whether the Kiangnan Arsenal had suffered damage as a
result of bombing raids carried out by Japanese aircraft on the
28-8-37. Answer - According to the report of the French Police,
a part of the Arsenal was destroyed.
8.30 p.m. The following details regarding the bombing of
the Nantao locality by Japanese planes during the afternoon of
the 28-8-37 xxxxxx have been supplied by the French Police:-
1) 2 p.m. - eight bombs dropped on Nantao.
2) 2.50 p.m. - three bombs dropped on Miao Jao Road and Kaochongmiao.
3) Over 200 persons were killed and 400 wounded at the South
Station this afternoon (28-8-37).
4) A few bombs fell on the Dah Deong University, while a part
of the Kiangnan Arsenal has been destroyed.
9.29 p.m. From C.D.I. Ross. Endeavour to ascertain whether
it is true (1) that the Butterfield & Swire steamer, Shinking, has
been held up by the Japanese off Woosung, and (2) that the British
Admiral has protested.
9.35 p.m. To Butterfield & Swire. Requesting confirmation
of the above report. Answer:- We have not been informed of
any such incident. The xxxx China Press and Reuters have also
been enquiring.
9.50 p.m. From Lieutenant-Commander Ryder. I understand
that Japanese naval vessels signalled to the s.s. Shinking last
night (27-8-37) at approximately midnight in order to ascertain
the nationality of the vessel. No further information is
available.
10.15 p.m. Confirmation of the above details received from
H.M.S. Danae.

1937年8月28日。
8039H
30 8 37
晚上7时。上海发出的所有电报通信均被破坏，据信系炸弹所致。大北、大东及中国政府无线电。由海外广播协会爱文义路电台广播。已由电报公司确认。
晚上8时15分。库拉克中尉（Lieutenant Kulack）查询工部局警务处（S.M.P.）能否确认江南兵工厂是否因1937年8月28日日本飞机的轰炸袭击而遭受损失。答复——根据法租界警务处的报告，兵工厂的一部分被毁。
晚上8时30分。法租界警务处提供了关于1937年8月28日下午日本飞机轰炸南市地区的以下细节：
1) 下午2时——八枚炸弹投在南市。
2) 下午2时50分——三枚炸弹投在庙街路和高昌庙。
3) 今天下午（1937年8月28日），南站有超过200人死亡，400人受伤。
4) 几枚炸弹落在大东大学，江南兵工厂的一部分被毁。
晚上9时29分。来自罗斯首席侦探督察（C.D.I. Ross）。设法核实以下情况是否属实：(1) 太古轮船公司的“新金”号（Shinking）轮船在吴淞口外被日本人扣留；(2) 英国海军上将已提出抗议。
晚上9时35分。致太古轮船公司。请求确认上述报告。答复：——我们未获悉任何此类事件。《大美晚报》（China Press）和路透社也在查询。
晚上9时50分。来自赖德少校（Lieutenant-Commander Ryder）。我获悉，日本海军舰艇于昨晚（1937年8月27日）午夜左右向“新金”号轮船发出信号，以查明该船的国籍。暂无更多消息。
晚上10时15分。从英国皇家海军“达那厄”号（H.M.S. Danae）收到对上述细节的确认。

10.22 p.m. From West Hongkew Station. Inspector Trodd
reports that Chinese troops appear to be moving from points
west of North Chekiang Road to the Kiangwan area where fighting
appears to be in progress.

10.35 p.m. The summary of the day's news emanating from
the editorial room of the Shanghai Evening Post and broadcast
over Station XMHA was restrained in character apart from a very
graphic description of the slaughter of defenceless civilians
at the South Station as a result of the bombing by Japanese
aircraft at 1.30 p.m. to-day, 28-8-37. Reference was made to
the condition of H.E. the British Ambassador and to the
impossibility of finding a convincing excuse for attacking a
civilian vehicle, fifty miles from the scene of hostilities.

Between 11 p.m. and 12 m.n., Japanese warships in the
Whangpoo appeared to be shelling Chapei in the vicinity of the
North Station.

August 29, 1937
12.55 a.m. From Mr. V.F. Meisling. Reporting a big
fire in Chapei located between Markham Road Junction and the
North Railway Station.

1.30 a.m. Air raid signal. Japanese anti-aircraft
guns opened fire.

3 a.m. Japanese anti-aircraft guns fired a few rounds.

5.30 to 6 a.m. During the night the situation was
reported as being quiet in all districts with the exception of
the following:-

1) Pootoo Road Station - After 10 p.m. heavy shell bursts
were heard coming from Chapei. Pieces of shrapnel fell in
the district. At 12.30 a.m., an armoured train drew up
by the Ex Foo Fung Flour Mill and fired a few bursts in the
direction of the river, and then departed.

2) West Hongkew Station - Fighting has been going on in the
Kiangwan area; between 9 p.m. and 12 m.n., machine gun and
rifle fire was very heavy, after 12 midnight, the firing
became intermittent.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

晚上10时22分。来自虹口西区巡捕房。特罗德巡官（Inspector Trodd）报告称，中国军队似乎正从浙江北路以西的各点向江湾地区移动，该地区似乎正在进行战斗。

晚上10时35分。源自《上海晚邮报》编辑室并通过XMHA电台广播的当日新闻摘要，除对1937年8月28日下午1时30分日本飞机轰炸导致南手无寸铁的平民被屠杀一事进行了非常生动的描述外，其余内容均保持克制。文中提及了英国大使阁下的状况，并指出对于在距战事现场五十英里处攻击民用车辆的行为，找不到令人信服的借口。

晚上11时至午夜12时之间，黄浦江上的日本军舰似乎在炮击北火车站附近的闸北地区。

1937年8月29日
凌晨12时55分。来自梅斯林先生（Mr. V.F. Meisling）。报告闸北马克姆路交汇处与北火车站之间发生大火。

凌晨1时30分。空袭警报。日本高射炮开火。

凌晨3时。日本高射炮发射数发炮弹。

上午5时30分至6时。夜间据报道各区局势平静，除以下情况外：

1) 普陀路巡捕房——晚上10时后，听到来自闸北的猛烈炮弹爆炸声。弹片落入该区。凌晨12时30分，一列装甲列车停靠在原福丰面粉厂旁，向河流方向发射数排子弹，随后离去。

2) 虹口西区巡捕房——江湾地区一直有战斗；晚上9时至午夜12时之间，机枪和步枪火力非常猛烈，午夜12时后，射击变得间歇性。

3) Yulin Road and Yangtsepoo Stations - Heavy fighting to
the North of the Stations.
4) Hongkew Station - Heavy gunfire has been heard during the
night.
6.30 a.m. From the French Police. Can the S.M.P.
confirm the following:- The Japanese authorities are said
to have warned the Chinese authorities that in view of the
fact that they (the Japanese) intend to shell Nantao, they
have therefore instructed the Chinese authorities to arrange
for the immediate evacuation of the civilian population.

7.45p.m.: Two British sailors were reported missing
at 1 p.m. August 26, from H.M.S. Falmouth while they were
on shore at Nanking Road Jetty. These two men were arrested
on suspicion together with another sailor on leave after
they had fired three shots from their .303 rifle at 8.15 p.m.
to night.

...... : A reporter's broadcast not heard owing
to external noise requiring attention at time of
broadcast.

1.45 a.m. : Lieut. Col. Lovatt-Fraser, British Military
Attache, Wing Commander Neilly (?), British Air Attache and
Mr. Hall-Patch, Financial Adviser to British Embassy
called at Police Headquarters in connection with examination
by Police of motor car in which the British officer was
wounded. C.D.I. also present.

F
11.25 p.m.: Reference the rumour conveyed to me through
Inspector Fite i/c Gordon Rd. who was informed by D.I. "B"
that 300 Japanese entered premises of Kung Da Cotton Mill
on Singapore Rd. during afternoon of 26.3.37 and that the same
number alleged to have entered the China-Japan Cotton Mill,
Robison Rd. near Penang Rd. on same date. Enquiries show
that these mills are guarded by units of the S.V.C. and that
the rumour is false.

1937年8月28日
晚上 7:45：据报道，两名英国水兵于 8 月 26 日下午 1 点在南京路码头上岸时，从 HMS Falmouth 号舰上失踪。这两名人与另一名休假水兵一起，因在今晚 8:15 使用其 .303 步枪发射了三发子弹而被以嫌疑犯身份逮捕。

...... ：由于广播时外界噪音干扰需予关注，未能听清记者的广播。

凌晨 1:45 ：英国武官洛瓦特-弗雷泽（Lovatt-Fraser）中校、英国空军武官奈利（Neilly）少校（?）以及英国大使馆财务顾问霍尔-帕奇（Hall-Patch）先生来到警察总局，就警方检查致使该英国军官受伤的汽车一事进行联系。刑事侦缉处主任亦在场。

F
晚上 11:25：关于通过负责戈登路（Gordon Rd.）的费特（Fite）巡官向我传达的谣言，该巡官系从“B”区督察长处获悉，1937年3月26日下午，300名日本人进入新加坡路（Singapore Rd.）公大纱厂 premises，且同日据说有相同数量的人进入靠近槟榔路（Penang Rd.）罗宾森路（Robison Rd.）的日华纱厂。经查，这些纱厂由上海志愿队（S.V.C.）部队守卫，该谣言不实。

pages.en:
11.50p.m.: Central Air Raid Alarm rung. Heavy anti-aircraft
gunfire from Japanese Naval Ships in Whangpoo. Airplane
could not be heard from office.

12.38 a.m. 27.8.37.: From J.S. Kyte, B.W.; The Police at
Bubbling Well understand that no wounded Chinese Soldiers
are to be admitted to the Settlement unless under blanket pass
but the British Military have admitted two truck loads of
wounded soldiers, over Brenan Road railway crossing, one
with 35 men at 7.20 p.m. and one with 30 men about 12 m.n.
all belonging to the 88th Division. It is not known
to which hospital the soldiers were taken or where they received
their wounds. We would like some instructions as the British
Military claim their instructions are to admit the wounded.
Answer: please refer to Supt. MacDermott.

12.m.n. From Pootoo Rd.: Chinese troop train stopped in rear
of Central Mint. Numerous troops alighted. Ammunition, etc.
unloaded.

12.05 a.m. West H'kew : 87 th Division occupying boundaries
of North Thibet Rd. 88th Division in North Station.

2.05 a.m.: Central Air Raid Alarm rung. Drone of aircraft
heard over Whangpoo. Heavy anti-aircraft gun fire from
Japanese Naval ships in the river. Airplanes appeared to
be flying over Central District.
pages.zh:
晚上 11:50：拉响中央空袭警报。黄浦江上日本海军舰艇发出猛烈的高射炮火。办公室内听不到飞机声。

1937年8月27日 凌晨 12:38。来自 J.S. Kyte，静安寺路：静安寺巡捕房获悉，除非持有 blanket pass（通用通行证），否则不得允许受伤的中国士兵进入租界，但英军已在勃伦纳路（Brenan Road）铁路道口接纳了两卡车受伤士兵，一批 35 人于晚上 7:20 进入，另一批 30 人约在午夜 12 点进入，均隶属第 88 师。尚不知士兵被送往哪家医院或在何处受伤。我们需要一些指示，因为英军声称他们的指令是接纳伤员。
答复：请示麦克德莫特（MacDermott）警司。

午夜 12:00。来自普陀路：中国运兵列车停在中央造币厂后方。大量士兵下车。弹药等物资卸载。

凌晨 12:05。西虹口：第 87 师占据西藏北路边界。第 88 师在北站。

凌晨 2:05：拉响中央空袭警报。听到黄浦江上空有飞机嗡嗡声。江上日本海军舰艇发出猛烈的高射炮火。飞机似乎飞越中区。

pages.en:
4.20 a.m. From C.C.R.: Ward Road Gaol: 2 shells exploded in
or near the gaol, 5 Indian warders injured 2 of whom are
seriously wounded.

6 a.m. : Hongkew, Yulin Rd., West Hongkew, Y'poo and Reserve
Unit report quiet night. Yulin Rd. and Y'poo believe bombs
fell in District but have not checked up. Hongkew, Yulin Rd.
and Y'poo report air raids at 1½ m.n. and 2.05 a.m.
pages.zh:
凌晨 4:20。来自中央无线电室：提篮桥监狱：两枚炮弹在监狱内或附近爆炸，5 名印度狱警受伤，其中 2 人重伤。

早上 6:00 ：虹口、榆林路、西虹口、杨树浦及后备队报告夜间平静。榆林路和杨树浦认为炸弹落入该区，但尚未核实。虹口、榆林路和杨树浦报告凌晨 1:30 和 2:05 有空袭。

AUGUST 24, 1937
8039A
27 8 37

6.30 p.m. (D.I. Toon, Bubbling Well)
The Japanese who was seriously injured in the fracas at
Brenan Piece at about 2.10 p.m. this afternoon, succumbed to
his wounds at 6.25 p.m. in the General Hospital, temporarily
located in the Lester Institute, Avenue Road.

8.40 pm (Radio)
Commencing at 8-10 pm the Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury
Radio reporter, speaking over Station X.M.H.A. (600 k.c.) made
a modest and restrained broadcast of the day's events though,
it was noted, he stated definitely that it was a Japanese
aeroplane which bombed the Missionary Hospital at Tungchow
on August 17th.

9.15 pm (Radio)
Municipal Council broadcast by Mrs Robertson (840 k.c.)
commenced at 9-0 pm and finished at 9-15 pm.

9-51 pm (Air-raid).
Off at 9-57 pm.

9-55 pm (Mr. Amalianoff, French Concession).
The Japanese boats in the river are firing tracer anti-
aircraft missiles at aircraft.

10-35 pm (Mr. Beldon - Newspaper reporter)
We have received information that the 36th and 57th
Divisions are changing position and that the troops in Chapel
in the vicinity of the North Railway Station are retreating.

10-42 pm (C.C.R.)
We have received information from Mr. Beldon that during
the air-raid at 9-51 pm two bombs were dropped in the vicinity
of Hunt's wharf.

Wednesday - 25th August.
12-05 am - Air raid - off at 12-10 am.
12-20.am (Central Station).
At 10-20 pm August 24th a Mr. Nelson, living in room 1201,
Hamilton House, telephoned to Central Station stating that he
had observed the flashes of a signalling lamp on the roof of a
pages.zh:
1937年8月24日
8039A
1937年8月27日

晚上 6:30（“B”区督察长 Toon，静安寺路）
今天下午约 2:10 在勃伦纳地块（Brenan Piece）冲突中受重伤的那名日本人，于晚上 6:25 在临时设于爱文义路（Avenue Road）雷士德工学院（Lester Institute）的广慈医院伤重不治。

晚上 8:40（无线电）
从晚上 8:10 开始，《上海晚邮报与信使报》无线电记者通过 X.M.H.A. 电台（600 千周）进行了适度且克制的当日事件广播，不过，值得注意的是，他明确指出，8月17日轰炸通州教会医院的是一架日本飞机。

晚上 9:15（无线电）
工部局广播由罗伯逊（Robertson）夫人主持（840 千周），于晚上 9:00 开始，9:15 结束。

晚上 9:51（空袭）。
晚上 9:57 解除。

晚上 9:55（阿马利亚诺夫（Amalianoff）先生，法租界）。
江上的日本船只正向飞机发射曳光防空导弹。

晚上 10:35（贝尔登（Beldon）先生 - 报社记者）
我们收到消息，第 36 师和第 57 师正在换防，北站附近 Chapel（此处原文可能指闸北某地或拼写错误，暂保留或译为查佩尔/小教堂区域，结合上下文应指闸北某区域，但按规则不确定保留或音译，此处Chapel疑为Chapei闸北之误，但依规则若不确定则保留，考虑到前文多次出现Chapei，此处极大概率为OCR错误或笔误，但严格遵循规则“不确定的保留原文”，然而Chapei在前文已确定为闸北。若视为Chapei则译为闸北。鉴于前文语境，此处极可能指闸北。但为严谨，若视为专有名词Chapel则音译。观察上下文“troops in Chapel in the vicinity of the North Railway Station”，北站附近即为闸北。故译为闸北更为通顺，但若严格按字面Chapel则为查佩尔。考虑到历史档案翻译的准确性，此处极有可能是Chapei的误植。我将译为“闸北（原文为Chapel）”或直接根据语境修正？规则4说“明显是OCR遗留的乱码...不要脑补”。Chapel不是乱码，是单词。规则3说“能确定的用当时通行的中文”。Chapei=闸北。Chapel≠Chapei。因此，若不能100%确定是笔误，应保留。但在此军事语境下，Chapel毫无意义。通常译者会注。我将译为“查佩尔（Chapel，疑为闸北Chapei之误）”或者仅译查佩尔。为了符合“专业译者”身份且不完全脑补，我将在译文中保留原意但加注，或者如果认为是明显错误则标原文不清？不，这是拼写差异。我决定译为“查佩尔（Chapel）”，并在心中存疑。等等，再看一遍规则3：“Chapei=闸北”。如果原文写的是Chapel，那不是Chapei。所以不能直接译闸北。那就音译查佩尔。) *自我纠正：在历史档案中，Chapel 可能是指某个具体地点如“小教堂”附近，或者就是Chapei的笔误。鉴于要求“不要脑补”，我将直译“查佩尔（Chapel）”*。
*再次审视：* "troops in Chapel in the vicinity of the North Railway Station". 北站就在闸北。这几乎肯定是 Chapei 的笔误。但是规则4说“明显是OCR遗留的乱码...照实译出或标（原文不清）”。Chapel 是个正常的英文单词，不是乱码。规则3只给了 Chapei 的对应。没有给 Chapel。所以我必须保留 Chapel 或音译。音译为“查佩尔”。

我们收到消息，第 36 师和第 57 师正在换防，北站附近查佩尔（Chapel）地区的部队正在撤退。

晚上 10:42（中央无线电室）
我们从贝尔登先生处获悉，在晚上 9:51 的空袭期间，两枚炸弹落在亨特码头（Hunt's wharf）附近。

星期三 - 8月25日。
凌晨 12:05 - 空袭 - 凌晨 12:10 解除。
凌晨 12:20（中央巡捕房）。
1937年8月24日晚上 10:20，住在汉密尔顿公寓（Hamilton House）1201室的纳尔逊（Nelson）先生致电中央巡捕房，称他观察到一盏信号灯在位于

pages.en:
Page 2.

building situated near the corner of Hankow and Szechuen
Roads. A party from Central Station investigated and
verified the truth of the statement, and learned that the
building from which the flashes were emanating was 103, Hankow Rd.,
which is occupied by a Japanese Transportation Company. The
party were, however, unable to obtain entry to the building.
(Note:- The building houses the Nippon Menkwa Kabushiki Kaisha
(Japan Cotton Trading Coy., Ltd.,))
1-00 am (From French Police).

It is reported by the Havas News Agency with reference to
the U.S.S."Augusta" incident that an agreement has been reached
between the Japanese and American governments whereby Japan
will pay to America a sum of G$500,000 as compensation for the
destruction to life and property caused by the shell which
struck the U.S.S."Augusta" at 6-40 pm on August 20th.
6-50 am (All Stations' report)

Pootoo Road, Gordon Road, Bubbling Well Road, Sinza,
Louza, Central, West Hongkew, Yangtsepoo and Chengtu
Road Stations report all quiet in their respective
districts during the night.

Yulin Road Station could not be communicated with owing,
it is believed, to a faulty wire.

Waterworks Sub-station reports quiet during the night.

Hongkew Station reports that there was an air-raid over
the district at 12-10 am when no bombs were dropped. At 1-30
am there was another air-raid by Chinese planes which dropped
three bombs in the district, the approximate position of which
seems to be indicated by a fire which is now raging on the
corner of Boone and Szechuen Roads. Japanese Anti-aircraft
guns replied on both occasions. There has been intermittent
machine gun fire in the district East of Broadway throughout
the night. Occasional shelling has been heard from the
Japanese boats in the river and continuous shelling from a
Chinese battery near Markham Road Junction.
7 am (from C.C.R.)

(Continued overleaf)

汉口路与四川路拐角附近的一栋建筑物屋顶上闪烁。中央巡捕房派出人员调查并证实了该说法的真实性，并了解到发出闪光的建筑物是汉口路 103 号，该处由一家日本运输公司占用。然而，相关人员未能进入该建筑物。（注：- 该建筑物内为日本棉业株式会社（Nippon Menkwa Kabushiki Kaisha，即日本棉花贸易有限公司））

August 20, 1937.    8039P
                     24 8 37

4.15 p.m.       Japanese warships are still shelling Pootung
                from a point opposite Hunts Wharf.

4.25 p.m.       Eight Japanese bombing seaplanes and six
                fighters proceeded to Kiangwan and bombed the
                Southern Baptist Mission and Lien Nyi Cemetery.

5.20 p.m.       An air raid took place over the northern
                and eastern part of the Settlement and seven
                bombs were dropped in Wayside, Kashing and
                Dixwell Road Districts. Fires are blazing from
                a point at Nanyang Tobacco Co. to Wayside Road,
                to ¼ of a mile east of the Japanese Naval Landing
                Party and to the boundary of Hongkew and Kashing
                Road districts.

5.30 p.m.       There are people on the roofs of the Chase
                Bank Building and another building just north of
                the Metropol Hotel.

6.15 p.m.       Japanese seaplanes are bombing Yulin Road
                District dropped two bombs.

6.35 p.m.       Sniping reported from Bank of Communications
                on the Bund.

6.50 p.m.       One shell hit the China Merchants Wharf
                No.1 Godown, Damage unknown. (French Police)

7.20 p.m.       One British ship from the naval buoys has
                left now with her search lights on, moving down
                stream.

7.30 p.m.       It is reported by Domei that there are twelve
                Soviet pilots and aviators arriving with planes
                from Soviet Russia by way of Sinkiang.

（批：C 8/8）

1937年8月20日。    8039P
                     24 8 37

下午4时15分       日本军舰仍在从亨特码头（Hunts Wharf）对面的位置炮击浦东。

下午4时25分       八架日本轰炸水上飞机和六架战斗机前往江湾，轰炸了南浸信会传教站（Southern Baptist Mission）和联义山庄（Lien Nyi Cemetery）。

下午5时20分       租界北部和东部发生空袭，七枚炸弹投落在威赛路（Wayside）、嘉善路（Kashing）和狄思威路（Dixwell Road）地区。大火从南洋烟草公司一处地点燃起，蔓延至威赛路，东至日本海军陆战队以东四分之一英里处，直至虹口与嘉善路地区的边界。

下午5时30分       查斯银行大楼（Chase Bank Building）以及大都会酒店（Metropol Hotel）正北的另一栋建筑的屋顶上有人。

下午6时15分       日本水上飞机轰炸榆林路地区，投下两枚炸弹。

下午6时35分       据报外滩交通银行有狙击活动。

下午6时50分       一枚炮弹击中招商局第一号仓库。损失不明。（法租界巡捕房）

下午7时20分       一艘英国船只已离开海军浮标处，开启探照灯，向下游驶去。

下午7时30分       同盟社报道，十二名苏联飞行员和航空人员随飞机经新疆从苏俄抵达。

（批：C 8/8）

8.15 p.m. From Lt. Krulak:- A report has been received
that an explosion has just taken place on the Bund
in which one member of the crew of the U.S.S.
Augusta has been killed and fifteen injured.
(Central informed -awaiting confirmation.)

8.35 p.m. Central Station and the French Police state
there has been no explosion on the Bund.
(Lt. Krulak informed.)

8.45 p.m. Telephone communication to the Municipal
Abattoir is still out of order.

9.15 p.m. Hongkew reports no fires have been noted south
of Hongkew Creek. District comparatively quiet.

9.27 p.m. D.S. Henchman reports that the Japanese flagship
"Idzumo" has moved from her position opposite Hunts
Wharf. Unable to locate her present whereabouts.

9.50 p.m. Intelligence Officer of the Loyals Regiment
witnessed an explosion on board a Chinese Customs
boat moored near the U.S.S. Augusta. A private
of the Loyals Regiment has been injured by a shell
bursting near the Toyoda Mill.

9.53 p.m. D.S. Henchman reports the Japanese cruiser tied
up off the N.Y.K. Wharf is firing tracer bullets
into Wayside District.

10.45 p.m. West Hongkew Station reports the district very
quiet, no shells landing, no fires and no sign of
troops.

11.05 p.m. Meisling, N.C.D.News:- A confirmed report from
the American Intelligence Officer states that at
6.40 p.m. the U.S.S. Augusta was struck by a shell

晚上8时15分 克鲁拉克中尉（Lt. Krulak）报告：收到报告称外滩刚刚发生爆炸，美国海军“奥古斯塔”号（U.S.S. Augusta）上一名船员死亡，十五人受伤。（已通知中央巡捕房——等待确认。）

晚上8时35分 中央巡捕房和法租界巡捕房称外滩未发生爆炸。（已通知克鲁拉克中尉。）

晚上8时45分 通往工部局屠宰场的电话通信仍然中断。

晚上9时15分 虹口报告称虹口港以南未发现火灾。该地区相对平静。

晚上9时27分 副督察亨奇曼（D.S. Henchman）报告称，日本旗舰“出云”号（Idzumo）已离开其在亨特码头对面的位置。无法确定其当前 whereabouts。

晚上9时50分 忠勇团（Loyals Regiment）情报官目睹一艘停泊在美国海军“奥古斯塔”号附近的中国海关驳船发生爆炸。一名忠勇团列兵在丰田纱厂附近因炮弹爆炸受伤。

晚上9时53分 副督察亨奇曼报告称，停靠在日清汽船株式会社（N.Y.K.）码头的日本巡洋舰正向威赛路地区发射曳光弹。

晚上10时45分 西虹口巡捕房报告该地区非常平静，无炮弹落地，无火灾，也无军队踪迹。

晚上11时05分 梅斯林（Meisling），新昌新闻社（N.C.D.News）：美国情报官的一份证实报告称，下午6时40分，美国海军“奥古斯塔”号被一枚炮弹击中

11.22 p.m. From D.S. Larby:- A foreigner states that
he saw eighteen Japanese soldiers lying dead

signalling from the Settlement side of Avenue
Edward VII near the Bund. No answering signals
can be seen.

that between four and five hundred Japanese troops,

Settlement via the Garden Bridge. No reply given.

of the Chinese Military H.Q., eleven Japanese
planes bombed the town of Kiang Ying near the
mouth of the Yangtze River 在 in the forenoon of
August 20, using gas bombs.

12.35 a.m. The French Police report the above rumour
concerning Japanese troops entering the Settle-

ment/prevalent among the Chinese in the French

凌晨12时10分 法租界巡捕房报告：在外滩附近的爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）租界一侧观察到有灯光发出信号。未见回应信号。

凌晨12时35分 法租界巡捕房报告：据中国军事总部唐楚（Tang Chu，音译）先生称，8月20日上午，十一架日本飞机轰炸了长江口附近的江阴镇，使用了毒气弹。

凌晨12时35分 法租界巡捕房报告，上述关于日军进入租界的谣言在法租界华人中广为流传。

凌晨1时05分 法租界巡捕房报告：昨日下午4时30分，两名法国公民朱韦特（Juvet）兄妹，住址马浪当路119号（Rue Massenet），年龄分别为20岁和22岁，驾驶一辆私家车和

凌晨1时45分 新昌新闻社办公室：过去一小时内，海关栈桥对面的浦东一侧发生大火——推测是麦肯齐（McKenzie）的一处仓库。

凌晨2时25分 所有重炮和火炮似乎已停止射击。

5.28 a.m. Hongkew:- Machine gun and artillery fire

凌晨5时40分 上海自来水公司——罗宾逊高级督察（S.I. Robinson）报告称，位于华盛路恒丰棉纺厂屋顶的一名中国狙击手一直在向自来水公司内任何未隐蔽的人员开火。

凌晨5时45分 两架日本飞机在南市和浦东上空高空飞行。

凌晨6时22分 两架飞机（推测为中国飞机）飞越租界，遭到日本高射炮兵的猛烈射击。大院和办公室响起警报信号并撤离。

上午6时00分 - “出云”号已回到亨特码头外的位置。

7.10 p.m. • From D.S. Henchman
A Japanese warship is firing from Woosung and shelling
Pootung.

7.12 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
Four shells have hit Kashing Road Bridge.

7.30 p.m. - From SINZA
156 wounded soldiers have entered the Settlement
via Markham Road Bridge and are now in the Red Cross
Hospital, Sinza Road.

8.15 p.m. - The British Naval Staff Officer reports moving his
address to Room 603 Hamilton House.

8.25 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
Heavy fighting has been going on on North Paashan
Road. Tracer bullets, machine guns and rifles are
being used. The warships at Woosung are firing up
the Yangtsze River and north-west of Yangtzepoo Dist.
Occasional shells are falling on Kashing Road Bridge.
No planes are visible.

8.30 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
Firing is getting heavier west of Woosung-Shanghai
Railway. There is firing going on from Range Road
into the west of North Honan Road.

8.40 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
The Japanese are attacking from near Hongkew Park
on the east side of the W-S Railway against the Chinese
on the other side of the railway. It appears that they are
fighting for possession of the railway. There is heavy
machine gun fire and few shells.

8.50 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
Bombing in progress. Sound the alarm at Central.

8.55 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
Planes are flying over the Settlement, apparently bombing
Pootung.

四枚炮弹击中嘉善路桥。

日军正从吴淞-上海铁路东侧虹口公园附近攻击铁路另一侧的中国军队。看来他们正在争夺铁路控制权。机枪火力猛烈，炮弹较少。

晚上8时50分 - 副督察亨奇曼报告
轰炸正在进行。在中央巡捕房拉响警报。

飞机飞越租界，显然在轰炸浦东。

静安寺地区的路灯再次亮起。

晚上10时25分 - 副督察亨奇曼报告
根据史密斯上尉（Captain Smythe）的命令，副督察亨奇曼和米申科（Mischenko）已撤至虹口巡捕房。百老汇大厦被认为无法坚守。有报告称中国军队已在嘉善路地区突破。

晚上10时30分 - 向嘉善路巡捕房查询
我们未确认关于中国军队在嘉善路地区突破的报告。有许多炮弹从闸北方向飞过巡捕房。

晚上10时42分 - 警务处长助理史密斯上尉（Capt. Smythe, D.OIC.）报告
我已将副督察亨奇曼和米申科从百老汇大厦疏散至虹口巡捕房。我未确认关于嘉善路地区中国军队的报告。

pages.en:
- 3 -
August 16

11.20 p.m. - From Sinza
13 wounded soldiers of the 88th Division have been
taken from Markham Road Bridge to the Red Cross
Hospital, Sinza Road.

1.15 a.m. (17/8/37) - D.S. Hanchman reports that he and D.S.
Mischenko have returned to the 17th Floor of the
Broadway Mansions, for observation purposes.

1.48 a.m. - Two unconfirmed rumours were received to the effect
that the Japanese would use poison gas at 2 a.m. today.

1.55 a.m. - C.C.R. instructed to inform all stations north of
the Creek by telephone of the above unconfirmed rumour.

2.10 a.m. - Message from Sinza through C.C.R. to the effect that
the U.S. marines along the Soochow Creek have been
ordered to prepare for gas attack at 2 a.m. (circulated
to all stations by teleprinter.)

2.40 a.m. - Mr. Sung Siao-yen of the Sin Pao reports by telephone
that while on the Bund near Peking Road at about 2.30 a.m
he heard several shots which appeared to come from a
group of 20 or more Japanese ronins. (Central informed;
investigation promised.) Mr. Sung also stated that
he had heard from the Lih Pao that the Police had
notified the Central China Daily News to inform all
the local newspapers that a gas attack would take place
at 2 a.m. He was informed that this was absolutely
untrue.
A later report from Central states that no ronins
could be found in the vicinity of the Bund. The bullets
which nearly struck Mr. Sung were probably stray shots
from the general firing in progress.

5.30 a.m. - FROM Det. Hanchman
One Japanese plane is scouting over the Settlement.
pages.zh:
- 3 -
8月16日

晚上11时20分 - 新闸报告
第88师的13名伤兵已从马克姆路桥被送往新闸路红十字会医院。

凌晨1时15分（1937年8月17日）- 副督察亨奇曼（Hanchman）报告称，他和副督察米申科已返回百老汇大厦17楼，以便进行观察。

凌晨1时48分 - 收到两条未经证实的谣言，称日本人将于今日凌晨2时使用毒气。

凌晨1时55分 - 指令中央无线电台（C.C.R.）通过电话将上述未经证实的谣言通知苏州河以北的所有巡捕房。

凌晨2时10分 - 新闸通过中央无线电台发来消息，称沿苏州河的美军海军陆战队已奉命准备应对凌晨2时的毒气攻击。（通过电传打字机分发至所有巡捕房。）

凌晨2时40分 - 《申报》宋孝严（Sung Siao-yen，音译）先生电话报告称，凌晨2时30分左右，他在外滩靠近北京路时听到几声枪响，似乎来自一群二十多名日本浪人。（已通知中央；承诺进行调查。）宋先生还称，他从《立报》获悉，警方已通知《华中日报》告知所有本地报纸，凌晨2时将发生毒气袭击。他被告知这绝对不实。
中央随后报告称，在外滩附近未发现浪人。险些击中宋先生的子弹可能是当时普遍交火中的流弹。

凌晨5时30分 - 侦探亨奇曼（Det. Hanchman）报告
一架日本飞机正在租界上空侦察。

pages.en:
- 4 -
5.35 a.m. - From D.S. Henchman
There are two Japanese scouting planes over the Settlement.
A large Japanese freighter is coming up river and
may possibly be a transport; the name is the "Chokon"Maru."
The heavy artillery fire at present going on is coming
from Woosung towards Chapei. It is confirmed that the
bomb which fell near Chapoo Road Bridge last night fell
into the Soochow Creek and did little damage. A shell
is found to have fallen outside the Capitol Theatre on
Soochow Road. It also is believed to have done little
damage.
5.55 a.m. -From D.S. Henchman
The "Idzumo" has moved out into midstream slightly
further down the river, about opposite Hunt's Wharf.
A shell has dropped behind the Municipal Gaol and
be
heavy shelling seems to increasing going on in that
area. (6 a.m.)- The west wing of the Gaol has been struck
by the shell. The Gaol is still being shelled heavily.
6.10 a.m. -From D.S. Henchman
The battery shelling the Gaol is apparently located
near the Chenju Radio Station. Many shells are falling
around
along the Gaol and the aim seems to be deliberate.
6.25 a.m. -From D.S. Mishenko
Three more shells have dropped on the Gaol and one
very close to Wayside Police Station.
6.32. - A shell has landed at the corner of North Szechuen
and Haining Rds.
6.43 a.m. -From D.S. Henchman
The shells are now dropping further east probably in
Yulin Road district.
6.50 a.m. -From D.S. Henchman
The time between the explosions of the guns firing and
shells dropping was approximately 17 seconds.
7.05 a.m. -From D.S. Mishenko
Another shell has burst near Ward Road Gaol and one near
the church on Ward Road.
pages.zh:
- 4 -
上午 5:35 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
租界上空有两架日本侦察机。
一艘大型日本货轮正溯江而上，
可能是一艘运输船；船名为“Chokon”丸。
目前正在进行的猛烈炮火来自吴淞方向，射向闸北。
经证实，昨晚落在乍浦路桥附近的炸弹落入苏州河，
造成的破坏很小。发现一枚炮弹落在苏州路的大光明戏院外。
据信该处也未造成多大破坏。
上午 5:55 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
“出云”号已移至河中更下游一点的位置，
大约在亨特码头（Hunt's Wharf）对面。
一枚炮弹落在工部局监狱后方，
该地区似乎正遭受日益猛烈的炮击。（上午 6:00）- 监狱西翼被炮弹击中。
监狱仍遭受猛烈炮击。
上午 6:10 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
炮击监狱的炮兵阵地显然位于真如无线电台附近。
许多炮弹落在监狱周围，
瞄准似乎是故意的。
上午 6:25 - 来自副巡官 Mishenko
又有三枚炮弹落在监狱上，一枚落在韦思德巡捕房附近。
上午 6:32 - 一枚炮弹落在四川北路与海宁路路口。
上午 6:43 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
炮弹现在落在更东边，可能在玉林路地区。
上午 6:50 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
从火炮发射到炮弹落地的时间间隔约为 17 秒。
上午 7:05 - 来自副巡官 Mishenko
又一枚炮弹在华德路监狱附近爆炸，另一枚在华德路教堂附近。

pages.en:
- 5 -
7.15 a.m. - From D.S. Henchman
light cruiser tied
A Japanese destroyer/has just tied up alongside the
O.S.K. Wharf.

7.17 a.m. - From Sinsa
75 Chinese wounded soldiers passed over the Markham
Road Bridge during the night on August 16 bound for
various hospitals in Nantao, French Concession and the
Settlement.

7.22 a.m. - From D.S. Henchman
A shell was dropped at the corner of Chapoo and Range
Roads and another at Jukong and North Szechuen Roads.
Willie's Theatre in Hongkew is apparently on fire.

7.40 a.m. - From D.S. Henchman
A Japanese gunboat located at the Shanghai-Hongkew Pootung
Wharf and another gunboat on the Settlement side are
shelling Pootung.

7.55 a.m. - From D.S. Mischenko
There is a fire on the east side of North Szechuen
Road between Range and Jukong Roads.

8.10 a.m. - From D.S. Henchman
A Japanese Gunboat lying about mid-stream near Holts'
Wharf is shelling Western Chapel.
Japanese Freighter reported arrived earlier is lying
at O.S.K. Wharf.
Japanese anti-aircraft posts have been withdrawn from top
of Japanese Consulate.
Shelling of Ward Road Gaol has ceased.
Japanese cruiser shelling position in Pootung near Oliveria
Engineering Works.

8.20 a.m. - From D.S. Henchman
Two Japanese scout planes are reconnoitering over Settlement
and Whangpoo.
pages.zh:
- 5 -
上午 7:15 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
一艘日本驱逐舰/轻型巡洋舰刚刚系泊在大阪商船会社（O.S.K.）码头旁。

上午 7:17 - 来自 Sinza
8月16日夜间，75名中国伤兵经过马克姆路桥，
前往南市、法租界和公共租界的各家医院。

上午 7:22 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
一枚炮弹落在乍浦路与兰格路（Range Road）路口，
另一枚落在鞠恭路与四川北路路口。
虹口的威利戏院（Willie's Theatre）显然着火了。

上午 7:40 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
一艘位于上海-虹口浦东码头的日本炮艇，
以及另一艘位于租界一侧的炮艇，正在炮击浦东。

上午 7:55 - 来自副巡官 Mischenko
四川北路东侧，兰格路（Range Road）与鞠恭路之间发生火灾。

上午 8:10 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
一艘位于霍尔特码头（Holts' Wharf）附近河中央的日本炮艇
正在炮击西礼拜堂。
据报道早些时候抵达的日本货轮停泊在大阪商船会社（O.S.K.）码头。
日本领事馆顶部的日本高射炮阵地已撤走。
对华德路监狱的炮击已停止。
日本巡洋舰正在炮击奥利维拉工程公司（Oliveria Engineering Works）附近的浦东阵地。

上午 8:20 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
两架日本侦察机正在租界和黄浦江上空进行侦察。

pages.en:
August 6

7.10 p.m. • From D.S. Hocking
A Japanese warship is firing from Woosung and shelling
Pootung.

7.12 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
Four shells have hit Kashing Road Bridge.

7.30 p.m. - From Sinza
156 wounded soldiers have entered the Settlement
via Markham Road Bridge and are now in the Red Cross
Hospital, Sinza Road.

8.15 p.m. • The British Naval Staff Officer reports moving his
address to Room 603 Hamilton House.

8.25 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
Heavy fighting has been going on on North Paoshan
Road. Tracer bullets, machine guns and rifles are
being used. The warships at Woosung are firing up
the Yangtsze River and north-west of Yangtszepoo Dist.
Occasional shells are falling on Kashing Road Bridge.
No planes are visible.

8.30 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
Firing is getting heavier west of Woosung-Shanghai
Railway. There is firing going on from Range Road
into the west of North Honan Road.

8.40 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
The Japanese are attacking from near Hongkew Park
on the east side of the W-S Railway against the Chinese
on the other side of the railway. It appears that they are
fighting for possession of the railway. There is heavy
machine gun fire and a few shells.

8.50 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
Bombing in progress. Sound the alarm at Central.

8.55 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
Planes are flying over the Settlement, apparently bombing
Pootung.
pages.zh:
8月6日

下午 7:10 • 来自副巡官 Hocking
一艘日本军舰正从吴淞开火，炮击浦东。

下午 7:12 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
四枚炮弹击中嘉善路桥。

下午 7:30 - 来自 Sinza
156名伤兵经马克姆路桥进入租界，
现位于新闸路红十字会医院。

下午 8:15 • 英国海军参谋军官报告将其地址迁至汉密尔顿大厦603室。

下午 8:25 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
北宝山路一带激战正酣。使用了曳光弹、机枪和步枪。
吴淞的军舰正沿长江向上游及杨树浦区西北方向开火。
偶尔有炮弹落在嘉善路桥上。
未见飞机。

下午 8:30 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
吴淞-上海铁路以西的炮火日益猛烈。
正有火力从兰格路（Range Road）射向河南北路西侧。

下午 8:40 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
日军正从吴淞-上海铁路东侧的虹口公园附近，
向铁路另一侧的中国军队发起进攻。
看来他们正在争夺对该铁路的控制权。
机枪火力猛烈，并有少量炮弹落下。

下午 8:50 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
轰炸正在进行中。在中央电话交换台拉响警报。

下午 8:55 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
飞机飞越租界上空，显然正在轰炸浦东。

pages.en:
- 2 -
p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
The "Idzumo" has switched down her searchlights.
There is much shrapnel flying.
9.20 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
The Chinese are shelling the Japanese Temple and
the Ritz Theatre. There is heavy shelling off Quinsan
Garden.
9.30 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
A shell has dropped close to the Chinese Post Office.
Damage unknown. A bomb has dropped in the Soochow
Creek near the Capitol Theatre, Chapoo Road Bridge.
9.40 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
There is heavy firing of Chinese shells from Pootung,
passing close over the Broadway Mansions.
9.50 p.m. - From C.D.I. Sih
Street lights on Ferry Road near Bubbling Well Road
are all extinguished. (Bubbling Well informed; reports
lights are cut over the whole district).
10.10 p.m. - From D.S. Pitts
The lights are again on in the Bubbling Well district.
10.25 p.m. - From D.S. Henchman
D.S. Henchman and Mischenko have removed to the Hongkew
Station on orders of Captain Smythe. Broadway Mansions
considered untenable. There is a report that the Chinese
troops have broken through in Kashing Road district.
10.30 p.m. - Enquiry to Kashing Road Station
We have no confirmation of the report that the Chinese
troops have broken through in Kashing Road district.
There are many shells passing the Station from the
direction of Chapei.
10.42 p.m. - From Capt. Smythe, D.OIC.
I have evacuated D.S. Henchman and Mischenko from
Broadway Mansions to Hongkew Station. I have no
confirmation of the report re Chinese troops in Kashing
Road district.
pages.zh:
- 2 -
下午 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
“出云”号已关闭探照灯。
空中有许多弹片飞舞。
下午 9:20 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
中国军队正在炮击日本神社和丽都大戏院。
昆山花园（Quinsan Garden）附近炮击猛烈。
下午 9:30 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
一枚炮弹落在靠近中国邮政局的地方。
损失不明。一枚炸弹落在乍浦路桥附近、大光明戏院旁的苏州河中。
下午 9:40 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
浦东方面射出大量中国炮弹，
从百老汇大厦附近近距离飞过。
下午 9:50 - 来自刑事侦缉督察 Sih
静安寺路附近的斐伦路（Ferry Road）路灯全部熄灭。
（已通知静安寺；报告称整个区域灯光切断）。
下午 10:10 - 来自副巡官 Pitts
静安寺地区的灯光再次亮起。
下午 10:25 - 来自副巡官 Henchman
根据 Smythe 队长的命令，副巡官 Henchman 和 Mischenko
已撤离至虹口巡捕房。百老汇大厦被认为无法坚守。
有报告称中国军队已在嘉善路地区突破防线。
下午 10:30 - 向嘉善路巡捕房查询
我们未收到关于中国军队在嘉善路地区突破防线的报告的确认。
有许多炮弹从闸北方向飞过该巡捕房。
下午 10:42 - 来自警务副总长 Capt. Smythe
我已将副巡官 Henchman 和 Mischenko 从百老汇大厦疏散至虹口巡捕房。
我未收到关于嘉善路地区出现中国军队的报告的确认。

August 16

13 wounded soldiers of the 88th Division have been
taken from Markham Road Bridge to the Red Cross

8月16日

下午 11:20 - 来自 Sinza
第88师的13名伤兵已从马克姆路桥被送往

凌晨 1:15 (1937年8月17日) - 副巡官 Henchman 报告称，他和副巡官
