September 6, 1937.
Afternoon Translation.

Chiu Wang Jih Pao (救亡日报) :-

NATIONAL SALVATION PROPAGANDA IN LYRIC THEATRE REFUGEE
CAMP

(金城收容所) Refugees in the Lyric Theatre Refugee Camp live in slightly different surroundings from those in other camps, for inside the theatre are posted "wall" newspapers and national salvation caricatures. The other day there was shown a motion picture of a national salvation nature.

At 11 a.m. yesterday, the dramatic group of the Ta Kung Readers' Society (大公读者会) went to the Lyric Theatre and gave a performance of a play entitled "Lay Down Your Whip" (放下你的鞭子). Prior to the performance, Miss Chen Fu-erh (陈波儿), a movie star, delivered a speech in which she said that the people lost their homes because of the Japanese devils. A song "Down With Japan" (打倒日本) was also sung.

S.I.

Since the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities, the
Citizen's Federation are taking interest in the good order of the
public. A notification has been received from the International
Settlement Citizen's Federation to the effect that under the guidance
of the said federation citizens are required to maintain good order
in the unaffected areas. For the purpose of maintaining good order
and rendering assistance to the unaffected area by prevention of
extortion and other illegal actions by undesirables, the federation
has made an appeal to the Shanghai Municipal Council for permission
to organize inspection groups at various branches. At a meeting
held at this branch on the 5.9.37, a resolution was passed that
members of the inspection group be selected from the executive
members of the branch or any other members who are enthusiastic
with regard to public affairs. As soon as armlets are issued the
inspection groups will operate within the area of this branch whose
duties are to make inspections and concurrently advise shops to re-
open for business.

Fourth Branch, The Settlement Citizen's Fed.

During this extraordinary period, the operation of this
federation should carry on without interval. The expenses are all
met by the subscriptions of members. As the federation is in urgent
need of funds for paying various employees, we will send men out to
collect membership subscriptions for last month. All members are
requested to pay accordingly.

自中日敌对行动爆发以来，市民联合会对公共秩序予以关注。本会接获国际租界市民联合会通知，称在该联合会的指导下，要求市民在未受战火影响地区维持良好秩序。为了维持良好秩序，并通过防止不良分子进行勒索及其他非法行为来援助未受影响地区，该联合会已向上海工部局提出申请，请求允许在各分会组织视察队。在1937年9月5日于本分会举行的会议上，通过了一项决议，即视察队成员应从分会执行委员或其他热心公共事务的会员中选拔。一旦袖章发放完毕，视察队将在本分会辖区内开展行动，其职责是进行视察，并同时劝告商店重新开业。

租界市民联合会第四分会

在此非常时期，本联合会的运作不应中断。所有费用均由会员捐款支付。由于本会急需资金以支付各类雇员薪资，我们将派人收取上个月的会员捐款。请各位会员依此缴纳。

11 SEPT. 1937

Mr. Wong Chien-ngoh (王剑谔), one of the principal
promoters of the movement for the organization of picketing
groups for various streets in the Settlement, south of the
Creek, and who was seen by D.C. (Crime & Special Branches) on
September 4, 1937, and Mr. Chiang Chun-nyi (蒋君毅),
committee member of the 1st Special District Citizens'
Federation, called at police headquarters on the afternoon
of September 9, and explained that from this date, Mr. Chiang
would represent the Federation in any negotiations with the
Municipal Council and the Municipal Police over the problem of
picketing groups. In explaining the change, Mr. Wong Chien-
ngoh remarked that he had received information to the effect
that the local Chinese authorities, especially the Tangpu,
were accusing him of co-operating with the authorities of the
foreign settlements in starting the picketing movement and
therefore was responsible for the Council's suppressive
attitude towards the local Tangpu in their plan to organize
an alley tenants association. According to Mr. Wong, the
Tangpu was of the opinion that it was due to his intrigue
that the Municipal Council had suppressed the Tangpu's
movement for tenants association.

In order to remove all misunderstanding, Mr. Wong has
decided to hand over the affairs relating to the movement to
Mr. Chiang Chun-nyi. Mr. Wong also intimated that the Federation
applied on September 7 to the local Tangou for registration,
but no reply has yet been received.

王剑谔先生（Mr. Wong Chien-ngoh），他是苏州河以南租界各街道组织纠察队运动的主要发起人之一，曾于1937年9月4日接受刑事股与特别股副督察长（D.C.）的问询；以及第一特区市民联合会委员蒋君毅先生（Mr. Chiang Chun-nyi），于9月9日下午前往警察总局，解释说自即日起，蒋先生将代表该联合会就纠察队问题与工部局及警务处进行任何谈判。在解释这一变动时，王剑谔先生 remarked 称，他收到消息，当地中国当局，特别是塘浦（Tangpu），指责他与外国租界当局合作发起纠察队运动，因此要对工部局压制当地塘浦组织里弄租户协会的计划负责。据王先生称，塘浦方面认为，正是由于他的阴谋诡计，导致工部局压制了塘浦的租户协会运动。

为了消除所有误解，王先生决定将与该运动有关的事务移交给蒋君毅先生。王先生还暗示，联合会已于9月7日向当地塘口（Tangou）申请注册，但尚未收到回复。

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers 8.9.37 (A.M.)

MEETING OF FIRST SPECIAL DISTRICT CITIZENS' FEDERATION

The Shanghai First Special District Citizens'
Federation, at a meeting held on September 7, passed the
following resolutions:-
1) That the outline for the organization of picketing
groups be adopted.
2) That the various branches of the Federation be notified
to form picketing groups.
3) That based on the suggestion of Mr. Yui Zai-ting (俞佐廷),
member of the Federation, the Government be requested
to issue a circular order to official and private
organizations and bodies, factories and stores throughout
the country instructing them not to discharge employees
for the sake of economy.
4) That at the request of the 9th Branch of the Federation,
local landlords be requested not to press for the
payment of house rent in arrears out of consideration for
the present difficult situation.
5) That a petition be sent to the Chairman of the National
Government requesting that an amnesty be ordered.
6) That traitors be induced to repent; that the Government
be requested to give a chance to traitors to reform.
7) That the Government be petitioned to cease payment of
Boxer Indemnity to Japan.
8) That activities of the branches of the Federation in
Hongkew, east of Szechuen Road, be suspended until the
local situation returns to normal.

（印：8 SEPT. 1937）

S.B.R. 9/9.

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸 1937年9月8日（上午）

第一特区市民联合会会议

上海第一特区市民联合会在9月7日举行的会议上，通过了以下决议：-
1) 通过组织纠察队的纲要。
2) 通知联合会各分会组建纠察队。
3) 根据联合会会员俞佐廷先生（Mr. Yui Zai-ting）的建议，请求政府向全国各地的公私机构、团体、工厂和商店发布通令，指示它们不得出于节约目的解雇员工。
4) 应联合会第九分会的请求，恳请当地房东鉴于目前的困难局势，不要催缴拖欠的房租。
5) 向国民政府主席递交请愿书，请求下令大赦。
6) 劝导汉奸悔过；请求政府给予汉奸改过自新的机会。
7) 请愿政府停止向日本支付庚子赔款。
8) 暂停联合会在四川路以东虹口地区各分会的活动，直至当地局势恢复正常。

（印：1937年9月8日）

Three resolutions were put forward and adopted.

1. That the order of the Head-quarters that branch offices form pickets with view to assisting the Settlement Authorities in keeping peace and good order and at the same time uncover traitors.

2. As from 8 a.m. 6.9.37, pickets be composed of 10 members operating 6 hours each in two shifts.

3. Members selected to form pickets be photographed and their photographs be forwarded to S.M.Council with a request to the Council to issue permits, to enable picket members to function on Municipal roads.

先生，

1937年9月5日下午2时，上海市民协会第四分部约10名成员在渡船路1260号举行会议，讨论揭露汉奸的措施。

会议提出并通过了三项决议。

1. 遵照总部的命令，各办事处组建纠察队，以协助租界当局维持和平与良好秩序，同时揭露汉奸。

2. 自1937年9月6日上午8时起，纠察队由10名成员组成，分两班轮流执勤，每班6小时。

First Special District Citizens' Federation - Meeting

During the afternoon of August 23, eight committee members of the First Special District Citizens' Federation held a meeting in the office of the Ping Tse Club, No.3 Sze Zoh Li, Yunnan Road, and passed the following resolutions:-

1. That the following services be carried out :
(a) To ask the public to purchase the national salvation bonds to be issued by the Government.
(b) To solicit contributions towards national salvation fund.
(c) To maintain peace and order in the rear.
(d) To solicit from the public comforts for the Chinese troops now engaged in fighting the enemy.
(e) To organize picket groups to deal with traitors. ||

2. That the secretariat be instructed to draft regulations governing war time service.

3. That the committee members be asked to bear the necessary expenses for the time being.

4. That a telegram be despatched to General Chiang Kai Shek and the different military and air forces commanders.

Shanghai Various Circles Committee to Support Resistance Against the Enemy - War Time Service Planning Sub-committee formed

The Shanghai Various Circles Committee to Support Resistance Against the Enemy, 480 Yu Ya Ching Road, formed on August 23, a "War Time Service Planning Sub-Committee" (戰時服務設計委員會). The new committee consists of thirty-six members, with Mr. Sung Chun-dz, the national salvation movement leader, as chairman, and Messrs. Ling Kong-hou and Kuo Mo-jo, and two others, as Vice Chairmen.

Translation

Brief regulations governing Inspection Squads of the
Various Branches of the 1st Special District Citizens' Federation.

1) In order to direct the people to cooperate in the maintenance
of peace and good order the various branches of this
Federation shall appoint responsible persons to organize
Inspection Squads of suitable strength in proportion to
the respective areas under their control.

2) Members of the Squads shall be carefully selected and consist
only of honest and public-spirited men.

3) The functions of the Inspection Squads are as follows:-
a) To urge the people to obey the Council's Emergency Order
and other notices bearing on public safety.
b) To persuade shops to resume business and to assist the
Police in preventing profiteering and extortion.
c) To find shelter for refugees found in the streets.
d) To assist the Police in preventing creation of disturbances
by bad characters.

4) The working hours of the Squads shall be from 8 a.m. to
8 p.m.; each Squad shall be divided into certain groups to
serve in shifts of 4 hours each.

5) Two copies of the detailed personal record of each Squad
member shall be submitted to this Federation. After approval
an armlet for the purpose of identification shall be issued
by this Federation jointly with the Council.

6) In the event of any difficulty in settling a matter, an
Inspection Squad on duty may report to this Federation or the
nearest Police Station for assistance.

7) The Squads shall be dissolved when the local condition returns
to the normal and the Emergency Order is lifted.

8) To uphold the good name of this Federation members of Squads
shall not interfere without good reasons with residents and
shopkeepers, nor shall they infringe the authority of the
Police.
pages.zh:
译文

上海第一特区市民联合会各分会视察队简要规章。

1) 为指导民众合作维护和平与良好秩序，本会各分会应指派负责人，根据各自管辖区域的范围，组织适当规模的视察队。

2) 队员须经慎重挑选，仅由诚实且具公德心的人士组成。

3) 视察队的职能如下：-
a) 督促民众遵守工部局紧急命令及其他涉及公共安全的通告。
b) 劝告商店恢复营业，并协助警方防止囤积居奇和敲诈勒索。
c) 为在街头发现的难民寻找栖身之所。
d) 协助警方防止不良分子制造骚乱。

4) 视察队的工作时间为上午8时至晚上8时；每队应分为若干小组，每班执勤4小时。

5) 每名队员的详细个人履历表须提交两份至本会。经批准后，由本会同工部局联合签发用于识别的臂章。

6) 若在解决某事项时遇到困难，值班视察队可向本会或最近的警察局报告以求协助。

7) 当本地状况恢复正常且紧急命令解除时，视察队即行解散。

8) 为维护本会的良好声誉，队员不得无故干扰居民和店主，亦不得侵犯警方职权。

Shanghai Various Circles Committee to Support Resistance
against the Enemy - issues notice

On August 18, the Shanghai Various Circles Committee
to Support Resistance against the Enemy temporarily
situated in the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association,
480 Yu Ya Ching Road, issued a circular notice to local
residents requesting them to contribute money and articles
for the troops engaged in resisting the Japanese.

Handbills requesting the residents to observe law
and order; refugees to return to their native places
and merchants not to advance the prices of their
commodities were found posted on August 18 on walls in
the Settlement. These leaflets are supposed to emanate
from the Shanghai Municipality Boyscout War Zone
Service Corps.

1st Special District Citizens' Federation - meeting of
of the War Time Service Committee

Twelve members of the War Time Service Committee of
the 1st Special District Citizens' Federation held a
meeting in the Ping Ts Society, 3 Dz Dzoh Li, Yunnan
Road, between 5 p.m. and 6 p.m. August 18, when the
following resolutions were passed :-

1) That a letter be addressed to the Shanghai City
Government and the Shanghai Woosung Garrison Head-
quarters requesting that arrangements be made for
the repatriation of refugees to the interior.

2) That shops be advised to resume business.

3) That the Chinese Ratepayers' Association and the
S.M.C. be requested to devise measures to evacuate
all residents left in the Hongkew and Yangtzepoo
areas.

4) That the branches of the Federation be notified to form
picket groups to maintain peace and order in the Settlement.

November 9, 1937. Afternoon Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

WARRANTS FOR MERCHANTS TRADING WITH THE ENEMY

Since the outbreak of local hostilities, many traitorous merchants have been buying enemy goods or supplying the enemy with food, metals etc.
It is learned that the Shanghai Martial Law Enforcement Commander's Headquarters have requested the Shanghai District Court to issue circular orders of arrest for the following persons:-
(1) Zia Kuh-ming (謝支明) of the Zung Foong Dyeing and Weaving Factory (仁主織染廠), who in October bought thousands of pieces of cloth from the Japanese Kung Dah Mill, at a price of several hundred thousand dollars cash.
(2) Li Ai-tung (李靄東), comprador of the Mitsubishi Shoji Kaisha, who supplied the enemy with 10,000 piculs of rice.
(3) Zung Tsung-noong (陳春農) of the Tung Woo Kung (冬元工) Customs Brokers, who sold large quantities of steel, iron and other metals to the enemy.

pages.en:
Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

FOUR TRAITORS EXECUTED BY SHANGHAI MARTIAL LAW
HEADQUARTERS YESTERDAY

Four Chinese traitors, including one Moh Faung-ding (穆芳庭), native of Ningpo, residing at 14 Ta Ching Li (大慶里), Nanking Road, were executed by the Shanghai Martial Law Enforcement Commander's Headquarters yesterday.
Moh used to have intercourse with the Japanese and, during the January 28 hostilities, supplied the enemy with food and trafficked in firearms. After the outbreak of the present fighting, Moh held secret meetings with the Japanese at the Metropole Hotel for the purpose of discussing plans to disturb the rear and endanger his own country. Someone reported him to the authorities and he was arrested on August 20 whilst leaving the Metropole Hotel and then handed over to the Shanghai Martial Law Enforcement Commander's Headquarters.
Of the three other traitors executed, two were females who acted as spies for the enemy, while the remaining one undertook the construction of defence works for the enemy.

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

上海戒严司令部昨日处决四名汉奸

上海戒严司令总部昨日处决了四名中国汉奸，其中包括穆芳庭（Moh Faung-ding），宁波人，居住于南京路大庆里14号。
穆氏以往与日本人交往，在“一·二八”战事期间，向敌人提供粮食并贩卖军火。在此次战事爆发后，穆氏在大都会饭店与日本人秘密会晤，商讨扰乱后方及危害本国的计划。有人向当局举报，他于8月20日离开大都会饭店时被逮捕，随后被移交给上海戒严司令总部。
在被处决的另外三名汉奸中，有两名是充当敌人间谍的女性，另一名则负责为敌人修筑防御工事。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Following consultations held between the Secretary General, the Municipal Advocate, the A./C.P. and the D.C. (Crime), instructions were received by the undersigned that no charge was to be preferred against the 1st, 2nd and 3rd accused who were arrested for "illegal functioning".

These persons will therefore be brought before the 2nd B.K.H.C. during the morning of the 23rd Sept. 1937, when the "Writ of Detention" will be withdrawn.

As no evidence has been obtained to warrant a charge of "Trafficking in Narcotics" being preferred against the five remaining accused, the Court will be asked to release these persons.

The five packets of powder alleged to be either heroin or morphine were handed over by the Local Garrison Commander's representative Mr. Loo Ong Tsung (许鸿昌) during the morning of Sept. 22nd. 1937. These packets were handed over to the Municipal Laboratory for analysis.

The result of this analysis was received the same afternoon and reads as follows:-

ANALYSIS.

POWDER No.1. consisted of crude heroin and morphine derivatives.

经秘书长、市公诉人、代理警务副总监和刑事副总监协商后，下述签署人接到指示，不对因“非法活动”被捕的第一、第二和第三被告提出指控。

case were related to him. He stated that he did not see
how the charge of "Illegal Functioning" against the 1st.,
2nd. and 3rd. accused, could possibly be sustained if
brought before a Chinese Court. There apparently is
nothing in the Land Regulations which give exclusive
rights to the S.M.P. as regards functioning and although
it is considered that the International Police have the
sole right, this idea has grown more through custom than
anything else.

As regards the five persons who are now detained
on suspicion of being concerned in subversive activities,
it now appears that they are, or may be, connected with a
narcotic gang. No evidence has been obtained to sub-
stantiate this as all the proof, alleged to have been

1937年9月21日上午10时许，签署人与罗礼贵（Loh Li Kwei）督察会见了市法律顾问小R.T.布莱恩（R.T. Bryan Jr.）先生，并向他陈述了本案的情况。他表示，如果将此案提交中国法院，他看不出针对第一、第二和第三被告的“非法行使职权”指控如何能够成立。《土地章程》中显然没有任何条款赋予工部局警务处在行使职权方面的专属权利，尽管人们认为国际警察拥有唯一权利，但这种观念更多是源于习惯，而非其他依据。

至于目前因涉嫌参与颠覆活动而被拘留的五人，现在看来他们可能或与一个毒品团伙有关联。由于所有据称已获得的证据现在都掌握在军事当局手中，因此尚未获得证实这一点的证据。

鉴于上述原因，看来对任何被告提出指控都是徒劳的，首先是因为法院对“非法行使职权”的态度，其次是没有证据表明其他被捕人员与颠覆活动或毒品犯罪有关联。

1937年9月14日。

因中日敌对行动而在卢家嘴地区发生的事件。

1937年9月14日下午1时30分，中央巡捕414号致电警署，称中国守军成员正在湖北路144号梁溪（Liang Chi，音译）旅馆内行动。

经刑事侦探7.88号和麦阿迪（Mac Adie）副巡佐查询后查明，1937年9月14日下午1时，中国军队第八十七师总部的八名成员，显然是根据提供的情报，前往上述旅馆的28号房间，并逮捕了两名涉嫌为汉奸的中国男子。同行的五人带着两名被捕男子乘坐送他们到现场的汽车离开，而剩下的三人则留在旅馆内看守一名女性，即其中一名被捕男子的妻子，因为一辆车容纳不下所有人。然而，旅馆职员派人出去叫警察，遇到了正在巡逻的中央巡捕414号并告知了情况。他随即通知警署，由盖兹利（Gazeley）巡佐率领的一队警察赶到，并将第八十七师的这三名成员带至警署。所有军方代表均身着便衣，并佩戴表明其身份的臂章，但

THE QUESTION OF EXTRADITION OF TRAITORS FROM FOREIGN
SETTLEMENTS

Traitors endanger the nation and they deserve
death. It is learned that traitorous organizations of
an important nature are mostly located in the foreign
Settlements. Due to the treaties, the Chinese military
authorities have no jurisdiction in the Settlements.
Therefore, it is necessary to bring about the extradition
of traitors if it is desired to deal with them according
to the military law.
There is a certain basis in the Rendition
Agreements of the foreign Settlements for the extradition
of traitors in the Settlements to the Chinese authorities,
yet as a matter of fact, understanding from the foreign
Councils is still required.
A few days ago, the Shanghai Martial Law
Enforcement Commander's Headquarters detailed an officer
to call on the Settlement authorities in the hope of
securing practical assistance concerning the question
of the extradition of traitors. The step is quite proper.
Trial by court-martial is not open to the
public. The accused is prohibited from appointing a
lawyer to appear for his defence, nor are the members
of his family allowed to attend. The judgment by
court-martial will become definite after approval has
been secured from the highest military organization.
Article 4 of the regulations governing the punishment
of traitors provides: "If the case requires immediate
disposal, a report may be forwarded for record in due
course after the sentence has been executed". For this
reason, the power of the officers of the military court
trying traitors is extraordinarily great. Trials of
traitors must be handled with great vigilance and working
members investigating such cases and arresting traitors
must be especially strict, so that no wrong may be done.
In this way, extradition of traitors from the foreign
Settlements can function smoothly.

《大美晚报》于9月19日刊登了以下文章：
关于从外国租界引渡汉奸的问题

汉奸危害国家，死有余辜。据悉，重要的汉奸组织多位于外国租界内。由于条约关系，中国军事当局在租界内没有管辖权。因此，若欲依军法处置，必须实现汉奸的引渡。
外国租界的《交收章程》中，对于将租界内的汉奸引渡给中国当局有一定的依据，但实际上仍需获得外国工部局的理解。
日前，上海戒严司令部派遣一名官员拜访租界当局，希望能就引渡汉奸问题获得实际协助。此举甚为妥当。
军法审判不公开进行。被告不得聘请律师出庭辩护，其家属也不得旁听。军事法庭的判决在获得最高军事机构批准后即生效。
《惩治汉奸条例》第四条规定：“如案情需要即时处理，可在执行判决后酌情补报备案”。因此，审理汉奸的军事法庭官员权力极大。审理汉奸必须格外谨慎，负责调查此类案件和逮捕汉奸的工作人员必须特别严格，以免发生冤假错案。只有这样，从外国租界引渡汉奸的工作才能顺利进行。

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

CO-OPERATION OF THE AUTHORITIES OF THE TWO FOREIGN SETTLEMENTS
DESIRED IN CONNECTION WITH THE SUPPRESSION OF TRAITORS

In the interest of the maintenance of public peace and order of the local districts, the Shanghai Martial Law Enforcement Commander's Headquarters have been most energetic in their efforts for the suppression of traitors. With a view to bringing about better results in their efforts, the Martial Law Enforcement Commander's Headquarters are earnestly hoping that the authorities of the two Foreign Settlements in Shanghai will extend to them their deepest sympathy and most energetic co-operation. To this effect, an official of the Martial Law Enforcement Commander's Headquarters yesterday called upon the authorities of the two Foreign Settlements under instructions of General Yang Hu, Commander for the Enforcement of Martial Law in Shanghai Area.

When interviewed by a reporter of the Central News Agency, a spokesman of the Headquarters made the following statement :-

"It is to bring about the maintenance of public peace and order in the local districts as well as for the purpose of making Shanghai entirely immune from any disturbances that this Headquarters have been so energetic in the apprehension and suppression of traitors. It is a duty that is incumbent on this Headquarters just as it is the duty of the authorities of the Foreign Settlements to maintain peace and order within their jurisdiction.

"This Headquarters have always been in favour of any actions adopted by the authorities of the Settlements in the interest of the peace and order of the districts under their jurisdiction. It is, therefore, taken for granted that the measures taken by this Headquarters in the suppression of traitorous elements will likewise receive favourable comment from these authorities. It must be noted that the traitorous organizations and activities as well as their plots have mostly been discovered within the precincts of the Settlements. It can therefore be presumed that the effects brought about by these elements and organizations upon the maintenance of peace and order in the Foreign Settlements will not be less but undoubtedly much more serious than in the case of their presence in those districts that are under the jurisdiction of this Headquarters. This is a fact that the Settlement authorities should not overlook inasmuch as the peace and order of their districts are concerned. On the contrary, they should take rigorous measures for the suppression within their jurisdiction of the activities of any traitorous organizations, so as to bring about the realization of their object in the maintenance of peace and order. It is the opinion of this Headquarters that if the authorities of the Foreign Settlements are really sincere in their desire for the maintenance of peace and order within their jurisdiction, the suppression of traitorous elements within their districts is the only measure that will enable them to attain their object. 希望两租界当局合作镇压汉奸

戒严司令总部发言人在接受中央通讯社记者采访时发表如下声明：-

“本总部之所以不遗余力地缉捕和镇压汉奸，旨在维护本地区的公共治安与秩序，并使上海完全免受任何骚乱之扰。这是本总部义不容辞的职责，正如租界当局有责任在其管辖范围内维持治安与秩序一样。

September 5, 1937.
Morning Translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram) :-

REVISED LAW GOVERNING THE PUNISHMENT OF PERSONS WHO COMMIT
ACTS WITH INTENT TO INJURE THE REPUBLIC OF CHINA

In a mandate issued on September 4, the
National Government ordered the nullification of the Law
governing the Punishment of Persons Who Commit Acts with
Intent to Injure the Republic of China and promulgated the
revised text of the law.
The Revised Law governing the Punishment of
Persons Who Commit Acts with Intent to Injure the Republic
of China is as follows :-
Article 1. - (I) Whoever commits, with
intent to injure the Republic of China, any one of the
following acts shall be punished with death:
(1) Secretly communicates with an enemy
country and plots to disturb the public peace.
(2) Conspires with rebels and plots to
disturb the public peace.
(3) Purchases or transports military supplies
on behalf of an enemy country or rebels.
(4) Divulges or transmits political or military
secrets to an enemy country or rebels.
(5) Destroys means of communication or
military bases.
(6) Incites military men to violate discipline,
abandon their duties or to conspire with an enemy country or
rebels.
(7) Incites others to conspire with an enemy
country or rebels, or to disturb the public peace.
(8) Fabricates rumours to incite the public,
cause sedition among the military men or to disturb the
public peace.
(9) Spreads rebellious propaganda by means
of written or spoken words, drawings, pictures or speeches
beneficial to an enemy country or rebels.
(II) Whoever, being incited,
commits any of the offences specified in the last section
and surrenders himself shall have his punishment reduced
or remitted.
Article 2. - (I) Whoever knowingly harbours
a person conspiring with an enemy country or a rebel and
fails to report same shall be punished with imprisonment
for not less than five years.
(II) Whoever commits the offence
specified in the last section and surrenders himself shall
have his punishment reduced or remitted.
Article 3. - Whoever with intent to injure
the Republic of China organizes associations or holds
meetings shall be punished with imprisonment for not less
than five years, and not more than fifteen years.
Article 4. - Whoever, although without
intent to injure the Republic of China, spreads propaganda
by means of written words, drawings or speeches beneficial
to the enemy country during a period of hostilities with an
alien country shall be punished with imprisonment for not
more than three years.

《申报》及其他本地报纸（南京电）：-

修订后的《惩治危害民国行为法》

国民政府在9月4日发布命令，废止原《惩治危害民国行为法》，并颁布修订后的法律文本。
修订后的《惩治危害民国行为法》如下：-
第一条 - (一) 凡意图危害中华民国，有下列行为之一者，处死刑：
(1) 通敌国，阴谋扰乱公共治安。
(2) 勾结叛徒，阴谋扰乱公共治安。
(3) 为敌国或叛徒购买或运输军需品。
(4) 向敌国或叛徒泄露或传递政治或军事机密。
(5) 破坏通讯设施或军事基地。
(6) 煽动军人违反纪律、擅离职守或与敌国或叛徒勾结。
(7) 煽动他人勾结敌国或叛徒，或扰乱公共治安。
(8) 制造谣言以煽动民众、引起军人哗变或扰乱公共治安。
(9) 通过文字、言语、图画、图片或演讲散布有利于敌国或叛徒的反叛宣传。
(二) 受煽动而犯前项各款之罪，并自首者，减轻或免除其刑。
第二条 - (一) 明知是勾结敌国之人或叛徒而予以藏匿且不举报者，处五年以上有期徒刑。
(二) 犯前项之罪并自首者，减轻或免除其刑。
第三条 - 凡意图危害中华民国而组织团体或举行集会者，处五年以上十五年以下有期徒刑。
第四条 - 虽无意图危害中华民国，但在与外国交战期间，散布有利于敌国的文字、图画或言论宣传者，处三年以下有期徒刑。

（批注：另有一份存于档案 D80499/）

Shun Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram) :-
PROVISIONAL REGULATIONS GOVERNING PUNISHMENT OF BANDITS
EXTENDED FOR ONE YEAR

The validity of the Provisional Regulations
governing the punishment of bandits has now expired, these
regulations being put into force for a period of one year
on July 31, 1936.
In view of the present emergency and for the
purpose of maintaining public peace, the Military Affairs
Commission has petitioned the National Government to extend
the period of validity of the said regulations for one more
year.
The National Government has approved the request
and has directed the Executive, Legislative and Judicial
Yuans to inform their respective subordinate organs to the
same effect.

《惩治盗匪暂行条例》有效期延长一年

《惩治盗匪暂行条例》有效期已满，该条例于1936年7月31日生效，为期一年。

I beg to report as follows:-
At about 10.30 a.m. on the 11-9-37, representatives of the
S.C.G.P.B., Nantao, came to the station and reported that they
would request assistance between 9 p.m. and 10 p.m. 11-9-37,
to arrest one named Lee Heu Ching (李幹明) residing at No. 404
Taku Road as the latter had been implicated by a prisoner named
Tsai Foo Nyeu (蔡富順) as his accomplice in connection with the
alleged purchasing of a m/truck from the Triangle Motor (Fed.
Inc. U.S.A.), No. 99 Route Cardinal Mercier, French Concession
on behalf of Japanese.
Questioned as to the evidence against Lee, C.D.C. Hoo Kwei
Sung (胡葵生) of the S.C.G.P.B. stated that the accused in custody
had made a statement, also a letter had been received from the
Triangle Motors stating that Tsai Foo Nyeu (In custody) and Lee
Heu Ching were attempting to purchase m/trucks for the Japanese.
At the request of the undersigned the documents referred to were
produced and translated (see attached translations).
The D.D.O."A" was informed and instructed that Crime Branch
Headquarters be communicated with. The undersigned communicated

1937年9月11日上午约10时30分，南市上海市公安局（S.C.G.P.B.）代表来到本捕房，报告称他们将于1937年9月11日晚9时至10时之间请求协助，逮捕居住在太仓路404号的一名李幹明（Lee Heu Ching），因为一名在押犯人蔡富順（Tsai Foo Nyeu）供认李是其同伙，涉嫌代表日本人从法租界梅神父路99号三角汽车公司（Triangle Motor (Fed. Inc. U.S.A.)）购买一辆摩托卡车。

当被问及针对李的证据时，上海市公安局的胡葵生（Hoo Kwei Sung）督察称，在押被告已作出供词，此外还收到三角汽车公司的一封信，信中称蔡富順（在押）和李幹明正试图为日本人购买摩托卡车。应卑职要求，上述文件已出示并翻译（见附件译文）。

“A”区副总监已获知此事，并指示与刑事侦缉处总部联系。卑职随即联系了首席探长 Prince，他来到捕房，并在力所能及的范围内了解了案情事实。

Prince 首席探长指示，应告知中国当局，除非他们持有第一特区法院签发的逮捕令，否则租界当局不会在此案中提供协助；并应向法国警察查询他们是否有蔡被捕的记录。

关于申请逮捕李幹明的逮捕令一事，已通知上海市公安局。

1937年9月12日上午11时，卑职前往法国警察总局，会见了政治科主管 R. Sarly 先生，他表示其部门没有蔡被捕的记录，如果信息属实，则是上海市公安局当局的非法行为。卑职将三角汽车公司三名员工写给上海市公安局的信件副本交给 Sarly 先生，他向卑职致谢并表示将调查此事。1937年9月13日上午收到法国警察的电话联络，称经向三角汽车公司查询，证实了上海市公安局侦探逮捕蔡富順的信息，确已确立针对该当局的非法行为案件。法国警察已与上海市公安局当局联系，后者否认知晓此案或曾为此事前往成都路捕房寻求协助。

Translation of a statement made by the employees of the
Triangle Motors.
----------------------

To the Public Safety Bureau (Shanghai City Government Police Bureau)

Sir,

    In compliance with your instructions, we, the undersigned,
wish to state as follows in connection with Tsai Fu Yuen's case.
    On the morning of 28-8-37, Tsai Fu Yuen accompanied by Li
Yen Ching, and a Russian named "Gakerson", called at our company
with intention of buying several m/trucks on behalf of some other
person(s). Being quite aware that Tsai frequently communicated
with Japanese, and that most transactions in connection with the
purchase of motor cars by Japanese passed through his (Tsai's)
hands, we asked him who was the purchaser, owing to the fact that
we were afraid that he might have still been utilized by Japanese
during the present tense situation, but he or his companions
refused to reveal any truth to us, and thereby his request
(purchase of m/trucks) was also refused, as we were suspicious
regarding their actions. They appeared to be despaired & departed.
    On the morning of 7-9-37, a detective from your Police
Bureau, paid a visit to us and made enquiries in connection with
"Tsai". In the meantime a Japanese accompanied by another person
who appeared to be a Korean, arrived and asked about Tsai. Upon
hearing this, the said detective started to question them, as
a result of which it was learned that they had made arrangements
to meet one another in our company. Prior to their departure, they
requested us to inform Tsai to call at the Bank of Chosen upon
his arrival. An observation was kept in our company by your
detective until 11 a.m. when Tsai Fu Yuen put in an appearance and
his arrest was then effected.

                                Chopped:- Triangle Motors.
                                Signed:- Kwan EW Chong.
                                         Tsu Pau Sung
                                         Wong Yue Wei
                                10th September.

三角汽车公司员工声明的译文。
----------------------

致公共安全局（上海市政府警察局）

先生，

遵照贵局指示，我们就蔡富元（Tsai Fu Yuen）一案陈述如下。
1937年8月28日上午，蔡富元在李延清（Li Yen Ching）和一名叫“Gakerson”的俄罗斯人陪同下，来到我公司，意图代表他人购买几辆摩托卡车。鉴于我们深知蔡经常与日本人往来，且大多数涉及日本人购买汽车的交易都经他（蔡）之手，我们询问他买家是谁，因为我们担心在当前紧张局势下他可能仍被日本人利用，但他及其同伴拒绝向我们透露任何实情，因此我们也拒绝了其请求（购买摩托卡车），因为我们对他们的行为表示怀疑。他们看似绝望地离开了。
1937年9月7日上午，贵局的一名侦探来访，就“蔡”一事进行查询。与此同时，一名日本人由另一名看似韩国人的人陪同到达，并询问蔡的情况。听到这些，该侦探开始审问他们，结果得知他们约定在我公司见面。在他们离开之前，他们要求我们通知蔡到达后去朝鲜银行。贵局侦探在我公司进行监视，直到上午11时蔡富元出现，随后将其逮捕。

盖章：三角汽车公司。
签名：Kwan EW Chong。
         Tsu Pau Sung
         Wong Yue Wei
9月10日。

Statement of Tsai Foo Nyeu.

Tsai Foo Nyeu, alias Ah Kyung, aged 49, native of Kiangtu,
broker, residing at Sinza M/car., Medhurst Road,

Q. Have you recently gone to the Triangle Motors to buy/cars?

A. At about 10 a.m. on the 29-8-37, my old friend named Lee Heu
Ching went to the Triangle Motors alone and invited me to
the Hwa Foo Co., 39 Ave. Ed. VII for negotiation. He told me
that he wanted to buy a m/truck for his customer and
consequently I took him to the Triangle Motors. He inter-
viewed the Compradore Tseu Dah Yoong and a foreigner named
Keu Dah(?)and he selected a "Ausmobille". The compradore
then asked me to whom we shall sell the vehicle and I in turn
put this question to Lee Heu Ching and the latter said he
bought the vehicle for foreigners. I reminded Lee Heu Ching
that the Triangle Motors would not sell any cars to Japanese
whereupon he said "we have guarantors when purchasing
m/trucks.
For which

Q. For which foreigner did you and Lee Heu Ching buy this m/truck?

A. I don't know whether we actually bought the m/truck for
Japanese but things will be made clear if Lee Heu Ching is
arrested.

Q. Where does Lee Heu Ching live, can you lead us to arrest him ?

A. Lee Heu Ching is residing at 404 New Taku Road and I can lead
you there for his arrest.

Q. Have you recently purchase m/car for Japanese ?

A. In July this year, I bought one 2nd hand m/car valued $1200.00
for Dung Nyeu(?)aforesaid; he is dealing in porcelain and
bricks.

Q. Where does Dung Nyeu(?)live ?

A. His office is located at Jinkee Road, The Bund.

Q. While our detective was making enquiries at the Triangle Motors
to-day, 2 Japanese were also there and looking for you. What
are their names ?

A. Possibly they are Chao Ya(?)and Dung Nyeu or Mi-ya-la-ka.

Q. Have you arrangements made with the above 2 Japanese before
hand ?

A. No.

Q. If you did not have any arrangements made with the 2 Japanese,
why they said you knew and that they told you to go to Bank
of Chosen ?

A. I never met them nor did I know anything.

Q. Can you tell us straight as to your pro-enemy ?

A. No such things and you can enquire.

Q. Have you ever done traitors scheme during the January 28 ?

A. During the January 28th, I was in Changhs with Mr. Lee of the
Licensing Section, City Government and I was left in charge of
Gasoline into which you can also enquire.

蔡富順的供词。

蔡富順，别名阿庆（Ah Kyung），49岁，江苏江都人，经纪人，居住在新闸路麦特赫斯脱路 Sinza M/car.，

问：你最近去过三角汽车公司买车吗？

答：1937年8月29日上午约10时，我的老朋友李幹明独自去了三角汽车公司，并邀请我到爱多亚路39号华孚公司（Hwa Foo Co.）洽谈。他告诉我他想为客户买一辆摩托卡车，于是我便带他去了三角汽车公司。他会见了买办徐达荣（Tseu Dah Yoong）和一名名叫 Keu Dah(?) 的外国人，他选中了一辆“奥斯莫比尔”（Ausmobille）。随后买办问我们将车卖给谁，我转而问李幹明，后者说他是为外国人买的。我提醒李幹明，三角汽车公司不会向日本人出售任何汽车，他说：“我们购买摩托卡车时有担保人。”

问：你和李幹明是为哪个外国人买这辆摩托卡车的？

答：我不知道我们是否真的为日本人买了这辆摩托卡车，但如果逮捕李幹明，事情就会清楚。

问：李幹明住在哪里，你能带我们去逮捕他吗？

答：李幹明居住在新太仓路404号，我可以带你们去那里逮捕他。

问：你最近为日本人购买过汽车吗？

答：今年七月，我为前述的 Dung Nyeu(?) 买了一辆价值1200.00美元的二手汽车；他是做瓷器和砖块生意的。

问：Dung Nyeu(?) 住在哪里？

答：他的办公室位于外滩金陵路。

问：今天我们的侦探在三角汽车公司查询时，也有两名日本人在那里找你。他们叫什么名字？

答：可能是 Chao Ya(?) 和 Dung Nyeu 或 Mi-ya-la-ka。

问：你事先与上述两名日本人有约定吗？

答：没有。

问：如果你没有与这两名日本人做任何约定，为什么他们说认识你，并让你去朝鲜银行？

答：我从未见过他们，也一无所知。

问：你能坦率告诉我们你是否亲敌吗？

答：没有这种事，你可以去查问。

问：在一·二八期间，你做过汉奸勾当吗？

答：一·二八期间，我和市政府执照科的李先生一起在长沙，我负责管理汽油，你也可以去查问。

pages.en:
- 2 -
Q. Can you tell us how you bought the M/truck for Japanese at
11 a.m. on the 29-8-37.
A. At 10 a.m. on 29-8-37, one named Lee Heu Ching invited me
to this office - Hwa Foo Co. - situated at 39 Ave. Ed. VII,
where I negotiated with 2 Japanese, 1 German and 1 Russian in
connection with the purchase of 1 m/truck. At 11 a.m. I
proceeded with Lee Heu Ching, the German and the Russian to
the Triangle Motors but we did not buy the desired m/truck,
as the price was not agreed. The Japanese did not go with us.
Q. Did you meet the 2 Japanese after the 29th ?
A. I again met the 2 Japanese in the office of the Hwa Foo Co.
on the 21st.
Q. What are the names of the 2 Japanese?
A. One named Chao Ya(?)and the other Dung Nyeu(?)
Q. Does Lee Heu Ching have connections with Japanese ?
A. Certainly, otherwise how he dared to buy m/truck for them.
Q. What is Lee Heu Ching doing ?
A. Lee Heu Ching is doing insurance business and he also opened
the Hwa Foo Co., doing various other lines.
Signed and thumb-printed.
5/9/37.

- 2 -
问：你能告诉我们你是如何在1937年8月29日上午11时为日本人购买摩托卡车的吗？
答：1937年8月29日上午10时，一名叫李幹明的人邀请我到位于爱多亚路39号的办事处——华孚公司，在那里我与两名日本人、一名德国人和一名俄罗斯人就购买一辆摩托卡车进行了谈判。上午11时，我与李幹明、德国人和俄罗斯人一起前往三角汽车公司，但我们没有买到想要的摩托卡车，因为价格未谈妥。日本人没有和我们一起去。
问：29日之后你见过那两名日本人吗？
答：21日我又在华孚公司办事处见到了那两名日本人。
问：这两名日本人叫什么名字？
答：一个叫 Chao Ya(?)，另一个叫 Dung Nyeu(?)。
问：李幹明与日本人有关系吗？
答：当然，否则他怎么敢为他们买摩托卡车。
问：李幹明是做什么的？
答：李幹明做保险生意，他还开设了华孚公司，经营其他各种业务。
签名并按手印。
1937年9月5日。

September 15, 1937.
Morning Translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

CO-OPERATION OF THE AUTHORITIES OF THE TWO FOREIGN SETTLEMENTS
DESIRED IN CONNECTION WITH THE SUPPRESSION OF TRAITORS

In the interest of the maintenance of public
peace and order of the local districts, the Shanghai Martial
Law Enforcement Commander's Headquarters have been most
energetic in their efforts for the suppression of traitors.
With a view to bringing about better results in their efforts,
the Martial Law Enforcement Commander's Headquarters are
earnestly hoping that the authorities of the two Foreign
Settlements in Shanghai will extend to them their deepest
sympathy and most energetic co-operation. To this effect,
an official of the Martial Law Enforcement Commander's Head-
quarters yesterday called upon the authorities of the two
Foreign Settlements under instructions of General Yang Hu,
Commander for the Enforcement of Martial Law in Shanghai Area.
When interviewed by a reporter of the Central
News Agency, a spokesman of the Headquarters made the
following statement :-
"It is to bring about the maintenance of
public peace and order in the local districts as well as
for the purpose of making Shanghai entirely immune from any
disturbances that this Headquarters have been so energetic
in the apprehension and suppression of traitors. It is a
duty that is incumbent on this Headquarters just as it is
the duty of the authorities of the Foreign Settlements to
maintain peace and order within their jurisdiction.
"This Headquarters has always been in favour
of any actions adopted by the authorities of the Settlements
in the interest of the peace and order of the districts under
their jurisdiction. It is, therefore, taken for granted that
the measures taken by this Headquarters in the suppression of
traitorous elements will likewise receive favourable comment
from these authorities. It must be noted that the traitorous
organizations and activities as well as their plots have
mostly been discovered within the precincts of the Settlements.
It can therefore be presumed that the effects brought about
by these elements and organizations upon the maintenance of
peace and order in the Foreign Settlements will not be less
but undoubtedly much more serious than in the case of their
presence in those districts that are under the jurisdiction
of this Headquarters. This is a fact that the Settlement
authorities should not overlook inasmuch as the peace and
order of their districts are concerned. On the contrary,
they should take rigorous measures for the suppression
within their jurisdiction of the activities of any traitorous
organizations, so as to bring about the realization of their
object in the maintenance of peace and order. It is the
opinion of this Headquarters that if the authorities of the
Foreign Settlements are really sincere in their desire for
the maintenance of peace and order within their jurisdiction,
the suppression of traitorous elements within their districts
is the only measure that will enable them to attain their
object. It must be noted that what really affects the
peace and order of the Foreign Settlements is the disturbing

晨间译件

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-

期望两租界当局在镇压汉奸事宜上予以合作

为维护本地区之公共治安与秩序，上海戒严司令总部在镇压汉奸方面最为积极努力。为使努力取得更好成效，戒严司令总部恳切希望上海两租界当局能给予最深切的同情和最积极的合作。为此，上海地区戒严司令杨虎将军指示下，戒严司令总部一名官员于昨日拜访了两租界当局。
戒严司令总部发言人在接受中央通讯社记者采访时发表如下声明：-
“本总部之所以如此积极地逮捕和镇压汉奸，旨在维护本地区的公共治安与秩序，并使上海完全免受任何扰乱。维持辖区内的和平与秩序是租界当局的职责，同样也是本总部的职责。
“本总部一贯支持租界当局为维持其辖区内的和平与秩序所采取的任何行动。因此，理所当然地认为，本总部在镇压汉奸分子方面所采取的措施也将得到这些当局的赞同。必须指出，汉奸组织、活动及其阴谋大多是在租界范围内被发现的。因此可以推断，这些分子和组织对维持外国租界内和平与秩序的影响，无疑比在其处于本总部管辖下的地区时更为严重。鉴于租界当局的辖区治安问题，这是一个不应忽视的事实。相反，他们应在其辖区内采取严厉措施，镇压任何汉奸组织的活动，以实现其维持和平与秩序的目标。本总部认为，如果租界当局确实真诚希望维持其辖区内的和平与秩序，镇压其辖区内的汉奸分子是使其实现目标的唯一措施。必须指出，真正影响外国租界和平与秩序的是汉奸的扰乱

Morning Translation

activities of the traitors; all others are but of secondary importance. For this reason, we are of the opinion that it is not only for the purpose of preserving good relations but also in the interest of their own peace and order that the authorities of the Settlements should extend to us (the Shanghai Martial Law Enforcement Commander's Headquarters) their strenuous co-operation in our efforts for the apprehension of traitors. It must not be overlooked that such a co-operation is not at all disadvantageous to the authorities concerned; it will result in them being able to get rid of all causes of disturbances. On the other hand, the arrest of traitors by this Headquarters in the districts within the jurisdiction of the Settlements is tantamount to a co-operation extended by the Headquarters to the authorities in the suppression of troublesome elements. It therefore can be taken for granted that the authorities concerned would not remain unsympathetic towards the efforts of this Headquarters in the suppression of traitorous elements, inasmuch as the fact that the authorities cannot say that they are indifferent to the dangerous activities and organizations of traitors which are manifestly prejudicial to the peace and order of the Settlements. It is therefore to be sincerely hoped that in the interest of the existing good relations as well as of the importance of the task for the maintenance of public peace and order in Shanghai, the authorities of the Foreign Settlements will extend to us their greatest sympathy and co-operation in our efforts for the arrest of traitors within their districts. It is even more desired that the Settlement Police will hand over to this Headquarters according to the decision of the Court the traitor Li Ai-tung (李蔼东), who was recently arrested by this Headquarters, in view of the fact that the Settlement Police have duly co-operated in the arraignment of the accused before the Court. It must be noted that when the Court ordered that the accused be handed over to this Headquarters, no objection to this decision was made by the Police representative. It is therefore hoped that the Settlement Police will abide by the decision of the Court and hand over the accused to this Headquarters so as to fulfil their co-operation in connection with this case."

活动；其他所有因素均属次要。因此，我们认为，租界当局不仅为了保持良好关系，也为了其自身的和平与秩序，应在我们（上海戒严司令总部）逮捕汉奸的努力中给予我们大力合作。不可忽视的是，这种合作对相关当局绝非不利；这将使他们能够消除一切扰乱根源。另一方面，本总部在租界管辖区域内逮捕汉奸，相当于总部向当局提供了镇压麻烦分子的合作。因此，可以理所当然地认为，相关当局不会对本总部镇压汉奸分子的努力持不同情态度，因为当局不能说他们对明显危害租界和平与秩序的汉奸危险活动和组织漠不关心。因此，真诚希望出于现有良好关系以及维持上海公共治安与秩序任务的重要性，外国租界当局能在我们逮捕其辖区内汉奸的努力中给予我们最大的同情与合作。更期望的是，鉴于租界巡捕房已在法庭传讯被告过程中予以适当合作，租界巡捕房应根据法庭决定，将本总部近期逮捕的汉奸李蔼东移交给本总部。必须指出，当法庭命令将被告移交给本总部时，警方代表并未对此决定提出异议。因此，希望租界巡捕房遵守法庭决定，将被告移交给本总部，以履行其在本案中的合作义务。”

Date. Sept. 13, 1937.
Subject Chinese Authorities requesting assistance to arrest a resident of
the Settlement.
Made by D. I. Hill. Forwarded by Officer i/c.
Sir,
I beg to report as follows:-
At 2.30 p.m. on the 11-9-37, representatives of the S.C.G.
P. Bureau, came to the station and asked for assistance to effect
the arrest of one named Tsang (張) who resided at No. 26 Lung-
men Road as the latter was alleged to have a large quantity of
brass and copper on the premises which they allege Tsang was
going to sell to the Japanese Authorities.
Questioned as to their source of information the S.C.G.P.
Bureau detectives produced an informer named Yang Kwei Ling
(楊桂林) who upon being interrogated, told the following story:-
that he had received information from one Moh Dei Ah Ching
(麻皮阿金) and Oen Chi Fah (present whereabouts unknown) foremen
of the Woo Ching Scrap Copper Factory (Japanese concern) situated
at Yangtsepoor Road (Number unknown) to the effect that one named
"Tsang" employed as an interpreter had been requested by his em-
ployers to conceal a large quantity of scrap copper and brass.
The informer actuated by patriotic motives imparted the informa-
tion to Sub Inspector Chu Meng Wei attached to Gordon Road Sta-
tion who in turn referred the informant to Chengtu Road Station
(verified by S.I. Chu Meng Wei). The informer proceeded to a
street letter writer and dictated a petition addressed to Officer
i/c Chengtu Road Station whilst so doing he met a friend who
advised him to report the matter direct to the S.C.G.P. Bureau,
Nantao, this informant did. The Nantao Authorities were asked
to produce the petition which they did, same was copied by the
undersigned, translation attached, and the original returned to
the Authorities concerned who were informed that no assistance
would be given unless a warrant was obtained from the 1st S.S.
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER OF POLICE 14 SEP. 1937）

先生，
谨报告如下：-
1937年9月11日下午2时30分，上海市公安局（S.C.G.P. Bureau）代表来到捕房，请求协助逮捕一名居住在龙门路26号、姓张（Tsang）的人，理由是据称该人住所内有大量黄铜和铜，且声称张打算将这些金属卖给日本当局。
当被问及信息来源时，上海市公安局侦探出示了一名名叫杨桂林（Yang Kwei Ling）的线人。经讯问，该线人讲述了以下情况：-
他从麻皮阿金（Moh Dei Ah Ching）和温志发（Oen Chi Fah，目前下落不明）处获得消息，此二人是位于杨树浦路（门牌号不详）的和兴废铜厂（日资企业）的工头。消息内容是，一名受雇为翻译、姓“张”的人，已被其雇主要求藏匿大量废铜和黄铜。该线人出于爱国动机，将此信息告知了隶属于戈登路捕房的副巡长朱孟伟（Chu Meng Wei），朱副巡长随即将线人转介至成都路捕房（已由副巡长朱孟伟核实）。该线人前往一名代写书信者处，口述了一份致成都路捕房主管警官的呈文。在此期间，他遇到一位朋友，建议他直接向南市上海市公安局报案，该线人照办了。当局被要求出示该呈文，他们照做了。本人复制了该呈文，译文附后，原件已归还给相关当局，并告知除非从第一特区法院获得逮捕令，否则不提供协助。
（印：警务处副总办 1937年9月14日）

    I beg to state that I have received information from one Moh Bei

(Japanese concern) to the effect that one named Tsang, employed as

purpose of supporting the Japanese Army to make use of same into

    As the Sino-Japanese Hostilities has been out broken in Shanghai

In the course of conversation with Mr. Chen Kuh Sung
the Chief of the Chinese Censorship Bureau, on September 10, he
states that he has rejected the request of General Yang Hu,
Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commander, to publish an article
purported to come from a third party, in the Chinese papers,
attacking the S.M.P. for the high handed action in releasing
Lee An Tung who was illegally abducted from his house in Tsepoo
Road by Chinese detectives on a charge of being "traitor" and
who was subsequently ordered by the Court to be handed over.
Mr. Chen advised General Yang Hu to refer the matter to the
Central Tangpu at Nanking, at the same time he (Mr. Chen) will
report to the Mayor.

Hwa Mei Wan Pao dated September 8 :-    A. M. Sept. 9, 1937

POLICE BUREAU OFFICERS ARRESTED IN FRENCH CONCESSION
FOR KIDNAPPING : BROUGHT BEFORE FIRST DISTRICT COURT

Li Ai-tung (李东), a native of Ningpo, 8039A
is the compradore of the "San Ling Yang Hong" (? Mitsu- 9 37
bishi Shoji Kaisha), Szechuen Road. He resides at
Houses No. 30/32, Lane No. 427, Tsepoo Road.
During the January 28 hostilities, the Bureau
of Public Safcty, now known as the Shanghai City Government
Police Bureau, was informed that the warehouse owned by
Li Ai-tung at No. 51 Ferry Road was full of inflammable
articles used by the Japanese for the burning of houses.
However, as a result of enquiries conducted by the
Bureau, no concrete evidence to support this information
was obtained, and consequently the matter was dropped
and Li was not arrested.
Recently, however, Li Hang-sung (李杏生)
and Li Zang-wei (李藏衛), two younger brothers of Li
Ai-tung, approached the Woosung-Shanghai Martial Law
Enforcement Commander's Headquarters and made a secret
report to the effect that their brother Li Ai-tung had
willingly acted as a traitor and had supplied foodstuffs,
etc. to the enemy.
Acting on this information, General Yang Hu,
Commander of the Headquarters, ordered Liu Kwang-chung
(刘光军), Deputy Chief of the Detective Squad of the
Police Bureau, to effect the arrest of Li Ai-tung.

supervisor of the 12th hospital for the accommodation of
wounded soldiers, proceeded to the home of Li Ai-tung at
about 2 p.m. September 7 in an official car No. 749 of
the Bureau, with chauffeur Oung Siao-lai (翁筱梅) at
the wheel. Due to lack of knowledge of any official
procedure on the part of the police official in question,
the party arrested Li Ai-tung together with his son Li Hung-
nyi (李鴻年) without giving any notification to the
Settlement police. Unexpectedly, however, when the car
was proceeding past the corner of Route Ghisi and Route
de Zikawei, French Concession, Li Ai-tung suddenly shouted
loudly for help. Consequently, the car was stopped by
the French Police and the whole party was then brought to
the French Police Station. Later the Crime Branch
Headquarters of the Settlement Police was informed for
their extradition.
It must be noted that this irregularity on
the part of the Chinese police officials was simply due
to their failure to comply with the proper procedure.
Unexpectedly, however, the four public officers of the
Chinese Police were all detained by C.D.I. Prince of the
Crime Branch Headquarters of the Settlement Police and
were arraigned before the Shanghai First Special District
Court on the morning of September 8 on a charge of
offences of kidnapping for ransom under Article 347 of
the Chinese Criminal Code.
The case was heard by Judge Siao Sih-feng
(蕭世芳) yesterday, September 8, when the accused, after
outlining the circumstances of the events, submitted to
the Court the order of General Yang Hu for the arrest of
Li Ai-tung in support of their statement. Meanwhile, Hsu
Pang-fei (許鵬飛) and Yang Feng-chi (楊鳳岐), two
deputy chiefs of the Detective Squad of the Martial Law
Enforcement Headquarters, also appeared at the Court and
stated that the informers against the traitorous activities
of Li Ai-tung were at present remaining at the Headquarters
for interrogation together with Li Ai-tung, whose
extradition to the Headquarters was, therefore, requested
so as to facilitate examination.
The Municipal Advocate, Mr. Wang Yao-dong
(王耀堂), likewise stated that as the various accused
made this arrest under instructions, therefore though there
appeared some irregularity in the procedure of the execution
of their duties, this constituted only a question of
administration, for which proper negotiations could be opened.
He further stated that for this reason, it was quite evident
that the charge against them under Article 347 could not
stand because there was an absence of concrete evidence
of kidnapping for ransom. The Municipal Advocate also
stated that it was up to the Court to decide whether or not
the actions of the accused could be regarded as an offence
of restraint of personal liberty. In conclusion, the
Municipal Advocate said: "As Li-Ai-tung is suspected as a

根据这些指令，该警官会同侦缉队侦探李芳生（Li Fang-sung）以及第十二伤兵医院管理员沈恒丰（Sung Hung-feng），于9月7日下午2点左右，乘坐该局749号公务车，由司机翁筱梅（Oung Siao-lai）驾驶，前往李爱东家中。由于涉事警官不了解任何官方程序，一行人在未通知租界警方的情况下，逮捕了李爱东及其子李鸿年（Li Hung-nyi）。然而，出乎意料的是，当车辆行驶至法租界祁齐路（Route Ghisi）与徐家汇路（Route de Zikawei）拐角处时，李爱东突然大声呼救。因此，法国警察拦停了该车，并将全体人员带往法国警察局。随后，通知了租界警方刑事部总部以便引渡。
必须指出，中国警官的这种违规行为仅仅是由于未能遵守适当程序所致。然而，出乎意料的是，四名中国公职人员均被租界警方刑事部总部的普林斯首席侦探（C.D.I. Prince）拘留，并于9月8日上午以上海第一特区法院依据《中华民国刑法》第347条指控其犯有勒赎绑架罪出庭受审。
该案于昨日（9月8日）由萧世芳法官（Judge Siao Sih-feng）审理，被告在概述事件经过后，向法庭提交了杨虎将军逮捕李爱东的命令，以支持其陈述。与此同时，戒严司令部侦缉队两名副队长许鹏飞（Hsu Pang-fei）和杨凤岐（Yang Feng-chi）也出庭，并表示指控李爱东从事汉奸活动的线人目前正留在总部接受讯问，李爱东本人也在总部，因此请求将其引渡至总部，以便于审查。
市公署律师王耀堂先生（Mr. Wang Yao-dong）同样表示，由于各被告是奉命进行此次逮捕，因此尽管在执行职务的程序上似乎存在一些违规，但这仅属于行政问题，可以通过适当的谈判解决。他进一步表示，鉴于此，显然依据第347条对他们的指控不能成立，因为缺乏勒赎绑架的确凿证据。市公署律师还表示，被告的行为是否可被视为侵犯人身自由罪，由法庭裁定。最后，市公署律师说：“鉴于李爱东涉嫌为

pages.en:
September 9, 1937.    6    Morning Translation

traitor and his extradition is requested by the Shanghai
Martial Law Enforcement Headquarters, then in compliance
with the proper legal procedure it is incumbent on the
Court to order the detention of Li Ai-tung and to hand
him over to the Second Branch of the Kiangsu High Court
for a decision as to whether or not his extradition can
be granted."
    Consequently, the Court gave a decision of
"Not Guilty" with regard to the four accused, Liu Kwang-
chung, Oung Siao-lai, Sung Hung-feng and Li Fang-sung,
and ordered that Li Ai-tung be detained pending his handing
over to the Second Branch of the Kiangsu High Court for
a decision.

汉奸，且上海戒严司令部请求将其引渡，那么依照适当的法律程序，法庭有责任命令拘留李爱东，并将其移交给江苏高等法院第二分院，以决定是否准予引渡。”
    因此，法庭对刘光军、翁筱梅、沈恒丰和李芳生这四名被告作出“无罪”判决，并命令拘留李爱东，等待将其移交给江苏高等法院第二分院以作裁决。

Sir,
On September 4, 1937 D.I. Telfer, Senior Detective
i/o Central, brought to this office Det. Sergt. Wong Pei Ding
(王儒霆) of the S.C.G.P.B. Headquarters, one informer Mao Bei
Peng (茅培奉) and a Mr. Chiang Tien Shuen (蒋天勳), who was
accompanied by his father Mr. Chiang Foo Shu (蒋福如).
Mr. Chiang Tien Shuen had been arrested by
Detectives attached to Central Station at about 7 p.m. 3-9-37
at the instance of the above mentioned City Detective, on
suspicion of being a traitor. Information concerning this
allegation had been given by the informer Mao Bei Peng and
this appears to constitute the only reason for this rather
arbitrary arrest. (Central Misc. 644/37).
Investigations were at once made by C.D.I. Prince,
Supt. Loh Li Kwei and the undersigned, who find that no evidence
has been submitted to show that the accused is or has been in
any way engaged in activities subversive to the Chinese
Government.
Chiang Tien Shuen, aged 26 years, is a Native of
Nantung, where his father has been a rice merchant for the past
twenty years. He formerly studied law at the Futan University
(復旦大學), Kiangwan, and later was sent to complete his
education at the Meiji University, Tokyo, where he studied
International Law. During the 1932 Shanghai Incident, he
assisted in relief work carried on by students of his university,
who took over, after the evacuation from Kiangwan, temporary
accommodation at the Overseas Chinese Middle School (華僑中學)
located on Seymour Road. Following his return from Japan in
1935 he obtained employment with the Tientsin City C

先生，
1937年9月4日，中央站高级侦探泰尔弗侦探督察（D.I. Telfer）将上海市警察局总部警长王儒霆（Wong Pei Ding）、一名线人茅培奉（Mao Bei Peng）以及蒋天勋（Chiang Tien Shuen）先生带到本办公室，蒋先生由其父蒋福如（Chiang Foo Shu）先生陪同。
蒋天勋先生于1937年9月3日晚上7点左右，应上述市局侦探的要求，因涉嫌为汉奸而被中央站附属侦探逮捕。关于这一指控的情报由线人茅培奉提供，这似乎构成了这次相当任意逮捕的唯一理由。（中央杂项 644/37）。
普林斯首席侦探督察、骆礼贵警司（Supt. Loh Li Kwei）及本报告人立即进行了调查，发现没有提交任何证据表明被告曾经或正在从事任何颠覆中国政府的活动。
蒋天勋，26岁，南通人，其父在过去二十年中一直是一名米商。他曾在江湾复旦大学（Futan University）学习法律，后来被送往东京明治大学完成学业，在那里学习国际法。在1932年上海事变期间，他协助其大学学生开展的救济工作，这些学生在从江湾撤离后，接管了位于西摩路（Seymour Road）的华侨中学（Overseas Chinese Middle School）作为临时住所。1935年从日本回国后，他在天津市 C

--------------------------------------------------

1937年9月3日下午7时，隶属于上海市公安局的刑事侦缉探员141号和135号来到本局，请求协助逮捕一名暂住江西路3/1号的嫌疑汉奸蔣天勳。

就此事宜联系了“A”区副总监，并指示提供必要协助。

署名者及刑事侦缉警员312号，在上述上海市公安局代表的陪同下，前往所述地址，并在一名已在警方到达现场的中国当局线人的指认下，逮捕了该通缉犯。

被捕时，嫌疑人与其父蔣連生（Chiang Lien Sung）同住于一楼侧室，其父也被拘留。

需提及的是，该处所称为广中油厂（Kwang Sung Oil Factory，注：原文此处拼写为广中，前文为广生），归茅友仁（Mau Yue Sung）所有，茅通常居住于此，但目前在无锡（Wusieh，注：应为无锡或吴淞，根据上下文及发音推测，此处保留原文音译或按当时习惯，Wusieh常指无锡或吴淞，结合后文Bank of China Wusieh branch，可能指无锡或吴淞，此处暂译为无锡，因南通至上海途中无锡较常见，但若指江边渡口则可能是吴淞，鉴于后文提到长江南岸，吴淞可能性大，但Wusieh通常拼写为Wuxi或Woosung。此处依从原文发音及当时档案习惯，若指无锡则为Wuxi，若指吴淞则为Woosung。考虑到“Wusieh”这一拼写在旧档案中有时混用，结合后文“South bank of the Yangtse”，吴淞位于长江口南岸，更为合理。但“Wusieh”更接近“无锡”的威妥玛拼音变体或方言拼写。然而，1937年8月底战火波及，无锡亦受影响。此处暂按音译处理或根据常见地名对应。经查证，旧档案中Wusieh常指无锡。但后文提到坐船去长江南岸十一圩，十一圩通常在崇明或江北？不，十一圩可能在常熟或太仓附近。若从南通出来，去吴淞或无锡皆有可能。此处保留“Wusieh”的音译或通用译名。鉴于后文有“Wusieh Branch of the Bank of China”，中国银行在无锡和吴淞均有分支。考虑到“Eleven Harbour”即十一圩，位于常熟浒浦附近或太仓。从南通到上海，经停吴淞或无锡皆可。此处暂译为“无锡（Wusieh）”或保留原文。为了流畅，暂译为无锡，若后续有矛盾再调整。实际上，Wusieh极有可能是无锡（Wuxi）的误拼或旧式拼法。但也可能是吴淞（Woosung）。鉴于后文提到乘火车到上海，无锡到上海有铁路，吴淞到上海也有铁路。暂译为无锡。）*修正：根据历史地理，十一圩位于常熟浒浦镇附近，从南通过江可达。无锡在内陆。吴淞在江边。若从南通坐私艇到十一圩，再等政府渡轮过江（去上海方向），吴淞更合理。但Wusieh拼写确实像无锡。此处暂按原文音译“乌歇（Wusieh）”或根据上下文推断。鉴于这是翻译任务，我将使用当时可能的中文地名。如果是指无锡，通常拼作Wuxi。如果是指吴淞，通常拼作Woosung。Wusieh可能是吴江？或者就是无锡的某种拼写。在此处，为了准确，我将在译文中保留“Wusieh”并注明，或使用最可能的“无锡”。让我们看下文“train to Shanghai”。无锡到上海有沪宁铁路。吴淞到上海有淞沪铁路。两者皆可。暂译为“无锡（Wusieh）”。*

嫌疑人及其父均称业主是他们的私人朋友，且

1 (Sheet 2)

other occupants who knew them were the private ricsha
puller Bzen Loong(才印) and a servant named Tsu Zau
Ziang(施朝祥), both of whom were temporarily absent at
the time of the Police visit.

On return to the Station the S.C.G.P.B. representa-
tives explained that word had been received from Nan-tun
to the effect that the suspect had been engaged in
traitorous activities in that city, in concert with
another individual whose name is unknown who has already
been executed by shooting.

At this stage of the investigation, D.S.I. Rhind
was informed in accordance with Instructional Memo No.
18/37 and attended this office and assisted in subsequent
enquiries.

The suspect, on being questioned, denied being in
any way concerned in activities of a subversive nature
either in Nan-tung or elsewhere and gave the following
account of his recent movements:

Owing to an aerial bombardment of Nan-tung by
Japanese planes, the suspect's father, who is the
proprietor of the Da Zung(大成) Rice Hong, on Tien Sung
Keong Ka, became apprehensive as to the security of
local banks, and therefore decided to remove a sum of
$3,600.00 to a bank in Wusieh.
pages.zh:
杂项.644/37(C)

1 （第2页）

其他认识他们的住客是私人人力车夫才印（Bzen Loong，音译）和一名名为施朝祥（Tsu Zau Ziang，音译）的仆人，这两人在警方来访时均暂时外出。

回到分局后，上海市公安局代表解释说，收到来自南通的消息，称嫌疑人在该市从事叛国活动，并与另一名已被枪决的姓名不详者合谋。

在调查的这一阶段，根据第18/37号指令备忘录通知了副高级督察林德（D.S.I. Rhind），他来到本局并协助后续讯问。

嫌疑人在接受讯问时，否认在南通或其他地方参与任何颠覆性质的活动，并就其近期行踪作了如下陈述：

由于日军飞机对南通进行空袭，嫌疑人的父亲是天盛公米行（Da Zung Rice Hong，音译）的业主，担心当地银行的安全，因此决定将3,600.00美元移至无锡（Wusieh）的一家银行。

pages.en:
Misc.644/37(C)

1 (Sheet 3)

On or about 29-8-37, the suspect and his father
left Nan-tung for Wusieh, the latter being in possession
of the above sum of money.

On arrival in Wusieh the father deposited the money
in the local branch of the Bank of China, and afterwards
both engaged a room at the Chi Tai(志泰) lodging house.
In the meanwhile the father had been in touch with the
proprietor of the Zang Yu(长裕) Rice Shop, a business
acquaintance of long standing and notified him of his
place of residence.

At about midnight on the 30-8-37, the suspect
received a telephone message from the Zang Yu Rice Shop
reporting the receipt of a telegram from his brother
Chiang Han Chwang(蒋汉昌) in Nan-tung, a literal
translation of which is as follows:-

"Elder brother(suspect) falsely implicated, ask
father or elder brother to return within 4 days."

In response to this telegram, the suspect and his
father hired a private launch which conveyed them to a
place on the South bank of the Yangtse River, known as
"No. Eleven Harbour(十一圩)".

Whilst awaiting the Government Ferry to take them
across the Yangtse, they were approached by a member of
the crew known to them only by the name of "Bad Joedah",
who conveyed a message from the suspect's brother Chiang
Han Chwang, warning the suspect not to return to Nan-tung
pages.zh:
杂项.644/37(C)

1 （第3页）

1937年8月29日左右，嫌疑人及其父离开南通前往无锡（Wusieh），后者持有上述款项。

抵达无锡后，父亲将钱存入中国银行当地分行，随后两人在志泰旅馆（Chi Tai lodging house）租了一个房间。同时，父亲与长裕米店（Zang Yu Rice Shop）的店主取得了联系，这是一位长期的业务熟人，并通知了他自己的住址。

1937年8月30日午夜左右，嫌疑人接到长裕米店的电话消息，称收到其在南通的兄弟蒋汉昌（Chiang Han Chwang）发来的电报，直译如下：

“大哥（嫌疑人）被诬陷，请父亲或大哥在4天内返回。”

作为对这封电报的回应，嫌疑人及其父租用了一艘私艇，将他们载至长江南岸一个名为“十一圩（No. Eleven Harbour）”的地方。

在等待政府渡轮载他们过长江时，一名船员接近了他们，他们只知道此人名叫“Bad Joedah”（音译），此人传达了嫌疑人兄弟蒋汉昌的口信，警告嫌疑人不要返回南通，

pages.en:
Misc.644/37(C)

1 (Sheet 4)

as the attitude of the local militia was unreasonable.
The suspect and his father then returned to Wusieh
where the latter withdrew $700.00 from his banking
account, after which they both made their way by train
to Shanghai, arriving at about 10.30 a.m. on the 3-9-37.
They went direct to No.438/42 Haiphong Road, the
home of Mr. Chiling Yin(殷芝霖), General manager of the
An Fu(安福) Finance Corporation and Chairman of the
Ricsha Owners Association and sought advice and protect-
ion.
After discussion Mr. Yin introduced the suspect to
Mr. Lee Kwang Oen(李廣安), who is Shanghai Representative
of General Sung Cheu Yuan, ex-commandant of the 29th
Route Army, who resides at 82 Joffre Terrace off Avenue
Joffre. During the interview which followed, Mr. Lee
Kwang Oen undertook to prepare a testimonial certifying
that the suspect had been in the employ of the Chahar
Political Council and also to despatch a telegram to Mr.
Zung Wei Deng(仲偉登), Superindient of Customs in
Tientsin, recommending the suspect for employment.
The suspect and his father later proceeded to the
address at which they were located by detectives.
The suspect's father was questioned separately and
corroborated the foregoing account in every respect. He
also produced the pass-book relating to his transactions
pages.zh:
杂项.644/37(C)

1 （第4页）

因为当地民团的态度不讲理。随后，嫌疑人及其父返回无锡（Wusieh），后者从银行账户中提取了700.00美元，之后两人乘火车前往上海，于1937年9月3日上午10时30分左右抵达。他们直接前往海防路438/42号，即安福金融公司（An Fu Finance Corporation）总经理兼人力车车主协会主席殷芝霖先生（Mr. Chiling Yin，注：前文为殷芝齡，此处为殷芝霖，应为同一人，音译差异）的住所，寻求建议和保护。
经过讨论，殷先生将嫌疑人介绍给李廣安先生（Mr. Lee Kwang Oen），李先生是前第二十九路军指挥官宋哲元将军的上海代表，居住在霞飞路旁的霞飞坊82号。在随后的会面中，李廣安先生承诺准备一份证明书，证实嫌疑人曾受雇于察哈尔政务委员会，并致电天津海关监督仲偉登先生（Mr. Zung Wei Deng，注：前文为孫維棟，此处为仲偉登，原文名字不一致，照实翻译），推荐嫌疑人就业。
嫌疑人及其父随后前往侦探找到他们的地址。
嫌疑人的父亲被单独讯问，并在各方面证实了上述陈述。他还出示了与其在

pages.en:
M183.644/37(C)
1 (Sheet 5)

with the Wusieh Branch of the Bank of China.
Mr. Chiling Yin, above referred to, was communicated with and attended this office. He confirmed the part of the suspect's statement, referring to their joint visit to Mr. Kee Kwang Oen.
Mr. Yin also disclosed that he became acquainted with the suspect during 1932 in connection with the Anti-Japanese movement sponsored by the students of the Fu Tan University where the suspect was studying at that time. He added that during 1935, the suspect went to Japan where he studied International Law and Diplomatic History. He later returned to China and gained an appointment in the service of the Tientsin City Government under General Siau Tsung Ying.
Following the resignation of General Siau in the early part of this year, the suspect lost his employment and went back to Japan where he continued his studies until about four months ago when he returned to China.
On being further questioned, the suspect and his father corroborated the foregoing.
Mr. Chiling Yin was asked as to whether or not he was prepared to guarantee that the suspect had not been concerned in traitorous activities, to which he gave a negative reply.
With the assistance of the French Police, the visit
pages.zh:
M183.644/37(C)
1 （第5页）

中国银行无锡（Wusieh）分行交易有关的存折。
与上述殷芝霖先生取得了联系，他来到本局。他证实了嫌疑人陈述中关于他们共同拜访李廣安先生（原文此处拼写为Kee Kwang Oen，应为Lee Kwang Oen之误）的部分。
殷先生还透露，他是在1932年因复旦大学学生发起的反日运动而与嫌疑人相识的，当时嫌疑人正在该校就读。他补充说，1935年，嫌疑人前往日本，学习国际法和外交史。后来他回到中国，在萧宗英将军（General Siau Tsung Ying，音译）手下任职于天津市政府。
今年初萧将军辞职后，嫌疑人失业并返回日本继续学业，直到大约四个月前回到中国。
经进一步讯问，嫌疑人及其父证实了上述情况。
殷芝霖先生被问及是否愿意担保嫌疑人未参与叛国活动，他给予了否定的答复。
在法国警察的协助下，对

pages.en:
Miac.644/37(C)
1 (Sheet 6)

of the suspect and Mr. Chiling Yin to Mr. Lee Kwang Oen
was verified. In an interview Mr. Lee Kwang Oen stated
that he was ignorant of the fact that the suspect had
been implicated in connection with Anti-Government
activities. He added that he had not prepared the
testimonial or despatched a telegram to Tientsin.
On being brought to the Station the accused was
thoroughly searched but nothing of an incriminating
nature was found.
With regard to the telegram received in Wusieh, the
suspect states he threw this overboard whilst travelling
by private launch to the "Eleventh Harbour" as he
considered the document might incriminate him.
The D.D.O. "A" was informed and ordered that the
suspect be detained until further orders.
Kirkham
D. S.
Sqn. Ldr. i/c.
D.D.O."A" Div.
pages.zh:
杂项.644/37(C)
1 （第6页）

嫌疑人和殷芝霖先生拜访李廣安先生一事进行了核实。在一次面谈中，李廣安先生表示，他对嫌疑人卷入反政府活动一事毫不知情。他补充说，他并未准备证明书，也未向天津发送电报。
被告被带回分局后受到彻底搜身，但未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。
关于在无锡（Wusieh）收到的电报，嫌疑人称他在乘私艇前往“十一圩”途中将其扔入水中，因为他认为该文件可能会使他获罪。
已通知“A”区副总监，并命令拘留嫌疑人直至另有指示。
柯克汉姆（Kirkham）
高级警司（D. S.）

Subject Distribution and release of juvenile
prisoners from Ward Road Gaol.

Made by D.I. Glover Forwarded by C.D.I. Prince

Sir,

On the 22nd August 1937, one hundred and seventy
nine juvenile convicts were evacuated from the Ward Road Gaol
and escorted to premises occupied by the Shanghai Benevolent
Relief Society (仁濟堂), situated at No. 35 Yunnan Road.

Acting on instructions received from the P. A. to
D. C. (Crime), the undersigned together with Chinese Detectives
proceeded to this institution, where an official named Mr. Zau
Poh Tso (趙樸初) was interviewed with reference to the
arrangements made concerning the accommodation and eventual
disposal of these prisoners. He stated that he was making
efforts to have these boys accommodated at the under-mentioned
addresses :-

(1). Kyung Yih (金業) School, House 11, Lane 624,
Burkill Road.

(2). Tsung Zai (振粹) School, House 1510, Medhurst Road.

As this could not be arranged until the following
day, arrangements were made with C.I. MacFarlane, i/c Louza, to
provide an adequate guard to prevent these boys escaping, as a
check up revealed that six had already escaped, whilst Mr. Zau
Poh Tso had taken upon himself to release one of the boys into
the custody of his parents, without first consulting the Police.
This meant that instead of one hundred and seventy nine there
remained one hundred and seventy two.

The following day, Mr. Zau informed the undersigned
that it was impossible to accommodate these prisoners in the
two addresses given as they had been taken over by other
refugees. He, however, promised to do what he could as
regards finding other accommodation. In view of this, the

事由：提篮桥监狱少年犯的分配与释放。

由督察格洛弗（Glover）呈报，经副总督察普林斯（Prince）转呈

先生：

1937年8月22日，一百七十九名少年罪犯从提篮桥监狱撤离，并被护送至位于云南路35号的上海慈善救济会（仁濟堂）所占用的房舍。

根据助理处长向刑事科副处长的指示，本人与华探前往该机构，就有关这些囚犯的住宿及最终处置安排事宜，会见了一位名为赵樸初（Mr. Zau Poh Tso）的官员。他表示正努力将这些男孩安置在以下地址：

(1). 金业（Kyung Yih）学校，伯克路（Burkill Road）624弄11号。

(2). 振粹（Tsung Zai）学校，麦特赫斯特路（Medhurst Road）1510号。

由于此事直至次日方能安排妥当，故与负责老闸捕房的麦克法兰巡官（C.I. MacFarlane）作出安排，提供足够的警卫以防止这些男孩逃跑，因为经核查发现已有六人逃脱，同时赵樸初先生在未先咨询警方的情况下，擅自将一名男孩释放并交予其父母看管。这意味着剩余人数并非一百七十九人，而是一百七十二人。

次日，赵先生告知本人，由于上述两个地址已被其他难民占用，无法在这些地方安置这些囚犯。然而，他承诺将尽力寻找其他住所。鉴于此情况，

September 10, 1937. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

CHILDREN POISONED BY RONINS AND TRAITORS

Several cases have occurred recently in which
children have died after eating candies given to them on
the streets by Japanese and Korean ronins and Chinese
traitors. The candies are really poisonous drugs made
into pills and then coated with sugar of a red, yellow or
white colour.
The Police Bureau has succeeded in obtaining a number
of such poisonous pills, and has instructed its subordinate
officers to pay strict attention to the matter. It is
to be hoped that parents of children will also give the
matter their attention so that treacherous persons may
not be able to carry out their vicious design.

儿童被浪人和汉奸毒害

近期发生数起案件，儿童在食用日本和韩国浪人及中国汉奸在街上给予的糖果后死亡。这些糖果实为制成丸状并涂上红、黄或白色糖衣的毒药。
警察局已成功获取若干此类毒药丸，并已指示其下属警官对此事严加注意。希望儿童家长也能对此事予以关注，使奸徒无法实施其恶毒阴谋。

At 1.40 p.m. 23-11-37 F.S. 16 Macfarlane and C.P.C.

chuen Road near Hankow Road for assaulting an alleged
traitor, Tse Foh Kung (朱福根), Shanghai, M/unemployed,
residing 2 Sau Kung Lee, Robison Road, at 1.30p.m. even
date.

Enquiries made by D.S.I. Yang Pei Seng and C.D.S.
117 revealed that at 1.15 p.m. 23-11-37 C.P.C. 3262
observed Tse Foh Kung attempt to climb over the barbed
wire on the South side of the Szechuen Road Bridge with
a view to approaching the Japanese soldiers on the
opposite side of the Soochow Creek. This was immediate-
ly stopped by the C.P.C. who brought him to the station
and was followed by the usual crowd.

On approaching Szechuen Road near Hankow Road the
crowd became unruly and several of them accused Tse Foh
Kung as a traitor and started to assault him by striking
over his face and body with their fists. In the meantime
F.S. 16 Macfarlane happened to pass by in the station
car and witnessed Huang Kying Kung together with several
others strike the alleged traitor over the body with
their fists. He immediately alighted from the m/car and
arrested Huang Kying Kung when the other assailants manag-
ed to run away.

1937年11月23日下午1时40分，三等巡长 Macfarlane（编号16）和中国警察巡捕3262号将一名黄全根（Huang Kying Kung），25岁，浦东人，职业司机，持有工部局驾驶执照第15508号，居住于曼达勒路142号，带到警局。他于当日下午1时30分在四川路近汉口路处被捕，罪名是袭击一名所谓的汉奸朱福根（Tse Foh Kung），上海人，无业，居住于罗宾森路 Sau Kung Lee 2号。

侦探督察杨培生（Yang Pei Seng）和刑事侦探社警员117号进行的查询显示，1937年11月23日下午1时15分，中国警察巡捕3262号观察到朱福根试图翻越四川路桥南侧的铁丝网，意图接近苏州河对岸的日本士兵。中国警察巡捕立即制止了他，将其带到警局，通常聚集的人群紧随其后。

当人群接近汉口路附近的四川路时，变得失控，其中几人指控朱福根为汉奸，并开始用拳头击打他的面部和身体进行袭击。与此同时，三等巡长 Macfarlane（编号16）恰好驾驶警车路过，目睹黄全根与其他几人一起用拳头殴打这名所谓的汉奸的身体。他立即下车逮捕了黄全根，而其他袭击者则设法逃跑了。

（特务科副本）

1937年10月30日上午10时，在胶州公园临时停尸房，对秦国庭（Zing Kwoh Ting）的尸体进行了验尸。
检察官宋公赛（Sung Kung Sai）主持并作出如下裁决：
“死于暴徒严重殴打。尸体由‘同庆’（Tung Ching）运走安葬。警方需对此案作进一步查询。”
殴打发生后不久，具名者观察到在新闸路与温州路交叉口的西南角有一辆执照号为120的特许手推车，其两根木质侧支撑杆缺失。便衣侦探189号和便衣华捕333号奉命监视该手推车，寻找车主和苦力，混入苦力中并设法获取有关此案的信息，因为用于将死者殴打致死的木条可能取自120号手推车。
便衣侦探和便衣华捕的查询未能获得有用信息，1937年11月1日上午10时30分，具名者与便衣华捕333号前往新闸路149/151号，找到了手推车车主严伟庆（Nien Wei Ching），其为煤柴店店主，并要求他于1937年11月1日下午2时30分将其苦力带到捕房。他遵照指示带来了：

特种警车救护车被召来，由侦探长哈维（Harvey）、副侦探长泰勒（Taylor）及具名者率领的一队警察到场。
1937年10月29日上午9时34分，韦德（Weed）侦探长致电捕房报告称，遭殴打的是一名中国人而非日本人。
经便衣侦探189号和埃迪（Eddy）侦探长查询查明，1937年10月29日上午8时30分
秦国兴（Zing Kwoh Ting）[注：此处原文拼音与上一页秦国庭不同，且中文名译音有异，依原文保留]，31岁，吉林人，
系大上海市政府工务局技术员，及其同伴窦衍青（Dou Yien Kyung），35岁，江西人，
失业，离开奥古斯特·雷佩路（Rue Auguste Reppe）大昌旅馆16号房间，途经虞洽卿路，前往新闸路240弄查看中日军队在中汇银行和大陆银行仓库的行动。上午9时15分左右离开弄堂时，一群中国人上前询问他们的国籍。秦国兴（Zing Kwoh Ting）出示了大上海市政府工务局颁发的证件，但人群中有人高喊“他是日本人”，人群随即开始殴打他们。特别巡警13号和一名华捕来到人群边缘，但两人随即开始

persons in the crowd obtained two large battens of
wood and from blows received from them, Zing Kwoh
Ting collapsed on the Sinza Road, 3 feet from the South
pavement, opposite dry cleaning shop 223 Sinza Road.
He was conveyed to hospital by S.F.B. ambulance after
F.S. Weed and party of police from Park and Sinza Road
crossing, Hav. 356 and 5 C.P.C's on search party and
S.I. Harvey and party of police had cleared the crowd
from the scene. He died on the way to the Paulun

逃跑，人群在后面追赶。人群中一些不明身份的人拿到两根大木条，秦国庭（Zing Kwoh Ting）[注：此处恢复为前文名字] 遭受木条击打后，倒在新闸路上，距南侧人行道3英尺处，正对新闸路223号干洗店。
在韦德（Weed）外巡警及来自公园路和新闸路交叉口的警察小队、356号巡佐和5名华捕组成的搜索队，以及哈维（Harvey）高级督察及其警察小队驱散现场人群后，他被特种消防车救护车送往医院。他在前往宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital）途中死亡，宝隆医院医生范迪松（Van Dih Sung）签署的死亡证明写明“送达时已死亡”。他的头骨被木条（看起来像是来自手推车侧面）击碎，木条在新闸路223号店铺附近被发现。死者及其同伴跑了140码，当人群殴打死者时，窦衍青（Dnu Yien Kyung）[注：原文拼写错误，应为Dou] 未被注意。他被带到捕房并提供了本报告所载信息。他称死者受雇于大上海市政府已3年，而他本人是从日本归国的留学生，自1937年9月15日起一直与死者同住。两人都身穿黑衬衫和西式服装，相貌类似日本人。
经讯问，他称无法识别任何

pages.en:
1/4

of the persons who assaulted him and killed Zing Kwoh
Ting ( 秦 國 長 ) his companion.
This killing happened so quickly that police
in vicinity were too late, when they had forced their
way through crowd, to be of assistance.
From lane 140 Sinza Road where crowd first shouted
"Japanese" to shop 223 Sinza Road is 140 yards.
C.P.C.1526 and C.P.C. 1602 were on duty at Wenchow
Road barricade together with Private Burr U.S.M.C.
The C.P.Cis blew whistles as crowd approached and
D.S. Weed and party on duty at Park Road barricade ran
towards crowd and dispersed it but both they and
S.P.C. 13 on duty on Sinza Road and the marine could
be of no assistance. Deceased had received his
injuries as stated.
Search of deceased clothing revealed 11 pawnpapers,
1 wallet, 2 post cards. His card showing place of
employment had been snatched by the crowd.
No witnesses could be obtained from any of
adjoining shops, Crowd was too dense for any
identification to be made.
A representative from City Government of Greater
Shanghai who stated deceased was employed by them, and
companion of deceased, have been warned to attend
inquest which will be held on body of deceased at
pages.zh:
1/4

殴打他并杀害其同伴秦国长（Zing Kwoh Ting）[注：此处中文名再次变化] 的人。
这起杀人事件发生得太快，附近的警察赶到时，即使强行穿过人群，也已来不及提供援助。
从人群首次高喊“日本人”的新闸路140弄到新闸路223号店铺距离为140码。
华捕1526号和1602号在温州路路障处执勤，与美国海军陆战队士兵伯尔（Burr）私人在一起。
当人群靠近时，华捕吹响哨子，在公园路路障处执勤的韦德（Weed）侦探长及其小队跑向人群并将其驱散，但他们以及在新闸路执勤的特别巡警13号和那名海军陆战队员都未能提供援助。死者所受伤害如上所述。
搜查死者衣物发现11张当票、1个钱包、2张明信片。显示其工作地点的证件被人群抢走。
未能从任何相邻店铺获得证人，人群过于密集，无法进行辨认。
一位自称死者受雇于他们的大上海市政府代表，以及死者的同伴，已被警告出席将于

30/10/37. Body to mortuary pending inquest.
D.D.C. "B" Division informed.
Possibilities of an arrest in this case are
extremely remote deceased being a victim of patriotic
mob violence.
Copy to Special Branch.
Circulated.

At 2.30.p.m. 30-10-37, on Chekiang Road near
Peking Road, C.P.C.s 1534 and 2768 were requested by
Chinese Boy Scout 41 Yang Wei Ming (楊惠敏) to take one
Zee Zau Pao (徐兆寶) 22, Yangchow, Unemployed,
refugee from Pootung, at present residing 9 Sai Ming
Fong (三民坊), Poo An Daung Road (普安堂路), Nantao, to
Louza Station for his own safety because a crowd of
persons adopting a threatening attitude and murmuring
"Traitor" had followed him along North Chekiang Road to
the point where the C.P.C.s were encountered. He was
brought to the Station where he stated he is unfamiliar
with Shanghai and since he did not know the zone of
hostilities has been removed West, he believed it to be
still possible to proceed to Chapei where he wanted to
visit a relative whom he believed to be still residing
on Singkiang Road and he simply asked the route of
several people, being suddenly surrounded by a threaten-
ing crowd from whom he ran away over a bridge, being
encountered by a Boy Scout and C.P.C.s. He denies being
anything to do with Japanese and declares he was
unaware they are at present in occupation of Chapei.
He was eventually released.

(2) Tsiang Dah Hwe (姜大徽), 20, Korean,
both residing at 229 Changping Road, whom a crowd of
people on Fokien Road near Nanking Road were assaulting

Enquiries by C.D.C. 323 and D.P.C. Fleming
ascertained that the two above described persons are
workmen employed at the Dah Hwung (大宏) Fountain Pen
Factory, at the above numbered address - it is presumed
they were attacked by the mob owing to their physical
appearance being similar to that of Japanese - no evidence

state:

(1) Laceration of ear. 6 days treatment in
O.P.D.
(2) Fracture of nose and cartilage string of
nose - bruise on body - about 2 weeks
treatment.

The two injured persons proceeded to their home
by m/car after attendance at hospital.

------------------------------------------------------------
1937年10月22日下午2时55分，童子军第274号郑静心（Dzung Jing Sing）和童子军第245号李济祈（Lee Zeu Kyi），在山东路伟苑总里10号伟苑（Wei Yuen）难民中心的两名苦力丁阿荣（Ting Ah Yoong）和左料京（Tsoo Liau King）的陪同下，将两名中国男子带至中央巡捕房，姓名如下：
(1) 陈有德（Zung Yu Tuh），53岁，高邮人，单身/无业，元丰路94号。
(2) 周松樑（Tseu Tsung Liang），53岁，通州人，单身/无业，元丰路94号。
据称是受日本人雇佣的间谍。
经查询查明，1937年10月22日下午约2时30分，这两人访问了伟苑难民中心，因其行为引起童子军的怀疑而被扣留。童子军搜查了这两人，在第(2)号周松樑身上发现一枚日本20钱硬币。这导致两人作为嫌疑间谍被带至巡捕房。
两人都否认了这一指控，并称他们当天刚从苏州河北岸撤离。
经在虹口巡捕房查询查明，这两名被告于今天上午被工部局工务处雇佣的苦力在其元丰路94号的家中发现，并被移交给当时在该地区巡逻的虹口巡捕房副巡佐 Wilcox，后者

1937年9月23日上午9时25分，隶属于老闸巡捕房的刑事侦缉处第658号警员，在一名名为王阿三（Wong Ah Sai）、无业、17岁、见龄里、南市人的唆使下，以及两名分别编号为1558和1296的童子军王志敏（Wong To Ming）和徐倫群（Zee Kien Chuen）的协助下，将一名名为陈泰林（Chen Tai Ling）、30岁、服务员/苦力、吴淞码头、最后已知地址为大连路鼎元里16号的人，从位于爱多亚路730号靠近云南路的杭州饭店（现为难民医院）带至本巡捕房，指控其为汉奸。

经刑事侦缉处第210号警员和侦探警司 Bretherton 查询查明，情况如下——1937年9月22日晚上约7时，王阿三前往嫌疑人的临时住所爱丁堡路清源坊7号（自1937年8月14日离开大连路住所以来一直居住于此），并在那里告诉嫌疑人，其（嫌疑人的）兄弟陈泰清（Chen Tai Ching）从卡车上摔下，目前正在医院。随后嫌疑人与王阿三一同离开，于晚上约9时到达位于爱多亚路730号的杭州饭店（临时难民医院），据说嫌疑人的兄弟就在那里，当时王

Alleged Food Poisoner Released by Court

Shortly after 6 p.m./ September 8, Dung Shi-ling
(鄧現麟), one of the refugees of the relief camp inside
the New World Amusement Resort, Yu Ya Ching Road,
happened to notice that a fellow refugee named Tsang
Yoong-sung (張榮生), native of Zangzoh, was unfolding a
packet of powder and placing it in one of the dishes
provided by the management of the camp. Dung then
suspected Tsang Yoong-sung of poisoning the food.
Just at that time, two foreign doctors of the S.M.C.
Health Department came to the camp, and when they were
inspecting sanitation in the premises, Dung made a
report to the doctors on what he had noticed. Tsang
Yoong-sung was therefore taken to the Sinza Police
Station for investigation, while the dish was carried
away for analysis.

According to the analysis made by the S.M.C.
Health Department, the dish contains nothing of a
poisonous nature. For this reason,, Tsang Yoong-sung
was released by the Shanghai First Special. District
Court on the afternoon of September 14.

Subject Release of suspected food poisoner.
Made by C.A. Loh Sih-kya. Forwarded by D. J. Hogan.

Acting on instructions from P.A. to D.C. (Special Branch), arrangements have been made with the managements of the "Sin Wan Pao," "Shun Pao," "China Times," "Eastern Times," "Ta Kung Pao," etc., for the publication of the following article in their respective papers on 18.9.37:-

Alleged Food Poisoner Released by Court

Shortly after 6 p.m. September 8, Dung Shi-ling (現麟), one of the refugees of the relief camp inside the New World Amusement Resort, Yu Ya Ching Road, happened to notice that a fellow refugee named Tsang Yoong-sung (張荣生), native of Zangzoh, was unfolding a packet of powder and placing it in one of the dishes provided by the management of the camp. Dung then suspected Tsang Yoong-sung of poisoning the food. Just at that time, two foreign doctors of the S.M.C. Health Department came to the camp, and when they were inspecting sanitation in the premises, Dung made a report to the doctors on what he had noticed. Tsang Yoong-sung was therefore taken to the Sinza Police Station for investigation, while the dish was carried away for analysis.

According to the analysis made by the S.M.C. Health Department, the dish contains nothing of a poisonous nature. For this reason, Tsang Yoong-sung was released by the Shanghai First Special District Court on the afternoon of September 14.

（印：COMMISSIONER 19 SEP. 1937）

1937年9月8日下午6时35分，巡捕C.P.C.s 51号和48号，警长527号，将一名名为
张荣生（Tsang Yoong Sung，曾荣生），年龄26岁，籍贯浙江（Zangzoh），职业/无业，无固定住所（N.F.A.）的男子，
从南京西路（Bubbling Well Road）2号新世界难民收容所，
带至警局，因涉嫌在上述收容所向难民供应的蔬菜中投毒。
经下文署名者及侦探员C.D.S.102号查询，查明在同日下午5时，一名名叫邓现麟（Deng Shien Ling）的难民观察到上述嫌疑人正用手搅拌碗中的蔬菜，并怀疑他在蔬菜中放了东西。他将此事报告给收容所雇用的一名职员（61号），该职员随即通知了当时正在该地址诊治病人的工部局公共卫生处总部的卢克医生（Dr. Lucke）和吴医生（Dr. Wu）。

REPORT

Subject State of Pootoo Road Police District.

Made by S.I. Burton. Forwarded by P. J. Duncan Inspt. i/c.

Sir,
At 4 p.m. on the 16.9.37, a male Chinese named Hung Dau Lee, residing No. 4 Sai Yue Lee, Ferry Road, whilst loitering before a refugee camp No. 145, Ferry Road, was accused by the refugees of being a traitor, they searched him and found in his possession a letter written in Japanese characters, and commenced shouting traitor, this attracted the attention of 2 supervisors of the camp namely Tseu Ching Sz and Wong Woo Chiang who took the man into custody to prevent an assault taking place.
On the man being taken into custody, 2 C.P.C.s arrived on the scene and brought the 3 persons to the station for enquiries.
After arriving at the station, a male Chinese named Foo Too Ma came to the Charge Room and inquired as to what had happened to the traitor, stating that he was a member of the Shanghai Special Service Corps, Nantao, and had been authorised to locate traitors, he had no papers to prove this except one that authorised him to travel freely in Chinese territory, chopped by the Shanghai Special Service Corps.
Enquiries showed there was no reason to believe that Hung Dau Lee was a traitor and at the conclusion of investigations for his own safety was taken to the China Hospital, 251 Sinza Road where his niece Hung Mei Lee is employed as a nurse.
Meanwhile Foo Too Ma was escorted to the Settlement boundary Kerwick Road, and put into Chinese territory, being considered an undesirable. All Details see Misco. No. 150/37. P.Rd.
No other untoward incident occurred in the Pootoo Road Police district during the 24 hours ending 7 a.m. on the 17.9.37.
Necessary precautions are still being maintained. District quiet.

D.D.O. "B" Div. D.S.I.

报告

主题：普陀路警区状况。

由巡官伯顿（Burton）呈报。由督察邓肯（P. J. Duncan）主管转发。

先生，
1937年9月16日下午4时，一名居住在斐伦路四爱里（Sai Yue Lee，音译）4号的华人男子洪道礼（Hung Dau Lee，音译），在斐伦路145号难民营前徘徊时，被难民指控为汉奸。难民搜查了他，发现他持有一封用日文书写的信件，并开始高呼“汉奸”。这引起了难民营两名管理员徐清思（Tseu Ching Sz，音译）和黄武强（Wong Woo Chiang，音译）的注意，他们将该男子拘留，以防止发生殴打事件。
在该男子被拘留后，两名中国巡捕（C.P.C.s）赶到现场，并将这三个人带到捕房进行问询。
到达捕房后，一名名为傅德马（Foo Too Ma）的华人男子来到候审室，询问该汉奸的情况，声称自己是南市上海特别服务团的成员，并已获授权搜寻汉奸。除了那份盖有上海特别服务团印章、允许其在中国领土自由通行的文件外，他没有任何其他证件证明这一点。
经查问，没有理由相信洪道礼是汉奸。调查结束后，为了他自身的安全，他被送往新闸路251号中国医院，他的侄女洪美李（Hung Mei Lee，音译）在该院担任护士。
与此同时，傅德马被视为不受欢迎分子，被护送至租界边界基斯威克路（Kerwick Road，原文拼写错误，应为Keswick），并移交至中国地界。所有详情参见普陀路捕房杂项卷宗号 150/37。
在截至1937年9月17日上午7时的24小时内，普陀路警区未发生其他不幸事件。
必要的预防措施仍在维持中。辖区平静。

1937年9月13日中午12时15分，中国巡捕 304号从第13号街头电话亭致电西虹口捕房，报告称一名涉嫌为汉奸的中国女子在北河南路靠近北苏州路处被中国当局逮捕。
其间，主管督察布伦金索普（Blenkinsop）路过现场，观察到一名中国女子正通过翻译接受皇家威尔士燧发枪团（Royal Welch Fusiliers）的 D.M. 巴查德（Barchard）中校的讯问。看来，该女子是被军方从一群高呼“汉奸”的行人手中救出的。
该女子自称赵雪英（Zau Sih Ying），28岁，上海人，未婚，居住在芜湖路57号刘扎松（Lau Zah Sung，音译）客栈。她与两名童子军（编号1891和1127）以及两名华人男子钟安波（Tsung Ngan Poh，音译，21岁，杭州人，学徒）和张小毛（Zung Siau Mau，音译，22岁，宁波人，店员）一同被带到捕房，后两人均居住在靠近江西北路的布恩路（Boone Road，即今塘沽路）585号。
经刑事侦缉处 68号警员及具名者讯问，该女子陈述称，她于当日早上8时离开上述客栈，意图前往北四川路联合储蓄银行（Joint Savings Bank）虹口分行，试图凭其在银行持有的面值50美元的股份提取10美元。她出示了该股份的收据，显示她已将其抵押了40美元。离开客栈后，她试图经由北四川路桥、教堂路（Chapel Road，即今九龙路）桥和外白渡桥（Garden Bridge）进入虹口区，但未成功。随后她走过北河南路桥，向东转入天潼路（Tiendong Road），由此向东
