    A search of her belongings failed to reveal anything that would

gave instructions for her to be escorted to her place of residence.

然而，当就此受到讯问时，他们声称当时正试图阻止人群殴打她。
该女子在接受讯问时的态度给侦探留下了精神错乱的印象。在审讯期间，她声称自己有一名情夫名为顾宗庆（Koo Zung Ching），居住在斐伦路。当侦探试图寻找此人时，她却将他们带到了汇丰银行经理亨奇曼（Henchman，音译）先生的家中。在客栈的调查也显示，她有歇斯底里的习惯。
她还告诉侦探，她在上海没有亲属。
对其随身物品的搜查未能发现任何能证明她是汉奸或与日本人有某种联系的证据。

Re alleged "traitors" mobbed outside
Yinmo Guild.

Further to this case, at 8.10p.m. 16-8-37 C.P.C.
2713 telephoned Louza Station to the effect that a
"traitor" was being mobbed on Yu Ya Ching Rd near Burkill
Rd.

A party of Police attended and found one Zee Oeng
Si(錢鴻喜), 16, Kampo, S/Unemployed, N.F.A., had been
slightly injured by the mob. Nearby was a box containing
2 phials of "False-Breenon" and on the ground a similar
empty phial. The male Chinese was brought to Louza
Station and questioned, he admitting that he had been
given the box of phials and instructed to place them in
public ricksha coolie's tea urns in the Settlement. He
states that the man giving him the phials had later
been mobbed on Yu Ya Ching Road some time previously
and had been rescued by Police and taken to hospital.
Owing to the confusion existing at present, it was
useless to attempt identification in any hospital,
however accused will appear before the S.S.D. Court
at 9a.m. on 17-8-37 when application will be made for
a Writ of Detention for one week, pending analysis of the
seized liquid.

关于在银模公所外被暴民围攻的所谓“汉奸”。

就本案而言，1937年8月16日晚上8点10分，中央捕房华籍巡长2713号致电老闸捕房，称一名“汉奸”正在虞洽卿路近伯基尔路处被暴民围攻。

一队警员前往现场，发现一名叫 Zee Oeng Si（錢鴻喜），16岁，广东人，身份/无业，非本埠居民协会成员，被暴民轻微打伤。附近有一个盒子，里面装有2瓶“False-Breenon”（假布林农？音译），地上还有一个类似的空瓶。这名华裔男子被带到老闸捕房并接受讯问，他承认有人给了他那盒药瓶，并指示他将它们放入公共租界内人力车夫的茶水桶中。他说，给他药瓶的那个人此前曾在虞洽卿路上被暴民围攻，后被警察救出并送往医院。由于目前局势混乱，试图在任何医院进行辨认都是徒劳的，然而被告将于1937年8月17日上午9点出席特别巡捕法庭，届时将申请为期一周的拘留令，以待对查获液体进行分析。

Subject...Arrest of a suspected traitor.
Made by...D.I. Glover Forwarded by...C.D.I. Prince.

Sir,
At about 9.20 p.m. Sept. 6th, 1937, Boy No.69 Woo Yung Kung (何永根), aged 21 years, Native of Ningpo, employed at the "Red Cross" Hospital established by Mme H.H. Kung at the Lido Cabaret, Avenue Road, was walking along the Sinza Road carrying a torch light when he was given into the custody of C.P.C.2516 on suspicion of being a traitor. (G.Rd. Misc.158/37). The informant one named Lee Yuen Hwo (李润厚), aged 40 years, Native of Kwangtung, employed as a Watchman at a Refuge camp situated at the Tsing Liang Sze Mian (清凉寺廟) Sinza Road stated that he observed the accused flashing his torch light onto the pavement, which made him suspect that he was signalling to enemy aircraft. Two boy scouts named Ong Foh Tien and Zung Han Wo, attached to the Cantonese Guild, observing a number of persons collecting, interfered and prevented the accused man from being assaulted. Calling the above C.P.C. they had the man escorted to Gordon Rd Police Station. Enquiries were made by D.S. Ley's and C.D.C. 242, who ascertained that it was absolutely essential for the accused man to carry a torch light as there are no lights at present allowed at the "Lido". Further that he succeeded in locating the undermentioned employees of this establishment who vouched for the loyalty and respectability of this man :-
1. Leong Shih Idng (梁锡心) No.1 Boy.
2. Wan Yok Sang (袁玉堂) Boy.
3. Tang Yoeng Wo (楊永田) No.1 Cook.
At the time of this man's arrest the three above mentioned witnesses interceded with the informant for the accused's release, and offered to produce proof of his employment at this Hospital, but the man refused to listen to reason.

（左侧批注：）
S.I.

先生，
1937年9月6日晚约9点20分，69号童子军何永根（Woo Yung Kung），21岁，宁波籍，受雇于孔祥熙夫人（Mme H.H. Kung）在爱文义路丽都舞厅设立的“红十字会”医院，当他手持手电筒沿新闸路行走时，因涉嫌为汉奸而被移交给中央捕房华籍巡长2516号 custody（监管）。（戈登路杂项158/37）。举报人名叫李润厚（Lee Yuen Hwo），40岁，广东籍，受雇为新闸路清凉寺廟难民收容所的看守，他声称观察到被告将手电筒光闪射到人行道上，这使他怀疑被告是在向敌机发送信号。两名隶属于广东公所的童子军，名叫翁福田（Ong Foh Tien）和杨永田（Zung Han Wo，注：此处英文名与中文名对应可能有误，见下文），看到聚集的人群，介入并阻止了被告遭受殴打。他们叫来上述华籍巡长，将该男子护送至戈登路捕房。副巡官莱伊斯（Leys）和华籍侦探主任242号进行了调查，确定被告携带手电筒是绝对必要的，因为目前“丽都”不允许开灯。此外，他们成功找到了该机构的以下雇员，这些人担保此人的忠诚和正派：-
1. 梁锡心（Leong Shih Idng） 1号侍者。
2. 袁玉堂（Wan Yok Sang） 侍者。
3. 楊永田（Tang Yoeng Wo） 1号厨师。
在此人被捕时，上述三名证人为被告向举报人说情要求释放，并提出出示其在该医院受雇的证明，但该人拒绝听劝。

（左侧批注：）
S.I.

On being informed of this case the undersigned, who was
accompanied by D.S.I.s Bebenin and Soong Ping Sung, had the
accused and witnesses taken to C.I, where they were interrogated.
A search of the informant's clothing revealed a torch
light concealed in the back of his waist band, which he stated,
he used in performance of his duty. Why this man should take
exception to anyone else using a torch light is inexplicable
especially when the person he accuses uses the light for exactly
the same purpose as he does.
In view of the above, the Hospital was communicated with
but owing to the lateness of the hour it was impossible to obtain
guaranters of any standing. However, it was arranged that the
"boy" should remain at Headquarters until responsible guaranters
could be found.
At 9,30 a.m. Sept. 7th, 1937, the accused was released
on instructions received from C.D.I. Prince into the custody
of a Mr. Read who is in charge of the hospital, whilst the
informant was released after being severely cautioned as to his
future conduct.

                                        I am, Sir,

搜查举报人的衣物时，在其腰带后部发现藏有一只手电筒，他称这是他在执行职务时使用的。此人为何对其他人使用手电筒提出异议，令人费解，尤其是当他指控的人使用手电筒的目的与他完全相同时。
鉴于上述情况，已与医院联系，但由于时间太晚，无法找到任何有地位的担保人。不过，已安排该“侍者”留在总部，直到找到负责的担保人为止。
1937年9月7日上午9点30分，根据刑事侦缉处主任普林斯的指示，被告被释放，交由负责该医院的里德（Read）先生监管，而举报人在受到对其未来行为的严厉警告后被释放。

Date. September 6th, 37.
Subject Arrest of a suspected traitor.
Made by D.S. Leys. Forwarded by A. White Insp. 1/c.

Sir,
At 10.p.m. September 6th 1937, C.P.C. 2516 brought to
Gordon Road Police Station a male chinese named Woo Yoong
Kung (何荣根) age 21, native of Ningpo, S/Coolie, residing
306 Medhurst Road, who was handed over to him on Sinza Road
by one named Lee Zung Yih (李润源) caretaker of the Ching
Liang Temple, Sinza Road and two boy scouts (1) Ong Foh Dee
(翁福田) (2) Sung An Woo (陈汉华) on the suspicion of
being a traitor.
According to the story related by Lee Zung Yih, the person
responsible for the arrest of the suspect, he was on duty at
the entrance to the Ching Liang Temple Sinza Road (at present
used as a refugee camp) when he observed the suspected person
flashing a torch on the pavement and being of the opinion that
he was signalling to Japanese aeroplanes had him arrested.
The suspect on being questioned by C.D.C. 248 and under-
signed, stated that he was a coolie employed at the Lido Cabar-
et located at 306 Medhurst Road and added that at the time of
his arrest he was returning to his quarters from No.13 Wuting
Road, the home of his friend named Lee Yeong Kwei (李永奎).
Questioned regarding the possession of the electric torch
the suspect stated that he used the same to assist him in
finding his way to his quarters at the Lido Cabaret, because
all the lights were extinguished on the premises after dark.
Enquiries at the Lido Cabaret showed that the suspect
had been employed there since the opening date and was of
good character.
Three employees of the cabaret (1) Yuen Yau Dung (袁有堂)
No.1. Boy. (2) Sung Iah Shing (松连兴) (3) Yang Yeong Wo

先生，
1937年9月6日晚上10点，中央捕房华籍巡长2516号将一名华裔男子何荣根（Woo Yoong Kung），21岁，宁波籍，身份/苦力，居住于麦赫斯特路306号，带至戈登路捕房。此人由新闸路清凉寺看守李润源（Lee Zung Yih）和两名童子军 (1) 翁福田（Ong Foh Dee） (2) 陈汉华（Sung An Woo）在新闸路上以涉嫌为汉奸为由移交给他的。
据负责逮捕嫌疑人的李润源所述，他当时在新闸路清凉寺入口（现用作难民营）执勤，观察到嫌疑人在人行道上闪烁手电筒，他认为这是在向日本飞机发信号，遂将其逮捕。
嫌疑人在接受华籍侦探主任248号和下述签署人讯问时，称他是受雇于位于麦赫斯特路306号的丽都舞厅的苦力，并补充说，被捕时他正从朋友李永奎（Lee Yeong Kwei）家所在的吴淞路13号返回宿舍。
关于持有电筒一事，嫌疑人称他使用电筒是为了帮助他在丽都舞厅找到回宿舍的路，因为天黑后场所内的所有灯光都已熄灭。
在丽都舞厅进行的调查显示，嫌疑人自开业之日起便受雇于此，且品行良好。
舞厅的三名雇员 (1) 袁有堂（Yuen Yau Dung） 1号侍者。 (2) 松连兴（Sung Iah Shing） (3) 杨永华（Yang Yeong Wo，注：此处英文名与前文不同，暂按音译处理，或为同一人不同拼写）

Subject Arrest of a Chinese woman suspected of subversive activities.
Made by D.I. Glover Forwarded by C.D.I. Prince

Sir,
Investigations made with reference to the woman
Tung Yin Sion (张月仙), aged 24 years, Native of Pootung,
residing No. 9, Lane 482, Jessfield Road, O.O.L., arrested on
suspicion of engaging in subversive activities (Kaching Rd.
Memo. 153/37) show that no evidence exists to substantiate this
allegation.
Her object of going into the Hongkew District was
simply to deliver two parcels containing cigarettes to her
former employer, a Japanese, aged 65 years, named Kimura, and
also to learn from him if her personal effects left in his
charge at No. 378 Woosung Road had escaped damage.
She is of Chinese parentage, but was born in Japan,
where she lived until she was fifteen years of age. After this
she returned to China and completed her education at the Soochow
Middle School. After leaving school she returned to Kobe, Japan,
where her father has a tailoring business. Here she met a
friend of her father's named Kimura, who offered her a position
as accountant in his clothing shop, situated at No. 378 Woosung
Road. She worked at this address until April 1937, when she
returned to Japan to visit her parents. Returning to Shanghai
in July 1937 she severed her connection with Kimura's business
and went to live with her husband on Jessfield Road, she
having been married at the age of nineteen. On the 1st Sept.
1937 Kimura telephoned to her and asked if she would purchase
some cigarettes for him, which she agreed to do. At about
9 a.m. on the 4th Sept. 1937 Kimura again telephoned to her,
and asked her if she would deliver the cigarettes to him at
11 a.m. outside the New Asia Hotel. She agreed to do this as

先生：

经对女子张月仙（Tung Yin Sion），24岁，浦东人，现住极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）482弄9号，越界筑路区（O.O.L.），因涉嫌从事颠覆活动而被捕一事进行调查（参考嘉兴路备忘录 153/37），结果显示并无证据证实此项指控。

她前往虹口区的目的，仅仅是为了向她的前雇主、65岁的日本人木村（Kimura）交付两包香烟，并向他打听寄存在吴淞路378号由其保管的个人物品是否在战火中受损。

她父母均为中国人，但出生于日本，并在那里生活至15岁。此后她回到中国，在苏州中学完成学业。毕业后，她返回日本神户，其父在那里经营裁缝店。在那里，她结识了父亲的一位朋友木村，木村在其位于吴淞路378号的服装店里为她提供了一份会计职位。她在该地址工作至1937年4月，随后返回日本探望父母。1937年7月回到上海后，她断绝了与木村生意上的往来，并与丈夫同住于极司菲尔路，她于19岁时结婚。1937年9月1日，木村给她打电话，问她是否愿意代买一些香烟，她同意了。1937年9月4日上午9点左右，木村再次给她打电话，问她是否能在上午11点将香烟送到新亚酒店（New Asia Hotel）外交给他。她同意了，因为

Shortly after receiving this telephone message, she left home
with her husband and they proceeded by tramcar to the Sincere
Coy., Nanking Road, where they alighted. They then proceeded
the Yoong Sing (永興) Lane Hong, Room No. 106, House No. 441,
Hankow Road, where her husband handed over to her the cigarettes
which he had already purchased. She then left her husband and
proceeded to the intersection of Tiendong and North Honan Road
Bridge, where she alighted. Here she met C.P.C. 3570 who
advised her not to proceed in an easterly direction along
Tiendong Road, but disregarding his advice she passed through
the barricade and continued on until she came to a barricade
situated at the corner of Tiendong and North Szechuan Road.
Here members of the J.N.L.F. on duty at this barricade prevented
her from going any further. As she can speak Japanese, she
informed them of her mission, but as they still refused to allow
her to proceed she left the parcels with them, asking that they
be given to Kimura when he arrived. On her return she was met
at the Tiendong, Kiangsu Road barricade by an angry crowd who
had been informed of her conversation with the J.N.L.F. members
by the two witnesses Hyni Ching Sung (徐金祥), residing No. 84
Tiendong Road, and Tsien Wen Ping (錢文平), residing at a
refugee camp on Tatung Road. Had it not been for the intervention
of C.P.C. 3570, this woman might have been seriously assaulted
or killed. These two men, on being questioned, denied that they
were agents of any political, military or police organisation,
and stated they were acting through purely patriotic motives,
as they were incensed by a Chinese woman having any dealings

    她急于知道存放在木村店里的个人物品是否在最近的战斗中幸免于难。

接到这个电话后不久，她与丈夫离家，乘电车前往南京路的先施公司（Sincere Coy.）下车。随后他们前往汉口路441号永兴里（Yoong Sing Lane）106室，她的丈夫将已买好的香烟交给她。随后她离开丈夫，前往天通庵路与北河南路桥的交叉口下车。在那里，她遇到了华捕巡长（C.P.C.）3570号，该警员劝告她不要沿天通庵路向东行进，但她无视劝告，穿过路障继续前行，直到来到天通庵路与北四川路拐角处的路障。在此处，在该路障执勤的日本海军陆战队（J.N.L.F.）队员阻止她继续前进。由于她会讲日语，她向他们说明了自己的任务，但由于他们仍拒绝让她通过，她将包裹留给他们，请他们在木村到达时转交。在她返回途中，在天通庵路与江苏路路障处，一群愤怒的人群拦住了她，这些人是从两名证人徐金祥（Hyni Ching Sung，住天通庵路84号）和钱文平（Tsien Wen Ping，住大同路难民收容所）那里得知了她与日本海军陆战队队员谈话的内容。若非华捕巡长3570号介入，这名妇女可能会遭到严重殴打甚至被杀。这两名男子在接受讯问时，否认自己是任何政治、军事或警察组织的代理人，并称其行为纯粹出于爱国动机，因为他们对一名中国妇女与日本人有任何往来感到愤慨。

She was at this time in possession of two paper packages, and
after finishing her conversation with the members of the J.N.L.
P. placed the packages on the footpath at the rear of the

August 31, 1937.
2 Afternoon Translation.

The Social Evening News (社会晚报) published the following article on August 30 :-

TRAITOR ARRESTED ON PAKHOI ROAD : HANDED OVER TO AUTHORITIES

On the afternoon of August 29, three postmen noticed a Chinese being escorted over the North Szechuen Road Bridge by Japanese marines. Holding the view that, as the man had free access into the district where the enemy troops were, he must undoubtedly be a traitor, the three messengers went after him to the vicinity of the Palace Theatre, Pakhoi Road, where pedestrians were informed and the man was subsequently held up. As a result of a search, he was found to be in possession of $40 in legal tender notes and two letters, one in Chinese and the other in English. After a close interrogation, the man was found actually to be a traitor. Consequently he was handed over to the competent authorities for severe punishment.

China Times (Noon Issue) :-

JAPANESE SPOKESMAN ADMITS WOOSUNG FORTS STILL IN CHINESE HANDS

During a press interview extended yesterday afternoon at the Metropole Hotel by a spokesman of the Japanese naval and military authorities to local foreign newspaper reporters, a certain reporter queried whether the Japanese troops had occupied the Woosung Forts since they had effected their landing. In reply, the Japanese spokesman admitted that the Woosung Forts were actually still in Chinese hands.

Nearly all the reporters present criticized the bombing of the Chinese refugees at the South Railway Station by the Japanese planes on August 28. The Japanese spokesman declared that according to reports received, a large force of Chinese troops occupied the station at that time. Foreign newspaper reporters asked further how several thousands of refugees could be accommodated since the station was occupied by a large force of Chinese troops. The Japanese spokesman was unable to make a reply, but he later added that Japanese planes would continue the bombing, but they would refrain from dropping bombs on civilians. Questioned as to the reason for a change in the Japanese attitude, the Japanese spokesman stated that no bombing would be carried out if it were regarded as unnecessary from a military point of view, and that warning would be given in advance if bombing of Nantao were to be carried out. Asked by foreign newspaper reporters how the people could effect their escape in a hurry in case of an air raid, the Japanese spokesman said that there would still be some means of escape.

《社会晚报》于8月30日刊登了以下文章：-

北海路逮捕汉奸：移交当局

8月29日下午，三名邮差注意到一名中国人正由日本海军陆战队士兵护送穿过北四川路桥。三人认为，既然此人能自由进入敌军驻扎区域，无疑是一名汉奸，便尾随其至北海路大光明电影院附近，告知路人并将该男子拦下。经搜身，发现其持有法币40元及信件两封，一封中文，一封英文。经严密审问，证实该人确为汉奸。遂将其移交主管当局严加惩办。

《字林西报》（午刊）：-

日本发言人承认吴淞炮台仍在中国军队手中

昨日下午，日本海陆军当局发言人在麦特罗波利坦酒店（Metropole Hotel）接受本地外文报纸记者采访时，有记者询问日军登陆后是否已占领吴淞炮台。日本发言人答复承认，吴淞炮台实际上仍在中国军队手中。
在场几乎所有记者都批评了日军飞机于8月28日轰炸南站中国难民的行为。日本发言人宣称，根据收到的报告，当时有大量中国军队占据车站。外文报纸记者进一步追问，既然车站被大量中国军队占据，如何能容纳数千名难民。日本发言人无法作答，但随后补充说，日军飞机将继续轰炸，但会避免向平民投弹。当被问及日本态度改变的原因时，日本发言人表示，如果从军事角度认为没有必要，就不会进行轰炸；如果要对南市进行轰炸，会提前发出警告。当外文报纸记者询问在空袭情况下人们如何迅速撤离时，日本发言人称仍会有一些撤离途径。

The Social Evening News (社會晚報) published the following
article on August 30 :-

TRAITOR ARRESTED ON PAKHOI ROAD : HANDED OVER TO
AUTHORITIES

On the afternoon of August 29, three
postmen noticed a Chinese being escorted over the North
Szechuen Road Bridge by Japanese marines. Holding the
view that, as the man had free access into the district
where the enemy troops were, he must undoubtedly be a
traitor, the three messengers went after him to the vicinity
of the Palace Theatre, Pakhoi Road, where pedestrians were
informed and the man was subsequently held up. As a
result of a search, he was found to be in possession of
$40 in legal tender notes and two letters, one in Chinese
and the other in English. After a close interrogation,
the man was found actually to be a traitor. Consequently
he was handed over to the competent authorities for severe
punishment.

China Times (Noon Issue) :-

JAPANESE SPOKESMAN ADMITS WOOSUNG FORTS STILL IN CHINESE
HANDS

During a press interview extended yesterday
afternoon at the Metropole Hotel by a spokesman of the
Japanese naval and military authorities to local foreign
newspaper reporters, a certain reporter queried whether
the Japanese troops had occupied the Woosung Forts since
they had effected their landing. In reply, the Japanese
spokesman admitted that the Woosung Forts were actually
still in Chinese hands.
Nearly all the reporters present criticized
the bombing of the Chinese refugees at the South Railway
Station by the Japanese planes on August 28. The Japanese
spokesman declared that according to reports received, a
large force of Chinese troops occupied the station at that
time. Foreign newspaper reporters asked further how several
thousands of refugees could be accommodated since the
station was occupied by a large force of Chinese troops.
The Japanese spokesman was unable to make a reply, but he
later added that Japanese planes would continue the bombing,
but they would refrain from dropping bombs on civilians.
Questioned as to the reason for a change in the Japanese
attitude, the Japanese spokesman stated that no bombing
would be carried out if it were regarded as unnecessary
from a military point of view, and that warning would be
given in advance if bombing of Nantas were to be carried
out. Asked by foreign newspaper reporters how the people
could effect their escape in a hurry in case of an air
raid, the Japanese spokesman said that there would still
be some means of escape.

《社会晚报》于8月30日刊登了以下文章：-

北海路逮捕汉奸：移交当局

8月29日下午，三名邮差注意到一名中国人正由日本海军陆战队士兵护送穿过北四川路桥。三人认为，既然此人能自由进入敌军驻扎区域，无疑是一名汉奸，便尾随其至北海路大光明电影院附近，告知路人并将该男子拦下。经搜身，发现其持有法币40元及信件两封，一封中文，一封英文。经严密审问，证实该人确为汉奸。遂将其移交主管当局严加惩办。

《字林西报》（午刊）：-

日本发言人承认吴淞炮台仍在中国军队手中

昨日下午，日本海陆军当局发言人在麦特罗波利坦酒店接受本地外文报纸记者采访时，有记者询问日军登陆后是否已占领吴淞炮台。日本发言人答复承认，吴淞炮台实际上仍在中国军队手中。
在场几乎所有记者都批评了日军飞机于8月28日轰炸南站中国难民的行为。日本发言人宣称，根据收到的报告，当时有大量中国军队占据车站。外文报纸记者进一步追问，既然车站被大量中国军队占据，如何能容纳数千名难民。日本发言人无法作答，但随后补充说，日军飞机将继续轰炸，但会避免向平民投弹。当被问及日本态度改变的原因时，日本发言人表示，如果从军事角度认为没有必要，就不会进行轰炸；如果要对南塔斯（Nantas）(原文如此，应为南市 Nantao) 进行轰炸，会提前发出警告。当外文报纸记者询问在空袭情况下人们如何迅速撤离时，日本发言人称仍会有一些撤离途径。

X ONE SUNG DAU SING, AGED 27, NATIVE OF YANGCHOW
MONK, RESIDING AT THE DA PEI S(大北寺)LINGCHING
ROAD, ATTACKED BY A MOB.
------------------------------------------------------------

At 10.30 a.m on the 24-8-37, P.C.977, G.V. Leow
(Specials) in company with C.P.C.3010, brought to the
station the above described Sung Dau Sing(僧道信), whom
he had rescued from a mob attack on Szechuen Road near
Jinkee Road.

Enquiries conducted by C.D.S.12 and the undersigned
ascertained Sung Dau Sing, who was uninjured, gave the
following account of the circumstances leading to the
attack: He stated he is a monk by profession and resid-
es at the Da Pei S(大北寺) Temple, on Lingching Road,
which he evacuated on the early morning of the 24th
inst. Whilst passing the vicinity of Wayside Road, he
picked up a Yue Feng Cotton Mill(Japanese) employee's
identification card No.2125 in the name of Kyoh Chang
Loong(陶长龙), which he considered might be of assist-
ance whilst passing the Japanese lines.

On arrival at the corner of Szechuen & Jinkee Rds.
he paused to obtain a drink of tea from a hawker.
During the ensuing conversation with a number of
pedestrians, he described how he had passed through
from Yangtseepoo and produced the identification card
as evidence.

僧道信（SUNG DAU SING），27岁，扬州人，和尚，居住于灵青路大北寺（DA PEI S），遭暴徒袭击。
------------------------------------------------------------

1937年8月24日上午10时30分，巡捕977号，G.V. Leow（特别班）会同华籍巡捕3010号，将上述僧道信（Sung Dau Sing）带至捕房，此人是在四川路靠近江西路处从暴徒袭击中被救出的。

经刑事侦探股12号及本人讯问查明，未受伤的僧道信就导致袭击的情况作了如下陈述：他声称自己是一名职业和尚，居住在灵青路的大北寺，他于本月24日清晨撤离该寺。在经过韦思德路（Wayside Road）附近时，他捡到了一张悦丰棉纱厂（日资）员工的身份证，号码2125，姓名为陶长龙（Kyoh Chang Loong），他认为这在通过日军防线时可能会有所帮助。

到达四川路与江西路拐角处时，他停下来向一名小贩买茶喝。在与数名行人的随后的交谈中，他描述了自己是如何从杨树浦过来的，并出示了身份证作为证据。

MALE CHINESE ASSAULTED BY A MOB.
------------------------------------

In connection with this case, the undersigned
interviewed Mr. Livingstone, S.C.2012, at Police Head-
quarters on the morning of the 25-8-37, and he stated
that the conduct of the two C.P.C.s appeared to him as
if they were not carrying out their duty in a proper
manner.

C.P.C.3010 was further questioned by the under-
signed and stated, that whilst he was taking the parties
concerned to the station, a Crowd of Chinese pedestrians
who were following again assaulted the injured person on
Foochow Road near Kiangse Road. At this time Mr.
Livingstone came on the scene, but as he (the C.P.C.)
could not cope with the crowd or understand what was
being said to him by Mr. Livingstone, he got flurried
and excited. After the crowd scattered the C.P.C.
immediately took the injured person to the Station.

The undersigned went to the British Consulate on
the morning of the 25-8-37, and ascertained that Col.
Lovat Fraser had left for Nanking on the 24-8-37.

Enquiries re the injured person at his relative's
address situated at 287 Kiangse Road ascertained that
he had left for Tsingpu on the 24-8-37 at about 6 p.m.

------------------------------------

关于此案，本人于1937年8月25日上午在警察总局采访了利文斯通（Livingstone）先生，苏格兰场警员2012号，他表示，在他看来，两名华籍巡捕的行为似乎没有恰当地履行职责。

本人进一步讯问了华籍巡捕3010号，他陈述道，当他将相关人员带往捕房时，一群跟随的华人行人在江西路附近的福州路上再次袭击了伤者。此时利文斯通先生来到现场，但由于他（该华籍巡捕）无法应付人群，也听不懂利文斯通先生对他说的话，他变得慌乱和激动。人群散去后，该华籍巡捕立即将伤者带至捕房。

本人于1937年8月25日上午前往英国领事馆，查明洛瓦特·弗雷泽（Lovat Fraser）上校已于1937年8月24日前往南京。

在伤者亲属位于江西路287号的地址进行的有关伤者的讯问查明，他已于1937年8月24日下午6时左右前往青浦。

Incidents in Louna District due to Sino-Japanese
Hostilities:

At 12.58 p.m. on 25-8-37, a telephone message was
received from the Ningpo Guild, Yu Ya Ching Road, that a
male Chinese "Traitor" had been beaten by a mob and re-
questing the services of an S.P.B. Ambulance, which was
summoned and conveyed one Wang Eh Hing (王克卿), 36,
Kiangsu, X/unemployed, Chapel, to the Lester Chinese
Hospital, from where he was discharged after treatment.
Medical certificate reading:- "Contusion and abrasion
of Face. Not serious."

Interrogated by C.D.Collil and the undersigned, the
suspect denied being a traitor or in the pay of the Ja-
panese. He stated that because he is unemployed and has
so much time on his hands, he was just wandering about.

Witness Tsang Yeong Lee (修永全), shop-assistant,
in a shoe shop at House 53, Lane 147, Sinar Road, reported
that he followed the suspect round several streets in the
Settlement, for quite a long period, suspect apparently
having no fixed purpose. He raised an alarm outside the
Ningpo Guild and a mob quickly gathered and assaulted
suspect who was eventually rescued by Special Constable
662 "Macishie" and the mob was dispersed.

There was no evidence that suspect was committing
any overt act and he was accordingly released.

因中日敌对行动导致的卢纳区事件：

1937年8月25日下午12时58分，接到来自余姚路宁波同乡会的电话消息，称一名中国男性“汉奸”遭到暴民殴打，并请求派遣工部局警务处救护车。救护车随即被召往，将一名名为王克卿（Wang Eh Hing），36岁，江苏籍，失业，职业为教堂杂役的男子，送往莱斯特尔华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital），经治疗后出院。医生证明书写道：“面部挫伤及擦伤。不严重。”

经刑事侦缉处 Collil 警探及本人讯问，嫌疑人否认自己是汉奸或受日本人雇佣。他声称因为自己失业，空闲时间很多，只是四处游荡。

证人修永全（Tsang Yeong Lee），鞋店店员，店铺位于西摩路（Sinar Road）147弄53号，报告称他跟随嫌疑人在租界内的几条街道上转了相当长的一段时间，嫌疑人显然没有固定的目的。他在宁波同乡会外发出警报，暴民迅速聚集并袭击嫌疑人，最终由特别巡捕662号“Macishie”救出嫌疑人，暴民随之散去。

由于没有证据表明嫌疑人有任何公开的犯罪行为，因此将其释放。

1

Writ of Detention.

At 7.25 p.m. 27/8/37, a telephone message was received from the Ping Kiang Guild, 平江公所, 635 Sinsa Road, reporting that an alleged traitor had been arrested and requested the service of Police.

A party of Special Police under S.I. Solovieff attended and brought to the station:-

Sung Lau S (沈老四), male, age 32, native of Nanking, S/Refugee, N.F.A.

and witness Yue Voong Fee (俞凤飞), a clerk employed by the Shanghai Refugee Association (上海難民救濟委員會) of the above address.

Enquiries made by the undersigned and C.D.S.196 ascertained that at 10 a.m. even date, the named above witness saw the alleged traitor stirring the cooked rice in a large jar placed in the courtyard of the above address. When questioned, the alleged traitor stated that he was hungry and intended to take some rice from the jar.

As the man gained entry to the premises without the knowledge of the officials, they suspected him of poisoning the rice.

Dr. Kwok Ting (郭庆), of the S.M.C. P.H.D. H.Q., who happened to be at the time in the Ping Kiang Guild attend to/some patients, took a quantity of rice for the purpose of laboratory examination without informing the Police of so doing.

D.D.O. "B" Div.
Sir,
All concerned in this case acted wrongly and the undersigned suggests action be taken to prevent similar cases occurring. Who will pay for analysis?

拘留令。

1937年8月27日晚上7时25分，接到来自新闸路635号平江公所的电话报告，称一名涉嫌汉奸已被逮捕，并请求警方介入。

由 S.I. Solovieff 率领的一队特别警察到场，并将以下人员带至警局：

沈老四（Sung Lau S），男，32岁，南京籍，身份/难民，非辖区居民（N.F.A.）。

以及证人俞凤飞（Yue Voong Fee），职员，受雇于上述地址的上海难民救济委员会（Shanghai Refugee Association）。

经本人及刑事侦缉处196号警探查询，查明当日上午10时，上述证人在上述地址的庭院中看到涉嫌汉奸正在搅拌一个大缸里的熟米饭。当被质问时，涉嫌汉奸声称自己饿了，打算从缸里拿些米饭吃。

由于该男子在管理人员不知情的情况下进入 premises（场所/大院），管理人员怀疑他在米饭中投毒。

当时恰好在平江公所诊治一些病人的工部局公共卫生处总部郭庆（Kwok Ting）医生，在未通知警方的情况下，取走了一些米饭用于实验室检验。

“B”分区副行动处处长。
先生，
本案所有相关人员的行为均有不当，本人建议采取行动以防止类似案件再次发生。谁来支付分析费用？

（批注：1937年8月29日。）
（批注：C.J.d.Sh 8月28日）
（批注：S.I. DBR 8月29日）

Misc. 386/37
Sinsa.
1 (Sheet 2)

A party of 3 boy scouts, (one of them believed to be named Hsu 许 ) who were on duty on the premises at the time, took the alleged traitor to their Headquarters situated at the Pootung Guild, Avenue Edward VII and South Chengtu Road corner, apparently for the purpose of questioning. At 7 p.m. the 27/8/37, these boy scouts brought the man back to the Guild, and requested the witness to dispose of him. The witness then decided to inform the Police of the occurrence.

When questioned at the Detective Office, the alleged traitor adhered to his original story, stating that he intended to take some food, being hungry, but strongly denied poisoning the rice.

A thorough search of the person of the alleged traitor revealed nothing, but 15 cents in nickels.

Dr. Kwoh Ting was communicated with by telephone, and stated that he had submitted the collected rice to the S.M.C. Laboratory for examination and the result of which will be forwarded to this station as soon as possible.

In view of the above, it was deemed advisable to place the alleged traitor under Writ of Detention pending the result of the Laboratory examination.

The alleged traitor will be arraigned before the S.S.D. Court A.M. 28/8/37, and accordingly a remand will be requested. Copy to Sp. Branch.

1（第2页）

当时在该场所执勤的三名童子军（其中一人据信姓许 Hsu），将涉嫌汉奸带至位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）与成都南路拐角处的浦东同乡会总部，显然是为了进行审问。1937年8月27日晚上7时，这些童子军将该男子带回同乡会，并请证人处置他。证人随后决定将此事件通报警方。

在侦探社接受讯问时，涉嫌汉奸坚持其最初的说法，声称因为饥饿打算拿些食物，但强烈否认在米饭中投毒。

对涉嫌汉奸的人身进行了彻底搜查，除了一枚15分的镍币外，未发现任何物品。

已通过电话与郭庆（Kwoh Ting）医生联系，他表示已将采集的米饭样本提交给工部局实验室进行检验，结果将尽快发送至本警局。

鉴于上述情况，认为宜在等待实验室检验结果期间，依据拘留令羁押涉嫌汉奸。

涉嫌汉匠将于1937年8月28日上午在特区地方法院（S.S.D. Court）出庭，因此将申请还押候审。副本送特务科。

At 8 a.m. on 24-8-37 Havildar 218 and party brought to
the station a male Chinese Koo Zai Loong, 38, Tsungming,
S/Unemployed, no fixed abode, whom they had rescued from a mob
on North Honan Road. He was being assaulted by the crowd who
accused him of poisoning drinking water with white powder.
He had his left arm in a plaster cast and bore several marks
of previous injuries. When questioned, the male denied having
poisoned any drinking water, but stated that he had been
assaulted by mobs 5 times in other districts and was discharged
from Lester Hospital two days previously. A date reading
"23-8-37" was shown on the plaster cast it is quite possible
that he was discharged from Hospital on the previous date i.e.
23-8-37. When questioned, he made no mention of a friend being
assaulted by the mob. He was cautioned re mixing with crowds
and allowed to go.

经12号华籍侦探副督察（C.D.S.）及具名者调查，查明未受伤的宋道信就导致此次袭击的情况作了如下陈述：他声称自己职业为僧侣，居住在领清路……的大北寺，他于本月24日清晨撤离该寺。在途经韦思赛德路（Wayside Road，即今溧阳路附近）一带时，他捡到一张裕丰棉纱厂（日资）雇员赵兆龙（Kyoh Chang Leong，音译）的2125号身份证，他认为在通过日军防线时此证可能有所帮助。

到达四川路与进吉路路口时，他停下来向一名小贩买茶喝。
在与数名行人随后的交谈中，他描述了自己如何从杨树浦过来，并出示身份证作为证据。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Male Chinese injured by mob.

At 12.30 p.m. 17-8-37, C.P.W. 1223 whilst on duty
Lane 290, Moulmein Road, saw male Chinese wearing white
cotton jacket and pants, approach a tea-urn (supplied
for coolies) in the above alleyway. He observed the
male turn the tap and told him that the urn was empty.
The party then lifted the lid, saw the urn was empty and
walked away. As he did so, C.P.W. 1223 saw him put his
hand in his jacket pocket and thought that he was perhaps
trying to put poison in tea-urn.

He followed the male Chinese who walked North along
Moulmein Road. At this time, C.P.C.s 1230 and 1983 on
duty at No. 318 Moulmein Road, were observed by the C.P.W.
and he voiced his suspicions to them. They stopped the
male Chinese and questioned as to his occupation and
address. He replied he was a native of Ningpo, employed
as washman, in French town. The C.P.C.s then searched
him but could find no incriminating evidence as per C.P.W.
's suspicions.

The only possession found was a cheque on the Bank
of Ching Foo, valued $16.00, but dated 1923 and altered
to 1927.

A crowd gathered and hearing the questions asked
by C. P.C.s appertaining to the C.P.W.'s suspicions

华籍男子被暴民致伤。

1937年8月17日中午12时30分，1223号华籍巡佐（C.P.W.）在穆尔黑文路（Moulmein Road，即今莫干山路）290弄执勤时，看见一名身穿白色棉布夹克和裤子的华籍男子走近上述弄堂内的一个茶水桶（供苦力饮用）。他观察到该男子转动水龙头，便告知他桶是空的。随后该人掀开盖子，见桶确为空，便走开。当他这样做时，1223号华籍巡佐看见他将手伸进夹克口袋，心想他或许是想往茶水桶里投毒。

他跟随该华籍男子沿穆尔黑文路向北行走。此时，在穆尔黑文路318号执勤的1230号和1983号华捕头（C.P.C.）被该华籍巡佐看到，他向他们表达了怀疑。他们拦下该华籍男子，询问其职业和住址。他回答自己是宁波人，在法租界做洗衣工。随后华捕头们对他进行了搜身，但未发现能证实华籍巡佐怀疑的任何罪证。

唯一发现的物品是一张正福银行（Bank of Ching Foo，音译）的支票，面值16.00元，但日期为1923年，并被涂改为1927年。

人群聚集起来，听到华捕头们询问有关华籍巡佐怀疑的事项

MALE CHINESE RESCUED FROM A MOB ATTACK

At 7.30 p.m. 21-8-37, C.P.C.s 129 & 3186 brought to
Central Station a male Chinese named Nyien Kee Kweng
(嚴其坤), 34, Canton, S/Unemployed, N.F.A., whom they
rescued from a mob at Honan Road near Nanking Road.

It appears that a crowd of Chinese surrounded Nyien
Kee Kweng and the cry rose that he was a Japanese subject.
They were preparing to attack the man when the two mention
ed constables arrived at the scene, and the crowd dispersed

The man was sent to the Lester Chinese Hospital, and
the following certificate obtained:-

"Mentally upset, not serious. (sd) Dr. Liu".

At the station it was found that Nyien Kee Kweng had
been drinking during the course of the day, and was under
the influence of alcohol.

Handed over to his brother one Nyien Kee Yeh (嚴其煌)
residing at 431 Hankow Road.

1937年8月21日晚上7时30分，129号及3186号华捕头（C.P.C.）将一名名为严其坤（Nyien Kee Kweng）的华籍男子带至中央警署，该人34岁，广东人，职业无业，无固定住所，系他们在靠近南京路的河南路上从暴民手中救出。

情况似乎是一群华人包围了严其坤，并高喊他是日本臣民。当上述两名巡警到达现场时，人群正准备攻击该男子，随即散去。

该男子被送往雷士德华人医院，并获得以下证明：
“精神受创，不严重。（签名）刘医生”。

在警署发现，严其坤在当天白天曾饮酒，处于酒精影响之下。

移交给其兄严其煌（Nyien Kee Yeh），住汉口路431号。

1.

三名华籍男子遭暴徒殴打
--------------------------------------

8月17日下午7时，本巡捕房接获报告，称在福州路附近的山西路上，一群华人正在殴打另外三名华人，怀疑这几人是日本间谍。接到上述报告后，印籍巡官（S.I.）Verhovsky 和副督察（D.S.）MacFarlane 立即前往上述地点，但警察到达时，人群四散奔逃，将以下人员遗留在地上：
(1) 洪留生 (Oong Liu Sung)，25岁，宁波人，无业，住杨树浦路公悦里125号，此人头皮撕裂并受休克，伤势可能严重。已送入雷士德华人医院留医。
(2) 郁光明 (Yoch Kwang Ming)，26岁，宁波人，单身/无业，住杨树浦路南市街23号，此人鼻口出血，伤势可能严重。
(3) 赵和向 (Zau Oo Zaung)，27岁，安徽人，单身/无业，住杨树浦路公悦里125号，此人眼睑撕裂，伤势不重。

驱散人群的副督察 MacFarlane 设法逮捕了一名名为宋巨史 (Sung Kyu Shee) 的男子，26岁，宁波人，单身/无业，该人在警察接近时逃跑

pages.en:

1 (Sheet 3)

on approach of the Police.
From enquiries made by C.D.S.203 and the undersigned
it appears that the man in question witnessed the assault
but not participated in the attack on victims himself.
Being afraid of the Police, he started to run away as
soon as he noticed the arrival of the Police. The
suspect is a cousin of one named Wan Yih Sung(万益松),
employee of the Sun Sun Picture Coy., 804 Lloyd Road, who
stated that the suspect is an honest and reliable person.
As there was nothing found to prove that the suspect took
part in the assault on the victims, he had been released
by the Police.
There was nothing found to show that the victims of
the assault had been connected with the Japanese Military
Forces and it appears that they are innocent victims of a
mob looking for Japanese spies.

V. Oshinisky
D.S.I.

经刑事侦缉处第203号警员及具名者查询，据悉该男子目睹了殴打过程，但并未亲自参与对受害者的攻击。因害怕警察，他在注意到警察到达后立即开始逃跑。嫌疑人名叫万益松 (Wan Yih Sung) 的表亲，万益松系新新影片公司（地址：劳合路804号）职员，其表示嫌疑人是一个诚实可靠的人。由于未发现任何证据证明嫌疑人参与了对受害者的殴打，警方已将其释放。
未发现任何迹象表明殴打受害者与日本军队有关，看来他们只是寻找日本间谍的暴徒的无辜受害者。

REPORT

19
Subject State of Pootoo Road Police District.

Made by D.S.I. Burton, Forwarded by G. R. Butler Inspt.

Sir,
During the 24 hours ending 7 a.m. 18.8.37, there were four incidents of mob violence.
At 1.10 p.m. 17.8.37, a male Chinese named Tseu Kwang Kyi (周昆生), age 32, Tungchow, Chihpei, was mobbed by a crowd of Chinese on Robison Road who accused him of being a traitor, he was rescued by a patrol of British Soldiers and handed over to the Police and when it was considered safe he was released.
At 5.57 p.m. a male Chinese named Tseu Yue Foo (周裕甫), age 50, Shanghai, residing Connaught Road, was attacked by a crowd on Gordon Road near Kapai Road who injured him about the head, he was removed to the Lester Chinese Hospital where he died at 11.10 p.m. One male Chinese named Zung Boo Sung (陳萬松) age 48, Kempo, residing Tonquin Road, was arrested by Police in the act of beating the deceased, he is charged with Grevious Bodily Harm Causing Death. (See F.I.R. P.R. 415/37.)
At 7.50 p.m. a crowd of Chinese attacked and killed an unknown Chinese (Male) on Tonquin Road near Robison Road.
At 8.30 p.m. another unknown male Chinese was attacked by a crowd of Chinese on Ferry Road near Kapai Road and succombing to his injuries. (See P.R. F.I.R. 414/37).
In all the above cases, some unknown persons have accused the injured parties of being traitors and that they were dropping poison into public tea urns.
Three Anti-aircraft shells fell on various roads in the district, no persons being injured.
Necessary precautions are still being maintained to protect lives and property.
Special patrols have been posted to counteract mob violence.

D.D.O.. "B" Division. D.S.I.

报告
日期 1937年8月18日 1937年8月26日
19
主题 普陀路巡捕房辖区状况。

由副督察 Burton 制作，由督察 G. R. Butler 转呈。

先生，
在截至1937年8月18日上午7时的24小时内，发生了四起暴徒暴力事件。
1937年8月17日下午1时10分，一名名为周昆生 (Tseu Kwang Kyi) 的华籍男子，32岁，直隶通州人，在罗宾森路被一群华人围殴，指控其为汉奸，他被一队英国士兵解救并移交给警方，在认为安全后将其释放。
下午5时57分，一名名为周裕甫 (Tseu Yue Foo) 的华籍男子，50岁，上海人，住康纳脱路，在戈登路靠近嘉庇路处遭到人群袭击，头部受伤，被送往雷士德华人医院，于晚上11时10分死亡。一名名为陳萬松 (Zung Boo Sung) 的华籍男子，48岁，金波人，住东京路，在殴打死者时被警察逮捕，被控以“致人死亡的重伤罪”。（见初步调查报告 P.R. 415/37。）
晚上7时50分，一群华人在罗宾森路附近的东京路上袭击并杀害了一名身份不明的华人（男）。
晚上8时30分，另一名身份不明的华籍男子在嘉庇路附近的斐伦路上遭到一群华人袭击，因伤身亡。（见 P.R. 初步调查报告 414/37）。
在上述所有案件中，均有一些不明身份的人指责伤者是汉奸，并称他们往公共茶桶里投毒。
三枚防空炮弹落在辖区内的不同道路上，无人受伤。
目前仍采取必要的预防措施以保护生命和财产。
已部署特别巡逻队以遏制暴徒暴力行为。

dress and nothing about his appearance suggested anything

C.D.S. 49 Zung Yue Yu (秦有裕) attached to Leh Ka Wei, who
attended this office and identified him, and explained
that he is slightly mentally deficient and very
excitable.

Male Chinese beaten by a mob who

At 11.00a.m. 21-8-37 C.P.C. 809 telephoned this
Station to the effect that a male Chinese was lying injur
on Honan Road and requested the services of the Motor
Ambulance.

The Motor Ambulance immediately attended and conveyed
to the Lester Chinese Hospital a male Chinese named
Chang Ah Sung (姜阿生), age 40, Ningpo, S/beggar, N.T.A.
upon being examined the following Doctor's certificate
was issued:-

"Multiple hematoma of scalp & chest, fairly
serious one or two days treatment in Hospital".

The above person upon being questioned in Hospital
by C.D.C. 208 stated that at about 11a.m. 21-8-37 he was
walking along Honan Road near Peking Road when suddenly
an unknown male Chinese accused him of being a "traitor",
shortly afterwards a crowd consisting of about sixteen
persons gathered around and started to assault him.

The victim was apparently knocked unconscious, as
he could not state how he was conveyed to the Hospital.

C.P.C. 809 stated that he was informed of the
incident by an unknown male Chinese and when he arrived
upon the scene, he observed the victim lying on the
roadway the mob having already dispersed.

Enquiries made by C.D.C. 208 and H.S. Rider.

一名华籍男子被暴徒殴打，

1937年8月21日上午11时，华籍巡捕 809号致电本巡捕房，称一名华籍男子受伤躺在河南路上，请求派出机动救护车。

机动救护车立即赶到，并将一名名为姜阿生 (Chang Ah Sung) 的华籍男子送往雷士德华人医院，该男子40岁，宁波人，单身/乞丐，非本地居民 (N.T.A.)。经检查，出具了以下医生证明：

“头皮及胸部多处血肿，相当严重，需住院治疗一两天”。

刑事侦缉处主任 (C.D.C.) 208号在医院询问上述人员时，他表示在1937年8月21日上午11时左右，他正沿着靠近北京路的河南路行走，突然一名身份不明的华籍男子指控他是“汉奸”，随后不久，约十六人组成的人群聚集在他周围并开始殴打他。

受害者显然被打昏，因为他无法说明是如何被送往医院的。

华籍巡捕 809号表示，他是一名身份不明的华籍男子告知此事的，当他到达现场时，看到受害者躺在路面上，暴徒已经散去。

由刑事侦缉处主任 (C.D.C.) 208号及 H.S. Rider 进行调查。

My name is Koo Sai Long, aged 38 years. I am a native of
Shanghai, residing at 655 Pingliang Road. I am a hawker by
profession.

At about 5.30p.m. on the 20-8-37, whilst passing Honan Road
near Siking Road, I was held up and assaulted by a mob who
accused me of being a traitor to China, but in the meantime two
police constables arrived at the scene and brought me to the
station. On no occasion had I been illtreated by the said
policemen nor did they wish to escort me toward the French
Concession. The above is my true statement.

C.P.C. 809 reports as follows:-

    At about 6.10p.m. on the 20-8-37, whilst on point duty
at the corner of Honan and Siking Roads, I observed a mob
consisting of about 80 or 90 people who were assaulting a man.
When I was proceeding to the scene the man who was held up by
2 or 3 hundred persons, was walking in a southerly direction
along Honan Road. I accompanied by C.P.C. 2517 produced batons
in order to disperse the crowd, but without result. In the
meantime a foreigner appeared and took out a small knife and
stabbed the mob in an excited manner. Shortly afterwards the
foreigner demonstrated to me that I should draw my pistol and
fire against the mob. On hearing this I produced my pistol
and fired in the air. After the dispersing of the mob, the man
in question was brought to the station in company with the
foreigner and C.P.C. 2517. On no occasion did I kick the
injured man according to the implication made by the foreigner;
neither did I wish to escort the injured man to the French
Concession.

MALE CHINESE ARRESTED BY S.V.C. CHINESE COMPANY,
AT 219 KIUKIANG ROAD, ON SUSPICION OF ATTEMPTING
TO POISON DRINKING WATER.

At 6.15 p.m. 21-8-37, a telephone message was received at Central Station from Lieut. Wong Tsze Zung (王志成), Chinese Company, S.M.C./S.V.C., Cathedral Boys School, 219 Kiukiang Road, requesting the assistance of detectives.

In response to this message, C.D.C.288 and the undersigned attended the mentioned address, when Lieut. Wong reported that Chinese members of the company had arrested an unknown male Chinese loitering in the building, and as he had in his possession a paper containing a small quantity of a yellow coloured substance, it was suspected that he intended to drop this in the drinking water and poison the members of the company.

It was verified that the male Chinese, one named Lee Kwang Jing (李光勤), 32, Yangchow, h/hawker, 131 Hankow Rd. had attended the building with a view to meeting an amah employed by Mrs. G. Ross, who is at present residing on the 1st floor, in an effort to obtain a sum of money loaned to her.

The yellow coloured powder was found to be used by the suspect to cure a venereal disease. His brother, one Lee Kwang Sung (李光松), was located, and admitted that he purchased the powder for the suspect two or three months ago.

Permitted to go.

1937年8月21日下午6时15分，中央巡捕房接到来自工部局/万国商团华队、驻九江路219号圣约翰男校（Cathedral Boys School）的王志成（Wong Tsze Zung）中尉的电话留言，请求侦探协助。

接获此消息后，刑事侦缉处警员288号及本人前往上述地址，王中尉报告称，该队华籍队员逮捕了一名在楼内徘徊的不知名华籍男子，因其持有一张包有少量黄色物质的纸片，故怀疑其意图将此物投入饮用水中以毒害队员。

经查证，该华籍男子名为李光勤（Lee Kwang Jing），32岁，扬州人，职业为小贩，住址为汉口路131号。他来到该大楼是为了会见受雇于G. Ross太太的一名阿妈（女佣），Ross太太现居住在一楼，李光勤试图以此收回借给她的款项。

经检验，该黄色粉末系嫌疑人用于治疗性病。其兄李光松（Lee Kwang Sung）被找到，并承认在两三个月前为嫌疑人购买了该粉末。

准予释放。

一名华籍男子遭暴徒殴打。
1937年8月23日上午9时10分，华籍巡捕3010号带至巡捕房三名华籍男子，姓名分别为：(1) 苏再清（Soo Zai Ching），中国护照办事处助理，编号5611，(2) 曹全芝（Tsau Chuen Zai），中国护照办事处助理，编号4514，两人均供职于位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）160号的中国护照办事处；以及 (3) 華如亭（Hwa Tseu Ting），居住在麦兰坊（Mai Nyi Faung / Myburgh Road）16号。他们在四川路附近的北京路上将一名名为曾富榮（Tsang Foo Yoong）的男子移交给该巡捕。曾富榮，26岁，高邮人，私人守夜人，受雇于黄浦路日本邮船会社（N.Y.K. Mail Wharf）码头，因遭一群华人殴打而受伤。
（特别科副本）伤者被送往莱斯中国医院，接受治疗后出院。
医生证明书称“头部、胸部及背部多处挫伤”，伤势不重，需在门诊部治疗数日。
经本人及刑事侦缉处警员212号查询，查明情况如下。
1937年8月23日上午8时，伤者离开黄浦路日本邮船会社码头，穿过外白渡桥。随后他向西转，沿苏州路行走，但当接近乍浦路桥时，几名一直跟在他身后的华籍男子大声喊叫，称他是日本人的密探。人群立即围住他并用拳头殴打，造成上述伤势。
两名护照办事处助理和華如亭在殴打发生时赶到现场，并将伤者沿四川路带至正在四川路与北京路拐角处执勤的华籍巡捕3010号处。

Wong Hsu Tsang (汪序章),
Ningpo, C.D.C. 392,
Sinsan Stn., 20/8/37 translated Clerk Kao.

My name is Wong Hsu Tsang, age 24, native of Ningpo. I am married, and reside at No. 3 Loh An Faung, Chengtu Road. I was formerly a stone-mason employed at the Tseu Ling Kyi Shop, situated at Mau Ka Loong, off Poo Zeu Road, Chapei.

Since the local hostilities, our shop has closed up, whilst Ying Ah Kung and I have been left there to watch the premises.

Finding it to be too dangerous to remain there, on the morning of 16/8/37, we escaped from Chapei, and stayed in my home as Ying Ah Kung had no fixed abode.

At 10 a.m. on 20/8/37, Ying Ah Kung left the premises as he had no work to do and decided to return to Ningpo.

At 6 p.m. even date, Ying Ah Kung led detectives to House 84 Lane 685 Gordon Road and arrested me, I do not know what was the matter.

This is my true statement.

(Sd) Wong Hsu Tsang.

汪序章（Wong Hsu Tsang），
宁波人，刑事侦缉处警员392号，
新闸巡捕房，1937年8月20日 由书记员Kao翻译。

我叫汪序章，24岁，宁波人。我已婚，居住在成都路洛安坊3号。我此前是一名石匠，受雇于闸北宝通路毛家弄（Mau Ka Loong）的资灵记（Tseu Ling Kyi）店铺。

自本地战事爆发以来，我们店铺已关闭，而应阿公（Ying Ah Kung）和我被留在那里看守店面。

鉴于留守过于危险，1937年8月16日上午，我们从闸北逃离，因应阿公无固定住所，便住在我家中。

1937年8月20日上午10时，应阿公因无事可做离开住处，决定返回宁波。

同日晚上6时，应阿公带领侦探到戈登路685弄84号将我逮捕，我不知道发生了什么事。

这是我的真实供词。

（签名）汪序章。

C.D.C. 135,
translated
xxxxxxx Clerk Kao.

Ningpo,
Sings Stu 20/8/57

My name is Tong Sing Yue, age 32, native of Ningpo.
I am married, and reside at 84 Heng Chi Li, off Gordon Road.
I was a mason forman employed at the Tseu Ling Kyi mason shop,
Mau Ka Loong, off Poo Zeu Road, Chapel.
Since the local hostilities, the shop, being in the War
Zone, has closed up and I stayed home.
At 6.50 p.m. to-day, whilst playing at the entrance to
my lane, I saw Ying Ah Kung lead detectives to my home. I
immediately returned home, when I was told that I was suspected
to be a traitor and they were coming to arrest me. They asked
me if I knew Tong Sing Yue, and I replied that he was one of
my subordinates. They then brought me to the Police Station.
I know nothing about the traitor. This is my true
statement.
(Signed) Tong Sing Yue,

xxxxxxx 书记员Kao。

宁波，
新闸巡捕房 1937年8月20日 [原文误写为57]

我叫湯興有，32岁，宁波人。
我已婚，居住在戈登路恒吉里84号。
我曾是资灵记石匠铺的工头，该铺位于闸北宝通路毛家弄。
自本地战事爆发以来，该店因地处战区已关闭，我便待在家中。
今天下午6时50分，当我在弄堂口玩耍时，看见应阿公带领侦探来到我家。我立即回家，随即被告知我被怀疑是汉奸，他们前来逮捕我。他们问我是否认识湯興有，我回答他是我的下属之一。随后他们将我带到巡捕房。
我对汉奸一事一无所知。这是我的真实供词。
（签名）湯興有，

TWO CHINESE POLICE CONSTABLES CONCERNED IN A

At about 6.10 p.m. 20-8-37, a male Chinese named
Koo Zai Long(古才郎), age 38, Shanghai, M.hawker, resid-
ing 655 Pingliang Road, was walking along Honan Road
near Siking Road when suddenly an unknown male Chinese
accused him of being a traitor, although he strongly
protested, the unknown person began to shout "traitor",
this attracted a crowd of about 80 persons, who gathered
around him and started to assault the alleged traitor,
at this juncture C.P.C.s 809 & 2517 arrived upon the
scene and endeavoured to rescue the victim and disperse
the crowd by using their batons, this however proved
fruitless. At this time a British subject named Mr. A.
Evelsigh, in charge of S.M.C. Weed Control, Administrat-
ion Building Room 602, happened to be passing by in his
private M/car Lic. No.2583, he stopped the car and went
to the assistance of the aforementioned constables, by
this time, however, the mob had increased to about 300
persons, and they appeared to be getting out of control,
therefore Mr. Evelsigh requested the constables to draw
their service pistols and fire into the air, with a view
to dispersing the crowd, this the constables did, C.P.C
809 firing six shots and C.P.C.2517 firing two shots,

两名华籍巡捕在试图营救一名被大批暴民攻击并指控其为卖国贼的华籍男子时，卷入枪击冲突。

1937年8月20日下午6时10分左右，一名名为古才郎（Koo Zai Long）的华籍男子，38岁，上海人，职业为小贩，居住在平凉路655号，当他在河南路靠近西京路处行走时，突然有一名不知名华籍男子指控其为卖国贼，尽管他强烈抗议，但该不知名人士开始高喊“卖国贼”，这吸引了约80人的人群聚集在他周围，并开始殴打这名所谓的卖国贼，此时华籍巡捕809号和2517号赶到现场，试图用警棍营救受害者并驱散人群，但此举无效。此时，一位名为A. Evelsigh先生的英籍人士，负责工部局除草事务，办公地点为行政大楼602室，恰好驾驶其私家车（牌照号2583）路过，他停下车前去协助上述巡捕，然而此时暴民人数已增至约300人，且似乎失控，因此Evelsigh先生要求巡捕拔出配枪向空中射击，以图驱散人群，巡捕照办，华籍巡捕809号开枪六发，华籍巡捕2517号开枪两发，

他被送往莱斯中国医院，院方出具了以下证明：

一名名为潘约泉（Phen Sih Zien）的华籍男子，23岁，无锡人，职业为码头苦力，居住在？北海路，当他在河南路靠近广东路处行走时，手臂被流弹击伤，他被送往莱斯中国医院，院方出具了以下证明：
“手臂枪伤，伤势不重。”
Eveleigh先生指控上述巡捕同情暴民，并称他亲眼看到他们在将该所谓卖国贼带往巡捕房途中对其进行殴打和踢踹。

本人亲自讯问了受害者，他坚决否认遭到华籍巡捕的殴打，并表示巡捕尽一切可能帮助他免受人群的严重伤害。

除头部受到的伤害外，受害者身上没有其他受伤迹象。

pages.en:
C.P.C.809

Central Station    26th Aug. 1937    Translated    Clerk F.C. Tan

C.P.C.809 reports as follows:-

At about 6.10 p.m. to-day, whilst on point duty at the
corner of Henan and Canton Roads, I observed a crowd of people
about 80 or 90 in number, who were assaulting an alleged traitor
to China on Henan Road near Siking Road. I immediately
accompanied C.P.C.2517 and proceeded to the scene with a view
to dispersing the crowd and rescuing the alleged traitor. The
alleged traitor by this time was surrounded by two or three
hundred persons walking in a Southerly direction along Henan Rd.
I and C.P.C.2517 again rushed to the scene and produced our
batons for the purpose of dispersing the crowd, but it was in
vain. In the meantime a foreigner who was assisting us in
saving the alleged traitor from danger, suggested to me that I
should produce my pistol. This I did and fired 6 rounds of
ammunition, as a result of which the crowd of people dispersed
and the alleged traitor was then brought to the Station.
pages.zh:
华籍巡捕809号

中央巡捕房    1937年8月26日    翻译    书记员F.C. Tan

华籍巡捕809号报告如下：

今天下午6时10分左右，当我在河南路与广东路拐角处执行定点执勤任务时，我观察到约有80或90人的人群，正在河南路靠近西京路处殴打一名所谓的中国卖国贼。我立即会同华籍巡捕2517号前往现场，旨在驱散人群并营救该所谓卖国贼。此时，该所谓卖国贼被两三百人包围，正沿河南路向南行进。我和华籍巡捕2517号再次冲向现场，拿出警棍试图驱散人群，但徒劳无功。与此同时，一位协助我们将该所谓卖国贼从危险中救出的外国人建议我拔出配枪。我照做了，并发射了6发子弹，结果人群散去，随后将该所谓卖国贼带至巡捕房。

pages.en:
C.P.C.8817

Central Station 20th. Aug. 1937 translated (1) at C.S. Stn

At about 6.10 p.m. 20-8-37, whilst I was on duty outside
the Tsing Yu Co., a Japanese firm on Siking Road, an unknown
pedestrian reported to me that a mob of about 80 or 90 people
were beating a man at the corner of Honan and Siking Roads. I
together with C. P.C.809 rushed to the scene and rescued the man
from the mob. Then this man, an alleged traitor to China, ran
along Honan Road. He was followed by about 200-300 people, who
were shouting "Tang, tang". C. P.C.809 and I then drew our
batons and tried to disperse the mob, without success. An
unknown foreigner gave assistance and advised us to put into
use our service pistols, this we did and the mob dispersed in
different directions. I fired two shots, and later the alleged
traitor was rescued and brought to the Station.
pages.zh:
华籍巡捕8817号 [注：原文编号与上文2517号不符，照实译出]

中央巡捕房 1937年8月20日 翻译 (1) 于中央巡捕房

1937年8月20日下午6时10分左右，当我在西京路一家日本公司清裕公司（Tsing Yu Co.）外执勤时，一名不知名路人向我报告，在河南路与西京路拐角处，约有80或90人的暴民正在殴打一名男子。我与华籍巡捕809号一起冲向现场，从暴民手中救出了该男子。随后，这名所谓的中国卖国贼沿河南路奔跑。约有200-300人跟随其后，高喊“唐，唐”（Tang, tang）。华籍巡捕809号和我随后拔出警棍，试图驱散暴民，但未成功。一名不知名外国人提供协助，建议我们使用配枪，我们照办了，暴民向不同方向散去。我发射了两发子弹，随后该所谓卖国贼获救并被带至巡捕房。

我叫潘约泉，25岁，无锡人，是上海印染厂的一名工人，居住在北海路，靠近工部局华童公学。

Koo Zai Long
Shanghai
Central Station 20th Aug. 1937 (signature) Clerk Y.L. Sung

My name is Koo Zai Long, age 38, native of Shanghai, residing at 655 Pingliang Road. I am a hawker.

At about 3 p.m. 19-8-37, whilst I was walking on a road (name unknown) in Yangtsepoo district, I was stopped by some Japanese soldiers who took me to a Japanese building. I was blindfolded and my hands were bound behind my back. Later I was sent to the Japanese □□ on Scone Road by m/car where I was questioned by some Japanese military men. At about 5 p.m. to-day I was sent to the Garden Bridge by two Japanese police officers together with several Chinese. After I had crossed the bridge somebody followed me and said that I was a traitor to China. I replied that I was not a traitor, but this man shouted "traitor, traitor". Then a big crowd came up and beat me. At this juncture two policemen came and used their batons to disperse the mob, without success. Then the policemen opened fire on the mob and the latter dispersed.

I was brought to the station by the policemen, who, however did not assault me.

Crossed & signed.

顾再龙（音译）
上海
中央巡捕房 1937年8月20日 （签名） 书记员 Y.L. Sung

本人名为顾再龙（音译），38岁，上海籍，居住于平凉路655号。职业为小贩。

1937年8月19日下午3时许，当我在杨树浦区一条道路（名称不详）上行走时，被几名日本士兵拦下，带至一处日本建筑物内。我被蒙住双眼，双手被反绑在背后。随后，我被汽车送往斯科恩路（Scone Road）的日本□□，在那里受到几名日本军人的讯问。今天下午约5时，两名日本警官连同几名中国人将我送至外白渡桥。过桥后，有人尾随我并称我是中国的汉奸。我回答说我不是汉奸，但这名男子高喊“汉奸，汉奸”。随即一大群人围上来殴打我。此时两名警察赶到，试图用警棍驱散暴民，但未成功。随后警察向暴民开枪，暴民随之散去。

我被警察带回巡捕房，警察并未对我实施殴打。

阅毕并签字。

pages.en:
Arthur Eveleigh(S.M.C. Room 610)
Great Britain
Central Station    20th Aug. 1937

Whilst driving in my car 2593 on Honan Road, going South, I noticed that a big mob was collected just North of Canton Road, on the West side of the street. I could see a policeman(in white helmet) as though struggling with the mob, the crowd opened up and started to proceed South towards the French Concession. I stopped and went among to the crowd to help the police. In answer to my question I was told they had caught a TRAITOR. I got up to the centre and found C.P.C.809(white helmet) and C.P.C. 2517 with a native - looks like a farmer - between them, as the constables were pushing their "prisoner" towards the French Concession, I could not understand it. I asked C.P.C.809, but he simply said "We are taking him to the French Town". "Why?", I asked, "your station must be Foochow Road". Still the 2 C.P.C.s continued going South. In the meantime the mob seeing that the 2 C.P.C.s were sympathising with the mob, kicked, struck and tried to kill the unfortunate prisoner. I distinctly saw several men with stones in their hands, struck the prisoner. He received a serious wound in his head. I saw that the 2 constables would do nothing. I shouted at both, telling them that I would report them to H.Q. I also grabbed one of them by the arm and swung him around toward Foochow Road. The mob by then was out of control and then I insisted that the 2 policemen draw their pistols and fired in the air, They did, but on the street, the mob dispersed and the 2 policemen with the prisoner marched off to Central Police Station. I went back to my car, here Mr. C. Wentworth drove up in his car and I asked him to wait till I get into my car. When I had turned around I distinctly saw C.P.C.809 kick

Arthur Eveleigh（工部局 610室）
英国
中央巡捕房    1937年8月20日

当我驾驶车牌号为2593的汽车沿河南路向南行驶时，我注意到在广东路以北、街道西侧聚集了一大群暴民。我看到一名警察（戴白色头盔）似乎正在与暴民搏斗，人群让开一条路并开始向南朝法租界方向移动。我停下车，走进人群中协助警察。针对我的询问，有人告诉我他们抓到了一个“汉奸”。我走到中心位置，发现华捕809号（戴白色头盔）和华捕2517号夹着一名华人——看起来像个农民——当这两名巡捕推着他们的“囚犯”朝法租界方向走去时，我感到无法理解。我问华捕809号，但他只说“我们要把他带到法租界去”。“为什么？”我问，“你们的辖区应该是福州路。”然而这两名华捕继续向南走。与此同时，暴民见这两名华捕似乎同情暴民，便踢打、击打并试图杀死这名不幸的囚犯。我清楚地看到几个人手里拿着石头击打囚犯。他的头部受了重伤。我看这两名巡捕无动于衷。我对两人大声呵斥，告诉他们我会向总部报告他们。我还抓住其中一人的手臂，将他转向福州路方向。此时暴民已失控，于是我坚持要求这两名警察拔出手枪朝天鸣枪。他们照做了，但在街道上，暴民散去，这两名警察带着囚犯步行前往中央巡捕房。我回到我的车上，这时 C. Wentworth 先生驾车赶到，我请他等我上车。当我转过身时，我清楚地看到华捕809号踢了

pages.en:
-Sheet 3-

his prisoner and C.P.C.2518 gabbing him in the ribs. I extremely
regret that in this particular instance the 2 policemen did not
act as guardians of the law.
(signed) A. Eveleigh.
pages.zh:
-第3页-

他的囚犯，而华捕2518号则猛击其肋骨。
我深感遗憾，在此特定事件中，这两名警察未能
履行法律守护者的职责。
（签名） A. Eveleigh.

At 7.00 p.m. 19-8-37 P.C. Adams and C.P.C.s 1863
and 1867 brought a male Chinese named Lieu Tuh Tsao (刘独操)
aged 43, native of Yangchow, N.P.A. whom they had rescued
from a crowd of Chinese who were attacking him on the
belief that he was a traitor, on Canton Road near Pekien
Road.

Enquiries by C.D.C. 23 and D.S. Macfie ascertained
that at 6.30p.m. the above described Chinese entered
the Dah Wu Yuen(大和園)Hot Water Shop, Lane 414 No. 19
Canton Road and paid for a bath. Instead of taking a
bath he went out of the shop into the alleyway to relieve
nature. However the occupants of the shop could not
understand why he had left after paying for a bath and
a rumour was started that he was a "traitor". The
man was searched outside and was found to be in possession
of a pay slip from a Japanese mill and a package contain-
ing a small quantity of powder. The crowd then fell
upon the man and beat him, he being rescued as reported.
It was ascertained that the pay slip was in respect of
the man's two daughters who had been employed at the
Dah Fong(大丰) Cotton Mill.

The powder was something similar to talc
been given to him by his daughter...

Subject (a) Emergency Measures:- (b) Alleged depositing of poisonous
substance in the various Tea Urns in the Louza Police Distr.
(c) The rescue of three male chinese from a serious assault.
Made by Adams, Sgt. 8. Forwarded by ....................

Sir,
Relative to the subject, I beg to report, that at
6.37.p.m. on the 19.8.37, whilst accompanying an S.V.C.
Armoured Car and S.V.C. Rifle Patrol throughout "A" Division
Shanghai Municipal Police District, I had occasion to visit
Canton Road, where the Japanese Shops are situated.
On arrival at the intersection of Canton and Pekien Roads, I
observed an exceedingly large crowd of chinese assembled
together, and adopting a very threatening attitude towards
three male chinese referred to below.
It would appear that one named Liu Kwei Seu age 23
a native of Yangchow, was in possession of some seasoning
substance, which the crowd suspected, was being deposited in
tea urns in the Louza Police District. (The urns referred to
however, have been withdrawn by order of the officer in charge
of Louza Police Station, at 9.15.a.m. 19.8.37.). Liu Kwei
Seu, had the seasoning contained in a piece of newspaper, and
was also in possession of a piece of wood, said to bear Japanese
characters. With this in mind, I investigated the matter on the
spot, and the enquiries elicited that the seasoning substance,
had been given to Liu Kwei Seu, by one named Wang Wei Sing, a
age 30/ Hu nan, resident at 414/9 Canton Road. The latter st
that he gave the substance to Liu Kwei Seu, to give to a sick
named Liu Ta Tech age 43/ Yangchow, N.H.A. solely as a herb
treatment for a certain sickness. Being satisfied that there
was no truth in the allegations made by the crowd, I sent the
three persons referred to, to Louza Police Station (Temporary)
for their own safety, and dispersed the crowd.

I am Sir,
Your obedient servant,
(签名)

先生，
关于上述主题，谨报告如下，1937年8月19日
下午6时37分，当我陪同一辆义勇军装甲车和一支
义勇军步枪巡逻队在整个上海公共租界警务处“A”区
巡视时，我有机会前往广东路，那里坐落着日本商店。
到达广东路与北四川路交叉口时，我
观察到一大群华人聚集在一起，并对下述三名
男性华人采取极具威胁的态度。
看来，一名名为刘桂生（音译），23岁，扬州籍的男子，
持有一些调味物质，人群怀疑这些物质正被投放到
老闸警察辖区的茶水桶中。（然而，所述的茶水桶
已于1937年8月19日上午9时15分奉老闸巡捕房
主管官员之命撤除。）刘桂生将调味品包在一张报纸里，
还持有一块据说刻有日文字符的木片。鉴于此，我在
现场对此事进行了调查，问询得知该调味物质是由
一名名为王维新的人给刘桂生的，王30岁，湖南籍，
居住于广东路414/9号。后者陈述
他将该物质给刘桂生，是为了让刘转交给一名名为
刘达德（音译），43岁，扬州籍，非上海籍华人（N.H.A.）的
病人，仅作为治疗某种疾病的草药。由于确信人群的
指控毫无事实依据，我将上述三人送往老闸巡捕房
（临时）以确保其安全，并驱散了人群。

此致，
您顺从的仆人，
(签名)

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Male Chinese injured by mob.
At 12.30 p.m. 17/8/37, C.P.C. 1223 whilst on duty Lane 290, Moulmein Road, saw male Chinese wearing white cotton jacket and pants, approach a tea-urn (supplied for coolies) in the above alleyway. He observed the male turn the tap and told him that the urn was empty. The party then lifted the lid, saw the urn was empty and walked away. As he did so, C.P.C. 1223 saw him put his hand in his jacket pocket and thought that he was perhaps trying to put poison in tea-urn.
He followed the male Chinese who walked North along Moulmein Road. At this time, C.P.C.s 1230 and 1983 on duty at No. 318 Moulmein Road, were observed by the C.P.W. and he voiced his suspicions to them. They stopped the male Chinese and questioned as to his occupation and address. He replied he was a native of Ningpo, employed as washman, in French town. The C.P.C.s then searched him but could find no incriminating evidence as per C.P.W.'s suspicions.
The only possession found was a cheque on the Bank of Ching Foo, valued $16.00, but dated 1923 and altered to 1927.

6.

因中日敌对行动而在老闸区发生的事件。

1937年8月17日下午6时50分，华捕2365号
打电话至巡捕房，称有一名华人正在
近伯基尔路的虞洽卿路上被暴民围攻。

经刑事侦缉处274号探员和侦探长 MacAdie 调查查明，
一名名为张林牙的男性华人，36岁，宁波籍，
居住于古岭路44号，在上述地点因外貌
类似日本人而遭到人群攻击。在怀特督察
率领下一队警察赶到，并将该男子救出，
动用警棍冲锋驱散人群。- 张林牙
被送往莱斯中国医院，医生出具了以下证明：-

“头皮撕裂 - 背部挫伤 - 不严重
门诊治疗5天。”

该男子被拘留，随后未发生其他事件即回家。

上午约9时30分，一名名为狄大姑的男性华人，
33岁，吴兴籍，居住于
浙江北路37号，被一群怀疑其为汉奸的
华人包围。事件发生在近福建路的北京路上。
除观察到该男子外，刑事侦缉处274号探员和侦探长
MacAdie 未能查明此事的其他原因

pages.en:
Misc.No.562/37.
6/Sheet 2.

gazing around as if spying. Doo Ts Kao was rescued by
Russian members of the S.V.C. before being informed and
was handed over to a party of Police under Inspt. White,
called to the scene. He was brought to the Station from
where he was released after it had been ascertained that
he was a coolie employed by the Sung Tsung (仁丰)
Woollen Goods Factory, above address.
At 10.41.a.m. C.P.C. telephoned to the Station
to the effect that a male Chinese had been injured by a
mob on Foochow Road near Yunnan Road.
Enquiries by C.D.C.237 and D.S. MacAdie ascertained
that the man named Wong Woo Zeng (王武曾) aged 23,
native of Taiyang, residing Tientsin (天仙) Tea Shop,
Foochow Road is alleged to have been seen putting poison
into a public tea urn on Foochow Road at the corner of
Yu Ya Ching Road at about 10.30.a.m. After a shout of
traitor had been set up, he was attacked and beaten by
a crowd of Chinese. He was rescued by a party of Police
under C/I McFarlane. Taken to the Bunter Chinese Hospital
he was detained. Doctor's certificate states "Large
Haematoma of orbit, probably fracture of arc of orbital
bones, moderately serious - several days' treatment in
Hospital." No evidence of the allegations of the crowd
could be ascertained.
pages.zh:
杂项卷宗第562/37号。
6/第2页。

四处张望，形迹可疑。杜子高（Doo Ts Kao，音译）在消息传开之前即被上海义勇队（S.V.C.）的俄籍队员解救，并移交给应召赶至现场的怀特（White）督察率领的一队警察。他被带往警局，后经查明其为上述地址仁丰毛织厂的一名苦力，遂予释放。
上午10时41分，中央巡捕房（C.P.C.）致电本局，称一名华籍男子在福州路近云南路处被暴民打伤。
经警探第237号及副巡官麦卡迪（MacAdie）调查，获悉该男子名为王武曾，23岁，籍贯太阳（Taiyang，音译），居住于福州路天仙茶楼。据称，上午10时30分左右，有人看见他在福州路与虞洽卿路转角处的公共茶水桶内投毒。在有人高喊“汉奸”后，他遭到一群华人袭击和殴打。麦克法兰（McFarlane）华籍督察率领的一队警察将其救出。他被送往伯特利华人医院（Bunter Chinese Hospital）并留院治疗。医生证明书称：“眼眶巨大血肿，可能伴有眶骨弓骨折，中度严重——需住院数日治疗。”无法查证暴民指控的任何证据。

pages.en:
Miss.No.562/37.
6/Sheet 3.

At 11.41.a.m. 17-8-37 a telephone message was received
from C.P.C.352, from Avenue Edward VII and Fokien Road
corner, reporting that a mob of Chinese were rioting and
assaulting two males who were thought to be of Japanese
nationality.

C.I. McFarlane, D.S.I. McPhee and D.P.S. Fleming
together with a large party of uniform police immediately
attended the scene. Upon the arrival, the French volunte-
ers were already engaged in dispersing the crowd. A
baton charge was ordered and the roads cleared for a
distance of 100 yards in all directions - on Avenue
Edward VII and Fokien Road. Two males were found,
injured, lying on the roadway, after the crowd had been
dispersed. Enquiries by C.D.S.374, C.D.C.42 and D.P.S.
Fleming ascertained the following information:-

The names and particulars concerning the two injured
persons were (1) Wong Tuk Kyi (王德騎), 24, Fokien,
s/school teacher, Doong An (東安) School, Lokwai Road,
T.C. and (2) Sung Peh Ung (鄧伯宏), 20, Fokien, s/school
teacher, Hee Sa (喜士) School, 58 Tsung Foo, Chapoi.
It appears that at about 11.30.a.m. 17-8-37, the two
above described persons were standing on Avenue Edward
when aeroplanes were sighted overhead - they therefore
decided to seek shelter in a neighbouring shop. However,
admittance to the shop was refused by the shop assistants
pages.zh:
杂项卷宗第562/37号。
6/第3页。

1937年8月17日上午11时41分，接到中央巡捕房第352号从爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）与福建路转角处打来的电话报告，称一群华人正在骚乱，并袭击两名被认为具有日本国籍的男子。

华籍督察麦克法兰（McFarlane）、副巡官麦克菲（McPhee）及代理副巡官弗莱明（Fleming）率领一大队制服警察立即赶赴现场。抵达时，法国志愿队已在驱散人群。当局下令持警棍冲锋，将爱多亚路和福建路四周100码范围内的道路清空。人群被驱散后，发现两名受伤男子躺在路面上。经警探第374号、警探第42号及代理副巡官弗莱明调查，查明以下情况：

两名伤者的姓名及详情为：(1) 王德騎，24岁，福建人，职业为学校教师，任职于通州路乐惠路东安学校；(2) 鄧伯宏，20岁，福建人，职业为学校教师，任职于闸北宗福路58号喜士学校。
据悉，1937年8月17日上午11时30分左右，上述两人正站在爱多亚路上，此时发现头顶有飞机飞过，因此决定到附近一家商店避难。然而，店员拒绝让他们进入

pages.en:
Misc. No. 562/37.
1/Sheet 4.

whereupon the two school teachers passed some remark
which was intended to assimilate the shop-assistants with
the Japanese. This being remarked, the shop-assistants
retaliated by calling out "You are Japanese." At once
a crowd of loafers and passer's-by took up the cry and
commenced to beat the two school-teachers with sticks and
pieces of brick and concrete lying at the roadside.

Upon arrival of police, an ambulance was summoned and
the injured persons removed to the Lester Chinese Hospi-
tal where the following Doctor's certificates were issued
in respect of the 1st described:-

"Laceration of forehead and concussion - not serious
will require a few days treatment in Hospital - detained".
in respect of the 2nd described:-

"Laceration of forehead - not serious, will require
about 10 days' treatment in the O.P.Dept."

Further enquiries failed to glean any further
information or the identity of the shop-assistants
responsible for the commencement of the disturbance.
pages.zh:
杂项卷宗第562/37号。
1/第4页。

于是这两名教师说了一些话，意在将店员与日本人相提并论。此言一出，店员反击喊道：“你们是日本人。”立刻，一群闲汉和路人随声附和，开始用路边散落的木棍、砖块和混凝土块殴打这两名教师。

警察到达后，叫来救护车，将伤者送往莱斯华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital），针对第一名伤者出具了如下医生证明书：

“前额撕裂伤及脑震荡——不严重，需住院数日治疗——留院”。
针对第二名伤者：

“前额撕裂伤——不严重，需在门诊部治疗约10天。”

进一步调查未能搜集到更多关于引发骚乱的店员身份的信息。

LOUZA STATION
Rep. No. 562/37.
14-8-37.

"AN
Louza
August 17th., 37.

Misc.No.562/37.
7.

INCIDENTS AND PERSONS ADMITTED TO HOSPITAL IN
LOUZA DISTRICT RE SINO-JAPANESE HOSTILITIES.

At 5.20.p.m. on 17-8-37 P.P.C.86 reported at Louza
Station by telephone that S.F.B. Ambulance had removed
2 male Chinese to Lester Chinese Hospital from Pekien Rd.
near Foochow Road corner. 1st:- Yeong S Dail (杨苏来),
suffering from shell wound. Injury not serious. About
5 days O.P.D. treatment required. As this person had
already been discharged from hospital on arrival of
detectives, further enquiries could not be made. 2nd:-
Tsu Yui Kyung (朱月情), 24, Wusih, S/unemployed, 62
Hoopeh Road. This man was drinking tea from an urn
supplied for ricksha coolies on Pekien Road near Foochow
Road and when doing so, rowdy elements began to accuse
him of being employed by Japanese to put poison in tea
urns. There is no evidence to substantiate this. The
man was beaten by the crowd which decamped on arrival of
Police. He is detained in Hospital, certificate reading
"Scratching wound of face. Not serious, about 5 days' O.PD
treatment required."

At 5.15.p.m. on 17-8-37, C.P.C.808 reported at Louza
station by telephone that fighting was in progress at
Yu Ya Ching and Peking Roads corner. A party of police
under Inspector R.J. White attended, dispersing a mob
and finding that a female Chinese, Wang Yen Ting (王英婷)
pages.zh:
老闸捕房
报告编号 562/37。
1937年8月14日。

“AN”
老闸
1937年8月17日。

杂项卷宗第562/37号。
7.

老闸区因中日敌对行动而入院的事故及人员情况。

1937年8月17日下午5时20分，第86号分区巡捕房通过电话向老闸捕房报告，圣约翰救护队（S.F.B. Ambulance）已将两名华籍男子从福州路转角附近的北京路送往莱斯华人医院。第一名：杨苏来，受炮弹伤。伤势不严重。需门诊治疗约5天。由于侦探到达时此人已出院，故无法进行进一步调查。第二名：朱月情，24岁，无锡人，职业无业，居住于湖北路62号。该男子正在北京路近福州路处饮用提供给黄包车夫的茶水桶里的茶水，此时一些流氓分子开始指责他受雇于日本人，在茶水桶里投毒。并无证据证实此事。该男子遭到人群殴打，警察到达后人群逃散。他目前留院治疗，医生证明书称：“面部抓伤。不严重，需门诊治疗约5天。”

1937年8月17日下午5时15分，第808号分区巡捕房通过电话向老闸捕房报告，虞洽卿路与北京路转角处正在发生斗殴。由R.J.怀特督察率领的一队警察前往，驱散了暴民，并发现一名华籍女子，王英婷

pages.en:
Misc.No.662/37.
7/Sheet 2.

age 38, Anhwei, M/female, 13 Sing Tsang Li (新昌里) Rue
du Weikwei had been injured. This female had been
standing at the mentioned place watching aerial activities
of the combatants and was suddenly accused by bystanders
of being a "traitor". She was then set upon. She was
detained in the St. Elizabeths Hospital, certificate
reading "Bruise of both eyes,"

At 7.05.p.m. on 17-8-37 C.P.U.1087 telephoned Louza
Station reporting fighting on Hoopah and Canton Roads
corner. A party of Police attended and dispersed a mob
of Chinese, one Tsang Sai Ziang (张赛祥), M. Tsungking
M/coolie, 9 An Kong Li (安公里), off Tientsin Road
being escorted to Lester Chinese Hospital where he was
treated and then discharged, certificate reading "Lacera-
tion of eye-lid and contusion of cheek, not serious.
About 5 days' O.P.D. treatment required." He stated
that he is sick and purchased a quantity of Chinese
medicine on 16-8-37 to treat himself. He was passing
on Kiukiang Road near Hoopah Road at mentioned time and
date when a cry went up that he was a traitor and was
going to poison Chinese by putting substances in teacups.
He denies this and states he lost his medicine in the
crush where he was attacked. He was allowed to go.

D.D.O. "A" Div.    Sen. Date 1/9.        R.D. Neanly.
                                        D.S. 888
pages.zh:
杂项卷宗第662/37号。
7/第2页。

38岁，安徽人，已婚女性，居住于魏格理路（Rue du Weikwei）新昌里13号，受伤。该女子当时正站在上述地点观看交战方的空中活动，突然被旁观者指控为“汉奸”。随后她遭到围攻。她被送往圣伊丽莎白医院（St. Elizabeths Hospital）留院，医生证明书称：“双眼挫伤，”

1937年8月17日晚上7时05分，第1087号分区巡捕房致电老闸捕房，报告霍帕路（Hoopah Road，音译）与广东路转角处发生斗殴。一队警察前往并驱散了一群华人，其中一名张赛祥，男，重庆人，职业苦力，居住于天津路旁安公里9号，被护送至莱斯华人医院接受治疗，随后获释，医生证明书称：“眼睑撕裂及脸颊挫伤，不严重。需门诊治疗约5天。”他声称自己生病，并于1937年8月16日购买了一些中药自行治疗。在上述时间和日期，他正经过九江路近霍帕路处，此时有人高喊他是汉奸，正要通过在茶杯中投放物质来毒害中国人。他否认此事，并称他在遭受袭击的混乱中丢失了药物。他被允许离开。

“A”区副总监    高级侦探 1/9.        R.D. Neanly.
                                        副巡官 888

"A"
Misc.No. 562/37. Louza
Aug. 17th, 37.
8

Incidents in Louza District due to Hostilities.

At 9.30 a.m. on 17-8-37 at request of the Zung
Chi Dong Guild, a male Chinese named Nyi Lau Doong(嚴老棟)
34, Tsungming, residing French Concession, was removed
to Louza Station ( and later released). It was learned
that he had been arrested by B'well Station for infringe-
ment of the Curfew Order and on release had got a lift
on a truck as far as the Guild. It is said that a
crowd gathered on the truck chauffeur spreading a
rumour of "traitor" and as the crowd adopted a threaten-
ing attitude, he sought shelter in the mentioned Guild
from where he was rescued by Police. No injuries, no
arrests.

At 10.20 a.m. 17-8-37 D.S. Heanly and C.D.C.237,
at request of Supt. Patersen, removed a Korean drug
addict from the Lester Chinese Hospital to temporary
Poo Ming Hospital, 24 Bund, the Supt. of the Lester
Chinese Hospital stating the Korean came to the Hospital
of his own accord at p.m. on 16-8-37 and requested an
injection of morphine. He was detained in the Hospital
until above time when his removal was effected, it being
feared that his presence would precipitate an incident.

At 2.20p.m. 17-8-37 a female Chinese, Tsang
Tseong "m"(張鐘氏), 24, Shantung, residing in Nantao,
was taken to Lester Chinese Hospital and treated for

“A”
杂项卷宗第562/37号。老闸
1937年8月17日。
8

老闸区因敌对行动引发的事故。

1937年8月17日上午9时30分，应崇智堂公会请求，一名名为嚴老棟的华籍男子，34岁，崇明人，居住于法租界，被带往老闸捕房（随后获释）。据悉，他此前因违反宵禁令被贝威尔捕房（B'well Station，音译）逮捕，获释后搭便车乘坐卡车到达该公会。据说，人群聚集在卡车司机周围，散布“汉奸”谣言，鉴于人群态度具有威胁性，他躲进上述公会寻求庇护，随后被警察救出。无人受伤，无人被捕。

1937年8月17日上午10时20分，应帕特森（Patersen）巡官请求，副巡官希利（Heanly）及警探第237号将一名韩国吸毒者从莱斯华人医院转移至外滩24号的临时普明医院（Poo Ming Hospital，音译），莱斯华人医院院长表示，该韩国人于1937年8月16日下午自愿来到医院，并要求注射吗啡。他一直留在医院直至上述时间被转移，因为担心他的存在会引发事端。

1937年8月17日下午2时20分，一名华籍女子，張鐘氏，24岁，山东人，居住于南市，被送往莱斯华人医院接受治疗，诊断为

pages.en:
Misc. 862/37.
2/Sheet No. 2.

"Abrasion of forehead and face. Hysteria. Not serious".
This female was changing money and was mobbed by loafers
after being accused of being a "traitor". on Foochow and
Hoopeh Roads Corner.

A. D. Healy.
D.S.84.

Sen.Det.1/8.

D.D.O."A".

2/第2页。

“前额及面部擦伤。癔症。不严重”。
该女子当时正在兑换钱币，在福州路与湖北路转角处被指控为“汉奸”后遭到一群闲汉围攻。

A. D. Healy.

Pootoo Road Station
REPORT
Date 19.8.37.

Subject (in full) State of Pootoo Road Police District.

Made by D.S.I. Burton. Forwarded by [Signature] 2/1 for Inspt. i/c.

Sir,
During the 24 hours ending 7 a.m. 19.8.37, there was
one incident of mob violence.
At 7.40 a.m. on the 18.8.37, one Yue Ching Woo ( ),
age 39, M/Food Contractor, employed by the Japanese staff at
the Dong Shing Cotton Mill, No. 1433 Gordon Road (where he
resides) was accused of being a traitor, and attacked by a mob
of unknown male Chinese on Robison near Seymour Road who
inflicted serious injuries on his head and body, he was conveyed
to the Red Cross Hospital, St. John's University, by S.F.B.
Ambulance where he is detained. See F.I.R. 416/37.
Necessary precautions are still being maintained to
protect life and property.
District Otherwise quiet.

[Signature]
D.S.I.

D.D.O. "J" Division.

1937年8月18日上午7时40分，岳庆伍（Yue Ching Woo，括号内原文空白），39岁，男，食品承包商，受雇于戈登路1433号东盛棉纺厂的日方职员（他居住于此），被指控为汉奸，并在罗宾逊路（Robison）近西摩路处遭到一群身份不明的华籍男子袭击，头部和身体受重伤，由圣约翰救护队救护车送往圣约翰大学红十字会医院，目前留院治疗。见首次调查报告第416/37号。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc.No. 117/37.
REPORT

File No........... 8039 H
No. S. I Gordon Road Station, 8 37
Date..August 18, 19 37.

Subject....................Situation in Gordon Road District.

Made by.........D.S.I. Coyne..........Forwarded by.........[Signature]

Sir,
    At 11.15a.m. August 18, 1937, a telephone message was
received from C.P.C. 1028 to the effect that looting was taking
place on Penang Road near Tonquin Road.
    A party of Police under the undersigned attended and
found that a ton of coal contained in baskets had been stolen
by a crowd of looters from a truck onto which it was being loaded.
    A.H.Pelookoff, of the Kaminsky Coal Corp. 75 Route Pere
Robert, stated that he was with Mr. Kaminsky, a Chinese driver
named Wu Dih Teen(伍立德) and a clerk named Chai Su Ching
(曾思俊) taking delivery of the coal when some loafers
gathered and alleged that it was to be delivered to the Japanese
forces.
    The crowd then attacked them and looted the coal,whilst
four C.P.C.s were unable to stop them.

August 20, 37.
Alleged poisoning of Street Tea Urns by traitorous Chinese.

D.S.I. Rhind.

Sir,

On the morning of 19/8/37, the undersigned was delegated to make enquiries with a view to ascertaining the motives underlying the various cases of lynching and attempted lynching which have occurred in the Settlement since the outbreak of hostilities. In this connection, he has conferred with the investigating detectives in charge of these cases, as well as with their Senior Detectives, and also read their diaries on the subject and learns that they are all of the opinion that the victims, contrary to the allegations of the mobs which set upon them, were definitely innocent persons possessing no traitorous designs. In most cases the inference was that the victims had polluted or attempted to pollute the Street Tea Urns by dropping poisonous substances therein. In only one case, however was the victim found in possession of a substance of such a nature as to justify suspicion. This person, a destitute youth of 15 - was rescued from an angry mob by Police attached to Louza Station on the night of 16/8/37. In his possession were found two phials of a medicine labelled "Salse Brecanon", and bearing an inscription tending to indicate that the substance was of Japanese origin. It was learned by Louza Detectives who have held the youth in their custody for several days under a Writ of Detention, that he is a refugee from Chapei and that he and his brother, being both destitute, decided to go in search of odd pieces of wood to sell as fire-wood and thus raise a few coppers with which to buy food. They apparently collected the wood from garbage boxes in the Louza district and in the process of rummaging through one of these boxes they found the two phials. They made the wood which they

关于叛国华人向街头茶桶投毒的指控。

高级督察林德（Rhind）。

先生，

1937年8月19日上午，署人受命进行调查，旨在查明自敌对行动爆发以来，租界内发生的各类私刑及企图施加私刑案件背后的动机。就此，署人与负责这些案件的调查侦探及其高级侦探进行了会谈，并阅读了相关日记，获悉他们均认为，受害者绝非如攻击他们的暴民所指控的那样，而是确凿无辜之人，并无任何叛国图谋。在大多数案件中，推断受害者曾向街头茶桶投放有毒物质，从而污染或企图污染茶水。然而，仅在一例案件中，发现受害者持有足以引起怀疑性质的物质。此人是一名15岁的贫困青年，于1937年8月16日晚被老闸捕房的警察从愤怒的暴民手中救出。在他身上发现了两瓶标有“Salse Brecanon”字样的药物，标签上的说明倾向于表明该物质源自日本。据老闸捕房侦探了解，该青年已被拘留数日，他是来自闸北的难民，因与其兄弟均陷入贫困，决定寻找零碎木柴当作薪火出售，以换取几枚铜板购买食物。他们显然是在老闸区的垃圾箱中收集木柴，在翻找其中一个箱子时发现了这两瓶药。他们将收集到的木柴捆扎起来，并将药瓶放在其中。

had collected into a bundle and placed the phials inside it.
While carrying the bundle along Yu Ya Ching Road, the two
phials fell out and dropped on the footpath. Bystanders on
seeing the phials became suspicious and attracted an unruly mob
by shouting out that suspect was a traitor and was distributing
poison.

Louza detectives questioned the suspect at considerable
length and have come to the conclusion that he does not possess
any disloyal designs and that the circumstances in which he
found the medicine are no doubt true. At any rate the contents
of the two phials on being analysed by the S.M.C. Pathologist
was found to contain medicinal properties which although
such
poisonous in themselves are in small proportions as to be
harmless. A British chemist was also consulted and he affirmed
that the contents of the two phials were incapable of effectively
poisoning even one tea urn.

As regards the other case, the following salient points
should be noted:-

(1) No substances of any kind have been found on the
persons of the victims.

(2) Most of the surviving victims, as the undersigned
and D.I. Lieu Zeh Kwei will testify, are bona fide persons
whose patriotism is above doubt.

(3) That one victim was accused of being a spy simply
because he is unable to speak the Shanghai dialect, being a
native of Fukien from which he is a recent arrival.

当他们沿虞洽卿路（Yu Ya Ching Road）携带这捆木柴时，两瓶药掉落并在人行道上摔落。旁观者看到药瓶后产生怀疑，高呼嫌疑人是汉奸并在分发毒药，从而引来一群乌合之众。

老闸捕房侦探对嫌疑人进行了详尽讯问，并得出结论认为他没有任何不忠图谋，且他发现药物的情况属实无疑。无论如何，经工部局病理学家分析，两瓶药的内容物虽本身具有毒性，但因含量极微，故无害。此外还咨询了一位英国化学家，他证实两瓶药的内容物甚至不足以有效毒害一个茶桶。

至于其他案件，应注意以下要点：-

(1) 在受害者身上未发现任何种类的物质。

(2) 正如署人和探长刘泽桂（Lieu Zeh Kwei，音译）所证明，大多数幸存的受害者均为真诚之人，其爱国之心毋庸置疑。

(3) 有一名受害者仅因不会说上海话而被指控为间谍，他是福建人，近期才抵达此地。

pages.en:
- 3 -

(4) No cases of poisoning have come to light in the
districts concerned or to the notice of the Lester Chinese
Hospital.

Conclusion.

(I) That these attacks are inspired for the most part
by ultra-patriotic persons. Loafer elements may be responsible
in some cases but so far there is no evidence of these attacks
being inspired by an organised group of persons.

(2) That up to the present time there is absolutely
no ground for the belief that Japanese elements are endeavouring
to administer poison to the Chinese population of the Settlement
either directly or through the instrumentality of traitorous
Chinese in their pay.

Subject to approval, the undersigned will arrange for
the publication of an article in the Chinese Press advising
members of the Public to refrain from doing bodily harm to
suspected spies, but to take them to the nearest Police
Station where they will.be appropriately dealt with.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,

D. S. I.

D. C. (Crime Branch)
pages.zh:
- 3 -

(4) 在相关区域或莱斯忒华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital）并未发现任何中毒病例。

结论。

(I) 这些袭击大多是由极端爱国分子煽动所致。在某些案件中，流氓无赖分子可能负有责任，但截至目前，尚无证据表明这些袭击是由有组织的人群煽动。

(2) 截至目前，绝对没有理由相信日本势力正试图直接或通过其收买的叛国华人作为工具，向租界内的中国居民投毒。

如获批准，署人将安排在中文报刊上发表文章，劝告公众不要对疑似间谍施加身体伤害，而应将其送至最近的捕房，以便得到适当处理。

此致，
敬礼，

高级督察。

刑事分部主任

Date August 17, 1937.
Subject Arrest of a suspected spy, Tong Jih, aged 26, a native
of Shaoshing.
Made by D. S. Pitts Forwarded by D.B.Rno C.D.

At 8.30 a.m. August 17, a telephone message was
received at Central Station from C.P.C. 1202 stating that a
Chinese mob was fighting at the corner of Nanking Road and the
Bund. C.D.C. 101 and C.D.S. 221 (Central) attended and
discovered that a male Chinese had been attacked by a Chinese
crowd, which, however, had dispersed upon their arrival.
Beyond the fact that the Chinese crowd had been heard calling
the injured man "a traitor", there was nothing to suggest
that he had done anything wrong. The Chinese male, who was
suffering from contusions to the face, scalp, chin, arms and
chest, was escorted to the Lester Chinese Hospital, where his
wounds were dressed. At 10 a.m. he was taken to Central
Station, where enquiries by D.S. Francis showed that he was one
Tong Jih (湯吉), aged 26 a native of Shaoshing.
After being searched this individual was found
to be in possession of a photo, badges, shoulder straps, etc.,
which clearly indicated that at one time he had been a machine
gunner in the 1st Company, 1st Battalion, 212th Regiment, 106
Brigade of the 36th Division of the Chinese Nationalist Army.
Suspected of being a spy in the pay of the Japanese,
he was brought to Headquarters by D.S. Francis and C.D.S. 287
(Central) for further questioning, and as a result of intense
interrogation, it became obvious that the man was mentally
deranged, but it was learned that he had for some time been
employed as a cook in the Tsung Yuan (春元) Native Bank,
Tai Chi Loong, Tientsin Road.
Enquiries made at this bank showed that a person
whose description tallied with that of the prisoner's, was
missing from the premises. One Chow Kuo-pao (周國寶), an

日期 1937年8月17日。
主题 逮捕一名嫌疑间谍，汤吉（Tong Jih），26岁，绍兴人。
由侦探警佐 Pitts 撰写 转呈 刑事侦缉处副主任

1937年8月17日上午8时30分，中央捕房接到中国巡捕 1202 的电话消息，称一群华人在南京路与外滩转角处斗殴。刑事侦缉处主任 C.D.C. 101 及刑事侦缉处副主任 C.D.S. 221（中央）到场，发现一名华籍男子遭到华人人群袭击，但该人群在警察到达时已散去。除了听到华人人群称受伤男子为“汉奸”外，没有任何迹象表明他做错了什么。该华籍男子面部、头皮、下巴、手臂和胸部均有挫伤，被护送至莱斯华医院包扎伤口。上午10时，他被带到中央捕房，经 Francis 警佐查询，查明其人为汤吉（Tong Jih），26岁，绍兴人。
经搜身，发现此人持有一张照片、徽章、肩章等物品，清楚地表明他曾是中国国民党陆军第36师第106旅第212团第1营第1连的机枪手。
因涉嫌为日本效力的间谍，Francis 警佐及刑事侦缉处副主任 C.D.S. 287（中央）将其带至总局进一步审问，经过严厉审讯，明显看出该人精神失常，但获悉他曾在天津路太极隆春元（Tsung Yuan）钱庄担任厨师一段时间。
在该钱庄进行的查询显示，一名体貌特征与囚犯相符的人员从该处失踪。一名周国宝（Chow Kuo-pao），

August 17, 37.

Arrest of a suspected spy.

At 8.30 a.m. August 17, a telephone message was
received at Central Station from C.P.C. 1202 stating that a Chin
Chinese mob was fighting at the corner of Nanking Road and the
Bund. C.D.C. 101 and C.D.C. 221 (Central) attended and
discovered that a male Chinese had been attacked by a Chinese
crowd, which, however, had dispersed upon their arrival.
Beyond the fact that the Chinese crowd had been heard calling
the injured man "a traitor", there was nothing to suggest
that he had done anything wrong. The Chinese male, who was
suffering from contusions to the face, scalp, chin, arms and
chest, was escorted to the Lester Chinese Hospital, where his
wounds were dressed. At 10 a.m. he was taken to Central
Station, where enquiries by D.S. Francis showed that he was one
Teng Jih (汤杰), aged 26, a native of Cheehing.
After being searched this individual was found
to be in possession of a photo, badges, shoulder straps, etc.,
which clearly indicated that at one time he had been a machine
gunner in the 1st Company, 1st Battalion, 218th Regiment, 106
Brigade of the 36th Division of the Chinese Nationalist Army.
Suspected of being a spy in the pay of the Japanese,
he was brought to Headquarters by D.S. Francis and C.D.C. 257
(Central) for further questioning, and as a result of intense
interrogation, it became obvious that the man was mentally
deranged, but it was learned that he had for some time been
employed as a cook in the Tsung Yuan (泰元) Native Bank,
Tai Chi Loong, Tientsin Road.
Enquiries made at this bank showed that a person
whose description tallied with that of the prisoner, was
missing from the premises. One Chow Kuo-pao (周国宝), an
